jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Compute AI Infra
jobs.desc:
About the team
We are the product management team for the Compute service of the volcano engine, which is the cloud service provided by ByteDance. It includes all the different types of compute instances and the supporting services built around it, such as Autoscaling, Server Migration and Systems Manager. Both the business and the team are growing rapidly as we are building the next generation AI infrastructure and innovate on behalf of our customers. We are a team with diverse backgrounds and we strive to provide everyone in the team with great opportunities to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:
We are currently hiring product managers to build our next generation compute services to power large-scale AI infrastructure. The candidate will need to:
- Work closely with internal and external customers as well as sales and solution architects to collect customer needs and feedback.
- Work with the R&D team to clarify and prioritize product needs and design product features accordingly.
- Define product go to market strategy, including positioning, pricing, promotion as well as lifecycle management.
- Define product goals and core business metrics, and continuously track these metrics to improve our products.
- Manage and maintain product roadmaps and be able to articulate the value of each feature to customers.
- Perform competitive analysis, track industry technology trends to feed into the product planning.

Minimum Qualification:
- Technical background with more than 3 years of experience as a ToB product manager
- Deep understanding of the cloud industry
- Some level of understanding of virtualization, networking, storage, server hardware, containers, etc.
- Be able to prioritize and maximize the product value for our customers
- Be curious about new technologies and new industry trends in areas such as cloud infrastructure, deep learning, big data, and security

Preferred Qualification:
- Previous experiences with large CSPs(Cloud Service Providers) are preferred
- Excellent communication skills and be able to work closely with various stakeholders to achieve product goals
- Strong analytical skills and strong execution

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Data and Safety
jobs.desc:
About the team
The AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed foundational models across modalities and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. We work across the data lifecycle, from defining evaluation approaches and translating user feedback and benchmark outcomes into data requests, to building scalable processes that improve data quality and support rapid model iteration.

Our team combines technical and operational capabilities, bringing together multidisciplinary talent across product management, data engineering, and data operations. Our work is driven by people who think deeply about model behavior, move quickly to solve complex problems, and bring first-hand experience as both builders and users of models and agents.

In close partnership with Seed researchers, industry experts, and leading data vendors, we tackle challenging data problems at the frontier of AI development, helping improve both model performance and user experience.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with technical teams to precisely define the data requirements necessary for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) across global markets.
- Develop methodologies for data acquisition and production, while also monitoring costs and assessing the effectiveness and efficiency of these processes. Ensure data quality is maintained at high standards and continually enhance processes based on both quantitative and qualitative feedback.
- Evaluate the impact of data production tools on the effectiveness and quality of data production. Work closely with technical teams to enhance both the quality and effectiveness of these tools.
- Proactively identify and mitigate potential biases and vulnerabilities in the data production process. This includes, but is not limited to, addressing human and system biases through the implementation of technical, product, and operational solutions.

Minimum Qualifications
- Solid understanding of alignment and related approaches, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and others. Or solid experience in moderation, labeling, search quality, or data synthesis.
- Minimum of two years of experience as a product manager or product strategist, including process design experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- A strong interest in both LLMs and human behavior/experience/wellbeing.
- Collaborative team player who knows how to assertively advocate for their ideas without being overbearing.
- Skilled in maintaining attention to detail while staying focused on prioritized goals and the bigger picture.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager Professional, Servers
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Job Description

The Server Product Manager owns the definition, delivery, and lifecycle performance of complex server products or product line elements. The role is accountable for making high‑quality product decisions, ensuring strong cross-functional execution, and maintaining product competitiveness throughout the lifecycle.

This role operates as the primary integrator across engineering, operations, sales, and marketing, translating requirements into clear direction, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution with consistency and predictability. The Product Manager applies deep domain expertise to improve decision outcomes, product quality, and business performance within their scope. You will be expected to own one or more server products as well as supporting sustaining activities on existing products.

Key Responsibilities

Product Definition and Decision Ownership

• Define product requirements, configurations, and positioning within assigned scope

• Develop clear, well-founded recommendations with explicit trade-offs across cost, performance, and timing

• Drive alignment on product decisions across stakeholders and ensure consistent understanding and execution

• Anticipate dependencies and downstream impacts to minimise rework and late-stage changes

Lifecycle Management and Execution

• Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, in-market management, and transition

• Ensure product readiness across all dimensions, including supply, quality, pricing, and sales enablement

• Maintain predictable execution cadence, proactively addressing risks and resolving issues

• Support lifecycle transitions, replacements, and substitutions while ensuring continuity for customers and sales

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Lead coordination across engineering, supply chain, operations, sales, and marketing teams

• Align priorities, timelines, and deliverables across multiple stakeholders and regions

• Resolve conflicts and remove execution barriers to maintain progress and delivery quality

• Establish clear accountability and ownership across all aspects of product execution

Product Competitiveness and Performance

• Ensure products meet competitive benchmarks across performance, cost, feature set, and customer value

• Monitor product performance in market and drive improvements where required

• Support pricing, positioning, and configuration decisions in collaboration with commercial teams

• Identify opportunities to improve product offering or address competitive gaps

Data, Tools, and Operational Discipline

• Maintain accuracy and consistency of product data, configuration tools, and supporting collateral

• Ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, up-to-date information for decision-making and execution

• Establish and uphold standards that improve data quality and reduce operational errors

• Resolve inconsistencies across teams, regions, or systems to maintain a single source of truth

Customer and Market Engagement

• Develop strong understanding of customer requirements and usage scenarios across target segments

• Incorporate customer and partner feedback into product definition and ongoing improvements

• Engage with key stakeholders to validate product direction and support business development activities

Expertise and Continuous Improvement

• Act as a recognized subject-matter expert within assigned product scope

• Track relevant industry trends, technology developments, and partner roadmaps

• Apply expertise to improve product decisions, resolve complex issues, and guide stakeholders

• Share knowledge and contribute to the development of team capability and best practices

Technical & AI Fluency

• Comfortable working closely with engineering and technical teams without needing to specialize in implementation

• Curious and open to continuous learning across technologies, tools, and evolving product domains

• Interest in leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve effectiveness, insight

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Platforms and Hybrid Cloud
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Role Overview

Lenovo is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Product Manager to shape the roadmap and drive delivery for our enterprise Hybrid Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will define the core capabilities that connect on-premises data centers with public clouds, giving enterprise customers a unified, reliable environment to run and manage their applications. You will focus on what to build and why—defining platform features across compute, storage, networking, and access control that make it easy for engineering teams and enterprise users to deploy workloads wherever they make the most sense.

You will treat both internal offering teams and external enterprise clients as your platform customers. Your mission is to listen to their needs, translate their technical challenges into clear product requirements, and partner with engineering squads who bring the technical architecture to life.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hybrid Cloud Strategy & Core Capabilities

• Define the product vision, roadmap, and release milestones for our hybrid cloud platform across private infrastructure and major public cloud providers.

• Specify core platform features across compute, storage, networking, and user authentication so teams can deploy and run applications seamlessly.

• Lead 0-to-1 MVP scoping for new platform releases, balancing customer-requested features against realistic delivery timelines.

2. Workload Management & Scaling

• Define requirements for workload placement, allowing customers to easily balance applications between their private environments and public cloud capacity.

• Ensure the platform provides reliable multi-tenant isolation, security policies, and health monitoring so customers trust it for production workloads.

3. Developer Experience & Customer Enablement

• Run regular discovery sessions with platform users (both internal teams and external customers) to understand integration friction and day-to-day pain points.

• Specify self-service platform tools, clear APIs, and developer documentation that make onboarding smooth and self-guided.

• Author clear Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and user stories that outline business value and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.

4. Cloud Economics & Usage Tracking

• Define capabilities that give customers visibility into their resource usage and spending across hybrid environments.

• Specify quota controls, budget alerts, and reporting dashboards so organizations can monitor their cloud investments with confidence.

5. AI & Modern Workload Readiness

• Ensure the platform is ready to support modern workloads, including allocating GPU resources and supporting modern AI tools and data services as customer demand grows.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ Years of Product Management Experience: Must have a proven track record of owning and shipping software products from concept through launch in a dedicated Product Manager capacity.

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

• Demonstrated Cloud Offering Ownership: Prior hands-on experience operating as a Product Manager for a commercial or enterprise cloud offering/product (public, private, or hybrid cloud environments).

• Cloud & Infrastructure Fundamentals: Solid understanding of core cloud infrastructure components (compute, storage, and networking) and how private enterprise environments connect with public cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Core Inbound PM Craft: Demonstrated experience gathering customer requirements, writing detailed PRDs, defining API interfaces, and prioritizing roadmaps using structured decision-making frameworks.

• Customer Empathy & Discovery: Strong background in customer discovery—uncovering underlying user needs and translating them into practical software capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Advanced Storage Platforms
jobs.loc: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States of America
jobs.desc:
Overview

The Senior Product Manager, Advanced Platforms owns product execution for Lenovo’s SDS, HPC storage, and emerging platforms. The role leads platform transitions, qualifications, governance, and lifecycle management, converting broader portfolio direction into scalable business outcomes.

Working across partners, engineering, solutions, sales, and support, this PM establishes repeatable operating models and ensures advanced platforms are competitive, supportable, and ready for adoption and growth.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio and Lifecycle Ownership

• Own roadmap, requirements, software cadence, launch, adoption, and growth for SDS, HPC storage, and emerging platforms.

• Lead platform transitions and develop business cases for new technologies.

• Translate portfolio strategy into executable plans with clear priorities and outcomes.

Qualification, Governance & Certification

• Lead platform qualification and certification programs.

• Establish repeatable governance for partner-based solutions and emerging technologies.

• Coordinate readiness across engineering, services, sales, support, and lifecycle teams.

Partner & Ecosystem Management

• Serve as the product interface for selected OEM and technology partners.

• Influence partner roadmaps through customer requirements, market insight, and business priorities.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and drive cross-functional execution.

• Track AI infrastructure, HPC, SDS, and data-platform trends to identify requirements, opportunities, and competitive risks.

Basic Qualifications:

• 8+ years of product management or related infrastructure technology experience.

• Experience with enterprise storage, infrastructure software, datacenter technologies, or adjacent markets.

• Experience operating in a partner-based business model, including joint roadmap planning, requirements alignment, commercial coordination, and cross-company execution.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Ability to translate customer, market, and partner needs into clear product requirements, priorities, and business outcomes.

• Strong communication, business judgment, and stakeholder-influence skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with HPC architectures, including parallel file systems, high-performance networking, data movement, and performance optimization for compute-intensive workloads.

• Understanding of AI infrastructure architectures, including GPU-based systems, training and inference data pipelines, storage performance requirements, and integration with the broader AI ecosystem.

• Experience with SDS, HCI, enterprise SAN or NAS, object storage, storage networking, infrastructure management, or automation.

• Experience working with major storage, server, silicon, cloud, or software partners to develop and bring joint solutions to market.

## About There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

## Role

- Define product roadmaps, requirements and success metrics for assigned product areas

- Identify user needs and translate them into product features, workflows and specifications

- Evaluate technical approaches with engineering, balancing performance, reliability, usability and development effort

- Lead product development from planning and design through testing, launch and improvement

- Analyse user behaviour, product performance and experiments to improve adoption, engagement and retention

- Assess market opportunities, competing products and user feedback to guide product priorities

- 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping technology products

- Strong system design knowledge and the ability to evaluate architecture, data models, integrations, reliability and performance trade-offs

- Ability to challenge technical proposals, identify architectural risks and work with engineering to resolve complex product and system constraints

- Experience owning complex products or workflows end-to-end, from problem definition and technical scoping through launch and production iteration

- Ability to balance quality, latency, reliability, development cost and time-to-market when making product decisions

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

USA - Remote

##### Who We Are

Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.

Our Collaborative Care program effectively targets and treats most behavioral health conditions, while embracing behavioral health as central to the patient's care journey and overall health. With its clinical excellence and operational efficiency, Concert Health is the preferred partner for health systems and medical groups seeking to deliver integrated behavioral health care that is both scalable and sustainable.

##### About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to drive the execution of our vision: a unified technology experience for our clinicians and patients that brings together EHR/EMR implementations, our care management platform, patient engagement tools, and healthcare data analytics. You'll join a small, dynamic product and technology team, shaping and delivering against an ambitious roadmap. As a technical product manager, you'll have the opportunity to bring together your product manager and product owner skills - partnering with clinical stakeholders to understand requirements, prioritizing the roadmap, mocking up features, writing user stories and documentation, iterating with great software engineers, collaborating with user support teams, and working with analytics - to deliver high impact features. This is not a typical project or program manager role, but a product-focused leader who translates product led growth strategy into scalable solutions and measurable impact.

On our team, you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to simplify the complexity of payroll for thousands of employers of every size, across all industries. We ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and values each builder brings to our mission: _**make paying people simple** ._ Check out our origin story! Lead partnerships with external providers - banks, processors, data vendors - when relevant to your domain.

# Senior Technical Product Manager

$175k

Going

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/923840889614507917?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2029652730419011255&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

At Going, data is our core product driver and a product in its own right. Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) is the team that runs it like an internal platform business: your product is the unified stream of flight data; your customers are our internal product and feature teams, and your ultimate end-users are millions of subscribers who rely on us for timely, hyper-relevant flight deals.

We're hiring a systems-thinking Senior Technical Product Manager to lead a cross-functional team of senior Data and Backend Engineers. You'll own the charter and roadmap for how Going acquires, pipelines, and engineers high-quality datasets that power Going's core products. This requires building the resilience and diversification that reduces our dependence on any single data source, and turning that data into a product every downstream team can build on without re-solving it themselves. You'll report to the VP of Product.

##### In The Short Term, You Will

- Take ownership of the product data acquisition strategy and data processing roadmap; supporting the parallel build of a new system to replace the current

- Establish baseline measurement across our data funnel — coverage, pipeline health, and data quality — so future architecture and business decisions are based on value and cost

- Drive architecture that enables efficiency — a single-record architecture that's durable and observable

- Make data usable, not just available — You'll push toward a dynamic system that learns and adapts based on market trends and real consumer demand

PeopleGrove builds software that helps higher education institutions support students and graduates at every stage of their journey — from experiential learning to career outcomes. Our CORE platform powers critical workflows for nursing programs, educator preparation, counseling, and social work — helping institutions meet accreditation requirements, track student competency, and demonstrate program impact.

Partner with engineering and design to ship high-quality product efficiently — from discovery through delivery

Serve as a key voice in go-to-market readiness — working with CS and marketing on positioning, release communications, and client onboarding

Collaborate with the VP of Product on annual and quarterly planning, contributing to roadmap strategy and resource prioritization

What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning a complex B2B SaaS product

**Title:** Sr. Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

Hanwha Vision America (HVA) is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems, founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across a wide range of industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.

Hanwha Vision is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Hardware) to lead product strategy and execution for our B2B surveillance portfolio. You will collaborate with a cross-functional team, including fellow hardware and software product managers, R&D, Sales, Marketing, Field Engineering, and Technical Support, to drive product success from concept through end of life. You will work daily with our headquarters team in South Korea throughout the development process and product lifecycle. You will also mentor other product managers within the group.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Translate customer requirements and pain points into Market and Product Requirements Documents (MRD/PRD), defining detailed feature sets, use cases, and workflows.
- Own the full product lifecycle, from introduction to end of life, including market and competitive analysis, requirements gathering, and market validation.
- Conduct product testing and evaluation, and provide detailed feedback to global product management teams.
- Monitor market trends and emerging technologies, and identify opportunities for new products and features.
- Develop a deep understanding of the B2B surveillance market, including pricing, features, value propositions, and use cases.
- Drive the product development process and partner with Marketing Communications to bring new products and features to market.
- Gather feedback from customers and internal stakeholders and ensure it is accurately reflected in feature prioritization.

CompanyCox Automotive - USAJob Family GroupEngineering / Product DevelopmentJob ProfileLead Product ManagerManagement LevelManager - Non People LeaderFlexible Work Option Hybrid - Ability to work remotely part of the weekTravel %Yes, 5% of the timeWork ShiftDayCompensationCompensation includes a base salary in the range of $111,500.00 - $185,900.00. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program.Job DescriptionEvery year, Manheim moves millions of vehicles across its auction network — and the operational infrastructure powering that movement is ready for transformation. For those that don't, the voice agent is often the tip of the spear that brings them in. We compete directly against well-funded AI startups and CCaaS incumbents, and we're winning. Job DescriptionHow We Work: We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it. Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer. What This Role Owns: You run one pod directly - one of our most complex customer engagements - and float across two others, providing product direction and unblocking teams. jobs.desc:

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Role

The Content Promotion & Distribution team is responsible for designing the suite of products that power a show’s journey from ingestion to streaming.  We build products to help Netflix and our partners plan, ingest, decorate, launch, and promote the best content to our members at a global scale. From artwork to collections, synopses to ratings, the team shapes much of what members see and feel, powering a nuanced promotion and discovery engine that leaves every member feeling that Netflix was crafted just for them.

We leverage vast data sets and cutting-edge AI technology to improve operational workflows, scale our catalog capabilities, and distribute at speed. We design products that bring insights and intelligence to creatives’ fingertips, enhancing their ability to make the best possible content and consumer member experiences. We own the global catalog, foundational elements that take raw media and decorate it with metadata, artwork, trailers, synopses, subs, dubs - our technology fuels one of the world’s most powerful entertainment platforms, ensuring that great stories can come from anywhere and be loved everywhere.

The Product Manager for Scaled Content Systems will partner with Engineering, Operations, and Design to build and scale the platforms, services, and tools powering the content lifecycle—while resisting the temptation to treat every new deal as a bespoke one-off. This is a pivotal moment for the business. We are reimagining the media lifecycle from ingest to play and moving from high-touch workflows to AI-powered, automated workflows, with exceptions that require human oversight. You will play a key role in shaping this evolution. Just as importantly, you will be a close product partner to the domain teams who run these workflows, turning their hardest problems into a durable product strategy.

We have launched the first suite of products, but we are far from done. This is a high-leverage role with direct impact on the speed, quality, and cost with which content reaches members around the world.

In This Role You Will:

• Set the strategy: define and drive the product vision for programmatic, scaled ingestion by investing in solutions that reduce manual effort, enable differentiated distribution workflows, and accelerate time-to-launch across a range of content types.

• Own the products that make delivering media to Netflix effortless: unified direct delivery via APIs, web portals, and standards-based feeds; spec-agnostic ingestion; partner onboarding and permissioning.

• Lead the path to automated publishing: work with domain PMs to simplify the path between ingestion and launch — automation as the default launch path, an extensible catalog architecture that lets new content bets evolve safely, and reliable fulfillment across the platforms and systems the business depends on.

• Partner with key cross-functional teams: act as the primary product partner to deal with partnership teams; translate deal terms into a prioritized backlog to invest in foundational capabilities. Work with partner domains to streamline asset workflows and launches.

• Communicate with clarity: use crisp written and verbal communication to provide context to stakeholders ranging from individual engineers to senior leadership, and to uncover new areas of opportunity.

Your Background Includes:

• 10+ years of product management experience for b2b or b2c focused products

• A track record of shipping complex technical or platform products ideally in content supply chain, media processing, ingestion/distribution pipelines, workflow orchestration, develope

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Inference Performance
jobs.desc:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIA is looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own the products that help customers extract the best possible performance from AI models and applications running on NVIDIA hardware. Every inference deployment — from a single-GPU workstation to a multi-thousand-GPU data center — lives or dies on latency, efficiency, and cost per token. Your job is to make NVIDIA the obvious place to run inference by turning deep optimization techniques into products that a broad range of customers can actually adopt. The work spans the entire inference stack — optimization techniques, the frameworks that deliver them; and the benchmarking and operational tooling customers rely on to trust the results. You will translate what our best-performing internal deployments do into capabilities that ship, are detailed, and work for everyone else. The Product Management organization at NVIDIA is a small, high-leverage team driving the company’s Deep Learning and Generative AI strategy. We need a self-starter who can operate with minimal direction, form a point of view from data and customer conversations, and drive it to a shipped result. If that sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

What You'll Be Doing:

•
Own the inference performance roadmap. Set direction across the stack: how models are represented, how memory and state are managed, how requests are scheduled and served, and how tokens get generated. The techniques change fast. Judge which ones matter, then decide what we build, what we adopt, and what we retire.

•
Build platforms, not one-offs. Deliver capabilities that generalize across model families, deployment topologies, and customer sizes. Build for easy adoption, sane defaults, and extensibility.

•
Agentic and Multi-Turn Workloads: Define the performance strategy for agentic applications, where long-running sessions, tool-call stalls, and unpredictable output lengths break the assumptions built into single-turn serving. Drive capabilities around cross-turn cache reuse, request prioritization, and efficient handling of idle time in agent loops.

•
Framework & Ecosystem Strategy: Define how our optimizations land across TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, and NVIDIA Dynamo. Partner with open-source communities and internal engineering teams so customers get great performance on NVIDIA hardware.

•
Benchmarking & Performance Claims: Own how performance is measured, published, and reproduced. Define the benchmark methodology, the metrics that matter (TTFT, ITL, throughput per GPU, cost per million tokens), and the guardrails that keep our numbers credible.

•
Run the product day to day. Own release readiness, quality bars, regression tracking, customer blocking issues, and the feedback loop from production deployments back into the roadmap.

What We Need to See:

•
12+ years in product management at a technology company, or comparable time as a founder, engineering lead, or technical product owner.

•
Depth in AI inference optimization: KV caching and reuse, quantization, speculative decoding, disaggregated serving. Know how each one moves accuracy, latency, and cost.

•
Familiarity with the inference and orchestration frameworks customers use: TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, NVIDIA Dynamo, and the surrounding serving and scheduling ecosystem.

•
Proven track

Foxit is a global leader in PDF and digital document software—powering over 700 million users and hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. As we expand our SaaS platform and evolve our customer-centric product strategy, we’re building a new generation of product leadership.

The Opportunity

You’ll serve as the technical heartbeat of our global product organization—connecting real customer feedback from our Alpharetta GTM teams and enterprise clients directly to our engineering centers in China and Asia-Pacific.

Fluent in both English and Mandarin, you’ll ensure nothing is lost in translation—from nuanced customer pain points to detailed developer requirements. You’ll turn ambiguity into clarity, accelerate decision-making, and drive high-impact product outcomes.

Initially, you’ll own the Foxit Editor platform roadmap. Over time, your remit will expand to other Foxit SaaS products as business priorities evolve.

What You’ll Do

• Be the founding technical bridge across global teams—aligning Product, Engineering, and GTM functions around a shared roadmap.

• Translate enterprise customer needs (captured by Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success) into clear, technically feasible requirements for our China-based engineering teams.

• Communicate in Mandarin with developers to ensure accuracy, context, and priority alignment—closing feedback loops faster and reducing misinterpretation.

• Partner with Engineering & Architecture to validate technical feasibility, manage trade-offs, and influence design decisions.

• Work side-by-side with GTM teams in Alpharetta to surface key customer insights and turn them into product improvements.

• Define success metrics, lead release planning, and champion post-launch measurement to ensure real customer impact.

• Build scalable frameworks for cross-regional communication, ensuring the next generation of Foxit products are truly global in design and delivery.

What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years in SaaS Product Management, Technical PM, or Platform PM roles.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

• Fluency in both English and Mandarin (verbal & written) — must be able to communicate technical detail to developers in Mandarin.

• Strong technical acumen: APIs, SDKs, cloud architecture, data flow, agile methods.

• Proven ability to translate between customer needs and engineering realities.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams and bridging cultural and time-zone divides.

• Willingness to travel regularly to Alpharetta (~1 week/month).

Nice to Have:

• Experience with document workflow, PDF editing, or SaaS developer tools.

• Background in software engineering or technical architecture.

• Experience supporting GTM and product alignment across US + APAC.

Why This Role Matters

This is not just a job—it’s an opportunity to define a new capability at Foxit.

You’ll:

• Be the founding member shaping how Foxit’s global product organization integrates GTM and engineering.

• Build bilingual, bi-continental collaboration models that scale.

• Influence strategic priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer experience across the full product lifecycle.

You’ll be joining a company where innovation meets execution—and you’ll sit right at the intersection of both.

We are revolutionizing network security by providing fast, accurate, and reliable threat protection and content filtering. We're a rapidly growing company dedicated to creating a safer internet for businesses and organizations worldwide. Leveraging AI-driven threat intelligence, DNSFilter empowers our customers to proactively block threats before they impact their networks. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and results-oriented culture where every team member contributes to our mission of making the internet safer. As we continue our product-fueled growth by adding new features and broadening our solution to meet the needs of the global market, it's clear there's a missing piece. That's where you come in! We are looking for a Staff Technical Product Manager to own our protection platform at the endpoint: the software our customers deploy across laptops, desktops, and mobile so their people stay safe wherever they work. The endpoint is our best vantage point on what a device is actually doing, and what a device needs in order to stay protected keeps changing. What was once people browsing is increasingly applications, services, and AI agents acting on their own. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical product manager who is comfortable starting from an open question rather than a specification, with the depth to turn it into something engineers can build and the judgment to reshape it as the constraints come into focus. Eligible candidates have worked successfully in a small to mid-sized fast-paced, hyper-growth, SaaS start-up or scale-up. This is a full-time and remote role with a strong preference for candidates in the United States who are located in either an Eastern or Central time zone. We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you feel like this job is for you, please apply. We believe diversity of experience and skills, including transferable skills, combined with passion, is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions! To qualify for this role, you have: 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time on security, networking, or endpoint products A real understanding of how traffic can be intercepted, inspected, filtered, or isolated, and of the encryption and privacy trade-offs that come with doing it Experience with software that runs on machines you do not control: deployment through MDM, RMM, and scripting, conflicts with other software, VPNs, and unfamiliar networks A point of view on AI as something to protect, not only something to build with, including shadow AI use and visibility into what agents and tools are doing on a device A track record of taking an open, undefined problem all the way to a shipped product Experience designing for technical users, including the interfaces, reporting, and data that make a capability usable Comfort working hands-on with engineers, writing both the roadmap and the individual work items they act on A working habit of using AI to move faster, Claude in particular, and a clear sense of where it helps and where it does not Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to executives, customers, and non-technical stakeholders Ability to work hours overlapping with ET hours Must be eligible to work in the region of hire without sponsorship from an employer now and/or in the future Bonus points for: Experience with multi-tenant, white-label, or partner-delivered products A prior engineering, solutions architecture, or security

About Us

Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home.

Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access.

We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered.

About You

Axle Health is building the operating system for home healthcare - scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement tools that give health systems and home-based care providers the infrastructure to run better, faster, and at greater scale. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own critical product initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and GTM teams to ship features that meaningfully improve how clinicians deliver care and how operations teams run the day-to-day. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product, where you'll have significant autonomy to shape what we build and how.

The Senior Product Manager who thrives here isn't waiting for a fully-scoped customer request to land in their lap. You have genuine product taste. You can look at a workflow and see immediately where the friction is, articulate what a great experience should feel like for home healthcare providers , and champion that standard all the way through to launch. You're a true advocate for the customer and the user - someone who leans into the user experience and holds the bar on experience even when it's easier to ship something just good enough. You're equally comfortable digging into the data and riding along with our customers to understand what they actually need.

You've shipped B2B vertical SaaS products at early-stage startups and know what it takes to move fast with limited resources, make smart trade-offs without losing sight of the user, and build things people actually want to use.

We do not monitor YC applications, please apply directly on our website to be considered for this position: https://www.axlehealth.com/careers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, PBM Platform
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

  

Rightway is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own claims adjudication, the system at the center of Rightway's PBM. Adjudication covers the full lifecycle of a pharmacy claim: eligibility, coverage, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits. It is one of the most complex and consequential product areas at Rightway, and this role owns its strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

You will develop deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate today and use that to define where the platform goes next — working through real claim behavior alongside engineering, writing requirements precise enough to build against, setting the bar for correctness, and owning the validation approach that proves the system is ready for production volume. The role reports to the Director, Product Management, and operates with a high degree of independence. It requires someone who can take full ownership of a major product initiative and work cross-functionally across product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plan for claims adjudication, including how it scales with volume, new clients, and new lines of business
* Build deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate across eligibility, coverage rules, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits, and turn that into a structured, prioritized plan
* Define the long-term strategy for how the platform evolves to support operational scale, regulatory requirements, and new lines of business, including Medicare
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can execute against, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination in an agile environment
* Partner day to day with the adjudication engineering team to sequence work, manage dependencies, and resolve ambiguity in claim behavior quickly
* Set the bar for correctness and own the testing and claim certification approach that proves the system is ready for production volume
* Own readiness and rollout planning, including validation against real claim volume, parallel testing, and phased release
* Coordinate go-live readiness across operations, clinical, client success, and compliance so changes land without disruption to members or clients
* Partner with PBM operations, clinical, legal, and client success teams to ensure the platform meets workflow and regulatory requirements
* Manage the drug data, formulary, and prior authorization dependencies adjudication relies on, treating the internal teams who own them as first-class partners
* Define and track KPIs for claim accuracy, system performance, and reliability
* Act as the primary product point of contact for adjudication across the organization and with external partners

**WHO YOU ARE:**

  

* Bachelor's degree required; 5 or more years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare or enterprise technology
* Experience with complex, rules-driven transaction processing systems such as claims adjudication, payments, or benefit administration, including responsibility for correctness and testing
* Experience leading a platform migration or major system transition from requirements through go-live
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving product, engineering, legal, and operations stakeholders
* Ability to work independently and drive execution with minimal direction
* Strong communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams
* Detail oriented and process focused, and comfortable in a domain where correctness is measured claim by claim
* Comfortable working across complex, data-heavy systems
* Curious and adaptable, willing to dig into unfamiliar and highly technical territory and find answers
* Experience working in or with PBMs, pharmacy claims, or pharmacy operations is a plus
* Familiarity with systems that support regulated healthcare markets

As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

Beazley Security’s Exposure Management platform provides continuous, automated visibility into organizations, internet-facing footprint: domains, IPs, exposed services, and externally accessilbe software. By having near real time visibility to changes to

This pre-emptive approach is essential to addressing potential risk before it can materialize.

**About Smokeball**  
Smokeball powers people-law. Our legal practice management software lightens the administrative burden, so legal professionals can serve those who need them most. With offices in Australia, the US, and the UK, culture plays a big part in our success, and our clear purpose and vision motivate us daily.

**Senior Product Manager, Personal Injury**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to help rebuild and expand Smokeball’s Personal Injury (PI) offering. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role where you’ll own a PI product area from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration — working directly with US personal injury firms and our engineering team in Australia.

You’ll report to the leader of our PI product team and work alongside our other Senior Product Manager, with the two of you sharing ownership of the PI portfolio. You’ll own your roadmap, make the calls on what gets built and why, and be accountable for the impact it delivers. Priorities will move, problems will change, and you’ll need to be comfortable jumping into something new, getting up to speed quickly, talking to customers, and turning messy problems into smart, well-scoped solutions.

One important thing: **don’t come in swinging a redesign hammer.** First, get to know the product. Firms rely on what exists today, and the quirks you might spot often exist for a reason. Your first job is to understand the *why* before deciding what should change.

We also build with AI in the loop. You should be comfortable using AI tools to design, experiment, and prototype — including Claude Code — and turning ideas into something customers can actually click on and react to. Around here, a good prototype can do a lot of the heavy lifting that a 20-page spec normally would.

Most importantly, this is a role for a Senior PM who wants to **do the craft, not just talk about it**. You’ll be in customer calls, sketching flows, building prototypes, making product calls, and getting into the backlog — not watching it all happen from a safe distance.

This is a **hybrid** position based in our Chicago, IL office. All Chicagoland employees are required to be in the office on **Wednesdays and Thursdays**.

**Customer discovery & validation**

* Build strong relationships with US personal injury firms and our in-house PI attorney to understand workflows, pain points, and market expectations.
* Run customer interviews, usability testing, and validation across your product areas.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to identify recurring customer and commercial problems.
* Develop a deep understanding of the existing PI product and the legal and workflow decisions behind it before proposing changes.

**Product ownership & strategy**

* Own the roadmap for your PI area, prioritizing opportunities based on customer impact, commercial value, and delivery effort.
* Make clear product decisions and trade-offs, and partner with the PI leadership team and other Senior PM to sequence the wider portfolio.
* Represent your product area with executives, customers, Sales, and cross-functional teams.

**Prototyping & AI**

* Produce your own wireframes and flows during discovery. You don't need to be a designer, but you do need to be self-sufficient. If you do have design experience, that’s a plus.
* Create your own wireframes and user flows during discovery and use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, to rapidly build working prototypes for customer validation.
* Treat prototypes as the primary product artifact, keeping documentation focused on intent, behavior, and key requirements rather than exhaustive PRDs.

**Delivery & iteration**

* Work closely with our Australia-based engineering team, giving them context, priorities, and fast answers. Engineering's role on this team leans toward reviewing, correcting, and hardening what comes out of AI-assisted development, so your prototypes and decisions feed directly into what ships.

**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the consumer prediction-market trading experience end-to-end - web and mobile - once someone can fund: discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / live, and the fan UX that makes OG the default place to trade on real-world outcomes.

Your mandate is to make OG fast, clear, and design-obsessive for sports and prediction users: the core trading surfaces that keep them coming back, the workflows that feel native to fans (and to retail traders), and the translation of that craft into regulated U.S. event contracts. Fiat, KYC, and payment rails sit with a partner PM. You own what they do after they’re funded.

You make the call on UX tradeoffs, what ships when design quality isn’t there yet, and which trading patterns we borrow from sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail perps -and which we refuse. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.

  

**You can come from one of three product worlds:**

* Native consumer predictions - sports fluency, parlays / live, fan UX - and you can bridge that into regulated event contracts.
* Prediction / event markets -you’ve already shipped this category.
* Retail perps / derivatives / advanced trading -you know trader-grade workflows and can make them accessible for fans, not only power users.

### **What You'll Actually Do:**

* Own the consumer trading roadmap. You are the DRI for web and mobile trading on OG -from first funded session through confident, repeat use. You set milestones, sequence work, and resolve cross-team dependencies. Nothing in this charter goes live without your sign-off on product and UX bar.
* Ship the product fans actually use. You prioritize market discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / multi-leg, live, and the workflows that keep sports and prediction users engaged. You kill “nice ideas” that don’t move outcomes.
* Bridge native prediction (or perps) into regulated event contracts. You take patterns fans already know -sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail advanced trading -and make them work under U.S. event-contract rules. You don’t copy a sportsbook blindly. You decide what translates.
* Hold the design bar. You champion usability and aesthetics as non-negotiable. You live in design reviews and give specific, actionable UX feedback -spacing, interaction patterns, information density, not vibes. Fan UX is a product skill, not a polish pass.

Build the platform that powers every Zeitview product. Define how domain objects and large-scale geospatial, imagery, inspection, and operational datasets are represented, connected, processed, governed, and exposed to applications, customers, and AI systems. This is a technical, high-leverage product role for someone who cares about building reliable, scalable, extensible systems. You’ll work closely with product engineering, data engineering, data science, security, and product teams to turn fragmented systems and data into durable platform primitives that teams can build on with confidence.

Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose-driven for the organization it serves.

**Let's achieve more, together.**

========================

This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds.

You lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces.

You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone.

**Why this role exists**
========================

In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing.

Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details.

The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves.

===============================================

You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure.

**1. Product strategy and roadmap ownership**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals.
* Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn.
* Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features.

**2. Discovery and definition**
-------------------------------

* Run discovery with members, buyers, and internal experts to understand the real problem before committing to a solution.
* Write clear definitions of what to build and why, including the assumptions and the bet behind each one.
* Validate early and often, so the team learns fast and adjusts faster.

**3. Delivery and execution**
-----------------------------

* Lead a cross-functional team through delivery, unblocking decisions and keeping momentum.
* Own trade-offs on scope, quality, and time, and make them explicit.
* Ship reliably, and hold a clear bar for what launch-ready means.

* Partner with applied AI and research to turn capability into dependable product behavior.

Senior Product Manager

About NavLogic AI

NavLogic AI is building an AI-native operating platform for freight forwarders and NVOCCs. Our platform helps automate complex workflows across emails, documents, data entry, shipment follow-up, exception handling, customer communication, and billing.

Our initial focus is U.S. ocean import operations, with plans to expand into ocean export, air freight, trucking, warehousing, and other logistics workflows.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to turn complex freight-forwarding operations into reliable AI products.

You will work closely with freight operators, customers, design, engineering, and AI teams to identify high-value operational problems and take products from discovery through production launch and adoption.

Key Responsibilities

* Study and redesign end-to-end freight workflows, including ocean import, shipment creation, availability and LFD, customs and release status, pickup and delivery coordination, exceptions, customer updates, and billing handoffs.
* Define product strategy, priorities, MVPs, and roadmaps based on customer value, operational needs, automation feasibility, and business impact.
* Translate real-world business processes into AI and workflow automation products.
* Work closely with design, engineering, AI, data, and operations teams from product discovery through launch.
* Define product metrics and evaluate automation accuracy, adoption, productivity, and customer ROI.
* Interview customers and freight operators, manage product feedback, and turn customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

* 6+ years of B2B, enterprise software, or complex workflow product management experience. Exceptional candidates with 5+ years and strong results will also be considered.
* Proven experience owning a product or major product area from discovery through production launch and adoption.
* Experience in either logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, TMS/FMS, or enterprise AI/workflow products.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM, AI agent, document intelligence, or intelligent workflow product into production.
* Strong product skills including problem framing, workflow design, PRDs, prototypes, prioritization, and release management.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in an early-stage startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Knowledge of U.S. ocean import, NVOCC, customs, trucking, warehousing, or freight exception management.
* Experience with FMS, APIs, EDI, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Startup or 0-to-1 product experience.
* Familiarity with AI workflow tools such as Dify, LangGraph, CrewAI, or n8n.

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity.
* Opportunity to shape the product and roadmap as an early product leader.
* Direct exposure to real freight operations and customers.
* AI-native working environment with modern AI tools.
* Opportunity to work with teams and customers across the U.S. and China.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

This role will provide dedicated Product leadership to understand current-state challenges, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and design scalable solutions that support continued growth, improve operational performance, and reduce financial and administrative friction.

* Lead product execution from discovery and requirements through delivery, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

For decades, schools, libraries, and institutions have turned to our resources to build information literacy and help learners develop the skills they need to succeed long after the classroom. The Senior Product Manager brings rigorous product management practice to bear on Infobase’s most ambiguous and complex product problems, working on a flexible, problem-driven basis rather than owning a single product area on an ongoing basis. The role partners closely with Franchise Owners — who own content strategy for their franchises — and with the Senior Director, Platform Strategy on the definition of new products and major product revisions on Infobase’s platform.

This is a senior individual-contributor role: for each assigned problem, the Senior Product Manager sets direction, builds the evidence base and business case behind major investments, and leads cross-functional alignment — including with Franchise Owners, the Senior Director, Platform Strategy, and Technology stakeholders — to move initiatives from strategy through adoption. Success depends on building alignment and driving outcomes through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. This role will create presentations for executive leadership and should be comfortable interfacing with all levels of the organization.

The Senior Product Manager and Franchise Owners work in close partnership on assigned problems, each bringing distinct expertise — product management discipline and rigor on one side, content and franchise knowledge on the other. Description:

Deep Sync is the industry leader in deterministic identity and AI-powered data solutions. Leveraging our 35-year foundation of compiling direct mail-grade datasets, Deep Sync develops data-first technologies that power marketing, measurement, AI, and business intelligence for agencies and brands with our fully deterministic identity graph, privacy-first audiences, comprehensive data solutions, and integrations with leading platforms and cloud providers.

**Position Overview**

Marketing depends on identifying the audience correctly. Deep Sync supplies the identity data that makes that possible, across offline and online channels, in both consumer and business marketing.

You will own the product surface on which a customer selects an audience, purchases it, and delivers it into the channel where the campaign runs, built on the platform now under development. The role also covers new product development: taking an idea from a hypothesis to a paid offering, and discontinuing the ones that do not justify further investment.

The products we build have to be ready for an AI first world. Customers increasingly reach data through agents and natural language rather than through a screen, which means what we ship has to serve a machine as readily as a person.

The position calls for a senior product manager fluent in advertising and in data, and equally at ease with AI. You should already understand what a match rate is worth to a buyer, the limits of lookalike modelling, and why one individual appears as separate records in separate systems, you should be able to go into the data and verify such questions yourself, and you should be building with current AI tools rather than reading about them. We run a flat organisation and a fast product development cadence. The position is based in Kirkland, WA.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and delivery**

* **Surface ownership.** Own an area of the product from the problem through to the outcome: the case for doing the work, the requirements engineering builds from, and the usage it shows six months after release.
* **Requirements and written decisions.** We work in documents. A requirements document states the problem, the decision taken, what is in scope and what is not, and how success will be measured. Presentations are for reporting, not for deciding.
* **Scope discipline.** A rebuild invites reproducing every feature that exists today. Establish what is actually used, make the case for retiring the rest, and hold that position in review.
* **Release management.** Select the customers who receive each release first, define the test that closes a milestone, and report the result as it stands.
* New product development
* **Opportunity identification.** Attributes that have never been packaged, audiences that have never been priced, and questions customers are currently paying somebody else to answer.
* **Early validation.** A test with two or three customers, a measure agreed in advance, and a short written finding. Evidence before a long build rather than after it.
* **Applied AI.** Determine where a model or an agent belongs in the product and where it does not, specify how its output will be evaluated, and demonstrate the idea with a working prototype rather than a description of one. Design for consumption by machines as well as by people: predictable interfaces, described data, and output that a system downstream can act on without a person in between.
* **Progression or discontinuation.** Both are acceptable outcomes. An idea that remains a proposal for three quarters is not.

**Market and commercial**

* **Customer contact.** The sales, delivery and client facing teams hold most of the knowledge about what fails, and customers hold the rest. Time spent with them is part of the role.
* **Consumer and business marketing.** The two buy different things for different reasons, and both are Deep Sync customers. Understand what each is measured on.

This role will help make every interaction more relevant, useful, and motivating for prospective customers while creating a connected experience across growth, brand, marketing, experimentation, and analytics.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Havenly**
-----------------

At **Havenly Brands**, we’re building this generation’s premier destination for all things home. Alongside our award winning Havenly design services, we proudly own and operate some of the best home furnishings brands in the business including Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, Burrow, Inside, and St.Frank. Our family of brands is growing and we’re looking for amazing people to join us on this journey!

Havenly is not just the #1 residential interior design service in America - we're architecting the future of how millions design their homes. With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. Join us in building the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.

**Our Core Values**

* **Exhibit Gumption:** meet every challenge with spirit and energy; believe the impossible is possible.
* **Overperform:** work hard, move fast, be scrappy.
* **Stay Playful:** no jerks, no whiners; have fun and keep perspective.
* **Act Like an Owner:** be accountable, speak up, act in Havenly's best interest.

**About the Role**
------------------

Havenly is looking for a **Senior Product Manager.** You'll own a product surface end-to-end — the roadmap, the top-line metric that defines success, and the calls about what's worth building and what to skip. This is a senior, highly cross-functional seat: you'll partner closely with engineering, supply chain, and marketing, and work directly with product leadership and executives to drive alignment on where we spend time and resources. We move fast and build with AI at the center of how we work, and we're looking for someone just as comfortable executing against an established playbook as they are bringing structure to a problem that doesn't have one yet.

**The two teams, and what you'd own**
-------------------------------------

* **Design Services** owns our interior design experience, from a new customer's style quiz to a booked designer and a finished room, and includes The Expert, our brand serving the interior design trade. Surfaces include onboarding and designer matching, the Studio 3D design tool, product sourcing and recommendations, and AI design assistance. Metrics you'd move: onboarding completion, quiz-to-booking conversion, design-to-purchase attach rate, and designer productivity.
* **Owned & Operated Ecommerce** owns how customers discover, customize, and buy across our brands. Surfaces include product listing and detail pages, customization flows, merchandising, and checkout. Metrics you'd move: conversion rate, average order value, cart completion, and repeat purchase.

A real problem you might pick up: reduce drop-off between the style quiz and a customer's first designer session, or lift product-detail-page conversion on a brand's storefront.

**What You'll Drive**

* Partner with design and engineering to turn opportunities into clear product work, trade-offs, and releases.
* Measure impact and use results to influence strategy and prioritization.
* Raise the bar for product practice on the team, and mentor other PMs.

**We Are Looking for People Who:**
----------------------------------

* Have **5+ years** of hands-on **product management experience with B2C, consumer-facing products**, with at least one product area where you owned the roadmap and a top-line metric end-to-end.
* Are comfortable executing against an established playbook, and just as comfortable navigating ambiguity when there isn't one — identifying opportunities and defining the highest-likelihood path forward.
* Are excellent communicators who build credibility quickly and influence effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.
* Are comfortable with both **quantitative** and **qualitative** decision making.
* Approach ambiguous problems

At CancerIQ, our technology is expanding access to precision cancer prevention, early detection and treatment to more patient populations. We build software and design services that make it easy for health systems to use genetic information to get ahead of cancer at scale. To date, CancerIQ has raised over $26 million to deliver on our mission, with our Series B funding round led by Merck Global Health Innovation Fund and Amgen Ventures.

CancerIQ is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the product roadmap for the CancerIQ platform, the full set of workflows that power hereditary cancer risk assessment, genetic testing, and screening compliance for our health-system customers.
