# Sr. Product Manager - Technical, QoS & Performance , Leo Network Infrastructure

Location:Redmond, WACompany:Amazon Kuiper Commercial Services LLC

## Description:

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) to own the Quality of Service (QoS) and Performance domain within Leo Networking. In this role, you will define the products and features that ensure Leo delivers on its performance promises — from core performance assurance to traffic shaping and congestion management algorithms. You will work at the intersection of networking engineering, satellite systems, and customer experience to build differentiated, measurable, and enforceable Performance & QoS capabilities.

This is a high-visibility role that requires deep technical acumen in networking, strong product sense, and the ability to influence across engineering, business, and leadership. You will own the Performance and QoS roadmap from concept through launch, write PRFAQs and technical requirements, and represent the customer’s performance expectations in every architectural decision.

Own the end-to-end Performance and QoS product strategy for Leo, including traffic classification, prioritization, shaping, and congestion management.

Define and drive the performance metrics framework — establishing SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs that govern throughput, latency, jitter, and packet loss across the Leo network.

Partner with Principal Engineers and SDEs to prioritize and implement network performance capabilities and enforcement mechanisms across the satellite, ground gateway, and SDN layers.

Write PRFAQs, technical narratives, and requirement documents to secure resources and align leadership on the network performance roadmap.

Collaborate with sales, demand management, and capacity management to gather customer performance requirements and translate them into product features.

Define acceptance criteria and performance gates for new feature performance capabilities, ensuring QoS compliance before customer-facing releases.

Work cross-functionally with the Beam Planning, SDN, and Satellite Operations teams to optimize resource allocation and minimize latency, packet loss, and congestion across the constellation.

Export Control Requirement:

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a review of overnight performance dashboards — checking throughput, latency percentiles, and congestion events across active beams and ground gateways. You notice a pattern in peak-hour congestion for a specific geographic region and draft a quick analysis to bring to your engineering sync.

Mid-morning, you’re in a design review with the SDN team, debating the trade-offs of a new traffic shaping algorithm that could improve P99 latency for enterprise customers but may impact other traffic. You push for a data-driven approach, proposing an A/B test framework to validate the change in a controlled environment.

*A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.*

*Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR**.* *This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.*

### **Intro to Position**

NPR is scaling and maturing our audience engagement practice into a unified, data-driven, cross-platform growth and engagement engine, and lifecycle management is at the center of that transformation. This role owns the lifecycle activation tools, with a mandate to replace manual, campaign-by-campaign execution with scalable, AI-enabled (where appropriate) processes, and their work focuses on key touchpoints of engagement such as email acquisition, repeat engagement and donation conversion/retention. This role works in daily partnership with Data, Editorial, Marketing, Design, Engineering and Product teams with a mission to make every relationship touchpoint personalized, measurable, user-friendly and tied to business outcomes.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:** Lead the product roadmap for NPR's audience lifecycle and martech ecosystem (including Piano.io and Salesforce Marketing Cloud), translating stakeholder requirements into prioritized engineering backlogs.
* **Martech Operationalization & Tooling:** Build, configure, and operationalize internal-facing audience activation tools, establishing intuitive self-serve processes, user permissions, and governance guardrails for content and marketing leads.
* **Audience Journey Optimization:** Partner with cross-divisional teams to design scalable automation rules and capabilities that enhance the full listener journey—from email discovery and content re-engagement to recurring donation conversion and win-back.
* **Data Integration & Measurement Alignment:** Collaborate with Data and Analytics teams to enhance customer data platform (CDP) segmentation, tracking taxonomy, and attribution modeling to measure the direct impact of activation campaigns.
* **Newsletter Product Infrastructure:** Drive technical development and platform enhancements for the NPR editorial newsletter suite in close coordination with newsroom and product leadership.
* **AI & Workflow Efficiency Integration:** Evaluate and deploy practical, responsible AI and automation capabilities within lifecycle workflows to minimize repetitive manual execution.
* **Diverse Audience Engagement:** Support audience diversification goals by designing personalization and segmentation workflows that welcome and sustain cross-generational and diverse audiences across digital touchpoints.
* **Standard Operating Procedures & Enablement:** Author product documentation, establish lifecycle governance best practices, and conduct internal training sessions to ensure cross-departmental adoption of activation tools.

**The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.**

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 3+ years of digital product management experience managing complex platforms, with a track record

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Identity
jobs.desc:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

Your Role

As a Senior/Principal Product Manager for Identity, you will own the core capabilities that power trust, security, identity, permissions and insights. You will define and deliver platform-level features that support our largest enterprise customers, ensure world-class security and governance, and enable teams across Zip to build consistent, performant, and compliant product experiences.

You Will

  • Lead Zip’s authentication and security roadmap, including MFA, step-up MFA, Multi-IdP SSO, IP restrictions, anomaly detection, and account takeover prevention.

  • Define and drive strategy for Zip’s data governance, reporting and insights capabilities.

  • Own enterprise-grade permissions and access controls, ensuring clarity, auditability, and scalability for complex organizational structures.

  • Collaborate deeply with engineering to define requirements, provide product direction, make tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality foundational capabilities.

Your Qualifications

  • 4-8+ years of Product Management experience, including substantial work on platform, security, identity/auth, RBAC/permissions or governance-adjacent products

  • Strong understanding of SSO/SAML, OAuth, MFA, and broader enterprise authentication patterns.

  • High technical fluency with the ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear product decisions.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse technical and non-technical audiences (including some of Zip’s largest customers).

  • Bias to action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Bonus

  • Data literacy with experience using BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.) and shaping how data is modeled and presented to customers.

The salary range for this role is $200,000 - $280,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

  • 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

  • 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Are you a product leader who thrives on turning complex operations into clean, well-built software? Join us as we close out a major rewrite of our core platform — and take the wheel on what comes next!

Imedview is a claims and litigation service partner specializing in Liability, Workers’ Compensation, and No-Fault/PIP Claims. Our expertise allows us to proudly service both legal and insurance professionals, nationally. With more than 20 years of experience and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and building lasting client relationships, we’re growing fast — and we’re always on the lookout for exceptional individuals to join our dynamic, expanding family. Ready to be part of something groundbreaking? Come grow with us!

This is a remote role designed to support flexibility while maintaining strong team collaboration. Candidates should reside within 100 miles of our Saugerties, NY office. While day-to-day work is performed remotely, periodic onsite attendance may be required for meetings, training, team events, and other business-related activities. Employees residing within 100 miles of the office will be expected to attend monthly in-person meetings.

**About the Role**

To meet increasing client demand, we are deepening our investment in product and engineering. We’ve assembled an in-house engineering team that combines startup execution discipline with experience from large-scale tech companies, and we’re committed to building an amazing product and engineering culture in-house. We’re wrapping up the rewrite of our core internal software and we’re looking to finish strong before moving into the next chapter of continued development.

jobs.desc:
**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Revenue at Tabs: the system that turns performance obligations and usage data into recognized revenue a finance team can close the month on and an auditor can sign off on.

Audit-defensible revenue recognition is core to what Tabs does. You'll own the recognition engine across methods, the ASC 606 treatment that drives it (SSP allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications), and the audit trail and controls that make the numbers defensible. You'll report to the Director of Product and work every day with engineering, Solutions, and the finance teams who use Tabs.

**Why this role exists:** most revenue software is built by people who have never had to defend a number at close. We want someone who has, and who has also built software with engineers.

### **How We Work**

* **We work hard.** Two-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. Built around intra-month product releases.
* **We work smart.** Get in front of the customer, use both data and customer feedback to drive decisions, while keeping the bigger picture in mind.
* **We work together.** In-office culture with people you want to work with. Lots of whiteboard space. Expense coffee, lunch, and dinner when in the office.

### **What You’ll Work On**

**Own the revenue recognition engine**

* Define how performance obligations convert into revenue schedules across methods — straightlined, point-in-time, usage-based, and milestone
* Ensure contract changes (amendments, renewals, terminations) flow through correctly to revenue schedules, including re-allocation and restatements
* Own recognized, deferred, and unbilled balances, and the movement between them each period

**Drive ASC 606 compliance**

* Own transaction price allocation across bundled performance obligations (SSP), variable consideration, and contract modification accounting
* Stay current on evolving accounting guidance and audit standards, along with the needs of active and prospective merchants, and translate them into product direction

**Build toward audit-defensible, SOX-grade revenue**

* Define the audit trail standard — what was recognized, when, why, against which obligation — so an external auditor can verify any number directly
* Build toward segregated permissions and approval workflows (RBAC) for revenue and journal entry changes

**Bring AI into the revenue workflow**

* Partner on AI-powered tooling that goes beyond answering questions — flagging anomalies before close, explaining what changed and why, and recommending the right recognition treatment as obligations and contracts evolve

* Background as a **Controller**, **Assistant Controller**, **Revenue Accountant**, or **Technical Accounting Manager** — someone who has done the hands-on technical accounting work of applying ASC 606 to real transactions

* Deep, practical ASC 606 fluency — comfortable reasoning through transaction price allocation, variable consideration, and contract modification accounting directly, not just at a conceptual level
* Comfortable translating complex accounting frameworks into product requirements and data models engineers can build against
* Highly analytical and data-driven; comfortable making decisions based on metrics and qual

As part of Norfolk Southern, you’ll join a collaborative team where there are opportunities for growth across the organization. We are building a culture where everyone can thrive by owning and driving exceptional results, being humble and leading with trust, serving our customers with excellence, and collaborating and coaching to win.

-------------------

Our Senior Product Owners are key members of an Agile Product Management team responsible for driving innovation and value Norfolk Southern’s suite of digital platforms. The role bridges the gap between intermodal terminal operations and technology delivery by partnering with terminal managers, operational leaders, internal stakeholders, and gate/yard personnel to facilitate the collection of business needs. The primary focus is forward-looking by defining and communicating features and associated Objective & Key Results (OKRs) for the upcoming quarters using a product roadmap. The Senior Product Owner is also accountable for in-sprint delivery with close collaboration with the team Product Owner(s), when applicable.

  

The Senior Product Owner works with the IT scrum team to refine the features in the backlog for the next quarter, define and communicate priorities, and ensures the business needs are incorporated in the creation of user stories. * Refine and maintain a ready backlog of features and user stories for upcoming quarters.

* Accountable for the quality and readiness of user stories, with refinement and review completed at least one week prior to Sprint Planning.

* Partner with Scrum Team members to address dependencies, escalate impediments as needed, and ensure in-sprint delivery.

**Delivery, Release & Quality Accountability**

jobs.desc:
**About Rocket Lawyer**

Founded in 2008, we believe everyone deserves to be legally protected. In one seamless experience that combines trusted legal AI and the right attorney for each legal matter, Rocket Lawyer members have always-on access to affordable legal guidance and services they need. To date we've helped over 30 million consumers and small businesses get the legal help they need and are now expanding the team in order to bring affordable legal protection to even more.

**About your role**

Have a passion for helping people through technology - especially AI? Join Rocket Lawyer as we disrupt the legal industry and advance our mission to make the law affordable and simple. You'll work at the forefront of agentic AI product development, building and launching cutting-edge products for attorneys. Sound exciting? We'd love for you to join us!

Your role will be to own the end-to-end delivery of our Legal Platform, the product that enables attorneys in Rocket Lawyer's network to deliver legal services through our on-demand marketplace.

Today, much of the legal work between attorneys and customers happens off platform - phone calls, emails, and file sharing. Your job will be to bring that experience on-platform through streamlined web conferencing, privileged workspaces, and secure collaboration tools for documents and messaging.

Creating a delightful experience for both attorneys and customers is essential. Attorneys already love Rocket Lawyer because it enables them to practice their craft on their own terms - without business development, invoicing, nor collections. Now we're equipping them with cutting edge legal technology and AI powered tools that enable them to do their job more efficiently than ever.

**How you will make a difference day to day**

*Product Strategy and Vision*

  

* Drive Product strategy and execution for our Legal Platform.
* Develop a deep understand of the needs of our network attorneys through quantitative and qualitative research.
* Passionately represent the voice of the customer (attorneys) while building products aligned with our product vision.
* Lead the ideation, development, and launch of products for our customers.

*Data Driven Product Development:*

  

* Define and analyze metrics to measure business impacts
* Prioritize features using data-driven analysis, business insights, and sound judgment.
* Develop and deliver a roadmap for our Legal Platform product capabilities.
* Understand and report on the direct revenue implications of product decisions.

*Design and Engineering Team Collaboration*

  

* Collaborate with a cross-functional team of Design, User Experience, Engineering, QA, and Content to bring product experiments to market.
* Develop a deep understanding of the marketplace and competitive environment.

**What you'll need**

* 8-10 years of software Product Development experience, ideally with B2B or B2C SaaS products.
* At least 4 years in SaaS (Productivity, Project Management, Collaboration, Workflow) specific product management.
* Ability to combine strong product sense with business acumen to deliver positive outcomes for both customers and the business.
* Passionate about our mission.
* Demonstrated ability to think critically and problem-solve.
* Excellent communication skills.
* An ownership mentality.
* Ability to engage in respectful debate and arrive at "win-win" decisions.
* A bias for action.
* Excitement to celebrate and win as a team.
* Self-aware and a growth mindset.

**A bonus if you have**

* Experience building or launching products that leverage agentic AI systems.
* Experience in the legal technology industry.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Comprehensive health plans (including Medical, Dental and Vision insurance for full-time employees)
* Unlimited PTO
* Competitive salary packages
* Life insurance
* Disability benefits
* Supplemental Optional Life Insurance Benefits
* FSA Options Optional
* HSA with Company Match
* 401k program with Company Match

jobs.desc:
**Type:** High-agency individual contributor  
**Products:** Single Brain + API Gateway  
**Location:** Full-time, remote (Los Angeles a plus, not required)  
**Comp:** $120,000–$150,000 USD / year

**One-liner**
-------------

Own what gets built and why across Single Brain and API Gateway — turn build build build into build measure iterate.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat owns product judgment for Single Brain and the API Gateway: which metrics matter, what is blocking them, and what engineering should build next.

Engineering owns **how** we build. You own **what** we build and **why**.

You work daily with a ~6-person engineering team. You do **not** manage that team as a people manager; you create clarity so their effort lands on the highest-leverage outcomes.

You should be an advanced AI user. Use AI for research, interview synthesis, analytics, specs, prototypes, experiment design, and competitive work so your product decisions get faster and better.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Identify the highest-leverage product metrics across Single Brain and API Gateway (activation, usage, retention, expansion, revenue, time-to-value, Gateway/integration adoption).
* Diagnose what is limiting those metrics.
* Decide what engineering should build next, with clear hypotheses and success criteria.
* Run strong weekly sprint kickoffs so the team leaves knowing: what metric are we moving, what are we doing to move it, and how will we know it worked.
* Own customer discovery — talk to customers often; separate loud requests from high-leverage opportunities.
* Own product analytics and instrumentation quality; no major initiative ships without a measurement plan.
* Review launches against real results and choose iterate, expand, revert, or move on.
* Keep the integration / Gateway roadmap intentionally prioritized.
* Protect the team from low-impact or poorly defined work.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** deep product understanding; customer discovery underway; core journeys/funnels mapped; analytics audited; clear view of which metrics matter and where the biggest opportunities are.
* **By day 60:** you own weekly sprint kickoffs; major initiatives have metrics and measurement plans; core funnels instrumented and visible.
* **By day 90:** prioritized roadmap tied to measurable outcomes; multiple complete build measure iterate cycles; measurable improvement in at least one meaningful product metric. Failure = features still shipping without hypotheses, instrumentation, or post-launch learning.
* **By 6–12 months:** durable product OS (Metric Diagnosis Hypothesis Build Measure Learn Iterate); customer discovery and post-launch measurement are standard; CTO is no longer the primary person deciding what engineering builds next; key product/business metrics improved materially.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* Experience owning a technical software product (APIs, integrations, auth, data fluency).
* Metrics you personally owned and improved — with diagnosis, not feature lists.
* Sprint leadership / prioritization with engineering teams.
* Product analytics and instrumentation ownership (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).
* Advanced daily AI workflows for product work.
* High-agency ownership: you set roadmap direction; you are not a conduit or Jira admin.
* Ideal: early-stage / growth-stage; developer tools, API, infrastructure, or AI products.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a project manager, not a backlog clerk, not “collect feature requests,” not “feature shipped = success,” not waiting for the CTO to dictate the roadmap.

-------------------------

**Remote: IT Senior Product Owner \_ Birmingham, AL**

**Contract To Hire/ Full Time**

**Position Overview**

The IT Senior Product Owner serves as the primary liaison between IT teams and business stakeholders, supporting the prioritization, planning, and delivery of technology initiatives. This role partners with business leaders to understand strategic priorities, manage demand, define requirements, and deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency, compliance, reporting, and employee experience.

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing business value, managing product backlogs, maintaining roadmaps, and ensuring technology investments align with enterprise objectives and operational needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as Product Owner for IT teams supporting business functions and operational initiatives.
* Partner with business stakeholders and IT teams to establish priorities, maintain product roadmaps, and align delivery with business objectives.
* Manage, refine, and prioritize product backlogs to maximize business value and support organizational goals.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing strategies, and release plans.
* Work closely with planning managers, Scrum Masters, Release Train Engineers, and business stakeholders to refine, prioritize, and deliver initiatives.
* Facilitate communication between business and technology teams to ensure successful solution delivery and adoption.
* Communicate delivery status, release timelines, risks, dependencies, and key decisions clearly and transparently.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.
* Promote Agile principles, continuous improvement, and product ownership best practices.
* Monitor delivery outcomes, stakeholder satisfaction, business risks, and alignment with expected value.
* Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, backlogs, and delivery activities using Azure DevOps.
* Provide guidance and mentorship on product ownership practices and stakeholder collaboration.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or in a similar role.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, backlog management, requirements analysis, and stakeholder engagement.
* Demonstrated experience translating business needs into effective technology solutions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and balance short-term requirements with long-term business objectives.
* Strong decision-making skills and the ability to navigate complex situations and ambiguity.
* Ability to influence outcomes, build consensus, and collaborate across diverse stakeholder groups without direct authority.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in complex enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and evolving business needs.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for backlog management, work tracking, and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, or other corporate systems functions.
* Working knowledge of accounting, financial operations, and related business processes.
* Experience coordinating initiatives across multiple IT teams and business functions.
* Familiarity with enterprise product roadmaps, value streams, and cross-functional delivery models.

**Enterprise Value Streams**

The role may support initiatives across the following business and technology value streams:

* **Commercial Growth**
* **Service & Relationship Management**
* **Product & Profitability**
* **Core Platforms & Processe**

**About DealerOn**

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape product direction and lead high-impact SaaS initiatives that deliver measurable value for dealerships, their consumers, and our business.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned, technically grounded product manager who balances customer needs, technical feasibility, and business priorities, and who uses AI as a core part of how they work every day. They prototype to validate ideas while collaborating with UX and engineering teams, have sound judgment about where AI belongs in the product, and help peers build the same fluency.

**What You’ll Do**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap around company goals and customer needs.
* Use market trends, competitive insights, customer research, and product data to drive feature prioritization.
* Balance short-term delivery with long-term platform scalability and product vision.
* Lead initiatives that improve customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue.

**AI-Assisted Product Development**

* Build and test working prototypes to validate concepts with dealers and internal stakeholders.
* Use AI to accelerate research synthesis, competitive analysis, requirements drafting, and documentation.
* Define, scope, and measure AI-powered product capabilities, including success criteria, evaluation approaches, accuracy and reliability thresholds, and cost.
* Define requirements for how DealerOn products connect with AI through protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol), partnering with Engineering to determine which data and capabilities to expose to end users and agents.
* Assess where AI creates real value for dealers and shoppers, and where it introduces risk, before recommending it for the roadmap.

**Product Delivery**

* Lead collaboration across Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Operations from concept through launch.
* Write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, release planning, and release readiness.
* Engage with engineering team as a technical peer, weighing performance and implementation trade-offs early so they shape the solution.
* Drive launches through validation, stakeholder communication, enablement, and post-release analysis.
* Define success metrics, instrumentation, and KPI tracking with Engineering and Data teams, and monitor adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention to find improvement opportunities.

**Customer Discovery**

* Collaborate with UX team for product discovery through customer interviews, workflow analysis, usability testing, and feedback synthesis.
* Build deep knowledge of dealership operations, automotive retail workflows, digital marketing, and agency workflows.
* Translate qualitative and quantitative research into unmet needs, workflow improvements, and scalable product opportunities.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Earning trust across Product, Engineering, UX, and operational teams.
* Making decisions that reflect strong customer empathy and measurable business impact.
* Shortening the path from idea to validated concept by using AI tools to test with stakeholders early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional exp

At CEO, Product Managers and Product Leads own a portion of the organization's technology ecosystem and staff user experience with a focus on ensuring efficient, compliant, and integrated systems that minimize user friction.

The **Product Lead - Business Systems** serves as a strategic, technical, leader for CEO's financial and operations systems. This role owns the Finance and Operations platforms strategy. An immediate priority will be supporting the end-to-end execution of our Finance technological transformation with implementation partners—including the modernization of accounting, financial planning, and grants management systems. Over time, this role will oversee adjacent enterprise platforms, including Payroll, Procurement, and potentially Contracts and People Systems.

This individual serves as a crucial organizational leader, bridging strategy, operations, and technical implementation. They will work closely with business leadership, key stakeholders, IT operations and implementation partners and to co-design, configure, deploy, maintain and support these platforms. They are responsible for driving continuous improvement, navigating complex trade-offs, and managing external vendor partners to support high-quality delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Usage & Pricing
jobs.desc:
**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Usage & Pricing at Tabs — one of the most foundational and fastest-evolving parts of the platform.

Usage- and token-based pricing are becoming standard across B2B technology companies, fueled by the high cost of LLM inference and the opportunity to pass through these costs to customers. You’ll define the vision, data model, and roadmap for how Tabs handles usage, rating, and pricing — aggregating usage, calculating what’s owed against committed and overage pricing, and defining the price books/rate cards and commitments that drive it. Expect to shape technical architecture decisions directly, not just define requirements for them.

**How We Work**

* **We work hard.** Two-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. Built around intra-month product releases.
* **We work smart.** Get in front of the customer, use both data and customer feedback to drive decisions, while keeping the bigger picture in mind.
* **We work together.** In-office culture with people you want to work with. Lots of whiteboard space. Expense coffee, lunch, and dinner when in the office.

**What You’ll Work On**

**Establish pricing as a first-class product domain**

* Define and own the data model for pricing — price books/rate cards, and the quantity/pricing layer used to calculate what should be billed and recognized for revenue
* Translate real-world pricing complexity — tiering, effective-dated changes, pass-through costs, contract-level exceptions — into a data model that's flexible without becoming unmanageable
* Enable rate cards/price books to be defined once and referenced across downstream systems
* Use AI/LLM extraction to parse pricing terms — rate structures, commitments, exceptions — directly from signed contract PDFs, so the price book reflects what was actually signed without manual re-entry

**Own usage aggregation and usage commitments**

* Define how usage is aggregated and rated against contracted amount
* Own the commitment model — how drawdowns, true-ups, and overages work — in close partnership with engineering on the underlying architecture

**Deepen support for usage and AI/token-based pricing**

* Build out the pricing infrastructure needed to support third-party and usage-based pass-through costs
* Give customers visibility into how their pricing has changed over time and what they were charged and why, so usage-based invoices are self-evidently correct

**About You**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, B2B SaaS, or platform/infrastructure products
* Experience owning a data model or product layer that many downstream workflows depend on — you think in systems, not just features
* Strong technical fluency — comfortable reasoning about data modeling and architecture tradeoffs directly with engineers, including on foundational/structural decisions
* Experience owning a public or developer-facing API as a product surface — versioning, rate limits, and documentation included
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you can bring structure to an evolving problem space without needing it fully specified for you
* Exceptional cross-functional operator who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, including engineering leadership and executives
* Thrives in fast-moving, high-growth environments where scope and priorities evolve

**Strong plus**

* Familiarity with billing, revenue recognition, or the contract-to

jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager, Grantseeker**

Fluxx is looking for a strategic, systems-thinking **Senior Product Manager** to own and evolve our Grantseeker platform. This role is a great fit for someone coming from FinTech. If you've built products that move money securely and compliantly, you'll find a natural home here, helping funds reach the organizations doing mission-driven work.

We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, candid, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

**This is a full-time, exempt position open to candidates located along the East Coast, with a preference for candidates based in the New York City area. Candidates outside of New York City must be willing to travel to our Manhattan office for in-person meetings and collaboration as needed.**

**About Fluxx:**  
At Fluxx, our mission is to be the leading collaborative grant management platform in our global communities. We build technology that drives positive impact by helping foundations, government agencies, and nonprofits streamline their grants management process – on both the grantmaking and grantseeking side – helping to accelerate impact across the communities we serve.

Today, Fluxx supports a global community of 500+ customers who collectively manage and distribute more than $39B in grants annually.

**About Fluxx Grantseeker:**

Grantseeker was originally launched by Fluxx in 2017 to help nonprofits manage the grantseeking process—a market traditionally underserved by grants management software. After serving more than 3,000 nonprofits, the platform was strategically divested in 2023, rebuilt as Grantseeker Pro for larger nonprofit and public sector organizations, and re-acquired by Fluxx in November 2025.

Today, Grantseeker helps nonprofits, higher education institutions, and government organizations manage grant portfolios, deadlines, budgets, reporting, documents, and compliance in one platform. Combined with Fluxx Grantmaker, it delivers a complete end-to-end solution for organizations that both award and receive grants.

**The opportunity**

This role owns Grantseeker's product direction at a genuine inflection point - having been re-acquired by Fluxx. Grantseeker has real traction, a durable data asset, and a newly dedicated product and engineering team — and it also has a two-platform architecture to reconcile, a free-to-paid conversion motion to sharpen, and an unrealized strategic advantage in being the only grantseeker platform owned by a major grantmaker platform.

You will be the person who decides what Grantseeker becomes over the next several years. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.

#### **What you'll do:**

**Own the roadmap.** Set and defend a 12–18 month product strategy grounded in customer evidence, funnel data, competitive reality, and commercial goals and keep the org aligned to it.

**Resolve the platform question.** Grantseeker Classic and Pro run in parallel. Own consolidation end to end —feature parity, migration tooling, customer communication, sunset timeline — balancing speed against long-tenured customers' trust.

**Sharpen the product-led motion.** Own activation, conversion, retention, and expansion as product metrics. Find where free accounts stall, build what converts them, and decide what sits above/below the paywall.

**Win competitive migrations.** Own import tooling, data mapping, onboarding, and the first-week experience that determines whether a migrated account survives.

**Connect funders and seekers**. Turn Fluxx's two-sided position into a shipped product — data flow, reduced duplicate entry, shared visibility — partnering with the Grantmaker team on shared data models.

**Build on the data asset**. Turn Grantseeker's public filing data into better matching and applied AI that saves grant writers real hours, with hones

jobs.desc:
### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We've proven we can build Nodes in small quantities. This role exists to make the path to repeatable production move faster. Manufacturing Technology defines the qualification requirements for each Node manufacturing process and owns delivery of the qualified process set. You will track readiness against those requirements — maintaining visibility into where each process stands, what evidence is still outstanding, and what is blocking it — and coordinate the cross-functional execution planning that closes the gaps. Your primary deliverable is velocity: sequencing process development work, surfacing constraints before they bite, and keeping engineering effort pointed at the qualification gates that matter most to the pilot program

This role is based at our new Pilot Manufacturing campus in Vancouver, Washington — the facility where Ocean-3 Nodes stop being drawings and start being steel. We're standing up heavy fabrication, blast and coatings, and full Node integration, which means the process development work happens feet away from the weld seams and the paint booth. You'll help build the line that builds the fleet.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage project milestone schedules for pilot manufacturing process development, ensuring clear communication of status, risks, and dependencies to internal stakeholders.
* Lead design and test sprint planning for the internal manufacturing team, balancing resource constraints and competing priorities across projects.
* Drive clear-to-build decisions, closing gaps across engineering release, material availability, tooling, and work instructions ahead of build start.
* Support the transition from development to pilot production by facilitating manufacturing readiness reviews and DFM feedback to engineering.
* Collaborate with the internal procurement team, external suppliers, and fabrication partners to ensure timely, high-quality delivery of components.
* Coordinate new equipment and tooling readiness from delivery through qualification.
* Monitor and escalate program risks, while proactively contributing to mitigation strategies.
* Develop and maintain documentation and tools that support production execution and scaling, in alignment with TPM best practices.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience managing technical programs in a manufacturing process development environment, including direct responsibility for coordinating materials, equipment availability, and teams to support learning plan exe

You'll also develop the case studies and proof points that show the market why Leap is the best solution for specialty care, and share ownership of sales enablement and custom deal support. jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing (Senior Staff)
jobs.desc:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Platform Vision:** Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.
* **Unified Entitlements:** Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.
* **Pricing & Packaging Delivery:** Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.
* **Metering & Usage Visibility:** Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.
* **Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle:** Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.
* **Enterprise & Marketplace Motions:** Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.
* **Fulfillment Automation:** Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.
* **Outcomes & Measurement:** Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager-Growth
jobs.desc:
**About Us:**

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for a ***Principal Product Manager*** with strong experience in Product-Led Growth (PLG) and AI-driven product experience**.** Product Managers at Stack work closely with engineering, focusing on the product systems and experiences that help more people discover, adopt, and get lasting value from Stack. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and writing skills, the ability to envision innovative technology, and a willingness to reimagine work to be more efficient and creative. Ideal candidates combine product intuition with analytical rigor.

This role sits at the intersection of product, growth, and AI. You’ll define how our platform connects with key systems (ERPs, partners, and emerging AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude) to drive activation, adoption, and long-term customer value. You will have end-to-end ownership of integrations, from strategy and roadmap through execution and iteration.

You will play a critical role in shaping how our product evolves in an increasingly AI-driven world. We operate in a fast-moving environment and expect our PMs to actively use AI in their day-to-day work to move faster, make better decisions, and keep pace with engineering.

**What You'll Do:**

* Drive activation, repeat usage, and paid conversion across web, mobile, and desktop.
* Build and iterate the levers that move them: upsells, onboarding, upgrade flows, lifecycle, and design new agent-driven growth loops.
* Grow adoption of new products and cross-platform conversion: identify the optimal set of users, surfaces, and moments to introduce them, and drive repeat usage.
* Ship a high volume of experiments, from hypothesis and metric design through analysis, and turn the learnings into roadmap bets that grow our metrics.
* Analyze funnels, cohorts, and segments to find the highest-leverage opportunities and define the metrics behind them.
* Protect product quality while improving conversion, holding guardrails on retention, support volume, and margin.
* Write crisp specs and experiment briefs and drive execution across engineering, design, data, and marketing.
* Continuously iterate using experimentation and customer feedback

  

**What You Bring:**

* 8+ years experience working in product management within a PLG or growth-focused environment
* Strong construction domain knowledge or experience working in construction technology preferred
* Strong track record of shipping and iterating on product features tied to adoption or growth
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools in day-to-day product work
* Bachelor’s degree required

  

**Who You Are:**

* A product leader who takes ownership and drives outcomes, not just roadmap
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building from zero to one
* Highly collaborative, with strong communication across technical and non-technical teams
* Passionate about building products that solve real customer problems
* Energized by fast-paced, high-impact environments

  

**Why This Role:**

* Own a critical growth lever for the business
* High visibility and impact across product and leadership
* Opportunity to shape how our platform integrates with the next generation of AI tools and workflows
* Work in a team that values speed, ownership, and modern product practices

  

**How We Work (AI-First)**

We operate with an AI-first mindset. In this role, you are expected to:

* Actively use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools in your daily workflow
* Leverage AI for writing specs, analyzing data, synthesizing feedback, and prototyping ideas
* Continuously improve how you work by incorporating AI into your processes

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager - Novus
jobs.desc:
The Team + The Role

Software is being written faster than ever, and AI coding agents are accelerating how teams build and ship. Novus is Pendo's answer to what happens after software ships: helping fast-moving teams understand what is actually happening in their products and where to focus next. This is a new product, in a new category, for an audience Pendo has not traditionally sold to before: product engineers and application owners building AI-native software.

As Lead Product Marketing Manager for Novus, you are the marketing lead and GTM owner for the product. You own the narrative, positioning, demand strategy, community presence, launch moments, and early commercial outcomes end to end. This is a 0-to-1 role for someone who can write the playbook, execute it hands-on, and drive clarity across product, sales, marketing, and leadership.

This is a remote role in the US. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Narrative and positioning: Own the messaging, positioning, and talk tracks for Novus, including the breakthrough narrative, category story, and positioning documentation. Keep product, sales, marketing, and leadership aligned as the product and market evolve.
  • End-to-end GTM ownership: Build and run the full go-to-market plan across audience targeting, channel strategy, campaign strategy, sales readiness, launch moments, and success metrics. Own the outcomes rather than handing strategy off to another team.

You'll bring real technical depth — enough to own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration-pattern decisions (Workato versus custom AWS-native build, sync versus event-driven) yourself — while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the team's Staff Integration Engineer on deep systems design.

* Align demand intake across BTS and Workato queues into a single structured, prioritized process, giving the team and its stakeholders one holistic view of integration/automation roadmap, planning, and priorities instead of disconnected backlogs
* Partner directly with Business Technology directors and stakeholders (Finance, Supply Chain, Member Experience, Commercial, Corporate) to elicit and structure platform demand, replacing ad hoc requests with a transparent intake and prioritization process
* Own the platform's API contracts, versioning, and integration-pattern decisions (Workato vs. custom build, sync vs. event-driven, batch vs. real-time) — technical enough to make and defend these calls yourself, partnering with Enterprise Architecture and the Staff Integration Engineer on deep infrastructure and systems design

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Strategy | Contract | Remote, USA
jobs.desc:
**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

#### **The Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, for a project based assignment, with deep experience in digital strategy, customer journeys, and conversion optimization. This person will define actionable digital acquisition roadmaps, translate business needs into functional requirements, and partner closely with engineering and analytics teams to drive execution.  
The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed working sessions with technical teams. You should be able to analyze funnel performance directly, establish clear priorities, and design operating models that help teams manage competing requests effectively.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage digital acquisition strategies and roadmaps tied to measurable business goals
* Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear functional requirements
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure requirements are understood, accepted, and successfully delivered
* Analyze funnel and customer journey data to identify conversion gaps and growth opportunities
* Work directly with analytics teams to define metrics, evaluate performance, and guide decisions
* Facilitate working sessions with business, product, analytics, and technology stakeholders
* Present recommendations, progress, and strategic priorities to executive leadership
* Design intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and operating models for teams managing a high volume of requests
* Align stakeholders around clear priorities, ownership, and execution plans
* Track roadmap progress and adjust priorities based on data, business needs, and delivery constraints

#### **Requirements:**

* 10+ years of experience across digital strategy, customer journey optimization, product management, or conversion-focused work
* Demonstrated experience building digital acquisition roadmaps and driving them through execution
* Strong experience writing functional requirements that engineering teams can confidently build from
* Ability to work directly with funnel and performance data without relying solely on prepared reports
* Experience designing operating models, intake processes, or prioritization frameworks for high-demand teams
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate strategic recommendations clearly
* Ability to collaborate effectively in detailed working sessions with engineering, analytics, and IT teams
* Strong organizational, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

#### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with membership, subscription, or recurring-enrollment acquisition models
* Experience working within nonprofit, federated, or franchise environments where national and local organizations share a customer journey
* Experience supporting offerings with multiple participation tiers, products, or enrollment paths
* Familiarity with youth or family audiences and the privacy requirements associated with minors

**Employment Type:**

* Contract

#LI-Remote

* **Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time**

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Vertical Partnerships
jobs.desc:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a **Principal Product Manager** who will shape and grow Constant Contact's partner ecosystem through product innovation and strategy. This is not a Sales or Business Development role; you'll focus on identifying which partnerships create the greatest opportunities, prioritizing the integrations and experiences we build, and developing a product roadmap that connects our platform to new customers and drives meaningful business growth.

Your focus is **Vertical Partnerships**: tailoring our platform and partner experiences to the needs of specific industries, then repeating that success across several of them. Real Estate is one example. It's a vertical where our value proposition is resonating today, and it shows the kind of work involved: identifying the right partners, shaping an experience that fits the industry's workflows, and landing and expanding quickly. Our priorities will follow where the evidence is strongest, so the specific verticals will change as we learn. What stays constant is the goal of a repeatable model for entering, validating, and scaling vertical partnerships across several markets with strong market size and similar customer needs.

You'll share company goals for user acquisition, revenue, and average selling price (ASP) with Strategic Partnerships (our business development team), and you'll work across the company to deliver them. Expect daily collaboration with Design, Engineering, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Data teams, as well as external partners.

This is an individual contributor role with company-wide scope. You'll succeed by building trust and alignment with teams that have their own priorities.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and launch of partner-driven experiences across multiple industry verticals
* Build a reusable vertical model: define how we identify, validate, and enter a new vertical, and which components carry over from one to the next
* Define and ship integrations, embedded experiences, co-built offers, templates, and marketplace listings with partners including platforms, industry associations, networks and franchises, agencies, resellers, ecommerce providers, and AI companies
* Work with engineering on APIs, data flows, authentication, and integration quality, including reliability, security, and ongoing maintenance

**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. jobs.desc:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**  
  
At Accelerate Learning, we’re dedicated to engaging and inspiring STEM education for PreK-12. Our mission is to spark curiosity in the STEM classroom with programs designed by experienced teachers and STEM experts. Supporting over 9 million students and 750,000 teachers, we constantly adapt to educators’ needs and customer feedback to promote powerful teaching strategies that shape the future of STEM learning.
  
  
“For teachers, by teachers” is not a slogan—it’s a fact. Our award-winning product, STEMscopes, was incubated in the classroom and developed by over 200 teachers, science experts, and science professors.  
  
We’re scaling rapidly and investing in cutting-edge cloud technologies, AI, and modern software practices to bring STEM education into the future. Join us, and your work will directly shape how millions of students learn.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**  
  
At Accelerate Learning, we’re on a mission to transform STEM education for millions of students and teachers. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives on curiosity, customer obsession, and strategic thinking — someone who doesn’t just follow a roadmap but helps shape it.  
  
*Location: Onsite two days a week, if you live within a 45-mile radius of the Houston headquarters. Remote for those outside of the Houston metropolitan area.*  
  
  
**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**  
  
Key responsibilities include:

* Shape and refine the product roadmap in alignment with business goals and educational outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for innovation in areas such as AI, adaptive learning, and scalable SaaS solutions.
* Engage regularly with teachers, administrators, and students to understand their challenges and motivations.
* Translate educator and learner needs into actionable product requirements.
* Define clear requirements, epics, and user stories to guide development teams.
* Prioritize features and manage the product backlog in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and QA to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality solutions.
* Establish success metrics for new and existing features.
* Analyze product performance and usage data to drive iterations.
* Incorporate customer feedback to refine the product experience.
* Partner with Product Leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align on goals and priorities.
* Communicate product vision and progress effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Explore new technologies and approaches (AI, event-driven systems, adaptive learning) to keep products competitive.
* Stay informed on EdTech industry trends, instructional practices, and regulatory requirements.

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally with SaaS, EdTech, or consumer-facing products.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments — writing user stories, managing backlogs, and leading sprint rituals.
* Strong skills in gathering requirements, translating them into epics and stories, and prioritizing work for development teams.
* Data-driven mindset with ability to analyze usage patterns and customer feedback to guide iterations.
* Excellent communicator who can collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for improving education and empathy for teachers and learners.
* Curiosity to explore instructional challenges and design products that enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
* Bonus: A love of STEM.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Reporting & Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
Operators ask us questions every day. How did yesterday go? Which channel actually converts? Did the new pricing pay off, or did it just move demand around? Your job is to turn those questions into data, reports, and visuals that answer them clearly and lead to a revenue maximizing decision.
  
**You'll own Reporting & Analytics end to end:** the reports, dashboards, and insights operators use to run their business, from the general manager checking yesterday's attendance to the finance lead reconciling a month of revenue across channels, and the data models and metric definitions behind them. You'll own its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. Your job is to prove that reporting can be the front door to RocketRez: where operators start their day, and what moves them to act. You'll be measured on usage, and on the revenue operators earn from the decisions reporting drives.
  
  
**What we're building:**  
Operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day, and that trust depends on the numbers. If the reporting is wrong, late, or confusing, nothing else we build gets believed.
  
First, reporting operators trust. Core reporting on par with the best in hospitality.
  
Next, a revenue engine. Operators set revenue targets and campaigns, track their pace against them and against past seasons, and get clear options when they fall behind.
  
Then, automated revenue management. Automation keeps tracking and planning running without the operator asking. It recommends actions grounded in the operator's own history and in how similar operators are performing, and makes acting on them a single click. Season pass sales dipping? Here are three options based on this season and the last two.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
Understand the question• Spend real time with operators across roles, from general managers and finance leads to marketers and front-gate supervisors. Learn the decisions they make and the questions they need answered to make them.
  

* Design reporting that leads to a decision. Every report should make clear what it means and what to do next.

Data fluency• Prototype with real data. Write your own SQL to mock up a report or metric and put it in front of operators before engineering builds it.
  

* Own the metric definitions the platform runs on: revenue, attendance, capacity utilization, and conversion mean the same thing in every report, in every domain.
* Apply statistical judgment: seasonality, small samples, cohorts, fair comparisons, and forecasting.
* Choose the right visual for the question, and hold a high bar for clarity, accuracy, and honest scales.
* Treat data quality as product quality.
* Work with other domains so new products capture the data reporting needs before they ship.

**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut.
  

* Shape how automation and AI turn insights into recommended actions: which recommendations are trustworthy, when a human should decide, and the guardrails around both.
* Define how cross-operator benchmarks work: peer sets, minimum sample sizes, and anonymization that operators trust enough to opt into.
* Make the build, buy, and partner calls on analytics tooling, and know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing.

**What we look for:**  
The trait we care about most is adaptability. The tools and methods of product management are changing, so we hire people who have already reinvented how they work on their own initiative and will do it again.
  

* You've rebuilt how you work without being told to, including becoming AI-na

IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.

To be successful in this role, there are some requirements to visit our office locations from quarterly to a few times a quarter for workshops, team meetings and collaboration between teams. IntegriChain is on a mission to help all stakeholders in the life sciences industry drive access. This role is for a **Sr. Product Manager who wants real ownership and real impact**. You’ll operate as a decision‑maker at the center of Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and customer‑facing teams, shaping strategy while staying deeply connected to how the product is built and used.

You’ll be expected to challenge assumptions, prioritize based on evidence, and make hard tradeoffs when constraints collide.

* Wants **clear ownership** of a product area
* Is energized by **hard problems with meaningful business impact**
* Can balance **long‑term strategy with hands‑on execution**
* Earns trust by making sound decisions and delivering results

**Required Skills**
