jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Data Cooperative & Activate)
jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager (Data Cooperative & Activate)**

**Company Overview**

InfutorData, an ActiveProspect company, delivers privacy-compliant consumer identity and data solutions that help marketers find, understand, and reach the right people. Our identity graph covers roughly 250 million US consumers and 120 million households. We are now building a transparent, consent-based data cooperative for consumer lead-generation publishers, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead it from concept to launch.

**Job Summary**

As Senior Product Manager, Data Cooperative & Activate, you will own a new publisher data cooperative and the Activate product line it powers. Publishers contribute on-site and form data under clear, documented terms. In return, they receive member services such as industry analytics and benchmarking, data appends, fraud and bot detection, and identity resolution.

This is a 0-to-1 build with a direct line to revenue on an established product line. You will design the member value exchange, sign and onboard publisher members, align other product teams around a shared member offering, and work with Engineering and Data to deliver the collection script, data feeds, and member services. You will work closely with Legal, Privacy, Sales, Finance, and an outside consulting firm, with regular exposure to executive leadership.

The role is an equal blend of partnership and product management. You should be as comfortable negotiating a data-sharing agreement with a publisher as you are writing acceptance criteria with an engineer.

**Responsibilities:**

**Co-op Strategy & Member Value Exchange**
------------------------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the publisher data cooperative.
* Define what members contribute and what they receive, including tiering (for example, Core and Premium) based on publisher discovery.
* Build and test member value propositions; decide which benefits lead and how to prove their value.
* Scope and launch member industry analytics (benchmarking and trend reporting) with the Data team, protecting each member's data in aggregate reporting.
* Model co-op economics and data-licensing value to inform packaging, pricing inputs, and investment decisions.

**Publisher Partnerships**
--------------------------

* Own the publisher pipeline from discovery through signed member agreement and onboarding.
* Lead conversations with publisher members and prospects on value exchange, integration, and data-use terms.
* Facilitate a Publisher Advisory Board to validate the model and gather ongoing feedback.
* Work with Legal and outside advisors to standardize member agreements and data-use terms.
* Select and launch pilot publishers, then scale membership month over month.

**Cross-Product Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Inventory existing products that can be offered to members (for example, API data appends, identity resolution, fraud and bot scoring).
* Partner with other product managers on what is included, at what tier, and on what timeline.
* Define packaging, entitlements, and member-facing positioning for bundled services.
* Identify new data products and member services that can be built on co-op data.

**Activate Product Line**
-------------------------

* Own the Activate roadmap, pricing inputs, and inventory health.
* Plan the transition of current Activate data sources into the co-op model so inventory holds during cutover.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on revenue attribution and commercial performance.

**Execution & Delivery**
------------------------

* Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with Engineering and Data for the collection script, scheduled data feeds, and member services.
* Define POC scope and success criteria with Data and Engineering.
* Work through dependencies across data infrastructure, identity, and integration teams.
* Build privacy into the program by design, including publisher notice

##### Senior Technical Product Manager, IT Service Management

[Oura](https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Oura?campaignid=mobvjcmp&from=mobviewjob&tk=1k67mj91ni970800&fromjk=9a6abe0577196476)

Remote

Remote

$117,000 - $169,000 a year

Apply on company site

#### Job details

$117,000 - $169,000 a year

Parental leave, Health insurance, Paid time off, Employee discount, Vision insurance, Dental insurance, Paid sick time

Remote

#### Full job description

Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Product Manager to own Oura's IT service management (ITSM) and employee service management (ESM) platforms. You will lead our move off a legacy ITSM tool to a modern, AI-native platform, then bring service management to teams like HR, Finance, Legal, and Security on whichever platform or platforms fit them best. You will be fluent in ITSM theory, comfortable evaluating tools without bias, and willing to roll up your sleeves to configure, integrate, and ship. Above all, you will care about the people on the other side of every request and work to make getting help easy and seamless.

### **What You Will Do:**

- Lead the migration from our legacy ITSM platform to a modern, AI-native one, from data model, workflow, and catalog design through integrations, cutover, and decommission, with no loss in service levels or employee satisfaction
- Be the voice of the employee. Design requests, catalog items, and knowledge from the worker's point of view so getting help is easy and frictionless, and use feedback and service data to keep removing friction
- Own the platform as a product: a single roadmap and backlog, clear intake, and prioritization criteria that every service team can see and trust

Seven Starling is revolutionizing women's behavioral health through our clinically-validated virtual care platform. As a venture-backed, rapidly scaling startup at the forefront of maternal healthcare innovation, we've developed a groundbreaking clinical model that combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat perinatal mood disorders. Our approach delivers exceptional results — 90% of patients experience clinically significant symptom improvement.

We've established strategic partnerships with leading health plans including UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna, plus a growing network of OBGYN clinics nationwide, positioning us for accelerated growth in the $50B+ women's behavioral health market.

### **About the role**

We’re hiring for a **Senior Product Manager** — a strategic, execution-minded builder who will be a core member of our Product team. This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the VP of Product and partnering closely with the engineering team and cross-functional roles to design and scale the systems and experiences that power our precision mental health care model.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience in product management and thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. We're looking for a mission-driven and resourceful self-starter who excels at turning complex problems into clear, scalable solutions. You should be a strong communicator, deeply curious about user needs, and comfortable experimenting with AI tools to build systems and documentation from the ground up. Experience in digital health and early stage startup environments is strongly preferred.

If you're an experienced product professional with a strong commitment to our mission, we want to hear from you. Join us in paving the way for expanded access to high-quality women's mental healthcare!

### **What you'll do**

* **Own our end-to-end product development process**, from user research and scoping to execution, QA, and post-launch measurement and iteration
* **Conduct deep user research** with patients, clinicians, referring providers, and internal team members to understand their pain points and needs
* **Develop clear, actionable PRDs and prototypes** to define product specs and workflows that meet the needs of cross-functional stakeholders and set clear objectives for the engineering team to execute on
* **Lead product launches,** partnering closely with engineering, operations, and clinical leads on training, documentation, and process updates to ensure seamless rollout and adoption of new products and tools

* **Own the tools that run our patient journey,** from third-party survey and communication platforms, to EHR templates and the automations tied to scheduling, screening, and care coordination

* **Use AI tools** to accelerate your own work and continuously innovate on how we build as a team, from research and documentation to prototyping and design

* **Define and monitor success metrics** for core tools and services that we build, including data analysis, dashboard creation, and company-wide impact reporting

* **Partner with our VP of Product and other senior leaders** to inform roadmap planning and strategic prioritization

### **Who you are**

* You are a **senior-level individual contributor (IC)** with 5+ years of experience in product management, ideally with a significant portion of that time in digital health
* You have a track record of **owning complex, cross-functional products** from problem definition to launch
* You’re comfortable with **ambiguous, early-stage environments**, and excited to be a part of a small team developing product strategy, process, and tools
* You’re both **empathetic and systems-oriented** — equally energized by speaking with users and by designing scalable, backend workflows

* You actively **use AI tools to move faster** — you’ve used agentic tools to actually build or prototype, not just ask questions

### **Who We Are**

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

**Description**

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager**, you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt's Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises.

You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact.

**What You Would Do**

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

* **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics.
* **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements.
* **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
* **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
* **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation.
* **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows.
* **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes.

Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  
  
Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  
  
We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  
  
Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software.

At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns!

For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring.

This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system.

## Description:

**About Midea America:**

Midea America Corp., is one of the world’s largest home appliance brands, offering the most comprehensive selection of products in the world to fully serve the needs of day-to-day living at home, at work, or anywhere else you go. In North America we strive to aim high, put the customer first, transform and innovate the marketplace, utilizing our commitment, dedication, inclusion, and partnership with our teams. Midea America is a subsidiary of the Midea Group, a global company with over 150,000 employees and operations in more than 195 countries. As a publicly listed company, we are ranked #245 as a Fortune Global 500 company and offer one of the most comprehensive product portfolios in the industry.

**Overview:**

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Sr Product Managerto lead our Room Air Conditioning (RAC) category, covering window ACs, portable ACs, and dehumidifiers. Reporting directly to the Product Marketing Director, you will serve as the commercial and strategic expert for the RAC portfolio in the U.S. market.

In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end product lifecycle management, portfolio strategy, product positioning, pricing, and channel expansion. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, R&D, and Global HQ, you will drive initiatives to protect our market leadership while launching innovative products to capture new growth opportunities from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**_Strategic Category Management & Execution_**

- **P&L & Business Growth:** Own category revenue, volume, and margin targets. Manage expense ratios, optimize product mix, and maintain healthy inventory levels through aligned PSI (Production, Sales, Inventory) forecasting.
- **Strategic Business Planning:** Develop, align, and execute comprehensive business plans and go-to-market strategies tailored to the U.S. market.
- **Process Improvement:** Identify and implement cross-departmental workflows to enhance category efficiency and speed to market.

**_Product Planning & Lifecycle Management_**

- **Portfolio & Positioning Strategy:** Partner with R&D, Design, and Quality teams to define local product lineup logic, positioning, feature sets, and pricing strategies for New Product Development (NPD).
- **Lifecycle Oversight:** Manage the full product lifecycle from launch to end-of-life (EOL) transitions, using targeted promotional budgets and sell-through strategies to maximize profitability.
- **Global Collaboration:** Coordinate technical, regulatory, and localized feature requirements directly with Global HQ and R&D teams.

**_Go-To-Market & Channel Enablement_**

- **New Product Launches:** Lead the end-to-end launch process, collaborating with Marketing Communications to develop launch briefs, digital assets, retail enablement tools, and channel activation plans.
- **Sales & Channel Support:** Serve as the product marketing partner for internal sales and external distributor teams. Ensure channels are equipped with technical specifications, marketing collateral, promotional materials, and field training assets.
- **Market Intelligence:** Serve as the U.S. market expert on HVAC/RAC trends, competitive movements, pricing shifts, consumer insights, and regulatory changes.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
- Minimum of 6 years of experience in product marketing or product management. Experience in Room AC, Home Appliances, or the DIY retail channel is strongly preferred.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, spec

jobs.desc:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers
* Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to help communicate product value and priorities to internal teams, including sales and marketing
Foster healthy culture, support and collaboration for a distributed team  

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Translate requirements from customers and defining the product functionality according to wider customer needs
* Inform senior stakeholders on progress and raise risks to the appropriate level
* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

Additionally, you are responsible for steering the product's overall strategy to ensure it aligns with long-term vision and promotes future growth.

**This is a remote position within the USA. You may be expected to travel occasionally.**

--------------------

**Staff Product Manager**
=========================

**This is a remote position.**  
**JOB ID #985**

Ad Hoc is a technology company that empowers organizations to deliver scalable, impactful digital services. Using modern, agile methods, our team creates products that meet people’s needs and transform their experience of government.

**Work on things that matter**

Our collaborations have shaped some of the defining moments in public-sector service delivery. We’ve helped build products that connect Veterans to tailored services, help millions access affordable health care, and support important programs like Head Start. As we work with agencies to deliver critical services, we’re also changing how the government approaches technology.

**Built for a remote life**

Our culture, communications, and tools are built for remote work, enabling us to bring together top talent nationwide. At Ad Hoc, remote life empowers our teams to design work environments that fit their lives and that foster flexibility and collaboration to achieve positive outcomes for our customers.

**Committed to high expectations and a welcoming culture**

Ad Hoc values acceptance, accountability, and humility. We aren’t heroes. We learn from our mistakes and improve the process for the next time. We build small, inclusive teams to collaborate closely with our partners to solve the right problems and deliver software that works.

The Staff Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping product strategy, guiding product development, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes across complex digital services and technology initiatives.

NOTE: this position can be remote anywhere within the United States.

As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders.

What you will do:

  • Define and drive the product roadmap for ClickHouse Cloud, with a focus on cloud-native database capabilities such as multi-region replication, distributed query execution, fault tolerance, storage tiering, and schema evolution.

  • Collaborate with engineering to prioritize and deliver improvements to the core database engine, storage layer, and query optimizer, ensuring the Cloud offering keeps pace with open-source and enterprise use cases.

  • Engage directly with customers, gathering insights through interactions, feedback, and market research to guide product decisions.

  • Work alongside design, marketing, operations, and sales teams to support feature launches, contribute to blog posts, and help shape product positioning and messaging.

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related communications, effectively managing expectations and keeping stakeholders informed.

About You:

  • Minimum 8+ years of product management experience with a strong background in cloud-based SaaS products. Deep familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, or real-time analytics platforms is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning.

  • Experience working with databases such as ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or other columnar databases.

  • Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design.

  • Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working and scaling open source technologies

  • Prior experience at a startup

 
 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values

jobs.desc:
As a Product Manager for Spot, you help design, build, and ship Boston Dynamics’ end-to-end robotic solutions, including software and hardware features, service offerings, and go-to-market plans. In this role, you will manage the enterprise hardware product initiatives for Spot and its ecosystem. This offers a rare opportunity to manage a highly successful product through its lifecycle evolution and gain broad, hands-on exposure while collaborating closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams.

  

You’ll help drive component enhancements, manage EOLs, gather and refine requirements, contribute to roadmap planning, and support execution from concept through launch. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to grow in responsibility in a way that aligns best with your strengths and interests. The successful Product Manager in this role is curious, organized, and eager to learn; ready to define the tactical initiatives that deliver against the strategic plan. This role sits at the intersection of many teams, balancing the needs of internal and external stakeholders to deliver the best results for our customers. This role is onsite in Waltham, MA, and will require occasional travel to remain closely aligned with market and customer needs.

  

Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.

  

**Day to day activities:**

* Gather and synthesize qualitative and quantitative data to identify product gaps, validate hypotheses, and inform requirements
* Rigorously prioritize features versus sustaining initiatives
* Work directly with customers (remotely and on-site) to understand workflows, pain points, and success criteria
* Work directly with supply chain and operations teams to creatively approach problems and develop sustainable solutions
* Support prioritization across competing initiatives by analyzing impact, effort, risk, and customer value
* Review product usage data and metrics to assess feature performance and inform iteration and pivot
Support the development of business plans, pricing models, service plans, and other go-to-market components critical to scaling our quadruped solutions in partnership with senior PMs and GTM teams  

  

**Desired skills:**

* Minimum 2 years of experience as a product manager *or* in a relevant industry *or* in a relevant academic program
* Proven ability to conduct comprehensive market research, including segmentation, sizing, and competitive landscape assessments
* Conceptual understanding of market dynamics and product-market fits
* Exceptional ability to synthesize complex data sets into clear, actionable market insights and recommendations
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments typical of early-stage commercial companies
* High level of curiosity, drive and autonomy
* Excellent skills in collaboration, prioritization, documentation, and communication
* Experience in supply chain management, operations, hardware development, and/or product commercialization is strongly preferred
Fluency in multiple languages is a plus  

  

**Travel:**

* Occasional travel to customer sites and regions of interest
Otherwise, this role is expected to be onsite  

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

The base pay range for this position is between $135,000 to $165,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Confluence Aggregation
jobs.desc:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities:

**About the team**
------------------

Confluence is where organizations write down what they know: decisions, architecture, process, and policy. But a company's work does not happen in one tool. It happens in file drives, chat, code hosts, CRMs, and data platforms.

The Aggregation team makes Confluence fill and organize itself from those tools. Content arrives with its source system's permissions intact, gets organized so a team can navigate it, and stays current as the underlying work changes. That content is what Confluence's AI answers are built on, which makes its coverage and quality the difference between an answer a team acts on and one they go verify by hand.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how Confluence turns connected content into knowledge that maintains itself: what a space pulls in, how it gets organized, how it stays current, and when it flags that something important is missing. Vision through launch and iteration, on problems that arrive undefined.

Quality is the job here, not a stage of it. Content that is stale, mis-grouped, or wrong does more damage than content that was never connected at all, because a team will have already acted on it.

You are building for three audiences, and the role requires you to name which one you are serving in every decision: the admin who approves connecting a system of record and will disconnect it the moment trust breaks, the space owner accountable for a body of knowledge staying current, and the end user who wants the answer without knowing which tool it came from.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for what connected content becomes inside Confluence: what gets pulled in, how it is grouped, titled, and summarized, and what happens to content that has gone stale or contradicts a published page.
* Define how messy inputs become usable structure. Documents, spreadsheets, meeting transcripts, chat threads, and CRM records do not arrive as pages, and deciding what shape they take in Confluence is the core of the work.
* Own freshness and decay. Decide what updates on its own when a source changes, what needs a human to confirm, and how a user can tell which one they are looking at.

jobs.desc:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, helping brands, CPGs, and retailer partners reach shoppers with relevant, effective advertising across the Instacart platform. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll own the Formats domain, where we place 0 1 bets that fuel double-digit growth for Ads and keep CPGs and new advertiser types engaged.

jobs.desc:
MarginEdge is seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our new Operator Tools team — the group responsible for helping restaurants understand and control their costs, and ultimately manage their restaurants better.

The team organizes around problems that define a restaurant's costs and operating workflows. We worry about things like what restaurants spend to bring goods in the door and the ordering workflow behind it; what it costs for the restaurant to make a dish and the recipe and prep workflows that produce it. We take the data a restaurant already has and turn it into insights and automations that drive savings, while giving operators hours back in their week. We believe that a number sitting in a report has limited value; helping operators turn those numbers into action is our job.

You will work closely with external stakeholders — restaurant owners, GMs, head chefs, managers, accountants and bartenders — and translate their pain points to the MarginEdge engineering, design, operations, sales, and marketing teams. The ideal candidate has a “buck stops here” mentality, where you take responsibility for ensuring that all the stakeholders are put in a position to succeed, and you proactively anticipate the concerns of both customers and your team.

**MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology**

Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture-backed and serve 12,000+ restaurants across the US and Canada.

We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them.

We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Data & AI Platform team and own the algorithmic systems that sit underneath dozens of downstream product features and quietly decide what gets prioritized, surfaced, and trusted across ServiceTitan.


This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who thinks in statistics, not just user stories. The specific problems you'll own will shift based on what domain teams and our customers need most — today that might mean ranking methodology, deduplication logic, or causal inference; tomorrow it could be a different statistically-driven problem entirely. What stays constant is the kind of thinking: translating ambiguous, statistically messy problems into clear product requirements that engineering and ML can build against with confidence. This is a heavily stats-driven PM role: you'll be evaluating model tradeoffs, defining what "correct" means for a given system, and defending methodology choices to a technical audience as much as you'll be writing a roadmap.


What you'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for whichever algorithmic systems — ranking, deduplication, causal inference, or similar — are highest-priority based on domain team and customer need.
  • Translate real customer pain (bad matches, untrustworthy rankings, wrong conclusions drawn from correlated data) into statistically rigorous product requirements.
  • Co-author PRDs for statistically ambiguous problems where the "right answer" isn't obvious — you're defining the evaluation criteria as much as the solution.
  • Partner with ML and engineering to evaluate model tradeoffs (precision/recall, false positive cost, explainability vs. accuracy) and make the product call when there's no clean answer.
  • Set measurable, multi-quarter goals for algorithmic system health and lead cross-functional teams toward them with rigor.
  • Lead discovery with domain product teams and customers to understand where algorithmic errors actually cost time, money, or trust.
  • Proactively identify and resolve disagreements over methodology, ownership, and model quality before they stall multiple teams building on your systems.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, strong track record in enterprise B2B SaaS; experience with at least one of ranking/recommendation systems, entity resolution, or causal inference — this role will likely touch more than one over time.
  • Genuine statistical fluency — comfortable with precision/recall tradeoffs, confounding vs. causation, and model evaluation, regardless of which specific problem you're applied to.
  • Demonstrated ability to define evaluation criteria and "what correct looks like" for a new statistical problem from scratch, rather than working from an existing rubric.
  • Comfort context-switching between different algorithmic domains as customer and business priorities shift.
  • Experience translating customer-reported problems (bad matches, low trust in recommendations, wrong conclusions) into statistically defined product work.
  • Strong communication skills — explaining model tradeoffs to domain PMs, ML engineers, and customers who each need a different level of technical detail.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and holds themselves accountable to outcomes — "mostly works" isn't good enough when customers are trusting your systems with real decisions.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.

Why This Role Matters:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Virtual Care
jobs.desc:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Virtual Care to join our Product team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

  

**About the role:**

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead product development for Oscar Virtual Care (OVC), improving how members access care and how clinicians deliver it. Your work will span the experience before, during, and after a visit, from intake and scheduling to clinical documentation, treatment, and follow-up.

Oscar brings together a health plan and its own care delivery organization, creating an opportunity to connect product decisions directly to the cost and quality of care. You'll work with clinical and business partners to identify where technology can help members get the care they need. This includes improving access to virtual care and health assessments, supporting effective clinical workflows, and reducing administrative work for care teams.

You'll turn ambiguous problems into a clear product direction, align partners around priorities, and work with engineering, design, and data science to deliver and measure results.

You will report into a Director, Product Management.

**Work Location:** This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: San Francisco, CA. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

**Pay Transparency:** The base pay for this role is: $163,944.00 - $215,176.50 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Virtual Care. Prioritize investments based on their expected impact on affordability, clinical outcomes, member experience, and operating efficiency.
* Lead discovery with members, clinicians, and operations teams. Combine user research with data analysis to identify problems, challenge assumptions, and build a business case for product investments.
* Improve the member journey from finding and accessing care through the visit and follow-up. Reduce friction in intake and scheduling, improve visit completion, and help care teams share context and coordinate next steps.
* Build tools that help clinicians deliver high-quality care efficiently, including reviewing medical history, documenting encounters, addressing care gaps, and ordering appropriate tests and treatments. Evaluate opportunities for AI and automation to reduce administrative work while maintaining clinical quality.
* Define success metrics and measure the clinical, financial, and operational impact of product changes. Use findings to refine priorities and improve the experience after launch.
* Lead alignment across clinical, operations, engineering, design, and data science partners. Bring clear recommendations, work through competing needs and tradeoffs, and establish decisions that move the work forward.
* Own complex initiatives from problem definition through delivery. Write clear requirements, manage dependencies and risks, and resolve issues across teams with the autonomy expected of a Senior Product Manager.
* Invest in strengthening the talent on Oscar's product team, by developing more junior team members through mentorship.
* Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* 6+ years of experience collaborating cross-functionally among engineers, designers, operations experts, and others in a Product Management or Product Management-adjacent role.
* 4+ years of experience in driving rigorous prioritization processes.
*

**Job Purpose/Summary**

The Product Manager (PM) owns the business and customer-facing product vision for Knowmadics' 360 Space platform, an API-first, cloud-native data platform for telemetry data ingest, entity and track management, data retrieval and delivery, and domain awareness capabilities through a user-centered front-end. Space and satellite data is the first domain the platform supports; the Product Manager is responsible for identifying the standardized, domain-agnostic core of the platform and extending it to additional domains. This role is the primary link between the market (Sales, Business Development, prospective and current customers) and the product roadmap: understanding who will buy and use 360 Space capabilities, validating product-market fit, and translating that understanding into clear, prioritized product direction.

This role owns overall product priorities and is accountable for the unified product vision and roadmap for our telemetry data platform technologies and product portfolio, beginning with the Space domain, and delivers on that by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering/Tech Lead, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) Lead, and Project Manager as trusted peers, each bringing deep expertise in their own domain. The Product Manager is expected to actively synthesize business, technical, and user-experience perspectives into a single, well-communicated direction, and to keep the broader team aligned and motivated around it. The Product Manager will work closely with the Project Manager, who governs schedule and budget constraints and decisions, to keep product development on track and within budget. This role carries the flexibility to absorb related product scope over time, including additional data domains and AI/ML-enabled features, as Knowmadics' product portfolio matures.

What this Role Owns: Product Vision Roadmap, Product-Market Fit Analysis, Product Scope and Priorities (e.g., Functional Requirements, User Stories), Domain Expansion Strategy (identifying the standardized core platform vs. domain-specific needs, External Customer and User Engagement Strategy, Internal Cross-Team Stakeholder (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Business Development, C-Suite) Communications.

What the Technical Lead Owns: Engineering Implementation Strategy and Prioritization, Technical Architecture Decisions, Development Sequencing, Resource (Staff, Data, Equipment) Requirements and Priorities.

What the Project Manager Owns: Funded R&D milestone and deliverable tracking and prioritization, subcontractor management, external (e.g., US Government) R&D sponsor / stakeholder management, product development schedule tracking and adjustments (e.g., push release to accommodate new feature or hold release to hit deadline), product budget tracking and adjustments.

Core America provides consulting expertise and software that help facility-management and cleaning organizations operate cleaner, healthier, and safer facilities. Our customers include leading institutions, universities, businesses, and other organizations managing complex facility operations.

Our software supports inspections, reporting, work management, and performance improvement. Because Core America offers both software and professional services, we have a valuable opportunity to turn deep industry expertise and recurring customer needs into scalable software capabilities.

**The opportunity**

Core America is seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape product decisions and lead the execution, adoption, and continued improvement of our product portfolio.

This person will work at the intersection of customers, consulting, business strategy, software engineering, and data. They will uncover the problems behind customer and internal requests, evaluate opportunities against Core America’s goals, and translate strategic priorities into a clear roadmap and well-defined product initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with practical execution. They are curious, creative, and adaptable as AI changes how product and engineering teams work. · Learn how facility management and cleaning operations work and represent the customer’s perspective in product decisions.

· Work with customers, subject-matter experts, and engineers to design, test, and launch AI-powered features.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — US Tax
jobs.desc:
Caseware combines over 35 years of industry expertise with AI-powered technology to transform how audit and accounting professionals work. Serving organizations across 130 countries, we bring intelligent automation directly into audit and financial reporting workflows—helping professionals reduce manual work, navigate complexity, and focus on informed decisions. Join our global team and help build technology that strengthens trust in financial information.

As Senior Product Manager, US Tax, you own the product strategy, roadmap, and success of Caseware's US tax solutions: the compliance and provision work US firms carry out, how it connects to the accounting and assurance work already running in Caseware, and where Caseware integrates with the wider US tax technology stack.

You'll be reporting into: Head of Solutions, US

A US CPA in good standing is a hard requirement. This role will require some travel.

### **What you will be doing:**

Strategy and roadmap

* Own the product strategy for Caseware's US tax solutions and keep it aligned with the overall product and company vision.

* Define what should be built for the US tax market, for whom, and the opportunity it addresses.

* Own the roadmap: what goes on it, in what sequence, and what each item needs to ship successfully.

* Define the requirements, scope, and success measures for each item before work starts.

* Work through the delivery teams to get roadmap items built.

* Produce the product case behind each recommendation, including the opportunity and the investment required.

* Own the product requirements for third-party tax integrations.

Market and customers

* Be the internal expert on US tax practice: federal and multi-state compliance, the forms, and firm workflow.

* Interpret IRS and state guidance, and legislative change with a compliance impact, and get it onto the roadmap before it is effective.

* Know the US tax software landscape and what firms already run.

* Spend time with firms of every size and and shape roadmap based upon customer need and highest value impact

* Represent the product with firm advisory groups and industry bodies.

Quality and compliance

* Treat compliance accuracy as a deliverable rather than an assumption.

* Set the bar a tax solution must meet before it ships.

Go-to-market and commercial

* Work with go-to-market teams on positioning, launch, enablement, and the success of the solutions you own in market.

* Provide the product view into pricing and packaging for those solutions.

### **What you will bring:**

* A US CPA in good standing, with a strong interest in technology.

* 7+ years in US tax practice, or combined US tax practice and product management experience.

* Deep knowledge of US federal and multi-state compliance across pass-throughs, corporates, and individuals, and the ability to read and interpret future guidance.

* Familiarity with the US tax software market.

* Experience delivering through teams you do not manage.

* Able to define requirements from which engineering and content teams can build.

* Experience prioritizing and planning across competing demands, and surfacing risk early rather than late.

* Able to set out priorities and the evidence behind them to a senior audience.

* A lifelong learner, self-motivated to stay current with professional standards and changes in the tax profession.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Vendor Relations
jobs.desc:
KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Manager – Vendor Relations owns the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of material handling and warehouse automation solutions, with primary emphasis on managing and growing the OEM, technology, and equipment vendor relationships that underpin those offerings. Because these solutions only deliver value once vendor hardware and software are working reliably inside the company's and customers' systems, this role also owns the software integration requirements that make multi-vendor solutions function as one system — defining API contracts, data exchange standards, and technical acceptance criteria alongside the commercial relationship. This role serves as the strategic and technical bridge between engineering, IT, sales, operations, and external partners — including robotics and automation OEMs, WMS/WES/WCS providers, and equipment/parts suppliers — ensuring product commitments align with vendor capabilities, integration feasibility, contract terms, and long-term partnership health. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with deep comfort negotiating, managing, and growing multi-vendor ecosystems, and enough technical fluency in software integration (APIs, data interfaces, middleware) to evaluate vendor claims and de-risk integration in a complex, integration-heavy industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Relations & Partnership Management (Primary Focus)**

* Serve as the primary product-side point of contact for OEM and technology vendors (e.g., robotics, AS/RS, conveyance, WMS/WES/WCS, controls) throughout the partnership lifecycle.
* Lead vendor evaluation, onboarding, and tiering processes; negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and roadmap commitments alongside Procurement and Legal.
* Own the vendor scorecard process — tracking reliability, cost, lead time, quality, and roadmap alignment — and drive corrective action plans with underperforming partners.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key suppliers and technology partners to secure preferential pricing, priority allocation, and early access to new capabilities.
* Coordinate joint go-to-market activities, co-development initiatives, and technology roadmap alignment sessions with strategic vendors.
* Manage vendor contract renewals, escalations, and dispute resolution in partnership with Legal and Finance, protecting margin and delivery commitments.
* Represent the company at vendor summits, industry trade shows (MODEX, ProMat, MHI events), and partner advisory boards.

**Software & Systems Integration (Vendor Interoperability**)

* Own the technical requirements and acceptance criteria for integrating vendor-supplied software and hardware (robotics controllers, WMS/WES/WCS, PLC/controls) with internal platforms and customer environments, partnering closely with Engineering and IT.
* Define and document API contracts, data exchange formats (e.g., REST/SOAP, EDI, MQTT), and middleware requirements needed for vendor systems to interoperate reliably with company and customer software stacks.

jobs.desc:
**WHY JOIN ALO?**

Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**

You will own the product discovery domain — everything from home, search, and browse through PLP, PDP, and the moment a customer decides to add an item to their cart — as the single point of product accountability for how customers discover and decide what to buy: searching or browsing for inspiration, filtering and comparing products, reading reviews, evaluating sizing and fit, and clicking add to cart. You'll partner closely with Site Merchandising, who curate what's featured and how the catalog is presented, while you own the underlying search, browse, and product page experience and functionality that makes that curation effective. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of Engineering, Product/UX Design, Site Merchandising, and Marketing, with real influence over conversion, discovery quality, and how confidently customers buy.

**Responsibilities**

* Own Shop end-to-end — home, search, browse, PLP, PDP, and the add-to-cart action — as the single point of product accountability for the space.

* Responsible for setting and leading the roadmap for Shop, from discovery through delivery, in tight day-to-day partnership with the Shop Engineering team's leadership.

* Accountable for defining and tracking the success metrics for Shop—including search success and conversion, zero-results rate, filter and refinement effectiveness, PLP-to-PDP click-through, add-to-cart rate, and AOV—and for measuring the customer and business impact of what you ship, not simply whether it shipped on time.

* Lead roadmap development and planning for Shop: translate business priorities into a sequenced, prioritized roadmap, and clearly communicate the trade-offs behind it.

* Partner diplomatically with Site Merchandising, Marketing, and other business stakeholders to align on priorities and scope — comfortable negotiating trade-offs, sequencing and deferring lower-priority requests, and keeping the team focused on the highest-impact work.

* Manage and influence the third-party vendors central to product discovery (e.g., search, personalization, recommendations platform; ratings and reviews provider) — pushing for roadmap alignment and product enhancements, and monitoring outcomes against the experience they support.

* Partner with Product peers on the Buy and Native App teams to align roadmaps and sequencing wherever initiatives span domains.

* Bring hands-on fluency in Shopify's storefront and content architecture, and the broader vendor ecosystem, to evaluate build-vs-buy decisions and navigate platform dependencies.

* Maintain a sharp understanding of international and localized discovery complexity — market-specific catalogs, assortments, and content.

* Alongside your UX Design partner, own the presentation, structure, and experience of product information — sizing/fit, materials, and shipping and returns details — as the lever for purchase conviction: the clearer and more usable that information is, the more confidently customers add to cart, and the less likely they are to return.

* Ensure your Engineering and Design teammates are solving the right underlying problem, not just working a features backlog — go beyond the symptom to the root cause.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 6+ years in product management, with meaningful time owning product discovery surfaces — site search, browse, or PDP — end-to-end.

* **Retail E-Commerce Background:** Proven track record in retail e-commerce, ideally at a DTC or omnichannel apparel/lifestyle brand with an elevated customer experience bar.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.desc:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.  
  
**This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

**About the Role**

You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.

You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.

**What You’ll Do**

**Reporting & Insight**

* Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.
* Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

**Attribution & Incrementality**

* Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.
* Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.
* Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

**Activation**

* Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.
* Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance more spend” flywheel.
* Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.
* Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

**What You Need**

* 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.
* Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.
* Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.
* A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.
* Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.desc:
Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

REMOTE, United States

JOB OVERVIEW

Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. 

Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Member Experience (Contract)
jobs.desc:
### **Who are we?**

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years, we've been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and a healthy dose of Foolish fun. We're a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we're driven by the impact our work has on real people's financial futures.

### **The Role**

Once someone becomes a Motley Fool member, the product they use every day is what earns their renewal. Our vision moves us from stock picks to a full investing system and platform experience, this role owns building it.

As a Product Manager for Member Experience, you'll own the daily product surface — dashboard, portfolio tools, personalization, and mobile — built on top of the AI scoring and research engine our Intelligence team maintains.

### **What you'll do**

* With your cross-functional team, own member engagement as your core metric, the product-side driver of renewal.
* Anchor the Member Platform team (web and app). You own its backlog and the quality of the member-facing product: dashboard, portfolio tools, community, and mobile app roadmap.
* Own onboarding and activation — get new members to their first valuable action fast, so the value they signed up for lands in the first days, not weeks. This is where early renewal is won or lost.
* Build personalized experiences on top of our AI scoring engine, the right research and insight for the right member, partnering with our Intelligence team, who provide the underlying AI/scoring APIs — keeping personalization on the right side of the line between helpful and regulated investment advice.
* Design and ship features that turn a "read the email" habit into a daily or weekly product habit, across both the in-product and email experience.
* Run a continuous member-research and usage-analytics practice, so decisions are grounded in behavior, not assumption, and feed what you learn into offering and packaging decisions with our commercial and domain experts.
* Write specs precise enough for engineers and AI agents to build against, and bring a business case to our weekly product review. This is a decision-making forum, not a status update.

### **What we're looking for**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on a consumer or subscription product with a strong engagement/retention focus
* A committed active investor with real skin in the game — you understand our members because you are one
* Experience building personalized or recommendation-driven product experiences is a strong plus
* AI-native working style — comfortable prototyping fast and working alongside AI agents day to day
* A strong product sense for daily-habit, engagement-driven experiences
* Strong stakeholder management — you'll work across engineering, design, and the Intelligence team every week
* Comfortable partnering with other product teams as well as marketing

**Compensation:**

Below is our target hourly rate. While we are budget conscious, we're also eager to find the right person for this role, so if your target is outside of this range, please don't hesitate to apply and we'd be happy to have a conversation.

*By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our* *Applicant Privacy Notice* *for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.*

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Product Manager owns a KWI product area end to end. You will evolve what clients run today and define where the product goes next. You are accountable for what it delivers, not only for what ships: adoption across the client base, measurable gains for the retailers using it, and a delivery pace the team can hold.

This is a hands-on role on a small product team. You will work directly with the retail teams who use your product every day, with engineering and design, and with the client-facing teams who see the problems first, in an AI-led, spec-driven development model.

**The Company**

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a complete, unified commerce solution, specifically designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, CRM, and Loyalty into one cloud-based platform. **AI at KWI**

We are serious about AI. Not as a buzzword, but as a real part of how we work. We expect every member of our team to actively use AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and do more with less. We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone who can walk us through how they use it day to day: in their current role, in how they organize their work, and in how they solve problems. **Join Our Team at HuFriedyGroup – Innovating Excellence in Dental Instrument Manufacturing**

HuFriedyGroup is a leading manufacturer of dental instruments and infection prevention products. Our 10,000-plus products, hand-crafted by highly skilled artisans, are known for their precision, performance, longevity, reliability, and quality. To help dental professionals be The Best in Practice, HuFriedyGroup provides a unique combination of world class products, value-added services, clinical education, and dental community platforms that result in superior clinician performance and enhanced safety for dental professionals and their patients. Working at HuFriedyGroup is so much more than a job, as every employee has a part in driving and supporting the organization’s inspirational vision to be a global force in advancing dental performance through Best-In-Practice dentistry that improves lives around the world.

**About the job**
-----------------

HuFriedyGroup is creating a new Senior Digital Product Manager role dedicated to our Dental Service Organization (DSO) customer segment. DSOs are among the fastest-growing and most strategically important customers in dentistry, and they buy, operate, and measure value differently than independent practices: through multi-location parent/child account hierarchies, centralized procurement, contract pricing, and system-to-system integration. This individual will own the roadmap for implementing digital solutions for DSO customers, which may include eProcurement, eCommerce, DSO portals, and DSO-specific digital service offerings. This is a foundational role: there is no DSO digital roadmap today. The right person will immerse themselves in the business, learning how HuFriedyGroup serves DSOs and how DSOs operate, while building a backlog of digital opportunities that evolves into a living DSO roadmap. The work is agile and iterative, not linear: this role will launch near-term proofs of concept and pilots to learn quickly, pivot based on what is learned, and keep driving toward longer-term outcomes at the same time. The role reports to the Director, Digital Solutions Management.

This Senior Digital Product Manager will own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through delivery and optimization, working closely with Strategic and National Accounts, Commercial Excellence, Customer Care, Enterprise Technology, and external partners. They will develop a deep understanding of how DSO corporate teams (procurement, supply chain, operations, and clinical leadership) and the practices beneath them work, and use data, experimentation, and AI-enabled approaches to inform decisions. Success in this role requires strong B2B product judgment, fluency in enterprise account structures and integration patterns, and the ability to translate complex commercial and clinical workflows into clear, scalable solutions aligned with HuFriedyGroup's premium brand and long-term digital strategy.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Shaping the DSO Roadmap**
