Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. We are building a product management organization to own and drive our product strategy, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to own a new team focused entirely on Security tooling for the Huntress SOC.

Our SOC is the cornerstone of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-market clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels. Your users are professional security analysts, and they are down the hall. You will get direct, immediate, unfiltered feedback on everything you ship from people who do this work for a living.

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

**Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.  
**Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.  
**Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

AI agents are becoming participants in customer and enterprise interactions. Organizations need more than a signal that a caller or participant is AI: they need to establish who the agent is, whom it represents, what it is permitted to do, and what evidence supports that decision. Pindrop is extending its real-time identity trust platform to help enterprises safely service authorized AI agents across communication channels, with verifiable identity, delegated authorization, risk-based controls, and auditable proof of access.

# Senior Product Manager, Underwriting

## Description:

**About Hippo:**

Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. We use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.

Today, that same tech-native approach powers our work beyond homeowners. Hippo operates as a diversified carrier platform, partnering with MGAs to deliver tailored program solutions that help them grow and deliver better customer experiences. Behind that work is a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

If youre energized by building whats next, wed love to meet you.

**About You:**

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager with a proven track record of owning complex, high-stakes technical platforms in risk-intensive industries to own Hippos Underwriting Platform charter. This is a strategic, high-impact role at the intersection of risk, technology, AI and business growth — responsible for the end-to-end UW platform including our rules engine, risk and underwriting models, and AI-powered workflows.

We are looking for someone who sets aspirational goals and has the agency to deliver them — someone who can think broadly about the future of underwriting technology while executing with precision in the near term.

**What You’ll Do:**

Strategy & Vision

- Define and own the multi-year product strategy and vision for Hippos Underwriting Platform — spanning the rules engine, risk and UW models, and AI/agentic workflows.
- Identify opportunities to modernize and scale UW infrastructure in ways that directly improve loss ratio, underwriting accuracy and efficiency, and speed-to-market for new risk appetite changes.
- Influence and shape company-level prioritization decisions for the UW platform, building alignment across product, engineering, and business leadership without direct authority.
- Stay ahead of emerging trends in insurtech, AI, and risk modeling — translating them into a roadmap that positions Hippo competitively.

Execution & Delivery

- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for the UW platform: discovery, prioritization, requirements, delivery, and post-launch performance.
- Lead cross-functional execution of major platform initiatives, partnering with Engineering, Data Science, Actuarial, and Underwriting to deliver on time and with quality.
- Translate complex business and risk requirements into crisp, actionable PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
- Drive measurable outcomes — own the metrics that matter, including loss ratio impact, underwriter efficiency, model accuracy, and automation rates.

Business & Stakeholder Partnership

- Serve as the primary bridge between the Underwriting and Actuarial business teams and the Engineering organization — deeply understanding business needs and enabling tech to meet them.
- Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders, earning trust through consistent delivery, clear communication, and a genuine understanding of underwriting and risk.
- Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and outcomes to leadership with narratives grounded in data and business impact.

Platform & AI Enablement

- Drive the evolution of Hippos rules engine — enabling faster, safer, and more auditable changes to underwriting logic.

jobs.desc:
As the first product lead for commercial systems at Zoox, you will own the vision and priorities for marketplace optimization in our ride-hail business — how we price, how we promote, and how we deploy a fixed fleet across the hours and zones of each market — and turn them into the requirements the teams building those systems plan against. Because we own and operate our vehicles, supply is fixed in the short run, and these levers are how we trade growth against profit week to week. They include:  
Planned pricing — the rate card and its shaping by time of day and geography, per-zone fees, and the controls operators use to manage a market before any model intervenes.

**Dynamic pricing** — the real-time engine that balances a fixed fleet against live demand, weighing growth against profit market by market.  
**Promotions and incentives** — from promo mechanics and budget planning through targeted, personalized incentives as the rider base grows.  
**Fleet supply** — how many vehicles are in service each hour and where they stage and charge, so fleet and pricing decisions optimize against the same objectives.

This is a hands-on role: you will write the PRDs that define what each system optimizes for, specify the models that make those decisions, and prove they worked. You will sit in the Commercial organization and partner closely with Data Science, Fleet Operations, Finance, and the product and engineering teams that build these systems. It is ideal for a marketplace product manager who has owned a pricing, incentives, matching, or supply lever and wants to shape how an autonomous mobility business makes money.

### **In this role you will:**

* Set the objectives that pricing, promotions, and fleet deployment optimize against, from the weekly supply plan to real-time dispatch, so that decisions made in separate systems add up to one commercial plan.
* Partner day to day with Data Science on elasticity estimation, price effects modeling, demand and supply forecasting, supply planning, and marketplace simulation, bringing a clear point of view on what to build.
* Set the priorities for the vertical: size the expected business impact and effort of each initiative with the science and engineering leads, stack rank them, and re-rank each quarter as results come in.
* Drive delivery across the teams that build these systems, managing dependencies, holding the schedule, and escalating early when a date is at risk.
* Design the experiments and simulation studies that gate launches, set ship criteria and guardrail metrics before launch, make the ship call, and write the readout against the sizing that justified the work.  
  Run the weekly operating cadence with Commercial Operations, Fleet Operations, and Finance: diagnose variance, propose changes to live levers, and present lever performance and roadmap status to leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 8+ years in product management, technical program management, or marketplace strategy roles, including significant time on marketplace products — ride-hail, delivery, travel, or similar — where pricing, incentives, matching, or supply planning was the product.
* Demonstrated ability to specify an optimization problem in writing: given "we should price better," you can return an objective, its constraints, the data it needs, the guardrails it must respect, and the experiment that validates it.
* A track record of driving a roadmap to completion through teams that do not report to you, changing priorities with evidence rather than authority.
* A quantitative foundation: a degree in economics, operations research, statistics, or a similar field, and practical experience applying it — specifying or building models, running experiments, and reading their results.
* Clear writing and presentation skills: PRDs that engineers and scientists can build from, and readouts that leadership can decide on.

### **About the role**

Proven builds an integrated EHR platform: clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, reporting and integrations, all on one system. We're hiring a remote Senior Technical Product Manager to own it: decide what we build, in what order, and what we don't build yet.

You'll be the person who sees the whole system. When the business asks for something, you'll know what it touches and what it risks. You'll know whether now is "the right time", and you'll have the standing to say, "not yet" and back it up.

### **What you'll do**

* **Own the roadmap.** Weigh customer requests, sales commitments, compliance deadlines and technical health, and turn them into a plan the team can actually deliver.
* **Push back.** Tell the business "no" or "not now" when a request doesn't fit, with clear reasoning and tradeoffs.
* **Protect the system.** Before anything is built, assess what it touches across clinical, billing, scheduling, permissions, integrations and customer configurations. Identify downstream risks and define the level of review and testing required.
* **Write requirements developers can build from:** workflows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and dependencies.
* **Own quality standards.** Write test cases and UAT guides that prove a feature works and didn't break anything else. Establish consistent testing standards and help improve AI-assisted regression testing, working with Operations to identify coverage gaps and validate results.
* **Drive release readiness.** Ensure testing results, unresolved defects and material risks are reviewed and documented before release decisions are made.
* **Partner with the Chief Software Architect** and developers on scope, design tradeoffs and release readiness.

### **What you bring**

* 5+ years in product management on complex, multi-module software, ideally after time as a BA or QA.
* A track record of owning a roadmap and defending it under pressure.
* Strong requirements and test-case writing.
* Systems thinking: you instinctively ask, "what else does this touch?"
* The technical depth to work closely with engineers without writing the code yourself.
* Comfort with AI tools, and the judgment to know when not to trust them.
* The ability to balance product priorities, quality, and risk without creating unnecessary process or slowing delivery.

### **Nice to have**

* Healthcare IT experience: EHR, revenue cycle or behavioral health.
* Familiarity with ONC certification, HIPAA or other regulated environments.
* Experience as an early or first product hire at a growing software company.
* Establish a practical risk-review and release-readiness process, including clear testing expectations and documented exceptions.

### **Your first 90 days**

* Learn the platform end to end and map how the modules depend on each other.
* Publish a roadmap that leadership has signed off on, including what's deferred and why.
* Put a requirements and test-case standard in place that every new ticket meets.

**About Property Meld**
=======================

Property Meld's mission is to radically improve how the property management industry handles maintenance, through our Intelligent Maintenance platform. If you have ever had a maintenance issue at a rental, you know how painful it can be to get fixed. It does not have to be this way. We are rethinking the entire experience to drive maintenance cost toward the minimum and make residents and owners want to stay with their property manager, not leave.

### **The role**

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes for a meaningful part of our product. You are accountable for solving problems that create real value, for our customers and for the business, not for shipping features. A shipped feature is a bet, not a result. Your job is to make the right bets and to carry them through to value customers actually recognize.

This is a role for someone who wants to own the whole arc of a problem: understanding it deeply, deciding what to do with your design and engineering partners, and staying with the work through launch and beyond to confirm it landed. If your ideal job is writing requirements and handing them off, this is not it. If it is living with a problem until customers rely on the answer, it is.

You will often be the only product person in the room, and what you decide there holds.

### **What you will own**

**Outcomes, not output.** You hold two questions at once: do customers get real value (desirability), and does the business (viability, which in our subscription model means strengthening why customers subscribe, expand, and stay).

**The "why" behind every bet — including the ones nobody asked for.** Before work earns a place on the roadmap, you make the case for it in writing: the problem, the job the customer is trying to get done, the outcome you expect, and why the bet will work. Responding well to inbound requests is table stakes at this level, not the job — you connect your work to where the business needs to be beyond the current cycle.

**Recognized value, not satisfaction.** A happy customer is a weak signal. You push past sentiment to whether customers recognize value they cannot do without, because that is what earns renewal.

**Carrying the "why" to everyone.** You are the face of the product trio to the rest of the company, and to customers directly. You package the reason, the outcome, and the value so the team, our customer-facing teams, and customers can each act on it. Value that is never understood is never realized.

### **How you will work**

**In a product trio.** You discover and decide alongside design and engineering, before the build, not by passing specs over a wall. The strongest solutions come from value, usability, and feasibility being reasoned about together.

**Close to customers, continuously.** Staying grounded in first-hand customer reality is a standing habit, not a kickoff phase.

**Across the whole lifecycle.** You stay engaged from the problem through delivery, rollout, and measurement. Staying close to the build and to QA is how you earn the technical fluency that makes you sharper at the job over time.

**Through influence, not authority.** You rarely manage the people you work with. Your job is to create clarity, alignment, and momentum in every direction without relying on positional power.

**What we are looking for**

We hire for how you work, not where you have worked, and we hire for culture add, not culture fit: people who bring something we do not already have.

**Deep customer curiosity.** You listen to understand, stay close to the people who use the product, and dig for the value they recognize, not just whether they seem content.

**Evidence over ego.** You hold your convictions strongly but loosely, and you change course when the evidence says a bet will miss.

**Priority discipline, earned.** You protect focus, can say no in a way earned by consistently delivering, and push for better evidence before the t

Phenom Cloud is not your average consultancy. HR is our home turf: we help clients solve their trickiest people-tech puzzles with smart, innovative solutions, backed by strong partnerships with leading HR technology vendors. Our clients operate in complex, highly regulated industries such as advanced manufacturing, life sciences, pharma, retail, and financial services, where "trusted relationship" is a real requirement, not a buzzword in a pitch deck.

What really sets us apart is our people. We know our stuff, we don't take ourselves too seriously, and yes, we are genuinely fun to be around (our clients said so, and we didn't even pay them). Through it all, we keep client excellence at the heart of everything we do. We are not a quick fling: we are a reliable, credible partner who remembers our clients' birthdays, shows up on time, and is still around years later.

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Product Management** professional to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements

jobs.desc:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional leadership, and agile execution — requiring someone who can both shape long-term direction and deliver with precision.

We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer's Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.

The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.

A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap:** Define and champion a clear product strategyand roadmap, utilizing data-driven prioritization methods to maximize customer value and business impact. Manage inputs from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
* **Customer Experience:** Drive customer research (surveys, interviews, data analysis) to identify top opportunities, optimize the end-to-end customer journey, and ensure product value realization.
* **Experience Design:** Partner with Product Design on prototypes, wireframes, and concepts, continuously improving the usability of both the UI and APIs for technical and business audiences.
* **Agile Execution & Delivery:** Maintain active, daily collaboration with engineering teams. Write clear user stories, scope work for sprints, and actively participate in Agile cadences. Proactively solve problems and manage ambiguity to ensure on-time delivery.
* **Performance Optimization:** Drive continuous data analysis and insights into customer adoption. Establish clear hypotheses and baselines for feature launches, then track progress toward strategic targets and drive continuous product iteration based on learnings.
* **Commercial Growth & Value:** Partner closely with Product Marketing to run targeted customer campaigns. These efforts will drive trial conversions, accelerate Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, boost retention, and increase high-value usage and adoption.

* You make complex things simple for non-technical users, favoring smart defaults and guardrails over configuration
* A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage
* Hands-on experience with SEO or organic growth and a current point of view on AI search, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and to know which details actually move results
* Rigorous about measurement. You test before you scale and can tell a result from a coincidence

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc: Senior Product Manager Job in US Senior Product Manager ❮ back to last search Nebulock United States 200000-230000 per year Full time NEW REMOTE Apply for this job About Us Nebulock builds hunt-first, behavior-first security operations. Enterprise security teams use us to find attackers already inside their environment by spotting behavior that's abnormal for that organization, rather than by matching signatures of attacks someone has already seen. Attackers rotate tooling constantly and it costs them almost nothing; changing how they behave is much harder. Series A, $34M total raised led by FirstMark, with Bain Capital Ventures, Decibel, Zetta, Step Function, and In-Q-Tel. Founding team out of CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, and Arctic Wolf. The platform is a closed loop: A per-customer behavioral system of record that learns what normal looks like in a specific environment and gets more useful the longer it runs Detections built from that context, re-baselining as environments shift, maintained by a detection engineering team rather than shipped and forgotten Autonomous hunting agents that work from a hypothesis instead of an alert, and write the detection when they establish root cause Detection engineering agents that take the context of threat hunts run to build, test, validate and deploy behavioral detections for Nebulock customers. Position Overview If you're a cybersecurity practitioner turned product leader, this one's for you. You'll join our product team as a Senior Product Manager , reporting to the Head of Product, and you will own significant, ambiguous problem spaces from discovery through delivery. This role spikes in two places: Zero-to-one discovery. You'll spend real time with SOC analysts, detection engineers, and threat hunters to figure out what to build next. You'll validate problems before we write code, kill ideas that don't survive contact with customers, and turn fuzzy market signals into sharp product bets. Execution with R&D. Discovery means nothing if it doesn't ship. You'll partner daily with engineering and research to turn validated bets into epics with crisp success criteria, make scope tradeoffs that keep velocity high, and get products into customers' hands fast. Expected Impact A year from now you'll have shipped things that measurably improve security outcomes and strengthen our customers' security posture, all in a modern, agentic way. Nebulock is an AI-native company, but we aren't building AI for the sake of AI. Automating, reasoning, and delivering autonomous security outcomes is what we do day in, day out, and the products you own will embody that. Your work will move customers meaningfully away from their SIEM toward hunt-first operations, your discovery will shape where we place our next bets, and R&D will point to your epics as the clearest they've worked from. Qualifications Deep cybersecurity knowledge. You've lived the problems we're solving; experience in SOC, IR, or threat research roles is a big plus. You can hold your own in a conversation about detection logic, attacker tradecraft, or why a hunt hypothesis is worth pursuing. Solid product management skills. You're comfortable writing epics and stories, defining success criteria, and partnering closely with R&D. You know how to run discovery and how to translate it into things engineers can build. A shipping track record. This won't be your first PM role. You've shipped things that matter and learned from what didn't. Comfort with speed and ambiguity. We're a Series A company moving fast. You'll often be the one bringing structure to a problem nobody has framed yet. How we work If books like Inspired (Marty Cagan), Product Management in Practice (Matt LeMay), and Extreme Ownership (Willink/Babin) resonate with you, you'll likely thrive here. We favor empowered teams over feature factories, direct customer contact over secondhand requirements, and owning outcomes over assigning blame. Compensation We offer a competitive comp

jobs.desc:
### **About Us**

Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? **Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.**

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly **$200M raised to date.**

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 **Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company,** and **swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards**, including *Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform,* and *the Hotelier’s Choice Award*. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.

**Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.**

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to drive Canary’s Digital Tipping product, the award-winning platform that lets hotel guests tip and thank staff from their phones. Housekeepers, valets, bell staff and others have long missed out on tips because guests no longer carry cash. Digital Tipping changes that and puts meaningful income and recognition in the hands of the people who make hotel stays great. Tip volume has more than tripled year over year, and we’ve been named Best Digital Tipping Solution in the HotelTechAwards three years running.

This role sits where guest experience, payments and workforce systems meet. A guest scans a QR code or taps a link and tips in seconds. Behind that moment, money has to move accurately and in compliance. It has to reach staff through digital wallets, bank accounts or payroll, and it has to stay in sync with the HR and payroll systems that hotels and management companies run on. Working closely with Product leadership, you’ll own the roadmap and delivery across that loop, from the guest’s first tap to the payout in a staff member’s account.

  

### **What You’ll Do**

* Own the roadmap and day-to-day execution for Digital Tipping, in partnership with Product leadership, across the guest tipping experience, staff onboarding and wallets, payouts, and hotel admin and reporting.
* Drive payments and money-movement work with engineering and finance: payout partner integrations, wallet funding and reconciliation, ledger accuracy, fees, and tax and compliance reporting (e.g., IRS tip reporting, PCI).
* Ship and improve HR and payroll integrations (e.g., UKG, Workday, Dayforce), helping move bespoke enterprise integrations toward repeatable, self-serve capabilities.
* Partner with customer success and sales on enterprise rollouts with hotel brands and management companies, including brand-app integrations, brand standards and complex staffing models such as contract workers.
* Run initiatives and experiments to grow adoption and tip volume: staff setup completion, scan-to-tip conversion, and guest touchpoints in use (QR, SMS, email, checkout, brand apps).
* Track and report on the product’s key metrics, including tip volume, conversion, staff activation, payout reliability and support volume, and use the data to inform priorities.
* Write clear requiremen

jobs.title: Senior Software Product Manager - Factory Systems
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE JOB:**

The Software Product Manager for ArsenalOS will own multiple Factory-touching platforms: software that enables stakeholders such as production managers, manufacturing engineers across disciplines, and automation and controls engineers to map the physical world to a digital one (its locations, work centers, stationed tools, assets, and more) and to execute workflows at the speed we require. These platforms sit within ArsenalOS Connected Factory and will start by unifying how locations, work centers, tools, and assets are modeled across the warehouse management system (WMS), manufacturing execution system (MES), and asset management system (AMS), along with multiple different types of sensor systems, into a seamless operating environment, replacing manual processes with purpose-built systems designed for how Anduril actually builds.  
  
You will build this product from the ground up, from vision through MVP to scaled adoption. You must be able to zoom all the way in to improve how a single user stands up a station or commissions a smart tool, sensor, tester, controller, etc., and zoom all the way out to design the systems, data models, and integrations that connect all manufacturing systems. At Anduril's build rate, every gap between the digital model of the line and its physical reality is where production quietly slows down, and closing that gap is the whole job.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for the Forge Factory, with a clear point of view on the what, why, and why now.
* Build Forge Factory from the ground up: define the vision, scope the MVP, ship it, and iterate based on real user feedback and business outcomes.
* Partner with manufacturing, reliability, and product operations to define and deliver the software that connects their workflows into one coherent operating environment.
* Define the integration strategy between manufacturing systems and adjacent platforms (MES, ERP, AMS & WMS), ensuring the right data flows to the right people at the right time.
* Leverage AI and modern tooling to accelerate product development, from prototyping and requirements generation to building intelligent workflows that surface insights and reduce manual decision-making.

You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Internet Map
jobs.desc:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to scale execution of the Censys Internet Map: the most continuously updated view of every asset, port, service, and certificate we can find across the public internet. Building it means running one of the largest internet-wide scanning operations in the world - 400+ Protocols providing access to 3Trillion+ scans in our APIs, 10PetaBytes+ of historical data, scanning 250Million+ IPs across 65K ports daily, resolving 8Billion+ names every 24 hours and tracking DNS at scale, tracking 18B+ certificates, fingerprinting 100K+ technologies behind what we find, enriching all of it with human readable labels, and third-party context so it becomes actionable intelligence rather than raw data.

This role is anchored in disciplined delivery, translating complex coverage and enrichment priorities into requirements engineering can build against. You'll define business and customer priorities, run the delivery cadence, and keep engineering and cross-functional stakeholders aligned on what's shipping and why it matters.

What You’ll Do

Internet Map Execution: You will define the business and customer priorities behind what goes into the Internet Map and how it stays best-in-class. This is the lever that enables Censys to be successful across every product and every segment we operate in.

  • Coverage: How do we grow the map, how often we refresh it, and how comprehensively? This spans expanding IPv4/IPv6 scan scope, adding and prioritizing ports and protocols, increasing scan and DNS resolution frequency, and improving certificate and host discovery. You'll define this data collection work as detailed engineering requirements and acceptance criteria, and track coverage against baselines to identify and close gaps.
  • Context: How do we enrich data into actionable intelligence? You'll define enrichment priorities based on customer and product needs: technology fingerprinting, risk scoring, and third-party data integrations. This includes evaluating external/third-party data sources for accuracy, coverage, and cost; defining the metrics used to judge data and enrichment quality; defining the schema that structures how coverage and context data is represented; and writing the documentation that makes both understandable and usable internally and externally.

Cross-Team Alignment and Execution:

  • Drive cross-functional data prioritization across the Censys suite and provide business priority input into sequencing for new protocols and enrichments, ensuring data investments align with company goals, resolve multi-product conflicts, and provide roadmap transparency to other product managers and EMs.
  • Engineering partnership and data quality: You ensure Engineering teams working on scanning infrastructure, data pipelines, and enrichment systems have well-defined requirements, clear acceptance criteria, and the context they need to make good architectural decisions. Track coverage and context quality against baselines. Identify gaps between current state and target, and translate findings into concrete engineering work to close them.

**AI at BambooHR**

At BambooHR, we're all about setting people free to do great work, and we believe AI is a powerful partner in that mission. We're leaning into intelligent tools to streamline our workflows, giving us more time for high-impact innovation. We look for curious, forward-thinking people who are ready to explore how AI can elevate their work and help us reimagine the future of HR.

**Essential Job Duties**

We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager to own the systems payroll runs on: data sync, calculation, payment operations tools, and the data model underneath them. You'll make sure payroll builds on BambooHR's shared platform services: canonical data entities, a permission service, an event bus, and an observability stack. You hold payroll to the contracts those services publish.

On a typical day you might sequence a migration step so no client's payday is ever the test case, agree on the direction of the payroll data model with payroll engineering leadership, or work out what it costs to keep an old system alive one more quarter. A new platform is still maturing while the old system carries production load.

You will:

* Own payroll platform modernization: decide what moves from old operational tools to their replacement, and when, and sequence each step so payroll is never at risk.
* Price the cost of keeping old systems running, including support escalations, manual fixes, and the risk of a missed pay date.
* Own the product half of the payroll data-model redesign, weighing event-driven streaming against the current full-resync approach, jointly with payroll engineering leadership. Validate it against the company's canonical entity models using real client examples.
* Own access and audit discipline on payroll systems: permission granularity, audit posture, least-privilege carve-outs, deny-by-default rollouts, and feature-flag discipline. Coordinate with the security organization and build on the platform's existing ways of recording who did what.
* Own compliance and retention for payroll: data retention positions, regulatory changes that affect payroll systems, and the audit interface with governance, risk, and compliance, documented as decisions rather than tribal knowledge.
* Test long-held assumptions about what payroll systems can and cannot do, publish the real limits and latency curves, and write them up so leadership can act on them.
* Run a payroll roadmap review cadence: a quarterly plan with dates, a weekly written status for leadership, and coordination with payroll services on operational readiness.

**Success in the First 180 Days**

* Deliver a dated plan for retiring the old systems with the cost of keeping each one priced, and retire at least one without a payroll incident.
* Land the payroll data-model direction as a written decision agreed with engineering.
* Make payroll's permission and audit setup the reference example other internal tools copy.
* Complete canonical-model validation for each payroll domain so payroll builds against platform contracts by default.

**What You Need to Get the Job Done**

* You feel aligned with the BambooHR values.
* 5+ years of product management experience. HCM, payroll, or payroll-adjacent platform experience is strongly preferred.
* You have coordinated with downstream consumers at scale: dozens of teams reading one system's contracts.
* Rollout discipline is a reflex for you: parallel runs, instant rollback, user acceptance testing, and release trains.
* You're technical enough to discuss database schemas, APIs, and migration mechanics with engineers as a peer.
* You're comfortable in regulated, sensitive-data domains and treat compliance counterparts as partners.

Backcountry is moving from manual, low-volume A/B testing to an always-learning agentic platform that designs, launches, monitors, and optimizes experiments across our family of ecommerce sites. As **Senior Product Manager, AI Experimentation Platform**, you will own this platform from the ground up — setting the roadmap, defining where AI agents act autonomously and where humans stay in the loop, and driving measurable gains in conversion and revenue.

At six to twelve months, success looks like a working platform that runs trusted experiments across multiple sites, a significant increase in testing velocity without sacrificing statistical rigor, and revenue and conversion improvements you can trace directly to platform-run experiments.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world's largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we're just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio, our Product Management team is hiring a Senior / Staff Product Manager to help build a new platform that will become the system of record for industrial operations: every asset, every change, every approval, and its full history, in one OT-native CMDB and service management platform.

Customers asked for this. Plant teams are tired of forcing industrial environments into IT ticketing and CMDB tools that were never built for them. Nozomi Networks already sees what is on the plant floor in real time; now we are building the platform that keeps the record and governs every change. The platform is in its design and early-access phase, shaped with enterprise and mid-market customers, and the data model is still open. You will own the problem and design the solution together with engineering.

This role starts with an advantage. CMDBs live or die on data quality, and this one sits on live, first-party asset data from Nozomi Networks sensors, so the platform can verify that what the record says matches what is actually on the network. AI is part of the core, not bolted on: agents that watch for changes, open the work, and answer questions about an asset's history.

We have deep OT expertise across the company. What this team needs now is someone who has built a CMDB before.

You could be the next "Nozomier"! If this sounds like you, read on.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

Own the OT-Native Data Model

* Lead the data model for an OT-native CMDB, designed with engineering: assets, installed positions, locations and ISA-95 hierarchies (site, area, line, cell), relationships, and the full change history of every asset from installation to retirement.

* Define how the recorded state of each asset relates to what live network data shows, and what happens when they differ.

* Decide how assets the network never sees (offline equipment, spreadsheet imports) live alongside observed ones, keeping it clear which values were observed and which were only declared.

Define Identity and Reconciliation

* Partner with engineering on identity and reconciliation rules: when records from sensors, integrations, and spreadsheets describe the same physical asset, which source wins for each field, and how every value stays traceable.

* Engineering builds the matching; you define what it must get right.

Shape Workflows, Integrations, and AI

* Shape the default workflows customers start from (planned and unplanned change, vulnerability remediation, asset changes, safety approvals) on a configurable workflow engine, including what proves a change was actually done.

* Define how the platform works alongside systems customers already run, such as an existing CMDB or ITSM tool: which system owns which record, and how work flows between them.

* Help decide where an AI agent acts and where a person must approve.

Drive Decisions and Delivery

* Make the calls: own the problem, negotiate the solution with engineering, hold the line on what a release must include, and turn weeks of debate into days of decisions.

* Work directly with early-access customers to validate, learn fast, and ship.

* Collaborate daily with an engineering team based in Europe and a cross-functional product team, reporting directly to the VP of Product.

* Embody Nozomi Networks' cultural pillars, promoting transparency, trust, and accountability.

**To be successful in this opportunity, you will have:**

**Becoming You Labs**

Full-Time · New York City (In-Office) · Reports to CPO · $170,000 - $190,000 base

**About Becoming You Labs**

Becoming You Labs is a life-discovery and career-planning platform built on a rigorous methodology that helps people find purpose at the intersection of their values, aptitudes, and economically viable interests. Founded in 2022 by Dr. Suzy Welch, bestselling author, NYU Stern professor, and host of the Becoming You podcast, the method is grounded in validated psychometrics and has reached nearly a million people through assessments like The Values Bridge, certified coaching, enterprise programs, and a growing product ecosystem. We’re a team of about 30 across behavioral science, psychometrics, product design, and economics, building products that reach people at the moments that matter most.

**The Role**

A year ago, Becoming You Labs had one major product. Today we have two full platforms and a variety of new products, with more customers and more coaches arriving every month. We’re growing rapidly as we look to bring our methodology to the world.

Over that same period, the Product Manager role has meaningfully evolved. AI is collapsing the talent stack by expanding what Product Managers can do autonomously and what they enable their teams to do. It is also making code cheap, so deciding what to build has never been more important.

We're looking for a dynamic Product Manager that can blend the core skills of a product manager, the sensibility of a product designer, and the foundational, AI-assisted technical skills of a software engineer to design, build, and ship functional software.

This will be the second product person here, working alongside the CPO across everything we build: the platform, the coaching and enterprise business, and our assessment products. You’ll help shape core strategy, ground what we build in real research, own a roadmap that holds up under pressure, sequence work in step with engineering, and keep stakeholders, founder included, clear on what’s coming and why. We’re hiring this role to make sure the right things get built, in the right order, at a quality bar we’re proud of, by someone the team trusts to know the state of everything.

**What You'll Do**

**Make the team faster**

- Own the product cycle end to end: scoping, sequencing, specs, launch readiness, and the post-launch follow-through most teams skip
- Write requirements the team actually builds from: clear enough that engineering and design don't have to guess, short enough that people read them
- Lead with context, not control. Give the team the strategic picture and the stakeholder alignment they need to make fast decisions without you in the room
- Anticipate blockers before they create delays (go-to-market, legal, privacy, data handling, enterprise commitments) and bring the hard questions to the table early
- Coordinate launches across the whole company, not just engineering: community, courses, enterprise, and the help content and messaging that have to land at the same time

**Make yourself faster**

- Use AI to compress the product development cycle. Build your own prototypes, narratives, and live experiments to surface and test assumptions before committing design or engineering time
- Do a first pass on technical complexity yourself with coding agents, so conversations with engineering start from a real estimate rather than a guess

### **About Oath**

Oath helps Democratic donors give with impact. We are a donor-first platform that turns political data into clear, objective guidance on where a contribution will matter most, and then makes giving to those races simple.

Political giving is noisy. Donors are flooded with urgent emails and texts and have little way to judge which appeals matter. Oath closes that information gap. Our impact scoring weighs race competitiveness, district fundamentals and chamber control, so donors can see the relative value of their dollars across federal, statewide, state legislative and local races. We don't charge candidates, we don't sell donor data, and our recommendations aren't for sale.  
Oath has processed over $100M dollars to thousands of candidates and organizations. Every federal Democratic candidate is now on the platform, and we are building for a step change in scale in the cycles ahead.

Oath is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own product strategy and execution. In this senior individual contributor role, you will set the roadmap, make clear trade-offs under uncertainty, and ship with engineering, design, data and our political team against immovable election deadlines.  
You will report to the COO and partner closely with engineering leadership. You will also help shape how product is practiced at Oath as the team grows: how we write specs, think about utilizing AI, measure outcomes and decide what to build next.

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Own the product vision, strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Oath's donor platform, grounded in donor research, data and the political landscape.
* Lead products from problem definition through launch and iteration, writing the PRDs and strategy docs that align engineering, design and data on goals, trade-offs and success metrics.
* Set and track goals for donor acquisition, retention and dollars directed, and find new growth loops such as peer-to-peer and recurring giving.
* Partner with the political and research team to evolve how we score race impact and turn it into donor-facing experiences.
* Work with engineering leadership on technical direction and platform scale, especially ahead of high-volume moments such as deadlines and Election Day.
* Drive AI enablement and adoption for the organization, including implementing new tooling and integrations that advance product goals while maintaining donor privacy.
* Protect donor trust in every product decision: privacy, objective recommendations and campaign finance compliance.
* Communicate strategy and progress to leadership, investors and partners, and raise the bar for product thinking across the team.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years of product management or related experience, including ownership of a consumer or marketplace product from strategy through launch.
* Experience defining product vision and roadmap for a product area, and influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams on technical trade-offs, system design and delivery planning.
* Experience using data to make product decisions: defining metrics, running experiments and analyzing results (for example, with SQL or a comparable analytics tool).
* Track record of shipping products that drove measurable growth, engagement or revenue.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including writing product strategy and requirements documents.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including leading strategy across multiple teams and mentoring other product managers.
* Experience as an early product hire, or building product processes at a high-growth startup.
* Experience with payments, fundraising or other transactional consumer products.
* Experience with recommendation, ranking or referral and growth systems.
* Familiarity with political campaigns, campaign finance or civic technology.
* Hands-on use of AI tools for research, specs and pr

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Practice Experience
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT PEARLY**

Pearly is a high-growth B2B SaaS and payments company at a critical inflection point. With deep product-market fit and over 3,000 dental offices across DSOs, groups, and private practices on the platform, we're now looking for builders to help shepherd the next stage of growth.

Because we're lean, you won't be inheriting legacy process or systems debt. You'll be building from a clean slate: leveraging process, technology, and AI in smart, creative ways to accelerate growth and productivity across dental billing, payments, and engagement.

We are a team of high-talent, high-integrity people who genuinely enjoy the art of building and competing; honing our craft and getting better each day, both as individuals and as a team. We care deeply about good outcomes, but just as much about how we get there with smart, passionate people who hold each other to a high standard, move fast, and take pride in the work.

That's what makes Pearly feel different. The caliber of the people and the intentionality behind how we operate.

**THE ROLE**

You'll own Practice Experience: the app the practice team works in every day, the workflows inside it, and the experience around it from onboarding to daily use. Your users are the people responsible for a practice's financial performance, some living in Pearly for hours a day working a queue of accounts, others, like an owner or a CFO, checking in weekly and needing to know where things stand without digging. And it isn't one customer. It's the single-location office running its own billing, the group or DSO standardizing across dozens of locations, and the outsourced billing company working on behalf of hundreds. You own that arc for all of them without building three versions of the product.

The problems are concrete. A new customer should get live and start collecting in days, not weeks. An RCM manager should be able to set up a payment plan in under a minute without calling support. A balance sitting 60 days past due shouldn't wait for a person to decide to chase it. And a DSO rolling out location 41 shouldn't need the hand-holding location 1 did. Some of those are workflow problems, some are product we haven't built, and some are automation that should have replaced the work entirely. All of them compound directly into collections.

Part of your roadmap exists to win customers and part exists to keep them, and you should know which is which. The metrics you'll answer for are listed below. Senior here means you own it end to end, from discovery through release, without day-to-day direction. The lines around your area are thin on purpose. With a lean product bench, breadth matters, and you'll own features that reach into Payments, Onboarding, and Integrations.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

Getting Live and Getting Unstuck. Onboarding and support are product surfaces, not someone else's problem. Own what gets configured versus defaulted, how fast a new customer connects their PMS and reaches value, and the in-product guidance that replaces a training call.

Own what staff see when a sync breaks or the data looks wrong, and treat recurring support volume as a product signal to remove the cause.

The Daily Workflow, and Automating It Away. How staff find an account, understand a balance, decide what needs attention today, take action, and trust what they see. The job underneath it is chasing money that's owed across thousands of accounts, usually while the phone is ringing. Make that work faster where a person has to do it, and build the automation and the new products that mean they don't.

One Product, Several Operating Models. A single office, a group standardizing across locations, a DSO with centralized RCM, and an outsourced billing company all need different permissions, reporting, and defaults. Own what generalizes, what stays configurable, and what we decline to build.

jobs.desc:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role**

AI is moving off the screen and into physical operations and Samsara is building it. If you want to be a product manager enabling the transformation behind how the real world works, join us.

We connect the vehicles, equipment, sites, and people behind the physical operations that power our economy. Our platform collects more than 30 trillion data points a year from vehicles that travel 99.9% of U.S. roads, and we design our own hardware to capture it. That mix of hardware, real-world data, and AI is why we're building things no one else can. We don't start with a model; we start with the data, embedded hardware, and deep customer understanding that make AI valuable.

And it's working. Samsara crossed $2.1 billion in ARR last quarter, growing 30% year over year, and we've been GAAP profitable for four straight quarters. Adoption of our AI agents has grown 7x since June, and voice agents overtook chat within four weeks of launch. We're just getting started.

This is a remote role is open to candidates residing in the US.

**Why the work matters**

Physical operations is tough. The work is repetitive, it's hard to hire for, and when something goes wrong, people get hurt. Our customers make thousands of decisions a day about whether people get home safely and whether deliveries and essential services keep running.

**How we hire**

We hire product managers into Samsara first and match you with the team and problem where you'll have the most impact. Problem spaces evolve consistently here and what's most important is your excitement about what and how Samsara is building.

You'll meet our Product leaders early in the process and your ultimate manager toward the end, so you get a real view of the whole org.

**What you'll do**

* Spend time in the field with customers, find the problems that matter most, and rally the troops with a strong perspective on what to build next.
* Build with AI every day: prototype, test, ship fast, and keep pushing what the newest models can do.
* Work across hardware, software, and AI teams to ship products customers pay for.
* Own outcomes end to end, measured in customer impact and revenue.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You've shipped products customers pay for and can show, with numbers, the impact you personally drove.
* You use AI tools daily and get excited when a new model changes what's possible.
* You find your own problems to work on and take full ownership of the outcome.
* You have strong commercial instincts and want to understand how the product gets sold.
* You have conviction and can move a room quickly, but low ego in changing your mind when someone else is right (or more right).

***If that sounds like you, let's go.***

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program deliver

Intuitial is a people-first, remote-friendly digital services company serving shoulder-to-shoulder with U.S. federal agencies to deliver innovative, human-centered solutions. We build modern, secure products the right way: with empowered teams, strong delivery discipline, and deep respect for the people who use—and operate—what we ship.

We’re guided by values like **Kindness, Grit, Growth Mindset, and Radical Candor**, and we aim to create a culture where people can do their best work with trust, autonomy, and support. We value clear communication, healthy collaboration, and continuous learning—because mission impact and excellent engineering both come from teams who feel safe, accountable, and energized.

About Circle

Circle sits at the forefront of digital money, bringing programmable, global, and instant value transfer to the internet through our infrastructure, including USDC-a blockchain-based dollar now core to payments, commerce, and markets worldwide. Our technology empowers businesses, institutions, and developers to capitalize on the breakthroughs of open blockchain networks, propelling financial innovation and economic inclusion at a truly global scale.

About the Role

We're seeking a Principal Product Manager, Ecosystem to drive new product initiatives with our Onchain Protocol team. If you are passionate about accelerating real-world adoption of stablecoins and blockchain infrastructure, thrive in highly cross-functional and externally facing roles, and excel at zero-to-one thinking, this is your chance to shape the future of digital money. In this pivotal role, you will lead strategy, vision, and execution for onchain protocols (including CCTP cross-chain bridge, Gateway chain abstraction, Paymasters, and Smart Wallets) already responsible for moving billions in digital assets each month. You'll engage with leading ecosystem developers, define how stablecoins are used in DeFi, wallets, and consumer applications, and ensure Circle remains ahead of fast-evolving crypto trends such as zK proofs, intents, and chain abstraction.

Key Responsibilities

Engage deeply with ecosystem builders to discover opportunities that materially accelerate USDC usage and adoption.

Own product vision, roadmap, and zero-to-one execution for new onchain initiatives-translating market and developer insights into actionable product bets.

Conduct onchain data analysis to identify trends, high-potential dApps, and emerging use cases, always remaining at the vanguard of blockchain advances.

Define and continuously optimize the end-to-end developer and user experience for Circle's stablecoin and protocol products.

Synthesize technical advancements (e.g., zK proofs, EIPs, chain abstraction) into competitive product strategies.

Lead cross-functional squads-engineering, legal, data science, marketing, and business-to launch and scale new protocols to market.

Act as Circle's ambassador to the crypto ecosystem: participate actively in developer conversations and community forums, contribute to EIPs, and evangelize best practices for stablecoin integration.

Requirements

5+ years of product management ownership driving business strategy and growth for complex commercial products; prior principal or group PM experience a plus.

Strong technical background: proficiency in computer science or engineering concepts, ideally via degree or prior engineering experience.

Highly analytical, data-driven; skilled at using onchain data and market evidence to inform hypothesis-driven product decisions.

Proven track record influencing, aligning, and leading cross-functional and exec-level stakeholders through matrixed organizations.

Bonus Skills

  • Founder, co-founder, or early employee experience within crypto startups or major ecosystem projects.
  • Demonstrated leadership in community engagement-open-source, standards, or developer advocacy.
  • Hands-on experience shipping user-facing blockchain products that reached scale.

  • Deep user fluency in DeFi, stablecoins, wallets, bridges, and consumer crypto-actively engaged with the broader ecosystem (e.g., reading EIPs, experimenting with dApps, contributing to discourse).

jobs.desc:
**About Presence**  
  
Presence is the leading provider of teletherapy solutions for children with diverse needs. Our award-winning technology connects speech-language pathologists, school psychologists, occupational therapists, and mental health specialists to K-12 school districts nationwide. With a growing network of over 2,000 clinicians and more than 7 million teletherapy sessions delivered, we're dedicated to ensuring every child has access to the support they need.

At Presence, we embrace the benefits of being a remote-first company while recognizing the importance of in-person connection to advance our mission. We place a high value on "cameras on" engagement, schedule coordination, and cross-functional communication to stay connected while working in different places. Travel is also an important part of many roles, helping us build stronger relationships with our teams, clinicians, and school partners. The frequency will vary by role and responsibilities, but may include activities such as department offsites, team gatherings, and school or industry events.

**About the role:**

As Senior Product Manager for Fulfillment & Operational Transformation, you will own the platform user experiences, operational workflows, and systems engine that power how Presence matches school district demand with clinical supply. In our SaaS-plus-service model, clinical delivery is an intricate two-sided marketplace: students have legally mandated IEP timelines, districts have strict calendar and credentialing constraints, and clinicians have specific availability, licensure, and skill profiles.

Behind every fulfilled therapy session is a complex web of handoffs between school partners, clinicians, and internal teams. Your mandate is to bring service and systems design discipline to this ecosystem. You will illuminate and map current-state friction, architect scalable human-and-technology interactions, dismantle manual workarounds, and build intelligent matching and capacity tools. You will partner with operational leaders who are urgency-driven, acting as both an empathetic partner and a disciplined product leader who translates operational pain into scalable, automated, and adoptable software.

To stay connected, all employees commit to being available on-camera during our Core Working Hours (Monday - Friday, 12 - 5 p.m. ET) with standard business hours of 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. in your local time zone. For this role, up to 10% travel may be required to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

**What will you do at Presence:**

* **Lead Service Blueprinting & End-to-End Journey Mapping:** Map multi-actor service blueprints connecting frontstage district and clinician touchpoints with backstage operational handoffs, technical systems, and third-party data flows. Identify structural failure points, hidden dependencies, and unnecessary operational handoffs before committing engineering resources.
* **Streamline Workflows & Eliminate Operational Friction:** Conduct deep discovery with internal operators to map day-to-day practices, uncover undocumented bottlenecks, and systematically transition teams to instrumented, scalable product features.
* **Define Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) & Optimize End-to-End UX:** Deeply understand the core jobs operational teams are trying to accomplish. Design seamless end-to-end user experiences that reduce cognitive load for non-technical internal users, ensuring tools feel intuitive and empowering rather than cumbersome.
* **Architect Human + Tech Interactions:** Design balanced Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) systems. Know when to apply algorithmic automation (e.g., rule-based matching, multi-variable constraint filtering) and when to empower human operators with decision-support interfaces, unified visibility, and exception-management queues.

Along the way, you'll turn that work into a repeatable launch process for every release that follows.

**Performance Tracking and Scorecards**

* Build scorecards and dashboards that track adoption, revenue impact, pipeline, and engagement for each release.
* Define success metrics before launch and measure results against them.
* Find trends, gaps, and opportunities in the data.

**Customer Insights and Feedback**

* Collect customer feedback and ideas after launch through interviews, surveys, sales conversations, and support data.
* Report regularly to leadership and cross-functional teams on what's working, what isn't, and what to do next.

Accumulus Technologies helps life sciences companies reduce regulatory friction, shorten timelines, and lower execution risk across product development and lifecycle management—delivering measurable and transformational ROI. **Job Summary**

Coinbax is seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Product Manager to define product strategy and oversee the product lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to development and delivery, while supporting long-term product growth.

In this role, you will work closely with engineering, design, analytics, and business teams to translate customer needs and business objectives into clear product priorities, actionable roadmaps, and valuable software solutions.

You will analyze market trends, customer feedback, and product performance to identify growth opportunities, enhance the user experience, and strengthen the product’s competitive position. You will also coordinate cross-functional teams, manage development priorities, and ensure product initiatives align with the company’s overall business objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in product management, sound business judgment, and excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Experience with Software as a Service (SaaS) platforms, mobile applications, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), databases, or Internet of Things (IoT) products is preferred.

We are looking for someone who can combine strategic planning with hands-on execution, use data to inform product decisions, and guide teams in delivering high-quality products that create meaningful value for customers and support the company’s continued growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy, analyze business requirements, and translate them into clear product plans, functional specifications, and testing criteria.
* Oversee product development projects, coordinating cross-functional teams on planning, timelines, and delivery while applying appropriate development and project management methodologies.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and other stakeholders to align software development, system development, and IT infrastructure initiatives throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Support product prototyping, requirements reviews, user acceptance testing, and release readiness, using data analysis and customer feedback to continuously improve product functionality and user experience.
* Monitor development progress and delivery quality, prioritize product initiatives, and ensure improvements align with customer needs, business objectives, and practical use cases.

**Skills**

* **Product Management:** Experience in product management, product development, roadmap planning, project coordination, and prioritization. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Familiarity with APIs, databases, software development processes, and IT systems. Knowledge of AWS, SQL, Java, HTML, Git, or UML is a plus.
