jobs.desc:
About Intuitial

Intuitial is a people-first, remote-friendly digital services company serving shoulder-to-shoulder with U.S. federal agencies to deliver innovative, human-centered solutions. We build modern, secure products the right way: with empowered teams, strong delivery discipline, and deep respect for the people who use—and operate—what we ship.

We’re guided by values like Kindness, Grit, Growth Mindset, and Radical Candor, and we aim to create a culture where people can do their best work with trust, autonomy, and support. We value clear communication, healthy collaboration, and continuous learning—because mission impact and excellent engineering both come from teams who feel safe, accountable, and energized.

Our work spans human-centered design, agile delivery, mobile and cloud-native engineering, and practical, responsible use of AI. We’re here to help government services work better for the public—and we believe that starts by building an environment where our teammates can thrive.

The role

Intuitial is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a cross-functional agile team supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs' Travel Pay product. The role sits within Intuitial Six, Intuitial's joint venture delivering a larger VA program serving Veterans. This role owns both product and delivery for the team: running the team's agile practice, managing the roadmap and backlog, coordinating releases with other VA teams, and keeping work moving when priorities shift. The Senior Product Manager will present upcoming and completed work to stakeholders and lead working sessions across teams.

We look for Product Managers who lead with confidence and bring structure to a team, and who also embrace empowerment and a growth mindset. If you care deeply not just about your own aptitude, but about supporting others' growth, we'd love to hear from you. We look for people who are both tactical and strategic, and who are energized by delivering in complex environments with many moving parts. Most importantly, we look for folks who are passionate about solving problems that impact millions of users. We are here to make a difference in government, and Product Managers are the primary champions of our cause!

Contract Timeline

The current contract period ends February 16, 2027. We expect VA to extend the work through June 2027, ahead of a planned recompete. These plans have not been finalized, and the timeline is subject to change. We welcome questions and will share what we know as transparently as we can throughout the hiring process.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and Delivery
    • Lead the team's agile practice day to day: plan and facilitate sprint ceremonies, run meetings, and keep the team on track
    • Help the team establish and refine how it works best, including norms, rituals, and ways of collaborating
    • Own release planning, dependency tracking, and status reporting for the team
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
    • Coordinate with other VA teams, product managers, and partners whose work the team depends on, and who depend on the team
    • Facilitate cross-team discussions and negotiate release timing and scope across teams
    • Raise and resolve blockers with dependent teams, escalating when needed so the team can keep delivering
  • Product Direction and Communication
    • Partner with VA stakeholders who set product direction, translating their priorities into a clear, iterative plan the team can deliver
    • Shape and communicate the roadmap as priorities shift, keeping stakeholders and the team aligned on tradeoffs
    • Bring ideas and recommendations to stakeholders with confidence, grounded in user needs and delivery realities
  • Agile Delivery
    • Manage and prioritize

Co–Star is hiring a Product Manager.

Most of the products we build don’t have obvious precedents. We need someone who can help the team navigate that uncertainty and turn ambitious ideas into products people actually use.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, and content throughout the product development process, using tools like Claude Code to prototype concepts. You’ll help shape what we build next, keep the team focused, and move projects from early ideation to launch.

**What you’ll do**

* Own major product initiatives, from defining the problem through launch and iteration.
* Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.
* Write product requirements, set priorities, and keep projects moving.
* Facilitate planning, reviews, and communication across the team.
* Help the team make informed decisions through user research, data, experiments, and using Co–Star deeply yourself.
* Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult tradeoff.
* Help the team decide what matters most and make smart calls about quality, scope, and speed.
* Have a hand in where the product goes next, not just how we get there.

**You might be a fit if**

* You’re roughly 7+ years in, and you’ve spent that time building consumer software people love to use.
* You know how to create structure without weighing a team down.

* Work > ego

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Quoting Tools
jobs.desc:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own that experience end to end. You sit between Sales and the quoting teams and you serve the customers who matter most to Xometry. Your job is to rethink how a request becomes a priced quote: every channel it can arrive through, every hand-off between a person and a system, and every step that does not need a human at all. You will design the agents that read the request, build the quote, and propose the price, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that let those agents work across our quoting systems and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, and the staff tools where people review what the agents did and decide what they should not. The measure is simple: how fast, how accurately, and with how little effort our best customers get a quote they can act on.

This role sits in the Pricing and Manufacturability (P&M) group alongside the product managers for cost prediction, pricing, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and reports to the head of P&M product.

You will be given a metric and a problem space, not a fully scoped backlog. Comfort defining your own roadmap from ambiguous signals is a requirement, not a bonus.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office location.

**How You'll Contribute**

* **Own the request-to-quote experience for our most important customers.** Map every path a quote request takes today, from the moment a customer emails, texts, uploads, or sends an agent, through Sales, quoting, pricing review, and back to the customer. Know the behind-the-scenes steps better than anyone outside the teams that run them. Remove the steps that do not need to exist. Your scorecard: quote turnaround time, cost per quote, quote accuracy, and quote-to-order conversion on the human-assisted path.
* **Redesign the funnel, not just the tools.** Treat each intake channel as a pathway with its own drop-offs and its own fix. Decide where a request should be read by an agent, where it should be routed to a person, and where the customer should be able to self-serve without either. Build the pathways so a request arrives structured, complete, and already half-priced by the time a human sees it.
* **Make agents do the work people should not have to.** Own the roadmap for agentic quoting: agents that read a request and its files and build the quote, assistants that propose margin and lead time, and automation that promotes human-priced parts into the instant-pricing engine over time. Decide what the agent does, what the human confirms, and what stays human. Define "good" and "failure" for every AI feature before engineering starts, and hold that bar through launch and after.
* **Connect the agents to the business through MCP and the ERP.** Own the integration layer that lets agents and people exchange work across Salesforce, our quoting systems, file storage, and the ERP: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool definitions, permissions, and the audit trail that shows who (or what) changed a quote and why. The exchange between humans and agents is a product surface; design it like one.
* **Build the staff tools the quoting and sales teams actually use.** Own the internal quote review, pricing, and quote summary tools. Treat adoption as the product metric: a tool the team routes around has failed, regardless of what shipped.
* **Instrument everything.** Every human pricing decision (override, margin change, lead-time adjustment) becomes structured data that improves the next prediction and the next agent run. Write your own queries, build your own dashb

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Internal Software
jobs.desc:
**About Fervo Energy**
----------------------

Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Senior Technical Product Manager, Internal Software will lead the development of internal software tools across Fervo. This role is the connective tissue between our internal users and the engineers building the tools they need, turning ambiguous internal needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Unlike a traditional product role focused on external customers, you will work across engineering, construction, drilling, completions, supply chain, finance, and operations to understand how work gets done and to identify the workflows that slow execution.

The ideal candidate is a deeply technical product manager, or a former software engineer who can code, partner credibly with engineers, and move comfortably between product strategy and software execution. Experience in geothermal, energy, drilling, or construction is not required. In the near term, this role will own product direction, technical scoping, delivery, adoption, and build-vs-buy decisions, and over time has the potential to evolve into leadership of Fervo's internal software development team as the function scales. Beyond strong software judgment and product instincts, the ideal candidate brings comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build useful tools quickly in a fast-moving environment.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Product Ownership:** Own internal software product development from idea to adoption. Work closely with teams across Fervo to understand their workflows, pain points, operating rhythms, and decision-making needs, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements, technical specs, user stories, and success criteria. Design for a connected software ecosystem rather than one-off applications, ensuring tools integrate with existing systems, data sources, and future internal platforms. Measure success through adoption, workflow improvement, and business impact, not just shipped features.
* **Engineering Partnership:** Partner closely with software engineers, contractors, and technical partners to scope, sequence, and deliver internal tools. Bring enough software fluency to evaluate technical tradeoffs, ask tough questions, and make pragmatic implementation decisions. Write clear technical product requirements, and own delivery cadence, backlog management, sprint planning, stakeholder updates, and risk escalation. Contribute technically when helpful, especially in early prototyping, agentic coding workflows, technical review, or lightweight implementation support.
* **Tools for Fast-Moving Teams:** Develop software that improves how Fervo manages complex work across engineering, construction, project execution, documentation, scheduling, modeling, procurement, and operations. Identify where teams rely on manual processes, disconnected data, or inefficient tools, and build products that are simple, usable, and practical. Sit with users before and after launch, and create feedback loops that drive continuous product improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Competitive Intelligence

This role requires a strong combination of product management expertise, retail domain knowledge, and a deep understanding of competitive data collection, product matching, and Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate can translate complex data capabilities into differentiated, scalable products that deliver actionable competitive insights to retailers in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery of Competitive Intelligence capabilities, including competitive price collection, product matching, data enrichment, and intelligence delivery.
* Drive product requirements for web scraping, automated data acquisition, data normalization, and scalable competitive data pipelines.

* Develop scalable **Data-as-a-Service (DaaS)** offerings that enable customers to access reliable, timely, and actionable competitive intelligence through APIs, data feeds, and analytics.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Search
jobs.desc:
#TeamNextdoor

Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at .

Meet Your Future Neighbors

As a Product Manager on the Search team, you'll take on one of the most consequential rebuilds at Nextdoor. Search is the most explicit statement of intent a neighbor makes on the platform, and most searches aren't commercial at all: a lost-pet post, a neighbor's name, a school thread from last week, and sometimes a plumber. Search has been under-resourced for years and it shows. That changes now, with executive sponsorship, dedicated investment, and a blank sheet. You'll own the rebuild end to end, organic and monetized search together, from the quality of every result to how sponsored content earns its place on the page.

We're looking for a search expert who has done this before: someone who has owned consumer search, made it measurably better for users, and defined the relevance and quality metrics to prove it. You'll need real commercial literacy too. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with the ads and monetization side, built genuine empathy for why the business needs to extract value from search, and you know firsthand how sponsored content, ad load, and paid-organic blending actually behave. You know that great search monetization makes results better, not worse, and you've seen engagement and revenue grow together when both sides pull in the same direction. This is a multi-year rebuild rather than a tuning exercise, and you won't do it alone: dedicated data science partners, ML engineers with search backgrounds, and design coverage are committed to the team. Ideally, you've also built beyond search and bring the range of a generalist athlete who can flex across consumer, marketplace, and business-facing problems. You'll partner closely with engineering, data science, research, design, and PMM to turn that thinking into shipped experiments with real, measurable impact.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

TheImpact You’ll Make

  • Build the missing foundation first: define the metric that tells us whether a neighbor found what they came for, and make it the measure every experiment and ship call answers to. It does not exist today, and it's the most important thing you'll deliver in your first six months
  • Own the Search rebuild end to end, organic and monetized together, from query understanding and retrieval to ranking, result quality, and how the page comes together
  • Make the majority of searches work: most queries are a neighbor looking for a post, a person, a place, or an answer, with no commercial intent, and today we fail them too often
  • Partner with dedicated data science and ML engineering on query understanding, retrieval, and ranking, going deep on the mechanics when the details matter
  • Design how organic and sponsored content blend

jobs.desc:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.

**About Product at LawnStarter**

Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow.

**About the First Service Experience at LawnStarter**

Every new customer meets us the same way. They land on our home page or marketing site, then move through a signup and booking flow where they get a quote, pick a service and a schedule, and pay. That flow runs across all three brands and brings in most of the company's new customers.

We built it many years ago. It's too long, and we lose customers at too many steps. So the real question isn't how to remove a step. It's whether the experience designed still makes sense at all, or whether it should be rethought entirely as an AI-native, agentic experience.

**The Role**

You'll own the consumer's first service experience: everything from the moment someone first encounters LawnStarter through signing up and booking their first service. You'll decide what that experience should become, then build it with engineering, design, operations, marketing, and data.

This is not a funnel-optimization job. We want someone who looks at a five-year-old flow, asks what a homeowner would want if we started from nothing today, and then ships the answer.

As Lead PM, you're an individual contributor with Lead-level scope and no direct reports. You'll work closely with the Consumer Experience lead, the Pro Experience PM, the Pricing PM, and the Conversational AI & Agents lead. You'll report to the Sr. Director of Product.

**What makes this role different:**

* **A rebuild, not a tune-up.** You're rethinking the experience from first principles, not polishing the one we have.
* **AI-native from the first screen.** You'll decide whether a form is even the right way to sign up anymore.
* **Every new customer passes through your work.** Across three brands, this is how people meet LawnStarter.

**What You'll Own**

* **The vision:** What the first service experience should become, and the plan to get there.
* **The home page and marketing site:** The first impression, and the first decision a customer makes about us.
* **Signup and booking for all three brands:** LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome.
* **Funnel data:** The numbers that show where customers move forward and where they leave.
* **Quotes, services, and scheduling:** How a customer gets a price, picks a service, and chooses when it happens.
* **Payment:** Checkout, including Apple Pay and Google Pay.

**Problems to Solve**

**Deciding whether today's experience should exist at all.**  
You'll start from what a homeowner needs to book their first service and work backward. Every step we have today has to earn its place again, and you'll defend each call with evidence.

**Designing an AI-native, agentic way to sign up.**  
Someone who wants their lawn mowed shouldn't have to learn our product to book it. What can an agent handle for them, and where does a person still want control? You'll answer with prototypes in front of real customers, not opinions in a meeting.

**Rebuilding without breaking what works.**  
This flow brings in most of our new customers. You'll need a path that proves the new experience works with real customers before it replaces the old one. Bold and careful at once: that's the job.

**Moving levers you don't own.**  
Signup touches pricing, Pro supply, and operations. Change how customers book and you change what Pros see and how jobs get priced. You'll work through the people who own those levers and bring them along on a vision that changes their world too.

jobs.desc:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. *There's something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams*. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We're energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we're just getting started!

We have an opening for a Principal Platform Product Manager to lead the definition of Constant Contact's core services, with particular focus on authentication and billing. These are the services every product we ship is built on: how a customer signs in, what their plan lets them do, and how what they use turns into revenue. You will set the direction for them, decide what we build and in what order, and define how they should behave so the teams that depend on them can move quickly and trust the result.

The first job is billing. We are moving from an in-house billing system to Stripe Billing, and hundreds of thousands of small businesses count on us getting it right. Alongside it, we are modernizing identity: sign-in, single sign-on, and the account and access model behind them. As those stabilize, the scope of this role grows with the business. Entitlements, account structure, partner and reseller models, and whatever core service we need next are all fair game for someone who has earned the trust to take them on.

You will partner with our Billing Infrastructure and Growth & Enablement engineering teams and with Security, and work closely with Finance, FP&A, RevOps, Support, Sales and our Growth PMs.

Success in this role looks like a clean move to Stripe, an identity platform that is simple for customers and safe for the business, and core services the rest of the company can build on without waiting on you.

The ideal candidate has real depth in how money moves through a subscription business, is technical enough to shape engineering decisions, and has the range to take on platform problems well beyond billing.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Lead the Definition of Core Services:** Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for the shared services every product depends on, starting with billing and identity. Define how each service should behave, what we build, in what order and why. Engineering owns delivery; you own what "done" means and whether we have met it.
* **Own Billing & Payments Strategy:** Set direction for subscriptions, plans and pricing, invoicing, payment methods, payment recovery, refunds and account changes. Decide the sequence and make the trade-offs explicit.
* **Finish** **the Move to Stripe:** Define the phasing, success metrics, acceptance criteria and sign-off bar for our migration from an in-house billing system to Stripe Billing. Set the testing, rollback and control expectations from day one. Every customer should come through without noticing.
* **Make Pricing Changes Simple and Fast:** Make price changes, new plans and add-ons quick and easy to launch. Define how what a customer pays for maps to what the product lets them do, so pricing, packaging and access stay in step across products.
* **Own Identity & Authentication:** Set the direction for sign-in, single sign-on (SSO), account access and the identity platform behind them, with Engineering and Security. Define the account, role and permission model that our products and partners build on.
* **Make Billing Data Trustworthy:** Define the billing data model and the source of truth across our systems so Finance's reporting, revenue recognition and audits reconcile without manual work. You define how the data should look; Finance and our data team own the reporting built on it.

jobs.desc:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $750M in bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for home services: three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, Home Gnome), one shared platform.

**About Product at LawnStarter**

Our BHAG: 1+ job per household, every year. Getting there means winning on four fronts at once: more customers, more Pros, excellent service experience for both sides, and an AI-run company that moves faster than its size should allow.

**About Consumer Experience at LawnStarter**

Hundreds of thousands of households book outdoor services through LawnStarter. Most come for mowing. The opportunity is everything that comes after: helping them discover what else we can do, and giving them every reason to stay.

That’s the opportunity. The customer web portal and app shapes everything after the first booking: how customers schedule, what they learn about their property, which services they find next, and whether they stay. Much of this experience has never had a dedicated owner, and retention is the biggest lever we haven’t pulled yet.

We believe AI changes what’s possible here. Instead of one product for everyone, we can build an outdoor-services experience tailored to each household: their yard, their schedule, and what they need next.

**The Role**

You’ll own the end-to-end consumer experience, after first booking through the lifetime of the customer relationship, and decide how AI shapes it. You’ll set the vision and roadmap for this area, then ship it alongside engineers, designers, data/ applied science partners, marketing, and operations.

As Lead PM, you’re an individual contributor operating with Lead-level scope: you own a full product area, build vision and strategy, set direction others build around, and work closely with the PM who owns the Pro experience so every customer win holds up on both sides of the marketplace. You’ll report to the Sr. Director of Product.

**What makes this role different:**

* You own the relationship, not a screen. Onboarding, scheduling, cross-sell, cancellation and win-back all sit with you, so you fix the whole journey, not one step.
* Room to define the product. These surfaces are live, yet much of the experience has never had a dedicated owner.
* AI is the strategy, not a feature. You'll decide where agentic and AI-based experiences help customers, then ship them.

**What You'll Own**

* **Onboarding**: From the first booking to a customer who trusts us with their yard.
* **Search and discovery**: Helping customers find what they need, including services they didn't know we offer.
* **Property details**: What shapes the service a customer gets and what a Pro walks into.
* **Scheduling**: Skips, reschedules, and frequency changes.
* **Reviews and tips**: How customers rate and reward their Pros.
* **Cancellations and win-back**: The moment a customer decides to leave, and the path back.
* **Cross-sell and personalization**: The right services for each customer, tailored to their household.
* **AI across the experience**: How AI enables all of the above, toward a customized outdoor-services product for every customer.

**Problems to Solve:**

**Turning a mowing customer into a household that trusts us for more.**  
Most customers come to us for one service and rarely see what else their yard needs. You’ll change that by building a deep understanding of each property and household (its size, condition, seasons, and what the customer cares about) and turning it into a personalized plan for everything outside the home. Discovery, search, and recommendations should feel like expert advice from someone who knows their yard, not a sales pitch. Get it right and customers trust us with more; get it wrong and we spend that trust.

**Keeping customers through the moments that make them leave.**  
Customers try to skip or reschedule a visit and get it wrong. Some cancel

**Senior Product Manager**  
Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C) | Boats Group (Miami, FL)  
  
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a new, high-priority consumer product from first concept through launch and growth. You will define the experience, work in fast build-measure-learn cycles, and be accountable for volume and revenue.

You will sit in the C2C organization and partner daily with product, operations, and commercial teams across the business, including marketplace and app teams, buyer and seller product teams, financing, closing specialists, CRM, and ancillary services.

**What You Will Do**

**Own the 0-1 launch and scale**

* Take a new product from concept through launch and scale, owning the full customer journey.
* Run short cycles of build, release, measure, and iterate, with a bias toward shipping and learning over perfecting.
* Map the customer journey and decide where the experience should be self-serve, AI-assisted, or handled by a person.
* Design the experience to work across multiple web and mobile surfaces so it can be reused and extended.

**Set direction and be held to results**

* Work with the GM of C2C to set product vision, prioritize quarterly objectives, and agree on the key results you will be accountable for.
* Translate company objectives into opportunities and solutions using an Opportunity Solution Tree (OST), and keep the tree current as you learn.
* Make clear tradeoffs across competing demands from partner teams, and communicate them openly.

**Discover and validate**

* Run discovery, user research, and validation on every significant opportunity and solution before and after build.
* Design and read A/B tests and other experiments. Form hypotheses, define success metrics up front, and act on the results.
* Work closely with Design so research and data shape the experience.

**Build with AI and agentic flows**

* Decide where AI and agents belong in the customer flow and where human judgment is required.
* Define guardrails, escalation paths, and quality measures for AI-driven steps in a high-trust experience.

**Design the operational layer**

* Own the handoff points where a case moves from the product to an operations or specialist team. Define the triggers, playbooks, tooling, SLAs, and feedback loops.
* Use operational data to find what to automate next and to reduce cost to serve.

**Run the product day to day**

* Lead team ceremonies (planning, grooming, standups, retros, demos) and write clear, testable tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Act as the point of command for the squad: unblock the team, make timely decisions, and keep scope, risk, and dependencies visible.
* Communicate status, risks, and results clearly to leadership and to partner teams.

**Drive decisions with data and finance**

* Build and maintain quantitative models of funnel conversion, volume, revenue, and unit economics, with support from an analyst.
* Turn the data into hypotheses to test, and into business cases for investment decisions.

**What You Bring**  
**Required:**

* Typically 6+ years in product management, including at least one 0-1 launch taken to scale.
* Experience building payments, marketplace, or checkout-style products with meaningful volume. Experience with high-consideration or high-value goods is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of AI and agentic design: you can describe where automation helps, where it fails, and how to build trust and fallback paths into a flow.
* Operational process experience. You have designed workflows where product hands off to an operations or support team, and you can specify those handoffs.
* Hands-on use of OST and continuous discovery, plus solid grounding in A/B testing, research, and validation.
* Strong quantitative and financial skills: comfortable building a model, reading a P&L, and defending a forecast. Fluent in BI tools, or willing to work closely with an analyst.
* Proven ability to run agile ceremonies and write clear

Kapitus is building a next-generation enterprise data and AI capability that replaces hundreds of legacy analytics workflows with governed, reusable business data products — moving the organization from producing reports to producing decisions.

As a Data Product Lead, you own data products through their full life cycle — from business problem and value hypothesis, through business case, build, launch, adoption, and usage reporting, to retirement of products and the legacy reports they replace. You are the bridge between business requirements, data engineering, governance, and customer-facing teams, and you manage products against outcomes business leaders recognize, not technical output.

* Own usage reporting and portfolio transparency: scorecards, value stories co-created with stakeholders, and regular reviews informing invest, pivot, or retire decisions.

* Own retirement: sunset policies, end-of-life roadmaps, and structured decommissioning for products — and legacy workflows — that fail to sustain business value.
* Elicit requirements through stakeholder interviews, focus groups, and customer journey mapping; translate vague, ill-defined needs into well-defined, testable product requirements with clear acceptance criteria.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Listing Media
jobs.desc:
**About the team**
------------------

On Zillow, most buyers see a home many times before they ever book a tour. The photos, video, 3D tours and floor plans on a listing serve as its first showing. They decide which homes people fall for, which ones make the shortlist, and how confident a buyer feels before they set foot inside. The Listing Media team builds the products behind that moment:
  
  

* Aryeo, the platform real estate photographers use to run their businesses and deliver their work
* Media experiences in Zillow Pro, where agents order, manage and market their listing media
* The connections that bring high-quality media onto Zillow listings seen by millions of home shoppers

**About the role**
------------------

Listing media is changing faster than it has in a decade. A photo shoot used to end with a gallery of images. Now it can be the starting point for an immersive, AI-enhanced experience: interactive floor plans, virtual staging, video walkthroughs, and new formats nobody has imagined yet. Everything rests on getting great media created, delivered and onto the listing.

  

As Senior Product Manager for Listing Media, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for that foundation. You'll set direction for how photographers create and deliver their work in Aryeo and how agents order and use media in Zillow Pro. You'll also shape how that media reaches the buyers who rely on it. Your work connects three groups: the photographers who capture homes, the agents who market them, and the buyers deciding where to live. Do it well, and every listing on Zillow feels a little more like walking through the front door.

  

**You Will Get To:**

* Set the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for Listing Media across Aryeo and Zillow Pro.
* Build tools that make running a real estate media business simpler, from booking and ordering to invoicing and delivery, so photographers can spend more time creating.
* Shape the agent experience in Zillow Pro. Agents should be able to order from the photographers they trust, bring their own media, and turn it into marketing that wins listings.
* Help high-quality media flow onto Zillow listings at scale, working with engineering and integration partners to keep it fast, reliable and easy.
* Partner with Rich Media, AI and Showcase teams so the media your products deliver powers what comes next: 3D tours, interactive floor plans, virtual staging and AI-generated video.
* Stay close to photographers, agents and home shoppers. Turn what they tell you into clear problem statements, and test ideas quickly with prototypes and AI-assisted research.
* Define annual and quarterly goals and success metrics. Dig into why metrics move, and drive action.
* Make clear tradeoffs between photographer, agent, consumer and business needs, and between new features and the reliability that makes them work.
* Align engineering, design, data science, sales, customer success and operations around a shared plan. Tell the story to senior leaders through product briefs, reviews and demos.

Company: Alaska Airlines The Team:

Guided by our purpose, core values, and leadership principles, we are creating an airline people love. Our corporate teams set the strategies and operational plans to ensure the success of our company. Whether we use our expertise in accounting, human resources, finance, planning, legal, marketing, or any of our operational divisions, our shared passion for travel and our guests is what motivates us to achieve excellence each day. If you share our passion for creating an airline people love, we want to hear from you.

Role Summary:

The Principal Product Manager is a lead subject matter expert responsible for crafting the vision and backlog(s) for an assigned product area. As an individual contributor, this role presents options for the long-term strategy for a product portfolio to key stakeholders and exercises considerable latitude and initiative to solve complex problems. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, designers, and engineers to design, implement, test, and refine functionality for digital experiences. The Principal Product Manager also acts as a mentor to teammates and provides thought leadership for Alaska Air Group (AAG).

Key Duties:

* Responsible for the creation, communicates, and regularly updates a vision and direction for their product portfolio.
* Responsible for the creation, decisions, and maintenance of a value-based prioritized backlog of opportunities for products which align to Alaska’s business strategy and goals.
* Responsible for the creation, communication, and maintenance of strategic roadmaps to ensure visibility and transparency of work planned.
* Use product discovery techniques to move from idea to prototype.
* Accountable for the creation of user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Utilize story mapping techniques to inform the creation of release plans, with a strong bias towards incremental delivery and iteration.
* Partner with the UX Design & Engineering teams to provide guidance and prioritization during the product development process and participate in user research and product discovery activities
* Exercise considerable judgment to make key tradeoff decisions.
* Engage in constructive conversations with - and deliver tough messages when needed - to key stakeholders, including senior executives, while continually building professional and productive relationships.
* Coordinates new & changed functionality with affected groups to ensure seamless rollout of new capabilities.
* Interacts with external vendors in design, delivery and support of software and hardware products.
* Develops and reports on key product development metrics and builds ability to track and measure into offerings.
* Provides day to day support of the portfolio of applications and products including managing support inquiries, responding to user feedback, creating communications, triaging reported system issues and identifying timeline for resolution as part of Agile Delivery Sprint processes, etc.
* Builds and establishes partnerships with external vendors and partners to achieve outcomes to support the operation and product(s).

Additional Details:

This product role will focus on shaping how Alaska Airlines shows up in an increasingly agent-driven world. jobs.desc:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative, strategic, and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry.

Pricing is the primary economic engine of Lyft's marketplace — a high-precision, real-time system that processes millions of fare calculations per hour, balancing rider affordability, driver earnings, and Lyft's sustainable growth. The Pricing team sits at the intersection of the marketplace, mediating between rider demand and driver supply, and is a core pillar of the Rider Organization.

The Base Pricing Team owns the systems that set the base price of a Lyft ride for every ride type, region, and ride intent. Behind these base prices is a machine-learning and optimization stack that predicts how the Lyft marketplace responds to price, translates the cost of serving a ride into a price, and recommends price changes across hundreds of markets every week. Base prices are the foundation of every fare, and they set the reference point that dynamic pricing and rider discounts build on.

The team serves two sets of customers: riders, who should see prices that are fair, competitive, and matched to what they value; and the analysts and market managers who use our models and tools to set pricing strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

As the Staff Product Manager for Base Pricing, you will own the vision and roadmap for how Lyft sets base prices, and define the success metrics that measure it. That includes:

* Determining the optimal granularity at which Lyft sets base prices (e.g., by time, location, and type of trip)
* Improving how our base price optimization engine works with downstream dynamic pricing systems to better respond to real-time market conditions
* Re-evaluating how costs to fulfill a ride impact prices
* Jointly optimizing prices across ride types, so that standard, alternative modes, and scheduled rides are priced as one portfolio
* Making our impact estimation models accurate and trusted by market management teams
* Evolving base pricing to function in a hybrid network with autonomous vehicles
* Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (engineers, scientists, analysts), and partner teams (Driver Earnings, Verticals, Market Management) to align on a shared vision, define requirements, and prioritize inbound requests.
* Communicate roadmaps, experiment results, and pricing decisions clearly to audiences from partner teams up to Lyft's executive team.

* Experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization; comfortable working directly in SQL and with data science partners on model design

Overview:

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

Senior Product Managers will deliver value to clients via improvements to our software product offerings. Specifically, you will identify problems and opportunities to direct our engineering R&D efforts and the improvements that create the most value—optimizing complex trade-offs in the process.

You sit at the intersection of business, UX design, and technology. You feel at home empathizing with customers’ business challenges, sharing thoughtful insights with product designers, writing detailed specifications for developers, passionately sharing your ideas to executives, politely saying “no”, making tough decisions without all the information you’d like, and pouring through data to extract the key insight, … all in the same day. You thrive on creating order from chaos and are a passionate advocate for creating systems and processes to avoid having to do the same thing twice.

Responsibilities:

* Translate users' experiences, usability feedback, unmet needs, and satisfaction levels into requirements and user stories
* Drive development of new features and enhancements through definition, planning, design, build, and launch phases of product development
* Glean critical feedback from users during the product discovery process to refine designs and reduce risks
* Clearly communicate customer stories, pain points, and product benefits to our users and internal stakeholders
* Collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data to inform decision-making, drive adoption and assess impact of decisions (build-measure-learn)
* Define requirements and evaluation criteria for AI/LLM-enabled authoring capabilities (e.g., prompt design, retrieval, human-in-the-loop review); partner with data scientists and data engineers to measure and optimize output quality, latency, and cost
* Promote Certara products in presentations, webinars, workshops, events, and conferences
* Author best practice guides and help articles; create in-app help and instructional tips for user onboarding
* Curate product knowledge to efficiently distribute key knowledge to various stakeholder communities and customers

Qualifications:

* BS/BA in science or technology related field
* 5+ years in product management or equivalent role
* Ability to work in a remote position requiring constant spoken and written communication; skill in exerting influence at all levels of the organization without leverage or managerial authority
* Systems-thinking and ability to anticipate and communicate downstream implications of today's decisions
* Experience working with data engineering teams on data pipelines, data quality, and integration requirements
* High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for mess; able to create order out of chaos, attend to details, and push quality higher
* Relentlessly resourceful and discerning in solving problems independently vs. seeking help from others; brave yet humble in working across multi-disciplinary teams where each person is more of an expert than you in their chosen field
* Eager to constantly learn and improve, flexible in adapting to change, comfortable in growing through successes and setbacks
* Fastidious for facts, insistent on evidence- and data-driven

Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands, including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. **About The Role & Team:**

The Lead Product Manager role sits in the Commercial Growth & Optimization organization within Technology for Disney Experiences supporting Festivals & Events across Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort. This role will be creating best-in-class digital experiences that reach Guests through our web and mobile platforms with personalized, timely, and relevant content. Partnering with the Manager and Senior Manager, the Lead Product Manager will help shape the Festivals & Events platform roadmap for both resorts, drive integration across products and capabilities, and support a long-term commercial growth program at scale. The role collaborates with marketing, operations, design, analytics, development, and executive partners to launch products and expand business opportunities for Disney Experiences. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, thrives in a matrixed organization, and knows how to weave together diverse technologies and capabilities into high-quality products that Guests love!

The Lead Product Manager will report to the Manager, Product Management – Specialized Verticals

This role sets the bar for standards, planning discipline, and delivery quality across the Disneyland Resort & Walt Disney World Resort Festivals & Events portfolio. It combines delivery ownership with functional leadership for the team, without direct reports.

The Lead Product Manager shapes product requirements for new features and capabilities, working alongside engineering, design, operations, and business partners across the entire product lifecycle - from early concept through development, launch, go-to-market, and ongoing operational support. The role drives execution of the roadmap brings creative solutions to complex problems and ensures products land successfully with Guests and are well supported after launch.

Key focus areas include owning our Festivals & Events content as a product - its strategy, standards, tooling, and process; continuously raising delivery quality across our core products; and stepping into incoming work, including the integrations and changes our products must adopt across both coasts.

This role is expected to put existing technology to work - using it to generate insight and efficiency, building tools that unlock performance, and maintaining the context layers that tools, agents, and workflows rely on to be effective.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for a defined product area, ensuring clarity of vision, goals, and measurable outcomes
* Define and maintain product strategy, roadmap, requirements, and success metrics for your domain

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Identity
jobs.desc:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to define the future of how hundreds of millions of Amazon customers prove who they are? AI-powered attacks are making passwords and legacy multi-factor authentication increasingly vulnerable, and our Identity team is responding by building the next generation of authentication — passkeys, digital IDs, phishing-resistant phone-number verification, and more. As a Senior Product Manager, Technical on this team, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for these new authentication experiences, from problem discovery through launch and optimization, across surfaces including desktop, mobile, TV, and smart-home devices.  
  
You will combine deep customer empathy with rigorous metrics analysis to understand how customers sign in, where friction exists, and what solutions will earn their trust. You will partner with engineering, design, legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship experiences that protect customers while keeping interactions simple and intuitive. If you are energized by solving complex security challenges at massive scale and want your work to be felt every time a customer interacts with Amazon, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and evolve the authentication product strategy — assess customer needs, market trends, and emerging threats to set a clear vision for passwordless and phishing-resistant experiences across your area of ownership.
* Own the product roadmap from concept to launch, prioritizing initiatives based on customer impact and business value while managing cross-functional dependencies with engineering, design, and legal teams.
* Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and success criteria; partner with designers on prototypes and with engineers on architecture reviews to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and intuitive.
* Analyze adoption metrics, customer behavior data, and performance indicators to identify optimization opportunities, root-cause issues, and inform roadmap investments.
* Collaborate with senior leaders, partner teams, and stakeholders across the company to build alignment on new authentication initiatives and influence organization-wide priorities.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might start by reviewing authentication success-rate dashboards and digging into an anomaly you spotted in passkey enrollment metrics. After a design review for a new digital ID verification flow, you join your engineering team's sprint planning to refine acceptance criteria and discuss technical trade-offs. In the afternoon, you draft a product requirements document for a phishing-resistant verification feature, then meet with a partner team to align on an upcoming launch across multiple device surfaces. Between meetings, you connect with customers through usability studies and support-ticket analysis to keep your roadmap grounded in real needs.  
  
About the team  
Our Identity Services team owns one of the most highly trafficked experiences at Amazon — the moment a customer signs in. We support products like Retail, Alexa, Prime Video, and Amazon Pay across every device type, and our mission is to make authentication secure, simple, and invisible. We are dedicated to mentorship and career growth. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels, and we pair new members with one-on-one mentors and thoughtful document reviews so everyone develops into a well-rounded product manager ready to take on increasingly complex challenges.

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

**Position Title**: Principal Product Manager, AI

  

**About the role**

For more than a decade, LTK has helped shape the creator economy by connecting thousands of creators and brands with millions of consumers. Today, our platform powers more than $6 billion in annual retail sales. Behind that scale is over a decade of commerce data on how people discover products, how creators influence purchasing decisions, and how brands and consumers connect.

You'll define how AI helps brands find the right creators, turns commerce intelligence into better decisions, and enables agents to work on behalf of customers—always with their goals in mind. Your scope will span LTK's Creator Management Platform (CMP) agent harness and LLM judges, in-house ML models, and the proprietary knowledge graph connecting our creator, brand, campaign, and marketplace intelligence.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Liquidity
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT CURRENT**
-----------------

Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our Liquidity team, which builds the products that help members get through the gap between paychecks. This is a hands-on role: you will own discovery and execution for your area end to end, write your own specs, and work closely with leaders who are involved in key decisions.

Liquidity products: early access to earned pay and fee-free overdraft, from eligibility and limits to settlement and the member experience around them. These products carry real complexity under the hood (eligibility rules, risk models, bank partners, compliance) and the member experience has to stay simple and clear.

Build the roadmap for your area, bring your own point of view on what should be in it, and drive it from discovery through launch.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* Drive discovery projects end to end: frame the problem, research, size the opportunity, and recommend a path
* Write clear specs and own timelines through launch
* Partner with backend and frontend engineering, design, and data
* Work across risk, data, engineering, design, product marketing, and compliance to ship
* Keep complex products simple for members
* Measure results and feed learnings back into the roadmap
* Use AI tools day to day to move faster: drafting specs, analyzing data, prototyping, and summarizing research

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

* 6+ years of product management experience, most of it on consumer (B2C) products, including setting the roadmap for a product area and a track record of driving projects from discovery through launch on your own
* Strong execution: you write clear specs, own timelines, and follow through to launch
* Experience partnering with both backend and frontend engineering
* Strong consumer product sense from shipping B2C experiences at scale, and a talent for making complex products simple
* Comfortable in a hands-on environment, working closely with leaders who are involved in key decisions
* Strong cross-functional collaborator, at ease with many stakeholders across risk, data, engineering, design, product marketing, and compliance
* High ownership and a growth mindset: motivated by quality work, adaptable, and eager to learn
* Fluent with AI tools in your own workflow, and curious about where they can speed up the team

**BONUS**
---------

* Experience in fintech or another regulated industry (not required; some of the best consumer PMs come from outside fintech)
* Experience owning strategy for an area, or building a product from 0 to 1

**COMPENSATION**

This role has a base salary range of $165,000 - $205,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. Current offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity in the form of stock options
* 401(k) plan
* Discretionary performance bonus program
* Biannual performance reviews
* Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents
* Flexible time off and paid holidays
* Generous parental leave policy
* Commuter benefits
* Fitness benefits
* Healthcare and Dependent care FSA benefit
* Employee Assistance Programs focused on mental health
* Healthcare advocacy program for all employees
* Access to mental health apps
* Team building activities

You'll define the multi-quarter thesis on which channels compound, the operating rhythm the rest of the growth PM team inherits, and the ZoomInfo POV on how buyers discover us in an AI-first world.

This is a rare opportunity to own a P&L-shaped surface with full air cover to ship fast, learn in public, re-pivot when the data turns — and to define the growth PM craft as ZoomInfo scales it.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Longitudinal Patient Record
jobs.desc:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we deliver improved outcomes at lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the longitudinal patient record, one trusted view of the care each patient receives across every setting, from the primary care office to the specialist to a hospital stay. Every Counterpart product builds on this record.

Our clinical data comes from hundreds of sources, including health information exchanges, EHRs, labs, ADT feeds, pharmacy fills, prior authorizations, and claims from our health plan customers. Each one captures part of a patient's care. The longitudinal record connects them into one history of the patient's visits, conditions, medications, and results.

You will ensure completeness and consistency in how those sources come together, so providers walk into each visit with the full picture, care gaps get closed, and quality and risk adjustment programs capture the care patients actually received.

Our AI reasons over the same record, so improvements to the record expand what our AI can reliably do. That work takes clear clinical definitions, sound data modeling, and AI applied where it adds scale, such as classifying documents and connecting records across sources. The result is that every AI tool we build works from the same view of each patient.

You will report to the Director of Product, Clinical Data Products, and lead the Longitudinal Patient Record pod. You will partner closely with engineering, our clinical team, and data consumers across the company.

**What you will own and improve**

* **Product strategy.** Set the vision and roadmap for the longitudinal record. Find the highest-value problems across the products and programs that depend on it, and make the trade-offs among completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and investment.
* **A trusted record.** Define how care events and their dates, settings, providers, and facilities are represented consistently, and how medications, conditions, labs, and procedures connect to those events and to the patient's history over time. Set clinically grounded rules for combining sources that each describe part of the same care, so every fact can be traced to the evidence behind it.
* **A unified record of acute events.** One record of each hospitalization, ED and post-discharge care management built from multiple sources such as: ADT notifications, prior authorization and admission notices, facility claims, medical records (especially discharge documentation), and where the patient went at discharge. Anyone working with the patient sees the whole stay, from admission through discharge to the next setting of care.
* **Data for every use case.** The record serves providers at the point of care and the programs that depend on complete care history: quality measurement (HEDIS), risk adjustment and RADV audits, payment integrity, and revenue operations. Providers, quality analysts, and operational teams all work from the same care history.
* **How every source becomes part of the record.** You own patient matching, deduplication, normalization, and clinical terminology mapping, which turn raw data from each source into a trusted part of the patient's record. Every new source runs through them, so improvements are built once and reused across products.
* **Adoption.** A canonical field counts only when clinicians use it. You own the path from definition to adoption: requirements, a migration plan per use case, and retiring fragmented, duplicate versions of the same data.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* The record gets more complete, accurate, and timely, and you can show it with numbers.
* Products and programs adopt the shared record and retire their own versions of it.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

Veeva Vault PromoMats is the industry-leading platform that life sciences companies rely on to manage the full lifecycle of promotional content, and digital asset management (DAM) is how customers store, find, reuse, and distribute the approved assets behind every campaign. We are looking for an experienced product manager to own and grow Veeva's DAM capabilities, making our customers' brand, marketing operations, commercial, and medical affairs teams more efficient and productive.

In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for DAM capabilities, such as asset ingestion and metadata, search and discovery, rights and usage management, content reuse, and multichannel distribution. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

### **What You'll Do**

* Product Strategy & AI: Own the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for DAM, including where AI capabilities such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and generative variations fit, balancing customer demand, market trends, and the realities of design and engineering
* Customer Discovery: Engage directly with brand, marketing operations, creative and agency, medical, and regulatory teams at life sciences companies to understand how they create, organize, find, reuse, and distribute assets, and translate those insights into prioritized product requirements
* Measurement & Impact: Define and track the metrics that prove customer value, such as asset reuse rates, time to find and publish an approved asset, metadata completeness, and feature adoption, and use them to guide the next set of investments
* Feature Definition & Delivery: Write clear specifications and partner with Engineering, UX, and QA through design, build, and release to ship capabilities that meet the scalability and quality standards of the Veeva Vault platform
* Governance & Automation: Deliver capabilities that reduce manual effort across the asset lifecycle, such as automated metadata extraction, rendition and format management, rights and expiration tracking, and approved-asset distribution to downstream channels, while preserving the auditability regulated customers require
* Cross-Product & Go-to-Market Alignment: Partner with product teams across Vault, including PromoMats MLR review and claims, to deliver connected experiences, and enable Sales, Services, and Support with the positioning, demos, and documentation needed to bring releases to market

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of enterprise software product management, engineering, or consulting experience
* 2+ years of hands-on focus on digital asset management (DAM), content management, or creative production platforms
* Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of how DAM systems are built, including metadata models and taxonomies, rendition and transcoding, APIs and integrations, and the application of AI/ML, such as auto-tagging, semantic search, and Generative AI, to asset workflows

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. At Planet Fitness, our purpose is to create a more connected and Judgement Free™ planet, where fitness and wellbeing are within reach for all. That commitment extends to our team members and how we work together.

Breaking Boundaries Together is how we bring our employee experience to life, creating a place where people can show up as themselves, explore what’s possible, continue to grow and achieve more together than they can alone. Guided by our PLANET Principles, we put people first, lead with authenticity and integrity, embrace change and thrive together.

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!

Overview:

The Sr. Product Manager is passionate about building digital experiences that deliver meaningful value to our members and business, such as supporting the member journey through technology, as well as driving member satisfaction, revenue, and retention through digital product features. The Sr. Product Manager owns the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for a workstream comprising of multiple PODs and is charged with leading high performing cross-functional development teams, focusing on achieving aggressive growth goals for member engagement and retention.

Overseeing multiple dedicated PODs within a workstream, this role partners closely with Engineering, UX Design, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, and other business stakeholders to bring new product features from concept through launch. The Sr. Product Manager is a strategic product leader who defines the vision and roadmap for a workstream, balances member needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility, and coaches product team members to deliver measurable business outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who has built consumer-facing applications within retail, subscription, or digital consumer businesses and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve real customer problems. Experience supporting subscription, membership, or digital products is highly desirable.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI-native platform
jobs.desc:
### **Who Are We?**

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural "core behaviors" with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say "Thanx" Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

### **Who Are You?**

You go to the customer first and the data second, and you can tell the difference between a loud request and a real pattern. You bring evidence, not anecdotes, and you have opinions you built yourself rather than inherited from a roadmap meeting.

You are hands-on with AI tooling in practice, not in a slide deck. You've spent real time in Claude Code, Codex, or comparable agentic tools, built your own prototypes and workflows with them, and you have opinions about where they break. You can read a schema, write a query, follow a pull request, and hold your own with engineers on tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer; you do need to be unafraid of the codebase.

You write well, because our specs are read by humans and agents alike and clear writing is the core craft. You thrive with a broad mandate and little process, and you build conviction with leadership through evidence rather than escalation.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. **We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.**

### **Position Overview**

You will own a meaningful area of the next generation of the Thanx platform, end to end, from the customer problem to the shipped product to whether it actually moved the business. This is real product, for real restaurant brands, on real data.

The surface area is wider than "loyalty software" suggests. Thanx today spans:

* **Consumer experiences.** Branded mobile apps and web ordering used by millions of restaurant guests, each brand distinct on a shared foundation.
* **Loyalty.** Points, tiers, check-in and card-linked programs, redeemable online and in-store.
* **Marketing automation and CRM.** Segmentation (including SegmentAI), campaigns, offers, and A/B testing in a self-serve merchant dashboard.
* **Data and reporting.** Capture rate, Insights Lab, guest identity resolution, and the warehouse underneath it all.
* **AI products in market.** RecoveryAI, which resolves guest issues after an order, SegmentAI, and a merchant-facing MCP server that puts a brand's Thanx data inside the AI assistant they already use.
* **Integrations.** The POS and ordering systems restaurants actually run on: Toast, Square, NCR Aloha, PAR Brink, Qu, Revel, Olo, and others.

There is a lot of surface area and not many PMs. That means real ownership: the decisions you make change how hundreds of brands run their guest relationships, and the data comes back fast enough to tell you whether you were right.

We are profitable, with industry-leading retention, and we are long past the search for product-market fit. We are rebuilding the platform around AI, and this role is about what that platform becomes next.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager (vMetal)
jobs.desc:
As a Staff Product Manager for vMetal at vCluster Labs, you’ll help own the systems that discover, provision, configure, and manage physical hardware, turning racks of bare metal into a programmable platform for AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers to build tenant clusters on top of. You’ll work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership on the tradeoffs that shape where vMetal goes next.

As a Staff Product Manager, your role will include:

  • Infrastructure Direction: Align on business priorities and technical direction for vMetal across compute and networking, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against..

  • Networking: Own vMetal’s networking layer. Define how vMetal provisions and isolates tenant networks across InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics, from tenant VPCs to rail-optimized GPU fabrics, and how it works with fabric controllers and NVIDIA’s networking tools.

  • Product Leadership Partnership: Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership to shape the direction of vMetal.

  • Hands-on Validation: Run alpha and beta builds yourself, including against real bare metal hardware and network fabrics where possible. Catch integration issues before customers do.

  • Customer Intelligence: Engage directly with platform and network engineers at AI Cloud operators and hyperscalers running bare metal at scale, and turn what breaks in their environments into product behavior.

  • Market Positioning: Track the bare metal, GPU infrastructure, and data center networking ecosystem. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: 5+ years experience in cloud infrastructure, data center networking, bare metal, or GPU/HPC platforms. We’re open to a range of backgrounds for this role, not just traditional product management, including networking and hardware vendors.

  • Networking Fluency: You understand InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, and the NVIDIA networking stack (Spectrum and Quantum switches, UFM, Cumulus Linux, NVUE), well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.

  • Infrastructure Fluency: You understand bare metal provisioning, out-of-band server management (Redfish, IPMI), and PXE boot well enough to make informed product tradeoffs.

  • Customer-Facing Infra Experience: You’ve sat across from platform engineers, network engineers, and architects, and you’re comfortable in that conversation.

Bonus points for:

  • AI Networking Depth: Familiarity with fabrics tuned for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

  • Kubernetes-as-a-Service: Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.

  • Startup Growth: Adaptable to startup pace and change.
