jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Movable Ink scales content personalization for marketers through data-activated content generation and AI decisioning. The world's most innovative brands rely on Movable Ink to maximize revenue, simplify workflow and boost marketing agility. Headquartered in New York City with close to 600 employees, Movable Ink serves its global client base with operations throughout North America, Central America, Europe, Australia, and Japan.

As Lead Product Manager at Movable Ink, you'll own the behavioral decisioning capabilities that sit at the heart of our most time-sensitive marketing activations. This means defining how our platform detects meaningful customer patterns over time and turns them into reliable, high-value triggers, from abandoned cart and price drop to the next generation of signals our customers haven't yet imagined. You'll partner closely with a technically strong engineering team to set product direction, resolve ownership boundaries across dependent teams, and build the foundation for self-serve behavioral configuration at scale. This is a role for a product thinker who is energized by technical depth, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by seeing their work drive real customer outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Movable Ink's Behavioral decisioning layer across Da Vinci and Studio
* Partner with engineering to define and evolve the trigger library, stateful contact context model, declarative pattern framework, and suppression and eligibility controls
* Establish and maintain clear product scope and integration contracts with dependent teams including events, data persistence, semantic labeling, and delivery
* Identify and prioritize the highest-value behavioral use cases by drawing on customer insight, commercial input, and data, and translate them into well-scoped requirements engineering can execute against
* Define the configuration model and taxonomy for the declarative pattern framework, enabling new behavioral signals to be created without engineering involvement
* Be a ruthless advocate for our customers in every interaction and decision

**Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of product management experience working directly with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders, with demonstrated ownership of a technical product domain
* Ability to reason about event-driven systems, stateful logic, and time-windowed pattern detection at a conceptual level, and translate those concepts into clear product requirements
* Strong prioritization skills, capable of distinguishing high-leverage investments from parity work and building alignment around sequencing decisions
* Skilled at navigating ambiguous ownership boundaries and establishing durable cross-team contracts in environments with multiple interdependent engineering teams
* Clear communicator who can operate across engineering, CX, sales, and executive stakeholders, adjusting depth and framing without losing precision
* Experience partnering closely with engineering in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where product direction and team process are shaped together

GRACE is ARPA-H's AI assistant, and its value depends on how well ARPA puts it to work. We are looking for a startup-minded Product Manager who is also the team's product owner and Scrum Master. You'll own the backlog, run the sprint cadence, write epics and product acceptance criteria, track and report the numbers, and be a main point of contact for the people using GRACE.

You'll work with the GRACE product lead, who sets strategy and epic priority, breaks ties, and makes the final call on sprint scope, releases, and architecture reviews. Engineering owns how things get built. You own getting work ready, keeping each sprint on track, and making sure what ships gets used and works.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked directly with customers or internal teams in high-velocity environments such as startups or big tech, listens more than they talk, and wants to apply practical AI across an enterprise. You'll do this while helping teams understand GRACE's capabilities and limits within the constraints of our mission and the broader federal environment, including privacy, security, safety, and responsible use by default.

**What You'll Work On:**

* Turn prioritized epics into a ranked backlog.
* Write user context and product acceptance criteria for every story, and technical acceptance criteria.

* Run a 60-minute grooming session with a hard stop, keep time, and move anything unresolved to a breakout with only the people involved.
* Track open items until they close, co-own the ready check before planning with the lead, and run ceremonies on a fixed schedule.
* Track velocity against capacity, along with carryover, raise trends before anyone asks, and keep meeting load in check.
* Get the right people together, make the call, and tell everyone when requests compete for the same sprint.

* Pull your own data, write SQL, read logs, and build and maintain dashboards.
* Publish a weekly update covering usage, velocity, carryover, bug burn-down, and what's shipping next.
* Review grooming health and delivery health with engineering every month.

* Triage bugs by severity, take part in every pre-release test huddle, and use GRACE every day the way users do.
* Help define what a good GRACE answer looks like, and contribute test cases to the team's evaluations.
* Serve as the accountable party for release sign-off when no other owner is named, and hold a release if testing, design review, or architecture review was skipped.

* Share customer-facing support with the product lead, by supporting intake, feedback channels, and office hours.
* Run discovery through interviews, usability sessions, and usage data.
* Help lead training and onboarding, including live sessions, release notes, how-to guides, and onboarding for new agency partners.
* Work with design and research to turn findings into epics, then measure what shipped.
* Bring security, compliance and ATO considerations in early, especially for external agency integrations.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Elevate is Zillow's media and advertising business. We connect advertisers with the hundreds of millions of people who visit Zillow's platforms, and we build the ad products, audiences and measurement that turn that reach into revenue. Our media business spans onsite placements across Zillow's owned and operated experiences and offsite placements across the open web, social, CTV and other channels, bought and sold programmatically through demand-side (DSP) and supply-side (SSP) platforms. We partner across Zillow's consumer brands and business lines so every advertiser and customer interaction is relevant and meaningful.

As a Senior Product Manager for Elevate, you will lead revenue-generating media and advertising products across three areas: audience targeting, media reporting and measurement. You will define how advertisers reach Zillow's unique, high-intent audience onsite and offsite, how they buy that media through all media channels, and how they prove the results. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited about shaping products that reach millions of customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and customer experience, turning ambiguity into clear product strategy? As a Technical Product Manager at Amazon, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of products that solve real customer problems at scale. You will partner closely with engineering, design, science, and business teams to define what we build and why — using data, customer insights, and sound judgment to make smart trade-offs. * Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and prioritized deliverables.

### **About Hipcamp**

Every year, Hipcamp makes it possible for millions of people to spend the night under the stars, supporting rural economies and biodiversity along the way. Everything we do is guided by our belief that getting outside is good for the health of people and the environment. While we are best known for unlocking access to 5 million acres of private land for camping around the world, we have also emerged in the last couple years as the leader unifying our public and commercial campgrounds, creating the one app that has “everywhere you want to camp." We are backed by world class investors including A16Z, Benchmark, Bond Capital and Index Ventures.

### **About the role**

Hipcamp is looking for two Senior Product Managers to join our product team across the two core areas of our marketplace: the camper experience, how millions of people discover and book trips outside, and the host experience, how landowners open their land to camping and earn from it. You'll lead a dedicated pod of engineering, design, and data, set the roadmap for your area, and be accountable for the results. This is a high-ownership role for a PM who stays close to users, makes decisions with data, and ships fast with AI as part of how they work.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the roadmap for your area of the marketplace: set priorities aligned with company strategy, make the tradeoffs and deliver results.
* Lead a cross-functional pod of engineers, a designer and a data partner: run planning, set backlog priorities and keep the team focused and unblocked.
* Build a deep understanding of campers or hosts through regular conversations, support tickets, reviews and research, and turn those insights into product decisions.
* Set the goals and metrics for your area, and work with your data partner to run experiments, read the results and decide what to build next.
* Work AI-first across everything you do: research, writing, data analysis, prototyping and improving how the team works. Bring the same thinking to the product, from trip discovery for campers to pricing and listing tools for hosts.
* Partner with Marketing, Growth, Host Success, Supply Operations and Support to ship changes that move the business.
* Collaborate with other product managers so changes on one side of the marketplace strengthen the other.

Houston, TX · On-site (hybrid negotiable) · Full-time

**About WePro**

WePro is AI-first SaaS for the home service industry. We build the tools home service businesses use to run every part of their operation: CRM, dispatch management, call answering, marketing campaigns and billing. Every part is customizable, with AI and automations built into each step.

In this industry, a missed call is a lost job and a slow dispatch is a lost customer. Our tools help our customers avoid both. Most software in this space treats AI as an add-on. We built WePro AI-first, and every part of the platform is customizable. We're bootstrapped and profitable, so we answer to our customers, not investors. We're a small team moving fast to change what home service software can be, and we're looking for a product manager to help us do it.

**Why this role**

* **Work directly with the founders and CTO.** Your ideas go straight to the people who decide, and decisions happen in days, not quarters.
* **Own the product, not a slice of it.** You'll set what gets built across our CRM, dispatch and AI features, and see it in customers' hands.
* **Hard, interesting problems.** AI that answers and books real calls. Dispatch logic for technicians in the field. Automations that run a business while the owner is on a job.
* **Real impact, fast.** Small team, short path from idea to production. What you ship this month changes how our customers run their business next month.

**Who we're looking for**

Someone who thinks like a product owner and executes like a strong project manager. You'll drive several initiatives at once, independently, from first idea to shipped result. You solve problems instead of escalating them, take ownership of outcomes, and challenge assumptions, including ours. You don't wait for instructions or just move tasks across a board; you decide what needs to happen and make sure it does.

**What you'll own**

* **Execution across many projects.** Run several initiatives at once. Plan the work, set deadlines, follow up with every owner and make sure what we start actually ships, on time.
* **Prioritization and coordination.** Prioritize features within the roadmap the CTO sets, and coordinate developers, designers and QA teams to deliver them.
* **Requirements and specs.** Turn founder ideas, business problems and customer feedback into clear requirements, UX flows, acceptance criteria and tickets.
* **Delivery.** Lead developers, designers and QA from idea to launch, and own testing sign-off before anything ships. You run the process; you don't manage people.
* **New AI features.** Find where AI can save our customers time or win them jobs, and get it shipped.
* **The release process.** Planning, QA, release notes and a steady shipping cadence.
* **Honest pushback.** Spot product issues, propose fixes, and challenge ideas that won't work, including ours.

**Other responsibilities**

* Improving internal workflows, operational efficiency and the customer experience.
* Coordinating vendors and technical integrations.
* Supporting cross-team initiatives.

**You might be a fit if**

You have:

* 4 years of hands-on product management at a SaaS company.
* A track record of shipping products and features end to end, and you can walk us through them.
* Strong project management: you've run several projects in parallel, kept deadlines and owners on track, and closed them out.
* Experience coordinating engineering, design, and QA teams.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX.
* Strong understanding of software development and APIs, and the confidence to work through technical tradeoffs with engineers.
* Hands-on experience building with AI, LLMs or automation.
* Strong written and spoken English; your specs leave no room for guessing.
* An owner's mindset: you run projects, fix broken processes and bring your own ideas about where the product should go.

Bonus points:

* CRM, field service management, dispatching or con

Overview:

**About Cherre, a RealPage Company**
------------------------------------

Real assets software has served consumers across two completed eras. Era One built systems of record to capture transactions. Era Two built data warehouses and dashboards to inform analysts. Era Three is now open, and its primary consumer is the AI agent.

Cherre, now part of RealPage, is building the ultimate trust layer for real assets: a resolved, governed, semantic infrastructure that AI agents can reason against, decide from, and act through. The world's largest institutional CRE investors and operators, collectively holding more than $5T in AUM, run on Cherre today. Combined with RealPage's operating data footprint and scale, we hold the foundational institutional truth that next-generation real asset intelligence runs on.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for an AI-Native Senior Product Manager with elite, deep-domain Commercial Real Estate product expertise to play a core role in our semantic, graph modeling, and platform activation layers. You will own day-to-day product execution across the Semantic Layer (Luna, Meridian), Graph Modeling (Meridian), Reasoning Agents (Atlas), and platform workstreams, partnering with product leadership to turn complex, highly disparate real estate data into reliable, agent-ready data systems.

You will step completely away from traditional "product management theater." There are no 30-page PRDs, rigid screen-by-screen wireframing dependencies, or slow-moving human-overhead sprints here. Instead, you will operate under an inverted "Build First, Evaluate Second" model, collaborating directly with highly autonomous engineers using agentic development environments (ADEs) to evaluate functional prototypes in real time.

* Lead the development of graph and resolution systems that serve external agents via the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, enabling seamless global ontology harmonization and multi-org comparison capabilities tailored to institutional CRE standards.

### **2. Bedrock Infrastructure & Agentic Activation**

* Oversee the migration and production hardening of our platform infrastructure onto our next-generation stack.
* Scale the Bedrock platform MVP to unify onboarding, data quality, enterprise governance, and global administration into a consolidated, intuitive command UI.
* Architect the foundational agentic layer: empowering clients to build custom agents on top of our governed semantic infrastructure, deploying the Janus hypothesis engine, and launching Agentic chat featuring advanced plan modes and programmatic source citations.

* **Semantic & Graph Modeling Fluency:** Working command of Semantic Data Modeling (SDM: defining business meaning, metrics, and relationships as a governed layer over raw data), Universal Data Modeling (UDM: standardized, source-agnostic entity models that many systems map into), and graph modeling (representing entities and their relationships as nodes and edges for resolution and reasoning

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Kubernetes Accelerated Runtime
jobs.desc:
Running GPU-accelerated Kubernetes reliably is deceptively hard. A small change to a driver, kernel, operator, or Kubernetes version can break a cluster in ways that are painful to diagnose and expensive to reproduce. AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) is NVIDIA's open source project to define a validated, reproducible software stack that can go into every AI cluster, published as version-locked recipes customers can trust through end-to-end supply-chain provenance.

NVIDIA is hiring a product manager to lead the accelerated runtime that defines every GPU Kubernetes cluster. You'll set the direction for the NVIDIA AICR project and grow it into how the industry runs NVIDIA's software stack on Kubernetes, growing its coverage across accelerators, clouds, and workloads. The role also represents AICR to customers, partners, and the open-source community. Want to bring GPU infrastructure to life and power NVIDIA innovation? We'd love to hear from you!

What we need to see:

The mission is ambitious: make NVIDIA's accelerated software stack the runtime that powers every GPU Kubernetes cluster! This role will:

•
Own AICR and related technologies, set product direction, and standardize how customers and partners run NVIDIA's GPU software stack on Kubernetes.

•
Expand coverage across accelerators, clouds, and workloads, from training and inference to agentic AI.

•
Keep the stack current and trustworthy, turning NVIDIA's validation into recipes that customers can deploy with supply-chain confidence.

•
Represent AICR and other NVIDIA projects to customers and partners, and lead their growth in the open-source community.

What We Need to See:

We're looking for an experienced product manager who can go deep on GPU infrastructure and lead an open-source project in the open.

•
12+ years in technical product management across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, or developer and platform tooling.

•
A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience.

•
Depth in the Kubernetes GPU stack: cluster provisioning and lifecycle, operators and drivers, scheduling, and the compatibility failure modes across kernel, driver, OS, and Kubernetes versions.

•
Experience with GitOps and cluster configuration delivery (Helm, Argo CD, Flux, or equivalent tools) and the realities of shipping configuration that has to be reproducible.

•
A track record of contributing to open-source projects, including community strategy and external presence such as conference talks or technical writing.

Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:

We're especially interested in candidates who also bring experience:

•
Hands-on work with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, DGX systems, the GPU Operator, or GPU-aware Kubernetes scheduling.

•
Software supply-chain security: SLSA, SBOMs, Sigstore or Cosign, or reproducible builds.

•
Packaging and distributing a sophisticated software stack (operators, drivers, platform components) across clouds and hardware.

•
Owning or contributing to a widely adopted cloud-native or CNCF open-source project.

As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for driving the development and delivery of innovative products that meet user needs and business goals. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, highly organized, analytical, curious, an excellent communicator, and possesses a deep understanding of agile product delivery principles and practices.

• Product Owner certification (e.g., CSPO)

• Passion for technology and a deep understanding of market trends and customer needs in the digital product space.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

The Product team at Airwallex is a group of passionate builders and problem-solvers who are obsessed with crafting customer-centric solutions that empower businesses to operate anywhere, anytime. We combine technical expertise with a deep understanding of our customers' needs to design and build unified, intuitive, and scalable products. As a team, we thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, constantly iterating and pushing boundaries to deliver exceptional product experiences.

What you’ll do

This role will be part of the payments product team, building out our capabilities that enable businesses to collect credit card payments and other forms of payments on their website or app from consumers around the world. You’ll be working on the payment lifecycle end to end, from connections with the card schemes, authorizations, captures, refunds, and reconciliation.

Expanding our coverage of card schemes and markets to provide merchants globally the ability to acquire payments of all major card brands

•
Optimizing the competitiveness of our card payments infrastructure through adoption of new industry standards and working closely with our machine learning team to increase the success rate of payments

•
Building stable foundations for our payment infrastructure to scale with our business growth, reducing internal manual efforts and minimizing the risk for any service interruptions for our merchants

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

8+ years of professional experience, ideally with exposure to a high-growth environment

•
Drive, grit, and persistence are necessary to take ownership and move ideas to reality in short periods of time

•
Ability to thrive in cross-cultural and cross-functional team

How it fits the AI era
AI is the core of the product here, so the work involves deciding how language models turn raw conversations into summaries, actions and personal memory, and testing new model abilities quickly. Judgment about what is actually useful, how much to automate, and how to keep privacy and trust intact stays with people. Deep customer contact also stays human, because models cannot tell what feels delightful or creepy.
How it builds AI experience
The role offers hands-on work with agents, proactive assistants, personal memory and connections to other AI tools through APIs and MCP, all built on real conversation data from a large base of devices. To build this experience beforehand, someone could prototype a small tool that turns recordings into notes or tasks, and try linking it to other AI apps through MCP.

Experience in physical products, hardware, manufacturing, robotics, or emerging technologies is advantageous. - Connect planning and scheduling seamlessly

This role mixes hands-on engineering with product leadership. The person sets what gets built, talks to customers, and leads a very small team of people and AI agents while still writing a lot of code. A strong candidate has a computer science background, a few years as a working engineer, and real experience owning a product roadmap. The posting is open to someone who has not managed a team before but is eager to step up.
How it fits the AI era
The role is built around the idea that AI is blending engineering, product management, and design into one builder job. AI tools can speed up coding, prototyping, and testing, so one person can cover far more product ground. What stays human is judgment about what to build, listening closely to customers and clinicians, and a high bar for product quality in a healthcare setting.
How it builds AI experience
The work involves building AI products for outpatient medical practices running automated virtual clinics for chronic care, while using AI tools daily and directing agents as part of the team. Someone in this seat would gain practical experience shipping AI features in a regulated field. To prepare, build and ship small AI projects end to end, and learn how care workflows in outpatient practices run.

Strong hands-on software engineering

Product and UX taste

##### VP, Product

Insurance underwriting runs on human judgment, manual workflows, and knowledge locked in someone's head. It breaks when that person leaves and doesn't scale when the book doubles. Sixfold is building AI agents that understand risk the way a 20-year veteran underwriter does. Not summaries or flags, but systems that make real decisions on billions in premium for some of the world's largest carriers. AI is the product, the workflow, and the moat. If you think in systems, move fluidly from research to pixels, and are energized by designing AI-native experiences where the best practices haven't been written yet — this role was made for you.

##### About the Role

You'll inherit a strong product and a capable team, but that's the starting point, not the job. The job is figuring out what underwriting becomes once AI stops assisting and starts deciding, and getting there faster than the market expects. You prototype to find out, not to perform speed. You're drawn to this problem because the underwriter of the future is one of the more interesting design problems in software right now.

In this role, you will:

- Set the direction for what AI-native underwriting looks like at Sixfold, and hold a 12-month theme even as the tactics under it change frequently
- Build the first version of new ideas yourself: a prototype, a working demo, a lighthouse customer test, before asking the team to build the tenth
- Stay current enough on AI's leading edge to have a real opinion on where things are going, not just what's already shipped
- Represent Sixfold's view of where underwriting is headed with customers, partners, and the industry, so people outside the company measure their own thinking against yours
- Take ownership of the existing product and team and raise the bar on how they operate, without mistaking "it's not broken" for "it's finished"
- Partner closely with design and engineering so prototyping speed doesn't turn into technical debt. Speed and guardrails are both you

We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding.

Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

You'll create the AI Care Partner category and make sure the market understands what we've actually built, not what we started as. This role sits at the center of product, brand, and commercial, turning every release into a moment the market notices, and every quality bar we hold internally into a reason clinicians and health systems trust us more than the alternative. You'll know you're doing this well when analysts stop describing us as "the scribe company" and competitors start describing themselves relative to us.

##### What You'll Do

- Own positioning and messaging for the AI Care Partner category, across clinician, enterprise, and patient audiences, tailored by specialty, buyer type, and geography.

##### Conveo Product Marketing Role

Conveo is building AI powered consumer understanding infrastructure platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

Positioning sits upstream of everything a company says. The words chosen for a segment decide which ads work, which pages convert, which deals open, and which category the market files us under. At most companies that thinking is scattered across founders, sales decks, and agencies. Here it has one owner. You.

Conveo is going from tool to infrastructure, and founding a category to do it. Categories are won inside the buyer's head, which makes the person who truly understands those buyers, and can tell their story back to them better than they can tell it themselves, one of the highest-leverage people in the company. What you write becomes what sales says, what the website claims, what the ads promise, and eventually what the market believes.

This is a whole-company seat. You are the resident empath for everyone who buys Conveo, from the insights leader who runs the platform to the CMO who signs for the infrastructure. Product asks you how a feature should be framed. Sales asks you what to say in the room. Founders ask you whether the narrative holds. When someone anywhere in the company needs to know what our buyers think, want, fear, or say, they come to you, and you know.

##### Your Mission

##### 1\. Understand our buyers better than anyone in the company

Confidence here comes from doing the work, and you know how the work is done.

- Run the positioning exercises: the interviews, win/loss reviews, and segmentation work that establish who buys Conveo, why, and why now
- Know where the information lives and go get it: sales calls, transcripts, closed and churned deals, communities, analysts, the product itself
- Become an absolute empath for every buyer, from the insights leader to the CMO

# Head of Product

Confidential

[Columbus, OH](https://jooble.org/jobs/Columbus%2C-OH)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1499635336049864987?p=1&pos=0&rgn=37003&pageType=7&jobAge=67&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7881785288295715751&crId=US_0US_0)

**Head of Product**

**About the Company**

Private-equity-backed animal health technology business unifying data, customers, and software platforms

**Industry**

Computer Software

**Type**

Privately Held, Private Equity-backed

**About the Role**

The Company is seeking a Head of Product to lead the strategic and executional aspects of product development. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and realizing the growth opportunity created by the unification of two software platforms. This role is pivotal in shaping the company's product strategy, establishing discovery practices, and delivering products that align with the defined direction. The Head of Product will be expected to produce a well-supported growth thesis, build a validation-driven practice, and lead a product organization that is embedded with AI. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in product management, with a focus on growth, and the ability to operate effectively at both the executive level and in hands-on product development.

Applicants for the Head of Product position at the company should have a background in B2B SaaS, with experience in both commercial and regulated segments. A minimum of 7-12 years in product management, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role, is required. The role demands a leader with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle, from strategy to execution, and a proven ability to drive product development that meets customer needs and business goals. Experience in private-equity-backed or high-accountability settings, as well as a background in data or platform products, is highly valued. The Head of Product will be expected to have a hands-on approach, be adept at working with cross-functional teams, and have a deep understanding of AI and its application in product development.

**Hiring Manager Title**

CEO

**Functions**

- Product Management

A minimum of 7-12 years in product management, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role, is required. The role demands a leader with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle, from strategy to execution, and a proven ability to drive product development that meets customer needs and business goals. Experience in private-equity-backed or high-accountability settings, as well as a background in data or platform products, is highly valued. The Head of Product will be expected to have a hands-on approach, be adept at working with cross-functional teams, and have a deep understanding of AI and its application in product development.

**About the Role**

The Company is in search of a Head of Product to spearhead the growth and development of its product organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization across a diverse SaaS portfolio. This role involves managing investment decisions, coaching and scaling product management and user research teams, and partnering with various departments to enhance product discovery, development, and delivery. The Head of Product will also be tasked with building a deep understanding of customer and market needs, driving business outcomes, and representing the product organization to a wide range of stakeholders.

Applicants for the Head of Product position at the company should have a minimum of 10 years' of product management experience, with at least 5 years' in a senior leadership role. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-product SaaS, experience in launching AI-native or AI-enhanced commercial products, and a proven track record of influencing commercial outcomes through product strategy and go-to-market activities. A background in vertical SaaS, healthcare, or a specialized industry is highly preferred. The role requires exceptional communication skills, the ability to make strategic investment decisions, and a strong partnership with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, customer success, engineering, and design.

Chief Product & Technology Officer

- Product Management

# Head of Product

Confidential

[Houston, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Houston%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7909807811264431777?p=1&pos=0&rgn=46481&pageType=7&jobAge=67&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1341090455408779592&crId=US_0US_0)

**Head of Product**

**About the Company**

Private-equity-backed animal health technology business unifying data, customers, and software platforms

**Industry**

Computer Software

**Type**

Privately Held, Private Equity-backed

**About the Role**

The Company is seeking a Head of Product to lead the strategic and executional aspects of product development. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and realizing the growth opportunity created by the unification of two software platforms. This role is pivotal in shaping the company's product strategy, establishing discovery practices, and delivering products that align with the defined direction. The Head of Product will be expected to produce a well-supported growth thesis, build a validation-driven practice, and lead a product organization that is embedded with AI. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in product management, with a focus on growth, and the ability to operate effectively at both the executive level and in hands-on product development.

Applicants for the Head of Product position at the company should have a background in B2B SaaS, with experience in both commercial and regulated segments. A minimum of 7-12 years in product management, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role, is required. The role demands a leader with a strong understanding of the product lifecycle, from strategy to execution, and a proven ability to drive product development that meets customer needs and business goals. Experience in private-equity-backed or high-accountability settings, as well as a background in data or platform products, is highly valued. The Head of Product will be expected to have a hands-on approach, be adept at working with cross-functional teams, and have a deep understanding of AI and its application in product development.

CEO

**Head of Product**

**About the Company**

Innovative provider of veterinary software systems

**Industry**

Veterinary

**Type**

Privately Held

**Employees**

51-200

**Specialties**

- veterinary technology & software

**About the Role**

The Company is in search of a Head of Product to spearhead the growth and development of its product organization. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization across a diverse SaaS portfolio. This role involves managing investment decisions, coaching and scaling product management and user research teams, and partnering with various departments to enhance product discovery, development, and delivery. The Head of Product will also be tasked with building a deep understanding of customer and market needs, driving business outcomes, and representing the product organization to a wide range of stakeholders.

Applicants for the Head of Product position at the company should have a minimum of 10 years' of product management experience, with at least 5 years' in a senior leadership role. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-product SaaS, experience in launching AI-native or AI-enhanced commercial products, and a proven track record of influencing commercial outcomes through product strategy and go-to-market activities. A background in vertical SaaS, healthcare, or a specialized industry is highly preferred. The role requires exceptional communication skills, the ability to make strategic investment decisions, and a strong partnership with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, customer success, engineering, and design.

Chief Product & Technology Officer

- Product Management

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Nemotron
jobs.desc:
Open large language models (LLMs) are unlocking exciting new capabilities. Developing, training, and deploying these models requires both technical expertise and domain-specific knowledge. They power applications in data centers and at the edge, including automobiles, drones, and medical devices. As their agentic capabilities expand, so does the need to identify and mitigate potential risks. NVIDIA is at the forefront of advancing research and delivering product innovations for the broader AI community!

As the Nemotron Product Manager for Model Risk, you will lead key areas of NVIDIA's model risk management portfolio, addressing frontier challenges in cybersecurity, content moderation, data protection, and more. Nemotron makes model checkpoints, datasets, and training techniques available to the community to help minimize risk and broaden adoption. You will define model safety requirements and evaluations, partnering with research and engineering teams to reduce harmful outputs and improve model robustness. You will also engage with customers to define products and roadmaps, develop business strategy and market positioning, and bring products to market. We need a self-starter to grow this area and help build the future of AI.!

What you'll be doing:

• Enterprise Model Risk Management: Define requirements for model evaluations and mitigations, such as post training improvements and guardrails

• Contribute to Open Source: Publish and guide the community on best practices for identifying and mitigating open model risks.

• Define and Prove: Collect insights and build market analysis that provides the data to enter or change new markets through a clear value proposition for the product

• Market intelligence: Understand the developers, partners, and competitors

• Build and Deliver: Collaborate with engineering to promote the customer's needs through setting feature priorities across roadmaps

• Sense and Respond: Work closely with customers, build surveys, present at conferences, understand product quality and supervise critical bugs

• Marketing content creation: Work with marketing to define positioning that enables the creation of technical content, including blog posts, webinars, developer tutorials, and more to communicate the product value proposition

• Product launches: Define the go-to-market strategy and provide mentorship to the cross-functional implementation of the plan across marketing, public relations, and sales.

What we need to see:

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or other technical field (or equivalent experience). MBA is a plus.

• 15+ overall years of technical product management, or similar, experience at a technology company

• 6+ years direct people management experience.

• Passion for delivering software, libraries and SDKs

• Proven track record of teamwork across teams, customers, and partners

• Outstanding interpersonal and public communication skills with a shown ability to articulate a value proposition to technical and non-technical audiences

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Background working with Large Language Models, specifically with setting evaluation tasks as well as curating data, training or fine-tuning, to increase model capabilities

• Experience with enterprise AI safety, responsible AI, or model risk management.

​NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the world's most forward-thinking and hardworking people on our team. . As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 425,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Publishing Product Management, Americas - VALORANT
jobs.desc:
As the VALORANT Publishing Lead for the Americas, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the publishing strategy across one of VALORANT’s most critical and high-stakes global footprints. You will bridge global ambition with local execution, ensuring our strategy serves a diverse player base across North America & Latin America.

With deep expertise in competitive FPS gaming, publishing, and cultural offenses, you will act as the voice of the Americas region. You will lead cross-functional publishing teams, manage subregional strategies, and advocate for Americas players in global leadership discussions to amplify the game’s success and propel VALORANT into its next era.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a cohesive publishing strategy for the Americas that aligns with global objectives while tailored to the unique cultural nuances and player behaviors across the US, Canada, LATAM, and Brazil.
  • Serve as the strategic authority for the Americas, with dedicated focus on driving growth, cultural resonance, and retention across North America and Brazil.
  • Act as the primary regional voice in global publishing and game leadership discussions. Integrate regional player insights into global product, marketing, and content roadmaps.
  • Lead cross-functional discipline leads (Brand, Creative, Community, Comms, and Content) to execute Category Offenses, product launches, and ecosystem beats across the region.
  • Oversee the Americas publishing OpEx budget, driving efficient resource allocation across subregions, optimizing marketing performance, and balancing global bets with local activations.
  • Align local agency retainers, regional programs (e.g., VCT Americas, local roadshows, community events), and go-to-market activations with central publishing strategies.
  • Recruit, mentor, and lead a matrixed, regionally diverse team of managers and individual contributors across the US, LATAM, and Brazil, fostering a high-craft, growth-oriented culture.

Required Qualifications: 

  • 12+ years of experience in video game publishing, entertainment, or tech, with a track record of driving product, marketing, and community strategy for major live-service titles.
  • 5+ years of experience directly managing and leading multi-functional, multicultural teams across different international markets.
  • Deep understanding of the gaming landscape, creator economy, and cultural nuance across North America and Latin America, with specific expertise in the US gaming and esports ecosystem.
  • Proven ability to launch, scale, and sustain live-service game products or major content beats in a complex, multi-region territory.
  • Demonstrated success navigating matrixed organizations, advocating for regional needs with executive stakeholders, and executing within budget constraints.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Professional fluency in English, with a strong benefit to proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese
  • Deep familiarity with the VALORANT player base, VCT ecosystem, and the tactical FPS genre.
  • Strong quantitative background with a track record of using data, player insights, and attribution models to optimize strategy and publishing outcomes.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Product Owner, Private Markets Businesses (Vice President)

**Job summary**

As a Product Owner on the Asset Management Private Markets Product team, you will serve as the product lead for multiple Private Markets businesses. You will set the roadmap and strategic direction for applications used by each business, prioritize the backlog, and oversee delivery by a dedicated team of technologists. • Establish agile-driven user acceptance testing and change management, and oversee day-to-day delivery including triage, issue resolution, and defect management.

• Product-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to lead discovery, strategy, requirements, and value management.

• Ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problem spaces and new initiatives.

• Proven track record delivering successful products or contributing to large-scale technology transformations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable with data, metrics, and process analysis.

• Strong communicator and collaborator who listens to users, reconciles priorities, and articulates solutions across business and technology teams.

• Familiarity with scaled agile methodologies and multi-team delivery environments.

**Preferred qualifications, skills and capabilities**

- Familiarity with private markets concepts such as waterfall calculations, capital call/distribution processing, and private investment structures.

- High aptitude with agile best practices and collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, JIRA).

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; diverse academic backgrounds welcome.

- Experience managing technology products or platforms; product management experience within Asset Management preferred.

- Experience using data analytics and insights to diagnose issues and inform product decisions.

- 5+ years of experience in project or program management in complex business or technology environments; Experience at an Asset Manager with familiarity concerning portfolio management, research, or reporting functions is a plus

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. * Founded in 2010 and headquartered in St. Louis, MO, with a distributed team across the US.

* The portfolio is multiplying. We are moving from one product line to a platform spanning sales, service, data, F&I, payments and digital retail. Each department has a different buyer, a different competitor set and a different vocabulary. Nobody owns the messaging architecture that ties them together.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (PrintOps)
jobs.desc:
**Director, Product Management (PrintOps)**  
**Pharos | US Remote**

  
  
*Here's what you'd actually be stepping into: an established product, two new markets it hasn't reached yet, and no one left who can tell you why it behaves the way it does. Some people need that explanation handed to them. Others go dig it up themselves. This role is for the second kind.*

### About Pharos

Pharos Systems International is the leader in PrintOps, the integrated, user-centric, and cloud-native approach to managing printing and the infrastructure and operations behind it. Pharos' modern print management software empowers enterprises to reduce costs, strengthen security, and support today's hybrid workforce with simple, reliable, and scalable printing solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including many of the world's largest Fortune 500 companies, Pharos has helped eliminate print servers, cut millions in print-related spend, and accelerate the transition to cloud-based infrastructure. Headquartered in Rochester, NY, Pharos has been delivering innovative print management solutions and measurable ROI since 1992.  
  
Our flagship product already runs inside a large, established customer base, which means it carries real history, real workarounds, and a level of hidden complexity that isn't written down anywhere. We're also pushing it into new markets it hasn't served before, without losing the trust of the customers who already rely on it every day. That combination, protecting what works while extending what's possible, is exactly why this role exists.

### What This Role Is

This role owns the full product loop for one of Pharos's most established product areas: understanding how it actually works today, bringing its capabilities under control, deciding what to build and what to explicitly leave alone, and making sure Engineering and the rest of the company are working from the same understanding you are.  
  
You'll work directly with enterprise customers, including the conversations where the answer is no, and you'll set direction across customer commitments, technical constraints, and two new markets at once, without letting the loudest voice in the room decide the roadmap for you.  
  
You'll also use AI as a normal part of how you work: discovery, synthesis, competitive research, epic drafting, documentation, not as a novelty, but as how the work actually gets done, in a fast loop with Engineering that doesn't wait on oversized specs.

### What You Will Own

* The model of how this product actually works, and keeping it current as you learn more.
* A visible roadmap where every item has a reason, an owner, and a real answer for what Pharos is and isn't doing.
* The path from a raw signal (a support ticket, a sales request, a customer complaint) to a decision someone can act on.
* Direct conversations with enterprise customers, including the ones where the answer is no.
* The translation of product direction into work Engineering can actually build and verify against.
* Making sure Sales, Support, Customer Success, Services, and Marketing know what changed and why, not just that it changed.

### What a Strong Background Looks Like

* You've owned a mature, complicated product, one with real history, real workarounds, and a real customer base, not just a green-field build.
* You've sat across the table from enterprise customers directly: discovery calls, pilots, advisory relationships, the uncomfortable ones included.
* You've turned a messy customer or market need into something Engineering could actually build against, and stuck around to see what happened after.
* You've made a complex product simpler, more consistent, or easier to reason about, not just added more to it.
* You reach for AI as a normal part of how you think through a problem, not as a novelty.

**Not a good fit if…**

**Strong fit if…**

  

You're looking to build and lead a team starting now.  
You've only ever built new products from a blank sheet,

**Director, Product Management (Security)**  
**Pharos | US Remote**

  
  
*Here's what you'd actually be walking into: one early customer, a real thesis, and everything else still unproven. Some people need the market validated before they'll commit to building in it. Others want to be the one who proves it's real. This role is for the second kind.*

### About Pharos

Pharos Systems International is the leader in PrintOps, the integrated, user-centric, and cloud-native approach to managing printing and the infrastructure and operations behind it. Pharos' modern print management software empowers enterprises to reduce costs, strengthen security, and support today's hybrid workforce with simple, reliable, and scalable printing solutions. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including many of the world's largest Fortune 500 companies, Pharos has helped eliminate print servers, cut millions in print-related spend, and accelerate the transition to cloud-based infrastructure. Headquartered in Rochester, NY, Pharos has been delivering innovative print management solutions and measurable ROI since 1992.  
  
Pharos has an early proof of concept in security and real conviction about where the market is headed. What we don't have yet is proof it holds up at scale, or a repeatable way to turn that thesis into a validated business. That gap is exactly why this role exists.

### What This Role Is

This role owns the full loop from thesis to revenue: understanding who the real buyer is and what they'll actually pay to solve, turning an existing proof of concept into something multiple customers can rely on, and building the go-to-market motion that gets it from a handful of pilots to a repeatable business.  
  
You'll work directly with Engineering, not just direct it: prototyping, reviewing technical tradeoffs, and getting into implementation details yourself when that's the fastest way to learn something. You'll also work directly with customers and, over time, with Sales, to turn early proof into paying accounts.  
  
You'll report directly to the CEO, with the autonomy that comes with that and the visibility too. There's no team here yet. What you build, you build largely with your own judgment and your own hands.

### What You Will Own

* The market thesis: who the real buyer is, what they're actually willing to pay for, and what this product will deliberately not attempt.
* The path from an early proof of concept to something multiple paying customers can rely on.
* Direct, hands-on work with Engineering: epics, prototypes, requirements, and implementation tradeoffs.
* The go-to-market motion: positioning, packaging, pricing input, and what it takes to turn a pilot into a paying customer.
* A fast, honest read on what's working and what isn't, reported straight to the CEO, without waiting for a perfect plan to have that conversation.

### What a Strong Background Looks Like

* You've built and shipped something close to zero to one, not just contributed to an already-mature product line.
* You've worked directly with customers to test whether a problem is real and worth paying to solve, not just gathered requirements secondhand.
* You've gotten into the technical details yourself: a prototype, a proof of concept, a spec you wrote and then helped build.
* You've made a real call with incomplete information and lived with the outcome, good or bad.
* You reach for AI as a normal part of how you think through a problem, not as a novelty.

**Not a good fit if…**

**Strong fit if…**

  

You need a validated market and an established team in place before you're willing to commit to a direction.

You're comfortable being the person who validates the market, not just executing inside one someone else already proved.

  

Your best work has come from directing others rather than building things yourself.

You still want to be hands-on with prototypes and implementation, not just strategy.

Head of Product Management for Quantum Modalities, Quantum Technology Solutions
  
Quantum Technology Solution (QTS) is the new business recently launched at GlobalFoundries to enable the Quantum industry to transition from lab-scale to Utility Scale Quantum Computing
  
The Head of Product Management for Quantum Compute Platforms is responsible for defining and commercializing GlobalFoundries' portfolio of modality-specific quantum computing platforms. This leader will own the business, develop the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plans for photonic, ion trap, neutral atom, and other emerging quantum computing modalities.
  
Working closely with strategic customers, ecosystem partners, and QTS process development team, the role translates customer requirements into scalable semiconductor manufacturing platforms and technology roadmaps. The successful candidate will help establish GF as the leading foundry partner for utility-scale quantum computing by developing differentiated process technologies, integration flows, and product offerings that accelerate the transition from research prototypes to manufacturable quantum systems. This role is ideal for an experienced business executive with a strong background in product management of new technology platforms incl. photonics, quantum modalities and advanced packaging platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the business growth and profitability, product strategy and roadmap for GF's quantum compute platform portfolio, with primary focus on photonic, ion trap, and neutral atom quantum computing platforms.
* Develop modality-specific product offerings including process technologies, integration flows, design enablement, and manufacturing solutions required to scale quantum processors.
* Engage with quantum computing customers to understand architecture roadmaps, technical requirements, and commercialization needs.
* Translate customer requirements into market requirements, platform specifications, and technology development priorities for QTS development team.
* Drive go-to-market strategy, business cases, ecosystem partnerships, and strategic customer engagements to accelerate adoption of GF quantum platforms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Materials Science, Quantum Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 15+ years of experience in product management, strategic marketing, business leadership, or technology commercialization within semiconductors, photonics, advanced packaging, or quantum technologies.
* P&L ownership, and demonstrated success launching and scaling complex technology platforms from concept through commercialization.

* Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams across business, engineering, and R&D organizations.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.desc:
**Who We Are:**

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

* **Integrity:** Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
* **Courage:** We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
* **Together:** The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

**Job Summary:**

  

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Leader of Product Marketing who will be responsible for leading our overall go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and sales enablement efforts. SmithRx isn't just building another technology platform; we are rebuilding the pharmacy benefits category from the ground up. In this highly cross-functional leadership role, you will define how we communicate the radical value of SmithRx's platform to brokers, employers, consultants, and members, establishing us as the clear alternative to the broken status quo.

You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and scaling a high-performing product marketing team, bringing complex new capabilities to market, and driving greater adoption of our products and services. As we expand our platform capabilities, a critical part of this role will be navigating the narrative around Artificial Intelligence in healthcare. You will lead the charge in educating our market, building trust around our AI-powered features, and demonstrating how these technologies improve outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you should demonstrate a strong track record of scaling PMM functions, driving category creation, translating complex and emerging technologies into compelling stories, and partnering closely with executive leadership across Product and Sales. You must be comfortable operating in an unstructured, fast-paced environment and learning as you experiment.

**What you will do:**

* **Guide Category Creation:** Positions SmithRx as a radical departure from traditional PBMs. You will shape market perception and educate the industry on a fundamentally new way to approach pharmacy benefits.
* **Own GTM Strategy:** Drive the overarching Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for SmithRx's platform and new product features, coordinating cross-functional launches across Product, Clinical Programs, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful rollouts.
* **AI Narrative & Trust Building:** Develop and execute GTM strategies for our AI-powered products and features, crafting transparent, education-driven messaging that overcomes industry skepticism and builds deep trust with employers, brokers, and members.
* **Team Leadership:** Hire, lead, and develop a team of high-performing product marketers.
* **Positioning & Messaging:** Work with our content team to establish compelling, differentiated positioning and messaging that clearly articulates SmithRx's unique value

Overwatch Imaging is an imagery intelligence technology company working to bring sensor autonomy to time-critical airborne search, detection, tracking and monitoring missions. Our Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software, native to our own line of purpose-built Smart Sensors and as an upgrade for airborne video gimbal platforms, brings *Superhuman Vision* and *Workload Reduction* to users of real-time imagery intelligence systems. Overwatch Imaging is hiring a **Director of ASO for Maritime Applications** to drive the adoption and growth of our Automated Sensor Operator product line across maritime domain awareness, maritime patrol, search and rescue, border and coastal security, counter-narcotics, fisheries enforcement, and related missions.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Job Ingestion
jobs.desc:
We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Job Ingestion to own and drive our enterprise job acquisition and processing strategy. You will serve as the strategic product leader bridging technical data systems with core business growth levers.

In this role, you will lead the evolution of our web scraping, API feed integrations, ATS (Applicant Tracking System) connections, real-time event processing, and job parsing/normalization architectures across all BOLD web properties. The ideal candidate does not require domain experience in recruitment technology or HR tech, but must bring a strong background in data engineering or data systems (e.g., former Data Engineer, Systems Architect, or Technical Data PM).

This is a player/coach role and you should be skilled at driving outcomes as an individual contributor at times. You will leverage your technical depth to partner credibly with principal data engineers while applying strong business judgment and executive storytelling to connect job inventory health, latency, and quality directly to platform engagement, SEO footprint, and monetization.

**About this team**

Job Ingestion is the foundational engine that powers BOLD's entire job discovery and recruitment platform. Our mission is to build, scale, and optimize high-throughput, enterprise-grade ingestion systems that aggregate, parse, normalize, and index millions of job postings daily across all BOLD properties and partner feeds. By transforming high-volume, unstructured job data into rich, standardized job entities, our team enables critical downstream capabilities – most notably powering Search & Match, job alerts, SEO landing pages, recommendations, and employer analytics. We operate at the intersection of Data Engineering, Core Infrastructure, Search & Match, and Enterprise GTM to ensure job content is accurate, fresh, comprehensive, and instantly accessible to job seekers globally.

**What you'll do**

* Own Enterprise Strategy & ROI: Define and execute the multi-year Job Ingestion strategy, directly linking job processing improvements – scraping, ATS feeds, parsing, deduplication, and schema mapping – to downstream search relevance, candidate engagement, and business growth.
* Executive Storytelling & Alignment: Translate technical data concepts (pipeline latency, schema health, ATS stability) into executive-ready business narratives and clear investment proposals for leadership.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Build trust and alignment across matrixed teams, including Data Engineering, Search & Match, SEO, Portal, Mobile, and Job Alerts, to ensure seamless integration of normalized job content into all downstream surfaces.
* Operational & Technical Execution: Lead cross-functional squads (data engineers, PMs, QA) to drive predictable delivery, establishing rigorous metrics for pipeline uptime, parsing accuracy, deduping precision, and data freshness.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish schema validation, content freshness, spam/scam detection, and compliance standards to maintain high job catalog health without breaking downstream search indices.
* Team Development & Product Rituals: Coach and mentor product managers in business sense and executive communication, while establishing operational rituals that drive velocity and clarity.

**What you'll need**

* 8–10+ years of product management experience (or equivalent technical leadership experience) leading complex, large-scale data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, scraping/crawling engines, or event-driven data architectures.
* Deep Data Background: Strong technical depth in data engineering foundations (e.g., former Data Engineer, Systems Architect, or Technical PM in data platforms). Hands-on familiarity with structured/unstructured data extraction, schema design, distributed processing, and cloud ecosystem components (AWS, GCP, Kafka, Snowflake).
* Proven Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills—able to synthesize complex data pipe

**Head of Product Marketing**
=============================

**About OpenArt**
=================

OpenArt is a gen AI creative platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination.

We believe the future of creativity is AI-native, and we’re shaping that future.

**Why Join OpenArt**
====================

* **Market products at the frontier of generative AI.** You’ll work on rapidly evolving AI products that are changing how people create.
* **Shape how a new category is understood.** You’ll turn complex AI capabilities into simple, compelling stories that resonate with creators, marketers, and businesses.
* **Work directly with Product.** You’ll be deeply embedded in the product development process rather than receiving a finished product to market.
* **High ownership, real impact.** You’ll own major launches and directly influence product positioning, adoption, and growth.

**About the Role**
==================

OpenArt is looking for a Head of Product Marketing to define how our products are positioned, launched, and adopted.

Sitting at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, and our customers, you will deeply understand our users, the generative AI landscape, and our product capabilities—and translate those insights into compelling positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.

This is not a traditional product marketing role. Generative AI is evolving extremely quickly, and we want someone who is already deeply immersed in the space. * 5+ years of experience in product marketing or closely related roles

* Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technology simple and compelling
* Strong understanding of customer research, segmentation, competitive intelligence, and market analysis
* Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Growth, and Creative teams
* Highly hands-on and comfortable moving quickly in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving environment
* AI-native in how you research, create, analyze, and work

* Experience marketing AI image, video, creative, or agentic products
* Experience with consumer subscription or product-led growth businesses
* Experience marketing products to creators, marketers, SMBs, or creative professionals
* Strong personal interest in AI-generated content and creative tools

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Lead Product Launches:** Own go-to-market strategy and execution for major product, feature, and model launches.

* **Drive Product Adoption:** Partner with Growth and Product to improve activation, adoption, engagement, and retention.
* **Create Product Narratives:** Develop compelling stories, demos, landing-page messaging, launch materials, and other assets that make OpenArt’s value clear.

* Experience managing global product portfolios and distributed teams

* Proven track record of solving tough problems and delivering working solutions throughout your career

**Even better, you may have…**

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**Type::** Full-time

**Location:** Remote, with a preference for candidates located in NY, TX, MD, or GA

**Compensation:** $140,000 - $180,000

**Job Level:** Director/VP (depending on experience)

**ABOUT LEMONTREE**
-------------------

There are more food pantries in the US than there are McDonalds, but most families facing hunger don't take that help. That's why we started Lemontree–because it makes no sense for our neighbors to go hungry when there's free food around the corner. We've helped one million households access the free food in their communities by bringing technology + empathy to the experience of food assistance. Learn more about us at https://www.foodhelpline.org/about.

### **Our Values**

**Service Over Self**

We put the mission — helping people find food — ahead of ego, credit, or agenda. That means caring for the people we serve and the team around us, and going the extra mile when it makes a real difference. We're here for the work itself and what it makes possible for others.

**Ownership**

We get shit done and we carry our piece so the whole team can move forward. When we make a mistake, we name it early and openly, because a problem we've owned out loud is one we can fix together. In a growing org, this kind of autonomy & accountability is how we do big things with a small team.

**Curiosity**  
We don't take anything for granted. We stay curious about our users and ourselves. We stay humble enough to accept that there's always room to improve. We stay ready to change course when the evidence points somewhere new. The plan we have today is a strong draft, but we'll always need to adapt to a changing world. We'd rather ask the better question and adjust than defend a stale answer.

**THE POSITION**
----------------

Lemontree is looking for a **Head of Product** **& Technology** that will partner with the Executive Director to own and evolve our platform strategy to scale our impact. Since 2020, we've grown from a simple helpline into a platform that serves thousands of families, partners, and volunteers daily. What we need now is someone who can shepherd us to the next level, bringing rigor and direction to how we evolve: sharper prioritization, better use of our data, and clearer decision-making & process around where we invest our resources. Every decision we make should align with our strategic anchors:

* User-centered

* Hospitality in every interaction

* Built for scale

This is a hands-on leadership role with high trust and high agency, reporting to the Executive Director. You'll be the person setting product direction and leading the charge to move it forward, partnering with an engineering agency on execution and collaborating closely across our broader Lemontree team. While product ownership is the focus, this is a multi-disciplinary position that combines product management, data analysis, and technical leadership to build toward stability *and* scalability. If you like operating with real autonomy and are motivated to take things from 1 100, this role will suit you.

### **What You'll Do**

Drive **technical leadership** that delivers a reliable, joyful, scalable user experience for neighbors looking for food assistance.

* Serve as a credible technical voice in conversations about architecture, tradeoffs, and feasibility.
* Direct our engineering agency, translating product priorities into well-scoped technical work and holding a high bar for what ships.
* Oversee third party services that support our product, including setting up integrations, managing billing, negotiating nonprofit discounts, etc.

Own a **product roadmap** that increases the breadth & depth of our impact, aligned with our organizational strategy.

* Partner with CEO & senior leadership to shape overall strategy & product direction. Rather than making every single product decision, you will own the process that helps those decisions happen with the right information, clear accountability, and strong follow-through.

As we transition from development to deployment in Las Vegas in 2026, we are setting the stage to scale our technology globally. This role requires a visionary product leader who can zoom out to build a cohesive Motional point of view on the product experience, while zooming in to untangle complex technical dependencies between hardware, AI, and operations. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Enterprise security is one of the fastest-growing and most strategic areas at Amazon Web Services (AWS), and we are looking for a marketing leader to own how the world understands it. As the leader of Product Marketing for AWS Security and Identity, you will set the marketing strategy for a high-growth business, define the category narrative, and build the team that brings it to life. In this role, you will sit at the center of how AWS establishes itself as a leader in enterprise security.
  
  
This is a rare chance to own a strategic business end to end from a product-marketing standpoint. You will decide where to invest, what story to tell, and how to measure whether it is working, while partnering with engineering, finance, go-to-market, and sales leaders to generate growth. You will be building the team that will drive the growth, including hiring, developing, and shaping a team of product marketers into a group known for sharp storytelling, strong business judgment, and deep technical credibility with security buyers.  
  
If you are a product marketing leader who wants the autonomy to shape a category, the scope of a business that matters, and the opportunity to build a team you are proud of, this role is for you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the product marketing strategy for the AWS Security and Identity portfolio, and set the category narrative that positions AWS as a leader in enterprise security.
  
  
Own positioning, messaging, and launch strategy across the portfolio, and represent AWS with customers, at industry events, and in analyst and executive interactions.
  
  
Partner with the Security and Identity product leaders to shape the portfolio roadmap based on working back from customer needs.
  
  
Decide where to invest for the greatest return, using data and customer insight to guide strategy, prioritization, and the initiatives the team designs and launches.
  
  
Set the bar for how the team measures impact, and build the habit of testing ideas, learning quickly, and deciding with evidence.
  
  
Build, grow, and develop a team of product marketers - hiring top talent, coaching for craft and business judgment, and creating an environment where people do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* 3+ years of leading a team with experience in hiring and developing talent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience setting marketing strategy for a business or portfolio, and using data and metrics to guide investment decisions.
* Experience marketing business-to-business technology products, such as cloud, security, or infrastructure software.
