**Overview**

Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.

We are looking for a **Director of Product Strategy, Commerce** to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.

This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.

In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:

* Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
* Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
* Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM SAM capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
* Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
* Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
* Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

AI Experiences employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft Hub in the U.S. are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own a current, first-principles POV on the agentic-commerce market, the protocol landscape (for example ACP, UCP, AP2, MCP), and where Microsoft’s advantage is real.
* Design and pressure-test monetization: the payer model across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner, the methods, and the sequencing.
* Build the opportunity models and forecasts that let the org rank bets and defend investment asks with numbers, including ARR- and ROI-based justification.
* Bring repeatable decision frameworks to major product bets so the reasoning is structured and legible.
* Synthesize the Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments threads into one coherent strategy and surface where they conflict.
* Turn the analysis into the strategy spine — the MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, and investment cases — and prep the VP with a sharp POV and the two or three things that would change it.

**Job Description:**
  
Our client is building the AI-native operating system that insurance agencies run on, starting with life insurance, where roughly one in ten new agents is still producing two years in. Every sales call an agent has is recorded and turned into intelligence: how well the agent performed, how interested the lead is, what objections came up, and what should happen next. This Head of Product will own product outright, reporting directly to the CEO, setting the vision and roadmap, and carrying the product numbers on the company scorecard. The first products are live with agents today, and most of the operating system is still ahead, so this person decides what gets built next and builds the product function as the company grows. Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

You take an active part in shaping product decisions and agree priorities and sequencing with engineering leaders, who own technical direction. You’ll work closely with Design, Data Analytics, Sales, Customer Support, and Product Marketing.

We're looking for someone who knows this market, stays close to customers, and can turn that understanding into clear product priorities. You'll help us improve the platform, develop new capabilities, and grow the business by making Verda a product customers choose and keep using.

jobs.desc:
**This is a hybrid position, with an expectation of being onsite up to four days per week.**

**Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!**

You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day.

Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform seamlessly connects the right tools, delivers real-time data, and drives smarter operations for more than 4,000 financial institutions nationwide.

We are a fast-growing team built on individual ownership, company-wide collaboration, and setting industry-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth truly matters as much as the company's. At Kinective, we are leading the way to intelligent banking together and enjoying the journey along the way.

**Why This Role Matters**

Every role at Kinective exists to move the needle for our clients, partners, and the financial institutions we serve.

As the Director of Product Management, Data Intelligence, you will guide the Data Intelligence (DI) roadmap and make sure it lands in the market. You will work hand in hand with Product Marketing, Marketing, and Sales to bring new capabilities to market successfully, and you will lead the DI product team to deliver the roadmap with consistency and quality. You will also be a key partner on cross-product initiatives that connect DI to the rest of the Kinective platform, so banks and credit unions can turn their data into action and measurable business results.

You will report to the VP of Product, Data Intelligence, and carry the strategy into day-to-day execution through your team and your cross-functional partners.

**What You'll Own**

**Roadmap Leadership**

* Guide the Data Intelligence roadmap in partnership with the VP of Product, turning product line strategy into clear priorities, sequencing, and release plans.
* Bring together customer feedback, market trends, competitive insight, and financial institution use cases to make well-reasoned prioritization calls.
* Prioritize scalable, repeatable capabilities over custom one-off requests, and communicate the "why" behind roadmap decisions to internal teams and clients.
* Keep the roadmap connected to commercial outcomes, including packaging, pricing, and the use cases that matter most to banks and credit unions.

**Go-to-Market Partnership**

* Partner directly with Product Marketing, Marketing, and Sales so every launch has clear positioning, messaging, enablement, and a plan that sales teams can use right away.
* Make sure launches are grounded in what the product can demonstrate today, with a clear view of what is coming next.
* Bring the voice of the customer and the field back into the roadmap through client conversations, advisory programs, and regular feedback loops with Sales and Services.
* Support sales and client conversations as a product expert where DI value, use cases, and roadmap direction need to be told well.

**Execution Leadership**

* Lead and develop the DI product team, including Product Managers and Product Owners, setting clear expectations, coaching on craft, and building strong operating habits.
* Drive execution on the roadmap with Engineering, UX, Services, and Support through clear requirements, healthy Agile practices, and predictable delivery.
* Run the operating cadence for DI, including planning, release readiness, KPI tracking, risk and dependency management, and status reporting to the VP and leadership.
* Spot risks early, remove blockers, and escalate with options and recommendations.

**Cross-Product and Cross-Functional Initiatives**

* Lead or co-lead cross-product initiatives where DI capabilities power broader Kinective solutions, platform work, and solution bundles.
* Partner with Platform, AI, and other product lines to align requirements, sequencing, and delivery across team

jobs.desc:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  

Director of Product Management owning the Fleet Lifecycle journey including Total Cost of Ownership analysis / benchmarking / scenario planning, vehicle remarketing (sales), and vehicle acquisition / financing. Digital experiences will need to blend seamlessly with staffed sales motions from both a Ford and dealer perspective.

This is a high-impact role for entrepreneurial candidates seeking to build something new but leverage Ford's scale and power in the commercial fleet space.

**In this position...**

* Ford is #1 in commercial vehicles in North America and the #1 brand in Europe. On this base of strength, we have built a rapidly growing software and services business (Telematics SaaS, Data/control APIs, Fleet Management services, Charging SaaS, etc.) by first building a great product, design, and engineering team
* This Ford Pro (commercial) product-development team is now being deployed more broadly to make the digital experiences for fleets seamless across the entire fleet/vehicle lifecycle
* One of the most critical lifecycle journeys for fleet customers and Ford is the process of fleet lifecycle optimization, which starts with Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis across their current assets, benchmarking these costs and scenario planning vehicle sales/purchases, selling (remarketing) the older vehicles, and selecting / configuring / negotiating / buying / financing new replacement vehicles

**What you'll do...**

* Own the product vision / roadmap for seamlessly stitching together the fleet lifecycle optimization process, enabling fleet managers to maximize their fleet operating cost and capital efficiency. This includes end-to-end ownership of the following customer journeys:
  + Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis: Consolidating all relevant operations and financing costs, including ideally indirect costs like downtime, and consolidating these in a manner that is clear and drives action
  + Benchmarking: Comparison of TCO between current assets within a fleet, between current assets to new vehicle options (esp. Ford vehicles), and of “my fleet” to similar fleets and “ideal” fleets
  + Scenario planning analysis: Help fleet managers understand how operating costs, financing costs, cash outlay etc. would change in different vehicle purchase/sale scenarios and help find the optimal scenario
  + Remarketing: Aid customers in selling vehicles for the highest prices possible at the lowest cost/effort through their preferred channel(s)
  + Vehicle selection/ configuration / quote / order: Aid customers in finding the best vehicle for their needs and streamline the quote / order process across DIY, human-staffed, and fully agentic workflows
  + Financing: Work deeply with the Pro Credit team to seamlessly incorporate vehicle financing into the vehicle purchase process for all commercial financing options
* Collaborate closely with the engineering, design, and business teams required to deliver on the vision and roadmap above
* Broker external dependencies and effectively evaluate build / buy / partner relationships
* Work closely with dealers to develop win/win strategies to deliver the above as dealers are the vehicle sales channel.
* Design input metrics to diagnose and improve the customer journey
* Become the undisputed expert on commercial fleet TCO analysis, fleet optimization, commercial financing, and the vehicle purchase process including customer needs/preferences, market norms/ competitive intelligence, and the relevant legal and regulatory frameworks
* Build and manage a high-performing product team to execute on the above

**You'll have...**

* 10+ years as a product manager, with a demonstrated track record of impact

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.desc:
**What We Are Building**

BigTime is a PSA platform for professional services firms. Thousands of consulting, IT services, and engineering firms run their business on it. We are now building our next-generation platform from the ground up, AI-native from the first line of code.

What we are going after is an autonomous back office, where agents run the whole chain from quote to cash. Scoping and pricing the work, staffing it, capturing time and expense, recognizing the revenue, getting the invoice out, and chasing the payment. Firms do all of that by hand today, stitched across half a dozen tools that do not talk to each other. Nobody in this market has built the chain end to end, and we have something a newer competitor cannot go out and buy: years of project history from thousands of firms to build against.

If we get this right, these firms stop running their back office and start supervising it. That is the thing you would be leading.

**The Role**

You will lead our product management team, and most of your time goes to the new platform. The roadmap, the release sequencing, the scope decisions, and the PMs who own each piece of it. It is the biggest investment the company has made and the board follows it closely.

You will also own the roadmap for BigTime Delivery, the platform our existing customers use today. It is the smaller part of the job and a dedicated team runs the day to day. What we need from you is the judgment on what gets fixed, in what order, and when we stop.

**What You Will Own**

* The roadmap. What ships in which release, what gets cut, which customers migrate when, and the written case for all of it. Priority gets argued from pipeline data, product usage, customer research, and win and loss analysis, rather than whoever asks most often.
* The product management team. Hiring, coaching, and the standard for the work.
* Specifications. We use spec-driven development, so the spec feeds the agentic build directly.
* Customers. You will run our Customer Advisory Board, hold executive relationships at our largest accounts including the unhappy ones, and do the discovery and win and loss work behind the roadmap yourself. Sales will pull you into deals where the roadmap decides the outcome. This is a real share of your week.
* The cross-functional loop. Engineering is the closest partner, where you and their leadership run one roadmap queue and your PMs pair with their tech leads from shaping through release. Support, Implementation, Forward Deployed Engineering, CX, Marketing, and Finance each need something different from you, and all of them need to know what is coming before a customer does.
* BigTime Delivery. Not the day to day, but the calls on what we fix and when we stop, including when it needs engineering time the new platform was counting on.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years in product management for the Director level, 10+ for Senior Director, including at least three years managing PMs.
* B2B SaaS experience on a product with real operational or financial depth.
* You have built something new at a company that already had customers to protect. A replatform, a migration, or a net new product running alongside an existing one. Tell us what went wrong and what went well.
* You use AI in your own work for analysis across sources, prototyping, and drafting product documents, and you have shipped AI or agent capability in a real product. Show us what you have built.
* You are comfortable in front of customers at the executive level, including when the conversation is difficult.
* You have managed people in other time zones, and you can get Sales, Support, Implementation, and Marketing pulling in the same direction without managing any of them.
* You have developed PMs.

* PSA, ERP, accounting, or financial software background.
* Cohort-based customer migrations, including the parity and reconciliation work.

Xponential Fitness, LLC (NYSE: XPOF) is a leading global franchisor of health and wellness brands. Through its mission to make boutique health and wellness experiences accessible to everyone, the Company operates a diversified platform of five brands spanning across verticals including Pilates, barre, stretching, strength-training, and yoga. In partnership with its franchisees, Xponential brands offer energetic, accessible, and personalized workout experiences led by highly qualified instructors in studio locations across 49 U.S. states, Puerto Rico, and 30 countries globally. Xponential’s portfolio of brands includes Club Pilates, the largest Pilates brand in the United States; StretchLab, a concept offering one-on-one and group stretching services; YogaSix, one of the largest franchised yoga brands in the United States; Pure Barre, a total body workout that uses the ballet barre to perform small isometric movements, and one of the largest Barre brand in the United States; and BFT, a functional training and strength-based program.

**Position Summary**  
Xponential Fitness is hiring a Director of Product Management to help lead the next phase of its digital experience. This role starts as a hands-on, senior individual contributor and is built to grow into a team-building, people-leading role as scope expands.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-on product ownership
* Own the roadmap for Xponential digital web and app cross-brand experience.
* Write product specs, prioritize the backlog, and run the day-to-day rituals of an agile team, including standups, sprint planning, and retros.
* Partner directly with engineering and design to scope, build, and ship features, staying close to execution rather than delegating it.
* Use data to make prioritization calls and to measure what shipped, working closely with analytics on funnel performance, engagement, and retention across brands.
* Cross-functional and franchise partnership
* Build relationships with brand presidents, general managers, and franchisee operators to understand what each brand needs from the digital product, and translate that into a shared roadmap.
* Partner with marketing, brand leadership, and the VP of Digital Experience on how digital product priorities support company-wide growth goals.
* Represent product in conversations with franchisee advisory councils and other stakeholders.
* Team building
* Define the hiring plan with the VP of Digital Experience for a product management team and lead recruiting as headcount is approved.
* Hire, onboard, and mentor product managers, setting the standards for how the team writes specs, runs experiments, and communicates with stakeholders.
* Work with the VP of Digital Experience to build the product management practice at Xponential from the ground up, including how the team works with design, technology, engineering and data.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, relevant experience required.
* 8 or more years of product management experience, with a track record of owning roadmaps and shipping consumer-facing digital products end to end.
* Demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team. This might be prior people management experience, or strong evidence of mentoring, project leadership, and the judgment to hire and develop others.
* Direct experience in fitness, wellness, franchise, or multi-brand retail is a plus but not required.
* Comfortable operating without a team in the near term.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders, including people who do not report to them, such as franchisee operators or brand leaders.
* A data-informed approach to product decisions, with fluency in product analytics tools and comfort defining and tracking success metrics.

*Xponential Fitness LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.desc:
**The role**
------------

We're in the midst of the most important buildout in U.S. history, with large growth across energy, transmission, commercial/industrial, housing, and conservation + carbon. Land is the bottleneck for all of these efforts. Aarden is a purpose-built solution to understand, invest in, and get deals done for land-dependent assets.

While only 16 months old, we are already working with the most important landowners and developers in the country, and it's time for the world to know about us. That's where you come in.

As Head of Product Marketing, your job is to show the market how Aarden thinks about land, in public, every week, and use that as a launching point to make Aarden the most influential and important voice in land markets. When a hyperscaler announces a campus, a county passes a moratorium, or a timber owner sells a million acres, you'll use Aarden to figure out what it means within the broader market context, what owners and developers should be doing in response, and what new opportunities it creates. Aarden is used to help clients make decisions like this every day, and your job is to elevate these capabilities to a much broader audience.

Over time, we want Aarden (and its leadership) to be who people turn to when they want to understand how America's land is changing, and we want that attention to turn into conversations with the landowners, developers, and investors who make the world move.

**About Aarden**
----------------

Aarden is the origination and investment partner for people building on and making decisions about American land, starting with the landowners and developers behind the energy & data center buildouts. For institutional timber and farmland owners, that means helping them see what their land could become and how to value it. For developers, it means finding willing owners with viable sites before sinking months of time and capital into a site that faces significant headwinds. For everyone, it means understanding the environmental and social impacts of these important decisions.

Under the hood, our platform combines parcel data, ownership resolution, zoning, community sentiment, and price signals with suitability models and defensible investment analysis.

We're a Seattle-based team, growing quickly and founded in 2025, with expansion plans into NYC in 2027. Four of the ten largest U.S. landowners are already clients, and our committed clients cover roughly 14 million acres of high value land. We have a wonderful cohort of investors as well. Our $4m pre-seed was announced last year but our subsequent fundraising efforts remain undisclosed; you would help us announce this.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Hunt for stories.** Read the news every day across data centers, energy, timber, farmland, and land policy, and comment on key events that change land markets (there are a lot of these!).
* **Use Aarden to find the answer.** Work with Aarden technology to figure out what each event means, lay out the options it creates for owners and developers, and back it up with historical and present-day patterns. Our data team will support you in this work.
* **Build Aarden's following on LinkedIn and X.** Publish several times a week across the company's and leadership's channels, and grow those audiences. You'll develop your own voice along the way, too.
* **Tell client stories.** Highlight our clients' efforts and help them grow their businesses with case studies that show how the smartest investors in the country partner with Aarden to drive results for their funds.
* **Turn attention into pipeline.** The stories we tell should help more organizations see the clear benefits of partnering with Aarden.
* **Speak to both sides of the market.** Write for timber and farmland owners who are weighing alternative uses, and for data center developers who are quite literally racing to secure sites. Help each learn about the benefits of working with the other.
* **Make Aarden

### **About the Role**

Foxit is looking for a **Director of Product Marketing, International** to define and lead the category strategy, portfolio positioning, and go-to-market approach for our product portfolio across **North America, EMEA, and APAC**.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a product marketer who can operate at both a strategic and executional level. You will shape how Foxit understands the market, where we play, how we win, and how we translate customer and competitive insight into product strategy, messaging, packaging, pricing, and commercial activation.

Reporting to the SVP, Head of Marketing, you will lead market intelligence, original research, segmentation, and positioning across the portfolio. You will work in close partnership with Product leadership to ensure market insight directly informs innovation priorities, roadmap direction, and long-term portfolio strategy. You will also partner closely with Growth Marketing, Integrated Campaigns, Sales, and Customer Success to bring positioning to life in market and support successful product launches globally.

This role is ideal for a senior product marketing leader who thrives in fast-moving B2B software environments, brings strong commercial instincts, and knows how to turn customer insight into differentiated market strategy and measurable business impact.

### **What You’ll Do**

#### **Lead Product Marketing Strategy**

* Define the market, category, and positioning strategy for Foxit’s product portfolio across global regions.
* Develop clear, differentiated messaging and value propositions aligned to target buyers, use cases, and customer needs.
* Own segmentation, buyer personas, pricing and packaging inputs, and portfolio narrative development.
* Ensure product marketing strategy supports both regional go-to-market needs and broader company growth objectives.

#### **Build and Lead the PMM Function**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of Product Marketers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and capability building.
* Establish PMM operating rhythms and sprint cycles aligned to product, release, and campaign timelines.
* Embed product marketing into R&D and product planning processes, including roadmap reviews, discovery sessions, and sprint reviews.
* Drive strong cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

#### **Drive Market Vision and Intelligence**

* Develop and maintain a 1–3 year market vision for each product area, including customer needs, technology shifts, competitive dynamics, and category evolution.
* Own the MRD process across both short-term and long-term planning horizons, translating research and analysis into actionable product and business recommendations.
* Lead original research initiatives to uncover customer insight, validate market direction, and strengthen competitive differentiation.
* Present market narratives, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, internal stakeholders, and external audiences.

#### **Own Positioning and Portfolio Narrative**

* Lead category definition, competitive differentiation, and positioning strategy across the portfolio.
* Develop and maintain core messaging frameworks and positioning for products, launches, and strategic pivots.
* Partner with Brand, Content, and Integrated Marketing to ensure consistency between product narratives and campaign execution.
* Act as a strategic advisor on how Foxit should evolve its story as markets, buyer needs, and competitors shift.

#### **Lead Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Own tiered go-to-market plans for product launches, including target segments, value proposition, pricing and packaging inputs, and recommended activation strategy.
* Drive launch readiness across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Lead launch retrospectives and ensure insights are fed back into future positioning, research, and planning cycles.
* Partner with regional and functional teams

Barings is seeking a Managing Director to lead Product Strategy & Management, reporting to the firm's Chief Operating Officer. The role owns the end-to-end product agenda across Barings' public and private asset classes.

The successful candidate will lead a single product organization that brings together product development and management with product strategy. This will include oversight of capabilities including competitive and market intelligence, pricing, and fund governance, supported by dedicated Public Assets and Private Assets verticals and regional product coverage. The role is the senior product voice to the investment platform, the Global Client Group and the firm's governance forums, and is accountable for translating investment capability into commercially viable products that serve institutional, insurance and wealth clients.

EHE Health is the leading national provider of preventive healthcare, partnering with mid- and large-sized employers to help their employees and dependents stay healthy. Named by Fortune Magazine and Great Place to Work® as one of the Best Workplaces in healthcare, EHE Health is headquartered in New York City and has over 200 health clinics and practices across the U.S., including our own company-owned clinics, staffed by a network of curated primary care physicians, clinicians and coaches.  
  
For more than 100 years, EHE has led preventive care. Now we are evolving into a health and performance platform that delivers measurable outcomes for employers, employees and individuals. This role will be instrumental in this evolution.  
  
EHE Health was recently acquired by Consello Capital, the private equity arm of Consello. This partnership brings Consello’s expertise in scaling high-growth businesses and its extensive network of industry leaders and gives EHE Health the backing to accelerate this next chapter.  
  
**What we’re looking for:**  
  
EHE is seeking a commercially minded **Director, Product Management** to turn our strategy into products we can sell and deliver at scale. Products our clients and members clearly understand and value. This is not a digital product role. You will own what we sell, how it is positioned and priced, and you will champion its delivery as promised.  
  
You will take products from definition to market. You will work with our medical leadership on what goes into each product, and with Finance on cost and price. You will collaborate with Sales and Client Success on how products are sold. You will work with Clinical Operations and our Network team to make sure products are delivered to standard and to the intended level of experience, both in our own clinics and across our provider network. You will own the end-to-end journey for our employer clients, their employees and individual members. You will also help shape how our portal and app contribute to those journeys, working with the digital and technology teams who design and build them.  
  
This role is for someone who has done this before and gets things done. You are as comfortable with a pricing model and a margin analysis as you are with clinical workflows or member feedback.  
  
**In this role, you will:**  
  
**Own the product portfolio**

* Own EHE’s product architecture: the core offering, its tiers and add-ons, and the experience levels at which each is delivered
* Turn strategy into clearly defined products, with documented scope, delivery standards and a clear definition of done
* Partner with our medical leadership to define the clinical protocols behind each product

* Lead product launches from definition to go-live, coordinating cross-functional workstreams and owners and holding the plan together
* Simplify the portfolio over time, consolidating or retiring products that no longer earn their place

* Define a clear value proposition for each product and audience: employers (HR, benefits and executive sponsors), brokers and consultants, and individual consumers
* Partner with Marketing on product naming, messaging and sales enablement so the story is consistent internally and externally
* Build and manage pricing for each product, tier and add-on with Finance, including list pricing, discount guardrails, and outcomes-based or shared-savings structures
* Know the unit economics of every product: cost to deliver by channel (owned clinics versus network), gross margin, and how pricing decisions affect both
* Track the competitive landscape, including lab-based testing, imaging, concierge medicine, institutional executive physicals and digital health, and use it to sharpen positioning and price

Description Director, Product Management

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

  
  

**About the Team**  
Joining Experiences is the product team supporting Talent Acquisition across Capital One's end-to-end hiring journey. The Joining Product builds for a wide range of users: recruiters, recruiting coordinators, interviewers, hiring managers, and candidates. Our mandate, in partnership with the TA organization, is to continuously raise the bar on hiring quality, streamline cycle time, and deliver consumer-grade experiences.

  
  

This product leadership role will drive strategic thinking on Selection Experiences - encompassing key steps in the hiring process including assessments, screening, and interviews. You will lead a team of Product Managers responsible for defining and delivering the future of Selection experiences. Success in the role will require building close strategic and operating relationships with a broad set of partners and stakeholders. The role requires a leader who can bring both technical skills and deep customer focus. If you love tackling complex problems and driving meaningful transformation, we would love for you to join our team and help us build the future of Selection!

**Capital One Product Framework**

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

* **Human Centered** - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
* **Business Focused -** Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
* **Technology Driven -** Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
* **Integrated Problem Solving** - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
* **Transformational Leadership -** Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment
  

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 5 years of Product Management experience
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products

jobs.desc:
**About EnerVenue**

EnerVenue is a Silicon Valley-based energy infrastructure company commercializing metal-hydrogen battery technology originally developed by NASA for the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station. Founded in 2020 by Stanford Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue adapts this proven aerospace chemistry for grid-scale terrestrial energy storage, delivering batteries with 30,000+ cycle lifetimes, inherent fire-safety, and a 30-year design life.

In 2026, EnerVenue closed a $300 million Series B extension and is well capitalized for growth. Funds are being deployed to build a high-volume manufacturing facility in Changzhou, China, targeting 250 MWh capacity by Q3 2026 and 1 GWh by 2027. EnerVenue has been named one of Time magazine's Top 10 US Green Technology Companies of 2025.

**The Role**

The Product Management Director reports directly to the Chief Product Officer and owns the full product lifecycle of EnerVenue's metal-hydrogen energy storage portfolio, from the Ni-H2 vessel and module, to racks, containerized and skid-mounted energy storage systems, and the accompanying BMS/EMS software layer. You are the single point of ownership connecting the market to the technology: translating utility, C&I and international customer needs into a prioritized roadmap, clear product requirements, defensible pricing, and products that R&D can design and the factory can build at scale.

This is a build-and-scale mission rather than a caretaking role. You will establish the product management function from the ground up: the roadmap process, the stage-gate NPI governance, the product cost and margin model, the competitive intelligence engine and the launch playbook. You will align product strategy with the company's gigawatt capacity roadmap, drive continuous reduction of levelized cost of storage (LCOS), and make the disciplined trade-off decisions across performance, cost, certification and time-to-market that determine whether each product wins in its target segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Define and own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for the full metal-hydrogen storage portfolio: cells and vessels, modules, racks, containerized/skid systems, and BMS/EMS software.
* Segment the market by application (utility-scale, C&I, microgrid, long-duration storage, harsh-environment and off-grid) and geography, and define the target product configuration, differentiation and value proposition for each segment.
* Build and maintain the business case for every product line: addressable market, volume forecast, price and cost trajectory, margin, investment requirement and payback.
* Align the product roadmap with the company's gigawatt capacity plan, R&D technology roadmap and go-to-market priorities; arbitrate scope, sequencing and resource allocation across competing initiatives.

**2. Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence**

* Run a structured voice-of-customer program with utilities, IPPs, developers, EPCs, integrators and channel partners; convert field insight into prioritized requirements.
* Maintain continuous competitive intelligence across LFP and other lithium chemistries, flow batteries, sodium-ion and long-duration storage technologies; quantify EnerVenue's advantage in cycle life, safety, temperature tolerance and total lifetime cost.
* Track policy, incentive, tariff, grid-code and standards developments in target markets, and translate the implications into roadmap and positioning decisions.
* Own LCOS and total-cost-of-ownership models used in customer-facing value engineering and internal product decisions.

**3. Requirements Definition & NPI Governance**

* Author and own market requirement documents (MRD) and product requirement documents (PRD), translating customer and application needs into unambiguous, testable engineering specifications.
* Establish and chair the stage-gate NPI process from concept, design, prototype and pilot trial

We are not a quick fling: we are a reliable, credible partner who remembers our clients' birthdays, shows up on time, and is still around years later.

If that sounds like your kind of place, and you're a product leader who loves turning great ideas into great software (and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves to make it happen), we should talk.

We're looking for a **Director, Product Management** to lead the strategy, execution, and growth of Phenom Cloud's expanding portfolio of enterprise software products, including innovative AI-powered solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages roadmaps, attends sprint reviews, and asks engineering for status updates. We need someone who takes real ownership, understands how software actually works, knows what customers need, and can turn product challenges into opportunities.

You'll have end-to-end accountability for product strategy, quality, prioritization, and delivery. That means quickly understanding our existing products, identifying what needs improvement, establishing clear priorities, and working closely with engineering to turn requirements into software that actually delivers.

But this isn't just about making products work better. It's about making them more valuable. You'll study the market, understand competitors, identify opportunities for differentiation, and help shape products customers genuinely want to buy.

You'll work directly with executive leadership, collaborate across product and engineering teams, and have meaningful influence over the direction of our software business. We're a growing company, so expect to wear multiple hats. If your ideal role involves a large team handling all the details while you focus exclusively on strategy, this probably isn't your gig.

**For the right entrepreneurial product leader, this is a rare opportunity to take real ownership, make a visible impact, and help scale an innovative software portfolio without navigating layers of corporate bureaucracy.**

### **Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, quality, prioritization, and overall success of Phenom Cloud's software product portfolio
* Quickly assess existing products, identify functional gaps and usability issues, and drive improvements that make a real difference to customers
* Establish clear product priorities, balancing critical fixes, customer needs, technical considerations, and strategic enhancements

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product
jobs.desc:
The Senior Director, Product — Transact is the business owner of Lone Wolf's Transact product line. Transact is our most-used product line and the transaction management platform agents, brokers, REALTOR® associations, and Multiple Listing Services rely on to get deals to the closing table. This role reports to the SVP, Product & Strategy and leads a team of Product Managers across the Transact modules.

This is a business-ownership role, not a feature-management role. Operating as the “Product CEO” for the line, the Senior Director owns the strategy, commercial results, and customer experience of the business, while driving the innovation required to remain the leader in an AI-enabled world.

The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

### **Role and Responsibilities:**

The Senior Director will lead the future of Lone Wolf Transact, embed AI throughout the transaction workflow to eliminate manual work (in partnership with our Innovation team), and simplify how customers enter and exit the product. They own the Transact P&L, lead the monthly Product Line Review with the leadership team, and serve as the connective tissue across Product, Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

What you will own:

* Own the Transact P&L — revenue, bookings, retention, and margin — and report on it through a disciplined, no-surprises monthly Product Line Review.

* Define and defend an outcome-based strategy and roadmap tied to Lone Wolf's financial goals, including clarity on what not to build.

* Embed AI across the transaction workflow — replacing manual steps with conversational automation and digital workers that customers adopt.

* Partner with peer Product leaders so handoffs between Transact and our other product lines are seamless and invisible to the customer.

* Lead, coach, and grow a team of Product Managers who act as owners and innovators, not order-takers.

* Maintain a real-time view of competitors and win/loss dynamics, and equip Sales and Marketing with field-ready battle cards and positioning.

* Own key customer and partner relationships, turning feedback into prioritized action that protects and grows the base.

### **Requirments:**

* 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of Product Managers in B2B or vertical SaaS.

* Proven ownership of a product line's commercial results — P&L, bookings, or retention — with strong financial fluency.

* Real estate technology, transaction management, or document and workflow software experience strongly preferred.

* A track record of consolidating or modernizing products and migrating customers off legacy platforms while protecting retention.

* Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around a single strategy.

The Director owns Product's portion of the software development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through launch readiness, and partners with Engineering to keep handoffs, capacity, and delivery visible. jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Position overview**

A Regional Product Manager (RPM) connects global product strategy to execution in a specific market. Product managers build features and own the core roadmap with engineering teams. An RPM takes that roadmap into one market, adapts it to local customers, regulations, and buying patterns, and owns its commercial success there. At ServiceNow, RPM markets are defined by geography, industry, or customer segment.

In this role, you will own one industry or customer segment in the Americas. You will be the person responsible for how ServiceNow's AI products are positioned, sold, adopted, and improved in that market. This is an individual contributor (IC) role, reporting to the leader of Regional Product Management for the Americas.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regional strategy and adaptation**

* Translate the global AI product roadmap into a plan for your industry or segment
* Tailor use cases, solution packages, and messaging to the operational problems your customers care about most
* Account for industry regulations and compliance requirements in how solutions are positioned and deployed
* Track AI adoption trends in your market and adjust priorities as they shift

**Go-to-market and sales enablement**

* Partner with sales, marketing, and channel partners to launch AI products into your market
* Run discovery on priority deals and shape buying criteria and deal sizing toward AI early in the sales cycle
* Build discovery guides, use case catalogs, demo stories, and value stories that sellers can reuse
* Make sure AI use cases go live after every win, working with customer success, professional services, and partners on success criteria, go-live dates, and adoption metrics

**Commercial strategy and financial targets**

* Own the commercial strategy for your market, including product mix, packaging, and deal structure, to meet revenue and margin targets
* Set and own quarterly targets for deals in motion, AI attach, and discovery completed before close
* Work with pricing teams on packaging and discount guidance suited to your customers

**Voice of the customer**

* Act as the technical and commercial expert in the field for your market
* Gather customer feedback and turn repeated needs into solution requirements for product teams
* Test emerging AI ideas with customers and bring the ones with traction to the teams that build new products
* Represent ServiceNow with customer executives, at industry events, and in customer advisory sessions

**Competitive intelligence**

* Monitor competitors selling AI into your market, including industry-specific vendors and horizontal AI platforms
* Analyze win/loss data to find patterns in why deals are won, lost, or stalled
* Equip sales teams with positioning and responses to competitor claims

  
**Qualifications**

To excel as a Regional Product Manager (RPM), you need a unique blend of commercial acumen, cross-cultural leadership, and technical credibility. Because you sit between global development teams and local sales teams, your skillset must balance strategic thinking with ground-level execution.

* You design and run launch plans suited to how your market buys, including the partners, procurement processes, and executives involved

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Vice President of Product Management to lead our product strategy and development initiatives. This executive role requires a visionary leader capable of managing cross-functional teams, driving innovation, and aligning product goals with overall business objectives. The ideal candidate will have extensive management experience and a strong understanding of AI technologies, playing a pivotal role in shaping the future of our products and services.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership for the product management team, setting clear vision and objectives to ensure alignment with company goals.
* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the technology team, ensuring efficient development, deployment, and maintenance of products.
* Manage cross-functional communication across departments such as engineering, marketing, sales, and customer support to facilitate collaboration and project success.
* Lead executive discussions on product roadmaps, innovation initiatives, and technological advancements including AI integration.
* Drive the development of innovative product solutions by leveraging emerging technologies and industry best practices.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, mentorship, and professional growth within the product management team.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to define long-term strategies that enhance market position and customer satisfaction.

**Experience**

* Over 15 years of management experience, demonstrating progressive leadership roles within technology or product-focused organizations.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale cross-functional teams effectively.
* Extensive experience in technology management with a focus on AI-driven products or solutions.
* Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate business needs into innovative technical solutions.
* Exceptional communication skills to facilitate collaboration among diverse teams and executive stakeholders.

This role offers an exciting opportunity for a seasoned leader to influence the future direction of our products while working in a dynamic and innovative environment.

Pay: $139,000.00 - $169,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Referral program

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director of Product & Cloud Engineering
jobs.desc:
Our Corporate Product Development team is seeking interest for a Director of Product & Cloud Engineering.

The Director of Product & Cloud Engineering leads Product Development, the engineering team that builds and runs BI WORLDWIDE's recognition and rewards platform. This role is responsible for leading and mentoring engineering managers and teams while owning how BI WORLDWIDE governs, secures, and manages the cost of its cloud environment as the organization moves out of its data center.

The ideal candidate is a proven engineering leader who develops managers, stays technical enough to make the hard calls, and brings strong cloud (AWS) governance, security, and cost management experience.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead product engineering managers, UX designers, and Cloud Engineering team; hire, develop, and retain strong talent.
* Mentor and coach engineering managers as they own their areas and run a sprint-based SDLC.
* Set cross-team priorities and make the trade-offs that keep the product roadmap predictable.
* Own product platform health, including reliability, performance, and disaster recovery.
* Partner with Product, Client Services, Sales, and offshore engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Own Cloud governance across teams, including cost management (FinOps), tagging, account structure, and access management.
* Partner with BI WORLDWIDE's Security team to keep the cloud environment secure, monitored, and compliant.
* Establish and lead a Cloud Center of Excellence that sets shared cloud standards cross functionally.
* Oversee the task force moving applications from private data center to the cloud.
* Provide director-level communication, status reporting, and escalation management to leadership.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and leading engineering managers.
* Proven leader and mentor of direct reports, with a track record of building strong teams.
* Experience leading multiple teams through a sprint-based SDLC with predictable delivery.
* Deep software engineering background; highly technical and credible with engineers and architects.
* 5+ years of hands-on cloud (AWS) experience and strong knowledge of cloud engineering and DevOps.
* Cloud governance experience, including FinOps, tagging, IAM, and security baselines, with strong knowledge of cloud and infrastructure security.
* Ability to influence teams and leaders who do not report to you.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including experience with executive audiences and clients.
* BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience migrating applications and databases from on-premise data centers to the cloud is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Maintains a strong product engineering team whose managers grow and own their areas.
* Delivers the product roadmap predictably while keeping the platform stable and secure.
* Brings cloud cost, tagging, and security standards under clear, centralized governance.
* Makes the Cloud Center of Excellence the go-to source for cloud standards across the organization.
* Moves applications out of the data center on plan, without disruption to clients.

Base Salary Range: $160,000.00 to $210,000.00. The final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant's background, experience, and skills.

More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.biworldwide.com/careers/benefits-page/

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing – Services
jobs.desc:
**WHO WE ARE**

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

**﻿**Cyera is hiring a Product Marketing Director to own go-to-market for DataWatcher, our managed service for the Cyera Data Security Platform, and for our proactive services portfolio: the Data Risk Assessment, the AI Security Readiness Assessment, and the Incident Materiality Assessment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real strategic scope. You will define how Cyera positions services alongside its platform, turn expert-led offerings into repeatable and scalable pipeline drivers, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Services and the CSO team to make services a core part of how customers adopt and expand with Cyera.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**The portfolio you will own:**

Cyera's services pair platform technology with expert-led delivery. You will own the story and the go-to-market for four offerings: DataWatcher, Data Risk Assessment:, AI Security Readiness Assessment, and the Incident Materiality Assessment, plus any new offerings created in the future.

Key responsibilities

* Define positioning, messaging and value propositions for DataWatcher and each proactive assessment, and make clear how each connects to the Cyera platform and to the others in the portfolio.
* Build a services narrative that resonates with CISOs, security leaders and data and AI governance owners, and with the practitioners who evaluate and run these programs.
* Own the go-to-market plan for each offering: audience, use cases, entry points, sales motion and success metrics.
* Position proactive assessments as entry points that lead to platform adoption and paid services engagements and build the customer journey that connects them.
* Lead launches and relaunches, including new assessment variants and responses to market events such as new AI regulation or high-profile breaches.
* Create sales and partner enablement: solution briefs, datasheets, pitch decks, FAQs, objection handling, battlecards and ROI and business-case tools.
* Partner with Demand Generation, Field Marketing and Content to run campaigns, webinars and events that turn services interest into qualified pipeline.
* Create meaningful content to support demand gen and sales engagement, including ebooks, videos, website content, webinars, etc.

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10+ years of product marketing, solutions marketing or closely related experience in B2B technology, with at least 3 years in cybersecurity, data security, risk or a comparable technical enterprise category.
* Proven experience marketing services, managed services, subscription advisory or professional services offerings, ideally alongside a software platform.
* A track record of owning positioning and messaging, and of leading end-to-end launches that produced measurable pipeline or revenue.
* Experience selling to or building content for CISOs and senior security and risk leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn complex technical and advisory work into clear, compelling stories for executive and practitioner audiences.
* Experience building sales enablement that field teams actually use, and working closely with sales leaders and solution engineers.
* Comfort with data: you set success metrics, track funnel and attach performance, and adjust the plan based on what the numbers show.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design
jobs.desc:
Join Us in Building the Future of Human Performance

At Viction, we're not building another health app — we're building a new category of human performance technology.

Our mission is to empower people to better understand themselves and continuously improve every aspect of their health and performance through scientifically grounded insights, intelligent coaching, and beautifully designed technology.

We believe sophisticated health science should feel simple, actionable, and inspiring. By combining biomarkers, wearable technologies, nutrition, recovery, behavioral science, and artificial intelligence into a unified platform, Viction will help individuals make better daily performance-based decisions, ultimately allowing them to realize their full potential.

We're seeking an experienced product leader who is energized by the opportunity to help define an entirely new category of human performance technology. This is a rare opportunity to shape not only a product, but the direction of a company.

The Opportunity

Product Strategy and Design are inseparable at Viction. As our Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design, you will serve as the steward of our product vision, translating strategy into execution while ensuring every feature contributes to a cohesive, differentiated, and compelling member experience.

This is a founding product leadership opportunity. You'll work directly with our founders, advisory board, UX/UI designers, engineers, AI specialists, and domain experts to determine what we build, why we build it, and how we deliver an experience that members genuinely love.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    What You'll Own

    • What problems deserve solving

    • Which features matter most

    • Which features should wait

    • How features reinforce one another

    • What creates lasting competitive differentiation

    • What gets built, and why it gets built

    • Feature priorities, technical and business dependencies, and product sequencing

    • Release planning

    • Protection of MVP discipline while guiding long-term platform evolution

    Core Responsibilities

    • Lead product strategy and evolve the long-term product vision

    • Translate strategy into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, and development plans

    • Lead product discovery, customer research, and journey mapping

    • Guide UX/UI direction to create a premium consumer-grade experience

      • Own the end-to-end member experience across onboarding, AI coaching, scoring, education, engagement, and retention

      • Partner across engineering, design, AI, clinical, marketing, and leadership teams

      • Champion a scalable design system and exceptional product quality

      • Continuously validate assumptions through customer feedback and analytics

      • Monitor emerging trends in AI, digital health, wearables, and human performance

Education & Experience

    Who You Are

    • An experienced product leader with a passion for building consumer products

    • Equally comfortable discussing customer psychology, UX, AI, engineering trade-offs, and business strategy

**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Director, Product Management (Test & Learn)Overview  
  
Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test & Learn experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management services.  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation & Optimization Product Management team you’ll work on Test & Learn, an industry-leading experimentation platform which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. Test & Learn development today spans front-end, analytic, and technical investments; we are rapidly building new products, improving existing products, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients.
  
  
Role  
  

* Lead product evolution - drive the evolution of our Test & Learn during a multi-year product transformation. #### **About the Job:**

LaunchDarkly is the runtime control plane for the AI software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC). Thousands of engineering organizations, including more than a quarter of the Fortune 500, use LaunchDarkly to ship, measure, and control every change that reaches production, whether it is written by people or by AI. Feature management built the company. The next chapter is bigger: as the cost of writing code falls and the volume of change outpaces human review, the constraint is moving from writing software to controlling it. LaunchDarkly is building the critical infrastructure for the AI-SDLC. Customers build their own software factories. We build the rails they run on.

We are hiring the leader of Product Management for LaunchDarkly. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own the product management organization end to end: the people, operating system, roadmap commitments, and commercial outcomes across every product pillar. You will sit at the technology leadership table as the Product Management peer to the heads of Engineering and Product Design.

The CPO sets the company's product vision and strategic direction. You will build and run the product organization that turns that direction into a coherent portfolio, shipped outcomes, customer adoption, and revenue growth. This is a hands-on operating role for a product leader who knows how to build the machine, make the tradeoffs, and finish the work.

#### **Responsibilities:**

* **Lead cross-functional product leadership.** Serve as the product counterpart to Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, establish shared commitments, and ensure LaunchDarkly presents one coherent product strategy to customers and the market.
* **Build and lead the product management organization.** Design the organization intentionally, allocate resources effectively, maintain a high talent bar, build succession plans, and establish clear ownership for every product surface a customer or sales representative may ask about.
* **Own the product operating system.** Establish the cadence that turns strategy into shipped software and met goals, including quarterly commitments, leadership reviews, squad-level inspection, launch briefs, new product introduction (NPI), and the product-to-field handoff. Make execution predictable enough that the executive team does not have to ask whether something shipped.
* **Drive roadmap delivery across every product pillar.** Lead execution across Enterprise, Foundation, Observability, Experimentation, Agent Control, Automation, and the platform beneath them. Build a culture of doing what we say we are going to do.
* **Create portfolio discipline without slowing the company down.** Ensure new bets enter the portfolio through explicit decisions rather than hallway conversations, while preserving the flexibility to respond to market changes. Marketing dates should be commitments the product organization can confidently support.
* **Drive finishing.** A product is not done when version one ships; it is done when the team has iterated based on learning. A launch is not done when it ships; it is done when the field is amplifying it. A process is not done when it is written; it is done when it creates leverage for the team.
* **Own packaging execution and commercial outcomes.** Lead how pricing and packaging land in the product and in the field so every representative can sell the full platform and every pillar contributes to its commercial goals.
* **Stay close to customers and the field.** Spend time with the largest customers and most demanding evaluators, translate what you learn into product decisions, and build a process that brings customer and field insight into the roadmap at scale.

NLM Photonics is pioneering the next generation of electro-optic materials and photonic technologies that enable dramatically faster, lower-power optical interconnects for AI, datacenter, telecommunications, and advanced computing applications. By combining breakthrough material science with scalable semiconductor manufacturing processes, NLM is accelerating the future of high-performance computing and optical networking.

As we move from technology development to commercial scale, we are seeking a Senior Director, Product Marketing to drive marketing strategy, product positioning, customer engagement, and commercialization efforts across our photonics portfolio.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Product Marketing will serve as the bridge between engineering, business development, customers, and industry partners. This individual will develop product positioning, market intelligence, competitive analysis, messaging, and go-to-market strategies that support commercialization of NLM’s electro-optic materials and photonic solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical aptitude with exceptional marketing and communication skills and has experience in semiconductors, photonics, optical communications, advanced materials, or related deep-tech industries.

**Product Strategy & Positioning**

- Develop clear value propositions, product messaging, and market positioning for NLM’s technology portfolio.
- Translate complex technical innovations into compelling customer-focused narratives.
- Define target markets, customer segments, and application opportunities.
- Support product roadmap decisions with market and competitive insights.
- Collaborate with leadership on commercialization and market-entry strategies.

**Market Intelligence**

- Monitor industry trends in AI infrastructure, datacenter networking, optical communications, silicon photonics, and advanced semiconductor packaging.
- Perform competitive analysis and market sizing activities.
- Identify emerging customer needs, technology shifts, and partnership opportunities.
- Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform product strategy.

**Go-to-Market Execution**

- Develop and execute launch plans for new technologies and products.
- Create product collateral, presentations, white papers, case studies, website content, and sales tools.
- Support business development efforts with customer-facing materials and messaging.
- Enable sales and partnership teams with training and market insights.

**Industry Engagement**

- Represent NLM at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer meetings.
- Manage external communication surrounding product launches and strategic partnerships.
- Support analyst relations, media engagement, and thought leadership initiatives.
- Work with technical teams to develop conference abstracts, presentations, and marketing content.


Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner closely with R&D, engineering, applications, and executive leadership teams to develop and grow the product marketing team and product line management.
- Coordinate messaging across customers, partners, investors, and industry stakeholders.
- Help establish scalable marketing processes and metrics as the company grows.


Qualifications

**Required**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Business, or related field.
- 10+ years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, product management, or commercial

As Director of Product Management, Value Added Solutions, you own the strategy, roadmap, and P&L for NMI's Value Added Solutions business line. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will set direction, lead a small but impactful team of Product Managers and Designers, and stay deeply hands-on: joining customer calls, negotiating with partners, working with engineers to create and deliver a meaningful roadmap, collaborating and advocating with multiple cross-functional teams across NMI, and making the hard product calls when needed.

This is a remote role based in the US.

### **About NMI**

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

### **How We Work - Our Core Values**

* **Be a Good Person, It's Simple.** We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
* **Align, Trust & Go.** We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
* **Raise the Bar.** Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

### **About the Team**

Value Added Solutions is one of NMI's highest-growth product areas. Our partners want more than payment processing: they want the surrounding capabilities that help their merchants run and grow a business, and they want those capabilities delivered through the platform they already use. That demand is expanding faster than any single team can build against, which makes disciplined choices about what to build, what to buy, and when to partner central to this role.

The Value Added Solutions line spans a portfolio of products, some built in house and some delivered through third parties. You will own that portfolio end to end: which products earn continued investment, which new ones are worth launching, how they reach market through our partner channel, and what each one contributes to the bottom line.

While there are existing products to maintain, this is largely a build role. You will be setting strategy in a space that is moving fast, with real revenue goals and growing partner demand.

Renesas' Performance Core Power (PCP) Business Group is scaling its Custom AI Power product line — Power Modules, Digital Controllers, and Lateral Power Stages — to serve the compute infrastructure of the world's largest AI platform providers. Both the Business Group and the Custom AI Power product line are growing extremely fast. This organization is structured around dedicated Business Unit (BU) teams for each of the "Big 3" hyperscale/AI accelerator customers: AWS, Google, and NVIDIA.

We are hiring a Business Unit Leader to take full, end-to-end ownership of the business for one of these two currently open seats — AWS or NVIDIA. **Business & Strategy Leadership**

* Serve as the single point of accountability for the AWS or NVIDIA business within Custom AI Power — strategy, roadmap, revenue/margin outcomes, and execution of the products already designed-in.
* Build and maintain the multi-generation product roadmap (Modules, Digital Controllers, Lateral Power Stages) in direct alignment with the customer's roadmaps.
* Portfolio management decisions — what to pursue, what to pass on, and how to sequence investment across competing opportunities.

Wood Mackenzie's trading customers act on our forecasts and analytical models every day, across power, gas and oil markets.
