jobs.desc:
**Director of Product Marketing**

Boston, MA, USA (Boston preferred; remote candidates in the US will be considered)

**Summary**

QuEra Computing is the leader in commercializing quantum computers using neutral atoms, which is widely recognized as a highly promising quantum modality. Based in Boston and built on pioneering research from nearby Harvard University and MIT, we are developing large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers to tackle classically intractable problems. QuEra operates the world's largest publicly accessible quantum computer, available over a major public cloud and for on-premises delivery. We are passionate about both the science we advance and the inclusive, collaborative culture we cultivate.

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing to own how the market understands QuEra's products and progress. Quantum computing is a field where bold claims are common and trust is scarce. Your job is to do the opposite of hype: translate real technical achievements, from error-correction milestones to system-level capabilities, into positioning, messaging, and sales tools that are specific, credible, and effective with the world's most demanding technical buyers.

You will work across QuEra's full portfolio, including our Gemini-class systems, the Aquila analog quantum computer, premium cloud access, and on-premise deployments, and across our three core market segments: HPC centers, national quantum programs, and enterprise innovators. You will report to the Chief Commercial Officer and partner daily with product management, quantum scientists, and the commercial team.

**Why this role exists**

You will own the bridge between QuEra's technical roadmap and the market's understanding of it, turning cutting-edge science into positioning that helps customers choose QuEra with confidence.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own positioning and messaging:** Develop and maintain messaging frameworks for QuEra's systems and services, tailored to HPC centers, national programs, and enterprise innovators, and keep them current as our roadmap advances.
* **Translate the science:** Work closely with quantum scientists, QEC researchers, and product managers to convert technical milestones and publications into market-facing narratives that survive expert scrutiny.
* **Enable the commercial team:** Create and maintain the tools sales needs to win: presentations, battlecards, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, and proposal content, and measure whether they work.
* **Drive competitive intelligence:** Track competing quantum modalities and vendors, maintain clear and honest positioning versus superconducting, trapped-ion, and photonic approaches, and brief internal teams on market shifts.
* **Support product launches:** Partner with product management and communications on launch messaging, web content, webinars, analyst briefings, and conference presence.
* **Be the voice of the market:** Bring segment and win/loss insights back into product and roadmap discussions so that customer needs shape what we build and how we talk about it.

**Qualifications**

**Make your mark for patients**

We are looking for a **Head of Data Domain Products** who is strategic, collaborative and business-focused to join our **Patient Evidence Digital Transformation** organization. This position can be based in our **Atlanta, Georgia, Raleigh, North Carolina, or Boston, Massachusetts offices.** This **hybrid role is limited to 10% domestic/ international travel.**

**About the role**

UCB is building a permanent enterprise data capability to improve how data is understood, connected and applied to critical business decisions, helping accelerate the development of medicines through trusted, reusable and interoperable data products which will support the development of AI.

As Head of Data Domain Products, you will build and lead the enterprise portfolio of strategic data domains and a team of seven Data Domain Product Leads.

Your team is comprised of individuals with deep expertise in both data and the business questions to be answered in the clinical pathway. For example, an expert on patient data – real world data, clinical data, biomarker data – how it comes together to answer strategic questions on how to develop assets – like feasibility and recruitment. You will have experts on public data and disease landscape.

You will set strategic direction, establish consistent ways of working and guide priorities, investments, dependencies and trade-offs across the portfolio. Working across business, data and technology, you will ensure domain data products connect business meaning with trusted data and are governed, reusable and capable of supporting business processes, analytics and AI-enabled use cases.

At the heart of the role is a clear objective: aligned domain leadership, reusable enterprise data products and measurable value at scale.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will lead seven Data Domain Product Leads and partner closely with Patient Evidence leadership, Data Strategy & Architecture, the Data Office, business process owners, domain subject matter experts, Digital Technology, Enterprise Architecture and business and functional leaders.

You will also work closely with Data Portfolio Leads. Domain Product Leads identify, understand and connect data across UCB, while Portfolio Leads draw from multiple domains to address recurring business questions.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead, coach and develop seven Data Domain Product Leads.
* Set strategic direction for the enterprise data domain portfolio.
* Align domain strategies, roadmaps and investments with business priorities.
* Establish consistent product management and ways of working across domains.
* Lead prioritization of dependencies, investments, risks and trade-offs.
* Drive adoption, reuse and measurable value from domain data products.
* Resolve cross-domain ownership gaps, duplication and strategic issues.
* Ensure alignment with data governance, privacy and compliance requirements.
* Drive consistency with enterprise semantic and architecture standards.
* Enable interoperability across domains, processes and business use cases.
* Strengthen collaboration between Domain Product Leads and Portfolio Leads.
* Ensure data products support priority analytics, automation and AI use cases.
* Communicate portfolio progress, risks, investment needs and outcomes to leadership.

**Interested? For this role, we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills:**

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data, Analytics, Life Sciences, Information Management, Technology or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data expertise and the appilcation of that data to business questions, data strategy, product management, busines data management or enterprise transformation.
* Pharmaceutical industry experience with strong knowledge of data supporting the development and lifecycle of pharmaceutical assets.
* Experience leading enterprise data from a business perspective (not IT or data office), strategic data

jobs.desc:
The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.

**Job Responsibilities:**

***Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.***

* **Set the Product Vision:** Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
* **Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture**: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
* **Build Products for Our Delivery Teams:** Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
* **Lead Direct-to-Market Products:** Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
* **Lead the Product Management Team**: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
* **Turn Development Talent into Great Products**: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
* **Drive Effective Execution**: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
* **Measure & Report Product Effectiveness**: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
* **Evaluate Emerging Technology**: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
* Additional duties, as assigned.

  
Requirements:
  

* **6**+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
* A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
* Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
* Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT** **DOT.CARDS**
=======================

dot.cards is building the platform for what happens after people connect in the real world. We began by making it effortless to share a digital profile with a tap. With 2.5M+ devices sold and 100M+ in-person connections facilitated, we now have a rare foundation: consumer scale, real-world distribution, and direct insight into how people connect.

Our next chapter is to turn that foundation into a configurable software platform. Reusable building blocks, including profiles, contact exchange, payments, messaging, booking, data capture, digital credentials, analytics, and integrations, will power focused products for different cohorts and industries. The opportunity spans individuals, teams, events, businesses, and the physical places where connections happen, with hardware and software working together as one seamless experience. We are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company based in Los Angeles, and this role will help define the product category we become.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring our first Head of Product to lead this evolution. You will work closely with our Founder & CEO, executive team, and Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape the long-term vision, understand where dot.cards can create the greatest customer value, and turn that opportunity into a focused portfolio strategy and roadmap.

You will bring an independent product perspective, deep customer understanding, and strong strategic judgment to the partnership. Together, you will turn ambitious ideas and market insight into clear priorities, a coherent platform, and products customers love. You will lead product across our consumer platform, Profile Plus subscription, dot.Teams, connected hardware experiences, and new software opportunities.

This is a high-impact builder role with meaningful influence over company strategy, product craft, organizational design, and the direction of dot.cards. You will stay close to customers and the product details that matter while building a product organization capable of operating at greater scale. Experience with connected hardware is valuable, but exceptional software product judgment and systems thinking are most important.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
=====================

**Product Vision, Platform & Portfolio**
----------------------------------------

* Define and communicate a compelling multi-year product vision and an outcome-based 12–18 month roadmap across consumer, subscription, business, and connected hardware experiences
* Shape a coherent portfolio of focused products for different cohorts and industries, built on a shared modular platform
* Determine which capabilities belong in the shared platform and how reusable building blocks such as payments, messaging, booking, data capture, digital credentials, analytics, and integrations come together in focused experiences
* Balance continued investment in our core profile, subscription, Teams, and hardware-to-software experiences with new products, business models, and vertical opportunities
* Set clear customer and business outcomes for each major initiative and make thoughtful portfolio tradeoffs using customer insight, behavioral data, and commercial judgment

**Customer Insight & Product Craft**
------------------------------------

* Build a continuous customer-discovery practice using interviews, product behavior, support and sales insights, churn analysis, and direct observation
* Spend time with consumers and business customers in the moments where dot.cards is used, and turn what you learn into clear product decisions
* Create simple, intuitive, mobile-first experiences across activation, profile creation, sharing, exchange, follow-up, subscription, and team administration
* Partner with early customers of new products to understand their workflows, identify patterns that can scale, and refine the product quickly

**Product Development & Business Outcomes**

jobs.desc:
**About Us:**

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Operating System, unifying retail media, commerce management, and advanced measurement across 100+ global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Instacart. Through Pacvue and Helium 10, our enterprise and SMB platforms, we empower over 70,000 brands, agencies, and sellers with AI-driven insights and technology to win in today's rapidly evolving commerce landscape.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don't just happen — they're built. Here, you'll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that's redefining the future of commerce.

**About the role:**

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to drive execution across Helium 10's product portfolio and to lead the product managers who deliver it. This role runs the discovery and delivery of our innovation agenda beyond the Amazon marketplace seller — into direct-to-consumer and multi-channel commerce, Walmart and TikTok, and AI-native experiences. This director will be responsible for turning agreed priorities into a sequenced, resourced roadmap and for making sure the team ships it on time and at quality.

Innovation is central to this role, and it is hands-on work. The Director of Product Management will run our new-product pipeline: validating, building, and launching the bets that open new revenue lines and new audiences. That means running structured discovery with sellers and brands, prototyping and testing quickly, defining what success looks like before we build, and retiring ideas that don't earn their place. This leader will bring rigor to how we evaluate emerging opportunities — AI agents, autonomous workflows, and adjacent channels — and work with go-to-market teams to land them with customers.

Innovation into direct-to-consumer expansion is a core focus. As brands diversify across Shopify and their own storefronts, Google, and social commerce, our portfolio has to follow them. This director will lead the discovery, requirements, and delivery of the features that serve a DTC-first brand, and partner closely with product marketing, growth marketing, and sales to bring those products to market.

This is a hands-on, execution-first role. Sets strategy and direction for the function while also driving execution hands-on. You will run weekly operating cadences, review specs and requirements, unblock your team daily, and stay close enough to the detail to catch problems before they reach a release. The role is based in the United States and requires regular, direct contact with customers: discovery interviews, advisory sessions, and time in the field with brands and agencies. Deep familiarity with marketplace e-commerce, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, and SaaS product-led growth environments is strongly preferred.

This role reports to the VP of Product Strategy & Ops and manages the product management function globally, leading both the U.S. product management team and the China-based product management team. lteads the global product management function through a mixed structure — managing the U.S. product managers directly, and leading the China product management team through its manager. Sets direction and shared standards for both; delegates day-to-day execution oversight in China to that manager, while staying closely involved in the U.S. team's execution. Comfort leading and developing a team across time zones and cultures is essential.

**Responsibilities:**

* Roadmap Development: Translate agreed priorities into a sequenced, multi-quarter roadmap and drive it to delivery. Run the planning process end to end, make explicit trade-offs between core platform work and new-growth bets, and keep commitments and dates honest. Priorities are revisited annually, but the trade-offs made here shape the business for years beyond the current planning cycle.

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.

At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

Versa Networks is seeking a visionary, technically deep, and execution-oriented Senior Director of Product Management – Core Security & Security Operations to lead and scale our foundational threat prevention, data protection, endpoint/browser security, and SecOps capabilities.

In this role, you will define the multi-year security strategy, roadmap, and vision to ensure Versa outpaces modern adversary tactics and maintains market leadership across SASE, SSE, and core security products and technologies. You will directly steer core inspection engines, govern federal/public-sector compliance certifications, orchestrate 3rd-party technology ecosystems, oversee security incident response and research, and commercialize next-generation security innovations across Versa’s product portfolio.

* Define, own, and execute the multi-year product strategy for core threat prevention, data security, secure browsing, and operational security across cloud-delivered and on-premises architectures.
* Benchmark Versa against top-tier competitive solutions (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Fortinet) to maintain market-leading efficacy, low latency, and differentiation.

Threat Prevention, Inspection & Secure Access

Data Protection & Endpoint Risk Posture

* Own API-driven Data Protection (API DP) and lead technical integrations with leading 3rd-party Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms (e.g., Cyera, BigID).

jobs.title: Director of Product, InCommand
jobs.desc:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

  

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.

Someone has to decide what that product is: what it does, what it leaves behind, what comes first, and what the industry will pay for. As Director of Product that is your call, and the engineers and coding agents who build it work from what you write. This is a hands-on founding role. Initially you write the specifications and acceptance criteria yourself and spend time on the data-center floor and in the operations center; the product function grows from you as the product grows. You start with a rare advantage: a decade of operational knowledge about what the product has to do, and the people who use it every day sitting down the hall. You partner closely with engineering and operations.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the new InCommand, from the first capabilities we prove on our own facilities to a product the industry adopts.

* Learn how a data center is run, on the floor and in the operations center: the power path from utility to rack, cooling, capacity, maintenance, alarms and customer requests. Turn that into the product's model of a facility and into workflows that operators and technicians trust.

* Own the living functional specification repository that engineers and coding agents build from, and the acceptance criteria that define what "done" means for every capability.

* Decide, capability by capability, what the new product does, what it does differently and what it leaves behind, using real usage data and the judgment of the operators who run data centers every day.

* Define the AI-first side of the product: insights, recommendations and an assistant built on live telemetry and years of operational history, with the provenance and control critical infrastructure demands.

* Make the product one the industry can adopt: bring operator and customer needs to engineering as requirements for the data model and the API, and make sure every capability meets the operational, security and compliance expectations of the people who run critical infrastructure.

* Shape packaging and pricing for a modular product offered in different deployment configurations.

### **Required Skills**

* 8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform or infrastructure product: roadmap, specifications and pricing.

* 2+ years building product for physical infrastructure or industrial

---------------

As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers.

(\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026)

--------------

Indeed Flex is a marketplace transforming how people find and access flexible work. As a Director of Product Management, you will drive the strategy and execution for a portfolio of products dedicated to accelerating the Flexer supply journey. In this role, you will lead the Supply service group, owning the jobseeker experience within the Indeed Flex ecosystem to drive compounding, measurable improvements in user acquisition, activation, and retention of Flexers. This scope is specifically focused on Indeed Flex's worker supply.

You are accountable for cost per hire and for how US worker acquisition spend is allocated. You decide where the money goes and what gets traded off, working with performance marketing and the recruiting team, who handle day-to-day campaign execution.

You will operate as a true Player/Coach, comfortably managing approximately 4 PMs and UX Designers while remaining deeply hands-on. You will set a clear product growth vision and guide long-term strategy while directly executing IC-level growth work, including SEM optimization, referral programs and other supply-growth experiments. You will foster a culture of ownership and deliver meaningful outcomes for Flexers and the business.

You will work closely with partners across engineering, design, data science, marketing, and business teams to identify opportunities, optimize our acquisition strategy, translate insights into product direction, and bring new ideas to market. Your leadership will help ensure teams move quickly, champion a high-velocity experimentation culture, make informed decisions using data and research, and deliver products that improve how people find jobs and connect with opportunity.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and drive product vision and long-term strategy for a portfolio of consumer growth products, establishing a comprehensive product growth roadmap.
* Oversee, mentor, and grow a team of product managers within the Supply service group while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and accountability.
* Build and prioritize product roadmaps using data, user research, and business goals to optimize user journeys and scale global user acquisition funnels.
* Partner with engineering, design, marketing, and performance marketing teams to deliver high-quality products, features, and cross-channel growth initiatives (including SEM and paid acquisition channels) at scale.
* Establish success metrics and use data and continuous experimentation (including rigorous A/B testing) to guide product decisions and measure impact on top-line growth KPIs.
* Build alignment across teams and leaders to support product strategy, growth vision, and execution, presenting results and strategy clearly to executive audiences.

jobs.title: CPO Quality
jobs.desc:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

The Chief Product Owner champions Agile product management practices, aligns quality strategies with organizational objectives, understands the documentation integrity quality initiatives in the industry and collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver innovative solutions that improve quality outcomes, efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.

* Define and communicate the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for outpatient/inpatient Quality products and capabilities.
* Align product strategies with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, customer needs, and market trends.
* Act as the owner of the Quality product portfolio for Solventum and industry quality methodologies such as AHRQ, Elixhauser, HCCs, CMS star and others.
* Lead product lifecycle management from ideation through implementation and optimization.
* Ensure product roadmaps support evolving business for the quality portfolio requirements.
* Serve as the primary liaison between leadership, business stakeholders, technology teams, and executive sponsors.
* Facilitate alignment and decision-making across cross-functional teams.
* Communicate product vision, priorities, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Gather and incorporate stakeholder feedback into product planning and execution.
* Define and manage product epics, features, and user stories.
* Ensure Agile teams maintain a clear understanding of business priorities and expected outcomes.
* Define quality outcome metrics, KPIs, and performance dashboards.
* Leverage data analytics to identify ROI outcome trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Monitor product performance and value realization.
* Use customer and operational insights to inform product decisions.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university

-OR-

* High School Diploma/GED from an accredited institution and minimum of 11 years of experience in a healthcare related field or in business
* 8 years of experience

jobs.desc:
**Position Title: Vice President, Product**

**Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer**

**Location: United States**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
* Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
* Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

**Roles and Requirements**

***Product discovery***

* **Discovery leadership.** Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
* **Continuous discovery habits.** Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
* **Insight engine.** Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
* **Discovery standards.** Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

***Investment coordination***

* **Single intake for engineering demand.** Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
* **Portfolio allocation.** Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Grants fund nonprofit work, but they also create some of the toughest operational challenges. Every grant brings its own deadlines, spending restrictions, reporting requirements, and commitments, so managing that complexity across fundraising, finance, and HR requires more than spreadsheets.

Instrumentl is the system of record for grants. We bring discovery, applications, award compliance, and grant operations into one platform, giving nonprofits a shared foundation to grow their revenue and impact.

More than 6,000 nonprofits rely on Instrumentl, from local community groups to state and county governments, universities, and maybe even your local animal shelter. We're a cash flow positive, YC-backed company building our next chapter, and we're hiring people who will shape and grow the impact of the nonprofit sector.

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Product, reporting to co-founder Angela Braren, to lead our product managers as Instrumentl becomes the AI-native operating system for grant-funded organizations. You'll mature the products our founders take from 0 to 1, raise how fast we ship without giving up quality, and help the team build agents that work in production. This is a builder's seat: you'll personally own a core product area while growing the team, at a profitable company that's still early.

Our ideal candidate is proactive, eager to learn, willing to experiment, and excited to collaborate with multiple teams to enhance the customer experience at Instrumentl. Get to know us at instrumentl.com/about!

 

For this position, we are looking for candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is in the office about once a week and includes about 25% travel.

What you'll do

Customers and product outcomes

  • Be one of the strongest voices of the customer outside our founders, and develop your PMs into strong voices of the customer too.
  • Own customer outcomes and account engagement across product areas.
  • Take new, early products built by our founders and lead them through launch, broader customer adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Get close to individual customers through calls, site visits, and conferences, and turn what you learn into product decisions.
  • Scope and sequence the work: find the smallest version that works end to end, ship it, and iterate.

Build hands-on

  • Own a core product area yourself, likely our GrantOS platform, from roadmap to shipped work.
  • Prototype and build alongside engineering and design, using AI tools to move from idea to working product quickly.
  • Help the team build effective agents, including eval loops, golden datasets, and clear measures of output quality.

Lead and scale the product team

  • Lead and develop our PMs, with clear principles for how we make decisions and ship.
  • Raise product velocity while keeping quality high, and bring the team along on AI-native ways of working.
  • Partner with our co-founders to turn the company's product vision into a roadmap the whole org can execute.
  • Partner with engineering, design, sales, and customer success to deliver cross-team work, especially on shared platform capabilities.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 8+ years in product management, including owning a whole product or most of a core product end to end in B2B SaaS.
  • A track record of taking a product from 0 to 1 and then scaling it, with the customer or business results to show for it.
  • You still build hands-on: you prototype, write specs, and ship products yourself

* Track the competitive landscape and analyst perspectives, and shape the product’s positioning and differentiation in the market.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**About Clarify**
-----------------

Clarify is building the AI-native CRM — a platform designed from the ground up for how modern go-to-market teams actually work. We raised $22.5M and assembled a team of ~27 people who believe the CRM category is overdue for a complete rethink: less manual data entry, smarter automation, and AI that actually understands your pipeline.

We're early and moving fast. The work you do here will directly shape how we grow.

**About the Role**
------------------

Clarify has shipped a lot in a short time: our AI Rep, permissions, reporting, and integrations with HubSpot, Stripe and Salesforce, with Signals launching in December. What we don't have yet is a product leader whose whole job is deciding what we build next, for whom, and making sure it lands. Today the founders do that alongside everything else.

You'll be Clarify's first Head of Product, reporting to our CEO. You'll set the product direction with our founders: who we build for, where we win and what we say no to. You'll own the roadmap, set the planning rhythm with engineering and design, and build a product team that great people want to join. At our stage this is a hands-on leadership role: you'll still talk to customers every week, write the specs that matter and prototype with AI yourself. You'll be accountable for whether what we ship gets used and moves retention and revenue.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set product strategy and own the roadmap with our CEO and CTO, making the tradeoffs explicit
* Build the product operating cadence with engineering squads and design: clear problems, tight scope, owners, dates and shipped outcomes
* Own Tier 1 launches like Signals from scope to adoption, on the date we committed to
* Own our core product metrics — weekly active usage and retention — and hold the roadmap accountable to them
* Hire and lead the product team, starting with our first PMs, and partner closely with design
* Stay hands-on: talk to customers every week and prototype ideas with AI before engineering commits time
* Make the case for where product is going, in writing, to the team and to the board

**Your background**
-------------------

* You've led product at a B2B SaaS company at the Sr Director or VP level, running multiple PM teams, ideally as an early product leader through the Series A-C stage
* You've hired, coached and led PMs, and people from your past teams would follow you to your next company
* You've shipped 0-to-1 products customers rely on and can point to the metrics you moved
* You've set a product direction and brought founders, engineering and go-to-market along with it
* You're technical enough to go deep with engineers and direct AI-assisted prototyping; many great candidates started as engineers
* You use AI natively in how you research, analyze and build
* You know what process to add at our stage and what to skip, and you're still happy to do the work yourself
* **Bonus:** You've built sales, CRM or GTM tools
* **Bonus:** You've been a founder or a founding PM

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

We offer a base salary range of **$225,000-$275,000** depending on level and location, benchmarked against market data for startups our size, plus competitive stock options with standard 4-year vesting and a 1-year cliff. Benefits include fully covered medical, dental, and vision for you (50% for dependents), a 401(k) with company match, flexible time off, and generous parental leave. We bring the full team together 2–3 times a year for offsites.

Our Seattle-based employees work from our Pioneer Square office three days a week. Outside of Seattle, we're a fully distributed team.

KioCafé is a growing B2B technology company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and deployment of autonomous robotic coffee kiosks, cold brew stations, and self-service beverage systems.

By combining innovative hardware, intelligent software, automation, and payment technology, KioCafé delivers fully integrated beverage solutions that help businesses streamline operations, reduce labor requirements, and provide convenient, high-quality beverage experiences.

With operations across Canada, the United States, and China, KioCafé is focused on advancing automated beverage technology and expanding its global presence.

**This is an exciting time to join KioCafé as we enter our next phase of growth.** As a growing startup, we offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contribute to innovative products, and help shape the future of automated beverage technology.

**Position Summary**

KioCafé is seeking an experienced and strategic **Head of Product** to lead the vision, strategy, development, and lifecycle management of our global product portfolio.

This role will oversee both hardware and software product initiatives, including payment technology, self-service equipment, embedded systems, and cloud-based platforms. The Head of Product will work closely with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and senior leadership to deliver innovative, scalable, and commercially successful solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product leader with a strong technical background, commercial awareness, and experience bringing integrated hardware and software products to market. This individual will be responsible for translating business objectives and customer needs into a clear product strategy while ensuring successful execution across teams in Canada, the United States, and China.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with KioCafé's business objectives.

* Establish short-term and long-term product priorities, balancing innovation, customer requirements, technical feasibility, and commercial value.
* Develop business cases for new products, enhancements, and strategic investments.
* Present product strategies, roadmaps, performance updates, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Product Development & Lifecycle Management

Hardware, Software & Payment Technology

* Lead product initiatives involving unattended payment systems, self-service equipment, embedded software, and connected hardware.
* Oversee integration requirements between physical equipment, payment processing systems, software platforms, and cloud-based services.
* Collaborate with technical teams

### **Our Purpose**

  

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

### **About Us**

  

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

### **What Are We Looking For?**

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. You will lead a team of up to 6 product managers, each owning part of the analyst workflow, and make sure their work adds up to a single product rather than a set of separate features. This role calls for someone who has run a product for an analyst-facing security operations product, understands how analysts work under pressure, and has taken enterprise customers through a major platform migration.

Primary responsibilities include:

* Define how analysts should work in the Singularity Platform, and write the narrative that connects the Operations Center, Purple AI, asset and entity inventory, investigation graph, and investigation timeline into one experience; set the agentic-first analyst direction, deciding where the analyst stays in the loop and how the interface earns trust in agent actions through transparency and control; and define and report on analyst outcomes, such as mean time to investigate and respond, alerts handled per analyst, investigations resolved by agents, and adoption of the new experience, alongside delivery milestones.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**About Atmosphere TV**

Atmosphere is the leading streaming TV platform built specifically for businesses. Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming gyms, bars, airports, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 150 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

We're looking for a highly motivated Head of Product to drive our highest-leverage initiatives and connect our product roadmaps into a coherent plan for the business. This is not a role with a fixed lane. You'll be dropped onto our highest-leverage problems across in-venue experience, advertising, and internal AI enablement, and you'll be expected to own each one end-to-end: getting close to the customer, framing the opportunity, aligning stakeholders, and shipping with a small product pod of designers and engineers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You'll stay close to product decisions and delivery while working across teams to make sure priorities, dependencies, and sequencing add up across the portfolio.

The core of this job is understanding our customers better than anyone else in the building. You'll quickly develop an accurate picture of what venues, advertisers, and internal teams actually need, use it to prioritize what matters most, and make those insights impossible for the team to ignore. The right person is entrepreneurial and moves fast, but knows how to bring departments along rather than run past them. You'll bring a consumer entertainment and media perspective to products that serve viewers, venues, and advertisers. You should also be among the most progressive AI users in any room you enter, using AI to improve your own research, analysis, and prototyping.

*This position will report to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, and is on-site in Austin, TX! Availability to be in-office 4-5 days a week is required.*

**What you'll do**

* Own key business initiatives end-to-end across in-venue experience, advertising, and internal AI enablement, from problem framing through ship and measurement.
* Get deep with users and customers (viewers, venues, advertisers, internal teams), rapidly build an understanding of their needs, prioritize what matters most, and bring those insights back to the team.
* Connect roadmaps across the product portfolio: identify dependencies, make prioritization and sequencing trade-offs clear, and align teams around how their work supports the broader business.
* Use AI as a daily tool for research, analysis, and prototyping, making ideas concrete for stakeholders and users quickly.
* Collaborate across engineering, design, sales, and operations to align on priorities and unblock execution.
* Define success metrics for every initiative, make sure the right instrumentation exists to measure them, and hold the line on outcomes over output.
* Work within a small product pod alongside design and engineering, keeping the team focused on the few things that matter.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer instincts: a track record of quickly understanding customer needs and turning them into the right priorities
* A demonstrated ability to get stuff done: you ship, and you have the track record to prove it
* Entrepreneurial ownership with the collaboration instincts to work across every department
* Experience aligning multiple product roadmaps and influencing priorities across teams without relying on reporting authority
* Extremely progressive daily AI usage: research, analysis, prototyping, and workflow automation (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar)

Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. * Enjoy the challenge of translating intricate requirements into clear, deliverable product plans.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can influence strategy and see your ideas come  
  to life.
* Find satisfaction in collaborating with diverse teams to achieve shared goals.

### **What you bring**

* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems and security principles.

* Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams.
* A strong drive that bridges strategic thinking with meticulous attention to detail.
* Adept at managing diverse stakeholder needs and expectations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

### **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in technology product management, with a significant  
  focus on the federal government sector.

  degree preferred.
* Must be a U.S. citizen.

With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

We are looking for a visionary, customer-obsessed, and technology-focused product management leader with expertise in building and scaling consumer mobile experiences. As Director of Product, Mobile, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for CLEAR's mobile app, shaping it from a collection of features into an intelligent, trusted travel companion that helps members prepare, navigate, and recover throughout their journey.

You will build the mobile app into the most helpful digital layer of the travel day and be accountable for driving adoption, engagement, and member value. You will connect CLEAR's identity capabilities, real-time travel context, airport operations, member relationships, and partner-enabled services into experiences that are personalized, proactive, and genuinely useful before, during, and after travel. This includes helping members understand airport conditions, find the right path through the airport, discover food and lounge options, and access relevant CLEAR and partner services in the moments that matter.

The ideal candidate has a proven history of setting bold product visions, leading through ambiguity, and delivering scalable, high-quality technology solutions that create meaningful customer value and support rapid learning and iteration. This role will initially lead a small product team with one direct report and will operate as a player-coach: setting a high bar for product thinking and execution while developing talent and scaling the team over time.

***What You'll Do:***

* Establish CLEAR's Mobile app strategic vision and product roadmap in alignment with enterprise goals and member needs. Translate a multi-year vision into a small number of strategic bets, prioritized product investments, structured sequencing, and clear success metrics.
* Own the mobile product portfolio end to end, including strategy, discovery, prioritization, delivery, launch, and ongoing optimization across iOS and Android.
* Transform the app into an intelligent travel companion that guides members through preparation, real-time navigation, food ordering, lounge discovery and access, and travel disruptions.
* Define and deliver proactive, context-aware experiences that translate real-time conditions into useful next actions including personalized timing, wayfinding, disruption support, family and group coordination, service recommendations, airport conditions and availability, and timely human assistance when digital guidance is not enough.
* Extend the app's value beyond the airport by creating reasons for members to return, share travel with family and friends, discover benefits, and build a deeper relationship with CLEAR.
* Be accountable for measurable business and customer outcomes, including mobile app adoption, activation, engagement, member retention, and contribution to CLEAR's broader membership and subscription goals.
* Build and lead a high-performing product team. Initially manage and develop one direct report, establish clear ownership and decision rights, coach for stronger product judgment and execution, and grow the team as the scope requires.
* Create a durable product operating model that supports fast learning and responsible scale, including strong analytics, experimentation, reliability, accessibility, platform foundations, and consistent product development rituals.
* Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, rapid prototyping, and member feedback to decide where to go deep, where to learn quickly, and where to say no.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.desc:
**Role Summary**

The Director of Product leads Greenshades' product organization — owning roadmap strategy, delivery execution, and product experience quality across our payroll, HR, and tax compliance solutions. This role carries a specific mandate to reorient product strategy for the AI era: identifying where AI can reshape workflows, unlock new efficiencies, and differentiate the platform. This role manages a team of Product Managers and a Product Experience/UX designer, and partners closely with Engineering, Customer Experience, and Product Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects real market and customer signal. As part of an integrated Product and Marketing organization, this role is central to tightening the loop between what customers need and what gets built.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Product Managers and the Product Experience/UX function; set clear priorities, coach on craft, and manage performance and growth.
* Own and maintain a groomed, prioritized product roadmap that reflects the highest-value initiatives across Greenshades' product lines, grounded in customer and market signal.
* Drive Greenshades' product strategy into the AI era — evaluating where AI/ML can create step-change efficiency and experience improvements across the product line, and ensuring roadmap prioritization reflects that lens going forward rather than treating AI as a bolt-on feature.
* Own Product Experience: ensure usability, design consistency, and overall product quality are considered alongside feature delivery, not treated as an afterthought.
* Drive day-to-day product delivery in close partnership with Engineering, ensuring features ship on time, within scope, and aligned with roadmap priorities.
* Partner with Customer Experience to strengthen how customer and market signal flows into intake, triage, and prioritization — bringing structure and clarity to how requests become roadmap decisions.
* Serve as a key product escalation point for significant customer and internal issues, working with Support, TPE, and Engineering to resolve or route issues appropriately.
* Partner with Product Marketing to ensure roadmap priorities, positioning, and launch timing are aligned and well-sequenced.
* Build and maintain deep working knowledge of payroll, HR, and tax business processes, including how AI is reshaping those domains, through customer research, competitive analysis, and ongoing industry engagement.
* Partner with the CMO on Product team budget, resourcing, and prioritization tradeoffs; report on progress against roadmap and team capacity.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* 5-7 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, including 5+ years leading a team of Product Managers or equivalent ICs.
* Experience managing a complex domain (payroll, HR, tax, compliance, or similar), or a track record of quickly mastering a new business domain, with a specific example you can describe.
* Have shipped AI or ML-enabled capabilities in a B2B product, or led a roadmap shift toward AI.
* Experience hiring, coaching, and developing product talent, including managing performance and supporting career growth.
* Experience balancing roadmap strategy with hands-on delivery, including keeping features on schedule and in scope alongside Engineering.
* Experience working day to day with Engineering, Customer Success/CX, and Marketing to align product decisions with business priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining product strategy and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience presenting product strategy, roadmap progress, and resourcing tradeoffs to executive leadership, with the judgment to tailor depth and framing for an ELT audience.

Travel Required: Up to 15%  
Location: This is a remote position.

SeekNow is transforming property inspections through technology, data, and human expertise. The Director of Product Operations will build and run the operating system for the Product organization.

jobs.title: VP of Product User Experience
jobs.desc:
Company Overview

Karat Financial is a financial technology company focused on providing financial solutions for creators, entrepreneurs, and growing businesses. Our services include business banking solutions, payment tools, and financial management products designed to help customers manage their finances and daily operations more efficiently.

We focus on developing reliable, practical, and easy to use financial products that meet the changing needs of our customers. We continue to improve our technology, services, and overall customer experience as the company grows.

Job Description

Karat Financial is expanding its business and preparing to establish a new division to support the company's continued growth and development.

We are seeking an experienced VP of Product User Experience to join our new division and lead product strategy, user experience, and product development initiatives. This position will be responsible for improving existing products, establishing effective product management processes, and building a strong product team.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in product management, strong leadership skills, and the ability to work closely with senior management and other departments. This role will play an important part in supporting the new division's operations and long term business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute product strategies that align with company objectives and customer needs.

Lead and manage product management and user experience teams, providing direction and guidance on key priorities.

Oversee product planning, design, development, testing, and ongoing improvements.

Analyze customer feedback, product performance, and market trends to identify opportunities for improvement.

Work closely with engineering, operations, and other departments to support product development and project execution.

Improve product functionality, accessibility, and overall user experience across digital platforms.

Establish product priorities, manage resources, and monitor project timelines.

Develop effective product management processes to improve team collaboration and operational efficiency.

Set product performance goals, evaluate results, and recommend improvements.

Provide regular updates to senior leadership on product progress, team performance, and development priorities.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in product management, user experience, digital product development, or related fields.

Strong experience in product strategy, product development, and team leadership.

Proven ability to manage product teams and coordinate projects across multiple departments.

Solid understanding of user experience design, product development processes, and product lifecycle management.

Experience in financial technology, financial services, or related industries preferred.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to make sound business decisions.

Excellent communication, organizational, and problem solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a collaborative environment.

Experience working with senior leadership and presenting product plans and performance reports.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Product Design, or a related field preferred.

Pay: $270,000.00 - $350,000.00 per year

* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

**Job Profile**

**Position Overview**
=====================

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As the Head of Product within PNC's Linga organization, you will be based remotely.
  
  
The Head of Product is responsible for defining and executing LINGA's product vision while leading the company's transformation into an AI-enabled product organization.  
  
This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, commercialization, and lifecycle management of the entire LINGA product portfolio, including POS, Payments, Customer Engagement, Hardware, Data, Integrations, and Platform Services.  
In addition, this leader serves as a critical sponsor of Artificial Intelligence across LINGA and the product development operating model, ensuring AI becomes a fundamental driver of customer value, operational efficiency, innovation, and competitive advantage.  
The role sits at the intersection of customer experience, commercial growth, emerging technology, and organizational transformation.

Growth:  

* Accelerating product adoption and utilization
* Improving customer retention and merchant lifetime value
* Support P&L through product innovation & monetization strategies.

  
Innovation:  

* Own product vision, strategy, roadmap, & prioritization across all products.
* Establishing LINGA as a competitive AI commerce platform
* Accelerating product innovation cycles
* Building differentiated merchant experiences

  
Execution:  

* Improving roadmap predictability
* Increasing product delivery velocity
* Reducing operational friction
* Improving software quality and reliability
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Technology, and Customer Success to align investments to business goals.
* Lead product managers and product delivery functions.
* Manage prioritization of features, enhancements, technical debt, and compliance requirements.
* Own software release governance and product lifecycle management.

  
Transformation  

* Embedding AI across every major product workflow
* Transforming the product organization through AI-enabled ways of working
* Creating measurable productivity gains across the organization.

  
Leadership Expectations:  

* Build a high-performance product organization focused on outcomes.
* Develop future product leaders.
* Create a culture of accountability.
* Foster innovation and experimentation.
* Encourage data-driven decision-making.
* Build strong partnerships across the business.
* Create a culture of continuous improvement and customer obsession.

  
Qualifications:  
  

* 8+ years of product management experience with at least 5 years leading teams.
* Experience in SaaS POS: retail & restaurant, payments, and fintech technology.
* Proven success building and scaling product organizations.
* Ability to leverage orchestration development, and software delivery.
* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.

Success Metrics (KPIs)  

* Product adoption and utilization rates

* Revenue contribution from product initiatives
* AI feature adoption
* AI-generated revenue
* AI-assisted productivity gains

jobs.desc:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

**What you'll be doing**

Treasury Management is focused on delivering solutions that help our clients manage cash flow, optimize liquidity, make and collect payments, and navigate their day-to-day business with confidence.

  
  

As the Managing Director, Head of Product Management and Digital Solutions, you'll define and lead the multi-year strategy and roadmap for the full Treasury Management portfolio and commercial digital experience. You'll set portfolio priorities and recommend investments that balance growth, client experience, risk, resiliency, regulatory requirements, and technology modernization. You'll lead the product lifecycle from market assessment and business case development through design, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement, while partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Onboarding, Client Service, and external providers. You'll also build and lead a high-performing team, establish strong governance and performance measures, and represent Product Management and Digital Solutions in leadership forums to drive client and business outcomes across the enterprise.

  
  

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. To successfully perform the work, you'll be on-site full-time.

  
  

*Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

**Set the enterprise strategy** - Lead the multi-year strategy and roadmap for the Treasury Management portfolio and commercial digital experience, aligning investments and priorities to business growth, client needs, regulatory expectations, resiliency, and modernization goals.

  
  

**Lead portfolio decisions** - Determine which capabilities should be built, bought, partnered for, enhanced, consolidated, or retired based on strategic fit, client impact, speed to market, economics, and long-term value.

  
  

**Drive product management excellence** - Establish consistent standards for product ownership, business cases, roadmaps, pricing, launch readiness, performance scorecards, post-launch reviews, and decommissioning practices across the portfolio.

  
  

**Advance digital client experiences** - Translate client journeys and business priorities into integrated roadmaps across online and mobile banking, application programming interfaces, enterprise resource planning and treasury workstation connectivity, file transmission, analytics, and self-service capabilities.

  
  

**Deliver commercial and financial outcomes** - Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Onboarding, Client Service, and Operations to commercialize solutions, improve adoption and retention, and manage performance across revenue, deposits, profitability, pricing, cost, and return on investment.

  
  

**Lead execution and talent development** - Build a high-performing Product Management and Digital Solutions organization, define clear decision rights and ways of working, and coach leaders who are accountable for client outcomes, economics, risk management, roadmap delivery, and performance.

  
  

**Who you are**

  

**You're an experienced product and digital leader.** You bring 15+ years of experience in product management, digital solutions, treasury management, payments, commercial banking, or related financial services environments. You have led complex portfolios with accountability for strategy, commercialization, and delivery.

This role helps ensure alignment with CERIS’ annual strategic objectives while addressing evolving industry needs within the clinical audit space. The Director serves as a subject matter expert in IBR and HBA, bringing relational, tactical, and technical expertise in payment integrity. The leader in this role is accountable for supporting product growth across the IBR and HBA portfolio, with a focus on enhancing revenue generation and elevating client satisfaction.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Support development of next generation IBR and HBA services aligned with prepayment and post payment solution strategies
* Build product relationships across CERIS/CorVel, including corporate marketing, IT, regional offices, external clients, and AE and AM staff within the IBR and HBA segment
* Function as a subject matter expert (SME) in IBR and HBA product development processes, solution areas, competitor offerings, and customer needs

* Provide mentoring and coaching to team members; contribute to a “learn and do” culture of continuous improvement

* Manage multiple projects, priority setting, and committed schedules
* Available to travel up to 25% for customer onsite visits and events

* Background in Itemized Bill Review (IBR) and Hospital Bill Audit (HBA) audit types required

* Solid problem-solving skills with an innovative mindset
* Verbally articulate with the ability to present product/topics at events
* Skilled in supporting product business plans with forecasting and maturation planning

jobs.desc:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team generates customer insights that shape Stripe's product strategy and leads go-to-market across our suite of products. It's a highly cross-functional role—we partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and Demand Generation, and we work across the entire product lifecycle: from helping shape what we build, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing adoption post-launch.

Market Intelligence is embedded within Product Marketing and provides product and GTM leadership with the insights, analysis, and recommendations needed to sharpen product-market fit and position Stripe effectively in the market.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a leader to manage the Market Intelligence team, define how it interlocks with partner functions across Stripe, and lead strategic initiatives to strengthen our market position. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between market signals and Stripe's most critical product and GTM decisions—clearly articulating priorities that inform what we build and for whom. You'll partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, manage a team of market intelligence analysts, and communicate complex ideas in ways that drive real decisions. Success in this role requires equal parts analytical rigor, storytelling, and the ability to operate fluidly between high-level strategy and ground-level execution.

Responsibilities

  • Define the direction and operating model of the Market Intelligence team at Stripe
  • Contribute to company-wide decision-making and roadmap prioritization by partnering with product operations and product management
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure market intelligence materials are discoverable, actively used, and meaningfully inform decision-making
  • Lead ongoing market research and competitive analysis, including tracking industry players' go-to-market strategies and messaging
  • Manage and develop a team of market intelligence analysts

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of product marketing or market intelligence experience, with a strong preference for candidates with experience working in B2B settings
  • Demonstrated track record building and scaling a market intelligence program, including tools, processes, and regular executive-level reporting
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally to drive results
  • Ability to leverage data to proactively identify opportunities and deliver impactful recommendations
