**Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion**

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly, our employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

**Job Overview:**

LPL is building the data foundation that enables AI across the firm. We are seeking a product leader to transform business information into reusable data products, shared business definitions, semantic models, and knowledge retrieval capabilities that support accurate and useful AI applications.

As Vice President, Product Management, Intelligent Data Layer, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for this portfolio while leading a team of product managers and partnering with engineering, data science, AI application teams, and business stakeholders.

You will ground product development in defined business use cases by establishing an end-to-end path from source information through its use in an AI application. This “steel thread” approach will validate capabilities in production-oriented use cases and inform the development of reusable data, semantic, and retrieval products that can support additional applications across the firm.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and manage the Intelligent Data Layer product strategy, roadmap, priorities, and investment decisions, balancing business value, reuse, delivery effort, operating cost, and technical dependencies.
* Lead the development and lifecycle management of reusable data products that make business facts, relationships, measures, and contextual information available to AI applications.

* Lead knowledge and retrieval product capabilities, including enterprise search, knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and GraphRAG, and evaluate their performance against defined business questions and use cases.
* Partner with AI application, engineering, data science, and business teams to deliver end-to-end use cases from source data through application consumption, using lessons from those implementations to expand reusable platform capabilities.
* Own the product lifecycle from discovery and requirements through launch and ongoing improvement, defining product requirements for accuracy, data freshness, access permissions, source traceability, reliability, and support.
* Establish product quality and AI evaluation measures for retrieval relevance, answer grounding, data accuracy, reliability, adoption, latency, and operating cost, and use results to prioritize product improvements.
* Hire, develop, and lead product managers, establish delivery commitments with engineering leaders, and manage cross-functional dependencies and priorities.
* Establish governance and ownership models with business and technology partners for shared definitions, semantic models, data products, and knowledge assets.
* Measure adoption, product quality, reliability, and operating cost, and partner with application owners to evaluate business outcomes and inform roadmap investments.

The VP, Product Manager, Strategy Development is a hybrid role, located on-site in St. Louis MO. The VP Product Manager will analyze complex data from multiples sources to identify actionable business solutions that drive results and project positive outcomes; partner with cross-functional teams to implement scalable tools and frameworks; and drive process improvement initiatives that inform business decisions and operational excellence.

This role will be responsible for defining and executing the bank's branch strategy, ensuring the branch network maximizes growth and efficiency. This includes leading branch network optimization, staffing models, and performance frameworks. The role will serve as the primary driver of branch distribution strategy and execution, partnering across functions to deliver a modern, high-performing, and economically optimized branch network.

* Champion process improvement initiatives, leveraging analytics, automation, and stakeholder feedback to improve decision quality and operational effectiveness.

jobs.desc:

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

jobs.title: Head of Product GTM & Market Intelligence
jobs.desc:
Oxford Data Plan is an alternative data company serving institutional investors, primarily hedge funds, with real time daily KPI and revenue tracking products. We work with around 100 funds across fundamental long/short, multi-manager and systematic strategies. Post Series B, scaling fast.

We are hiring a senior leader to own the link between what clients buy and what we build. Reporting to the CRO, you will analyse win and deal rates at product level, size our target market, rank coverage gaps by the revenue attached to them, and turn that into roadmap recommendations and clear go to market messaging for the revenue team. The role needs both data science skills and commercial judgment. The goal is to maximise ARR by building the right products in the right order and selling them well.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Win and deal rate analysis.** Own the product level view of commercial performance: win/loss themes, conversion rates by product, segment and sector, and where deals stall for product reasons.
* **Target market and TAM.** Define and maintain our target market and TAM analysis by client segment, sector and KPI coverage area, so roadmap decisions are sized against addressable revenue. This becomes the reference map for where we grow next.
* **Roadmap prioritisation.** Recommend which products, segments, sectors and KPIs to prioritise, ranked by ARR impact, drawing on client interactions, pipeline evidence and your own analysis.
* **Gap identification.** Keep a live, ranked view of gaps in the current offering versus client demand, each with the revenue attached. Coverage gap closure is the company-level metric this role owns; Tech and Partnerships execute the closures.
* **Product and Data Strategy Working Group.** Take a leading role in the working group, holding the Revenue seat and bringing win/loss evidence and client demand ranked by ARR into every cycle.
* **GTM messaging and timing.** Create the messaging Sales and Account Management take to market for each product and launch: positioning, proof points, competitive counters and launch timing.
* **Cross-department collaboration.** Work closely with the CRO, CTO and Head of Data Partnerships so commercial signal reaches product and partnership decisions, and new capability reaches the sales floor.
* **Market intelligence.** Track competitor coverage, pricing and product moves, and keep our differentiation and Series B product narrative current.

**Success Measures:**

* ARR from products launched through the working group, and improved win rates on deals where a roadmap gap had been cited.
* Coverage gaps closed per quarter, weighted by revenue attached.
* Shorter time from commercial signal to roadmap decision, with one ranked list.
* Sales and AM teams working from consistent, current messaging on every priority product.

**Requirements:**

* Buy side experience at a leading hedge fund or asset manager, ideally in a market intelligence or alternative data function, evaluating datasets the way our clients do.
* Strong quantitative background, with working Python and SQL. You go to the data yourself.
* Experience sizing markets and making prioritisation calls with capital or revenue at stake, for example in an investing or strategy seat.
* Experience leading a data function or workstream, and able to translate between technical and commercial teams.
* Clear communicator who can turn analysis into a short recommendation and defend it with leadership and with the sales team.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.desc:
**About Pocket**

*At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.*

Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it.

We’ve built an AI-powered device that captures real-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices.

Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet.

**About the Role**

A great recording is only the start. The harder question is what someone can do with it: remember a decision, find an idea, act on a conversation or give their AI tools the context they’re missing.

You’ll own Pocket’s product experience across hardware, mobile, desktop, AI features and integrations. Working directly with the founders, you’ll decide which problems matter, turn them into products and stay close enough to customers to know whether they work. This is a hands-on product leadership role, not a layer between the team and the work.

**What You’ll Own**

* The customer journey from device setup and activation to everyday use, retention and monetization.
* Product strategy, roadmap and prioritization, grounded in customer feedback and clear success measures.
* AI experiences that make captured conversations useful: personal memory, summaries, actions and contextual assistance.
* Integrations with the tools people already use, including APIs, MCP and agent workflows where they solve a real problem.
* Delivery with engineering, design, growth and operations, from early experiments through launch and iteration.
* Product quality, including the details that make a device and its software feel like one experience. Privacy and user trust are part of that work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Consumer products you have shipped and improved, with evidence that people use and value them.
* Strong judgment about design and user experience, backed by close attention to customer behavior and data.
* Hands-on curiosity about AI: you try new models and tools and can distinguish a compelling demo from a useful product.
* The ability to make difficult tradeoffs, challenge assumptions and bring engineers and designers with you.
* Comfort setting a long-term direction while staying involved in day-to-day execution.

**Bonus Points**

You have taken a product from zero to one and then scaled it; worked across hardware and software; built with LLMs, agents or developer ecosystems; founded a company; or led product early at a consumer technology or AI company.

**Why Join Pocket?**

Your work will reach people who already own the product. You’ll work directly with the founders and shape the experience across physical hardware and software, rather than optimizing one small part of it. There is a real customer base to learn from and important product decisions still to make.

Compensation Range: $220K - $300K

The role will initially be both strategic and hands-on, requiring someone who can establish the product vision while also driving early product decisions, hiring, prioritization, and delivery.

This is an opportunity to build a product and technology organization at the foundation of a growing insurance company. The person in this role will have meaningful influence over the company’s future operating model, technology architecture, AI capabilities, customer experience, and competitive position.

The Head of Product will not simply manage an existing product portfolio. --------------

Ozlo is a health tech company transforming how the world sleeps. We design and manufacture an ecosystem of sleep solutions, including the Ozlo Sleepbuds®, that use sophisticated technology and sound to unlock restorative sleep. Founded in 2022 by former Bose leaders, we have sold hundreds of thousands of units, are fully backed, and are now scaling our next generation of products as we expand from consumer wellness into clinical sleep and neuro health.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Director of Product - Core to own Ozlo's core product line, including consumer hardware and software, as part of a product team that also includes Platform (sensors, biometrics and shared technology) and Clinical (clinical software and applications). You will report to the Co-Founder and President, work directly with design and engineering, and own the product and its delivery. There will be some management responsibility, but the core of the role is owning the product, not managing others.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the full core suite: Sleepbuds hardware, case, firmware, and the iOS and Android app, current generation and next
* Set product priorities with leadership, bringing a clear, evidence-based view of what to build and why

* Approach product as a commercial build, not a feature list: build and own business cases covering pricing, unit cost, margin, attach, subscription and volume

* Work as one product team with Platform and Clinical to build cohesion across all Ozlo product lines
* Ground decisions in customer reviews, support and return data, app analytics and research
* Keep stakeholders informed with clear, regular updates on status, risks and decisions

------------------

* A strong background in product and program management for connected consumer hardware (audio, wearables, consumer electronics or similar)
* A track record of shipping physical products at scale, from concept through manufacturing, launch and post-launch support
* Technical depth across hardware, firmware and mobile software, with the ability to engage engineers on architecture and tradeoffs
* Commercial judgment, including building business plans and product P&L models
* A track record of owning delivery with engineering teams: hitting dates, managing scope and risk, and making hard calls
* Daily use of AI tools to guide and speed up research, specs, analysis, prototyping and stakeholder communication
* Clear, direct communication skills
* Comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment and willing to do the work yourself

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* You have built your own product, inside a brand or on your own, at any scale

* Experience with Bluetooth audio products (BLE, LE Audio)
* Experience with subscription or membership products attached to hardware
* Exposure to health, wellness or regulated products (FDA, SaMD)
* Experience working with global contract manufacturers

Our preferred location for this role is Dublin, Ireland (Dublin office), New York metro (Manhattan office) or Greater Boston (Marlborough office), but we are open to remote candidates anywhere. Some travel to our offices and manufacturing partners is expected.

**Why Ozlo**
------------

Join a collaborative, fast-paced, global team focused on helping millions of people sleep better. You will shape the product people sleep with every night as we grow from consumer wellness into clinical health.

As the world races toward Level 4 autonomy, the ability to reconstruct real-world driving scenes, generate infinite synthetic scenarios, and validate AV policies across millions of virtual miles before a single vehicle touches the road has become the defining competitive advantage. NVIDIA is building the full stack that makes this possible: from NuRec neural reconstruction and Cosmos world foundation models to AlpaSim closed-loop evaluation and the Alpamayo ecosystem. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Want to make a difference? Come join our team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

As the Director of Simulation Product Management, you will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for NVIDIA's autonomous driving simulation platform. You will be the connective force between research, engineering, go-to-market, and our OEM and AV developer customers—shaping how the industry uses NVIDIA's simulation technology to reconstruct real-world driving data, generate safety-critical synthetic scenarios, and close the loop between AV policy training and real-world deployment. This role demands deep fluency in AV simulation workflows, sharp product instincts, and the leadership presence to align a world-class organization behind a clear and ambitious roadmap.

• Build deep partnerships with OEMs, robotaxi operators, and AV software developers to understand their simulation pipelines, surface unmet needs, and co-develop platform capabilities that directly accelerate their path to safe deployment.

• Partner closely with research and engineering teams to translate fleet data workflows, sensor modeling requirements, and policy evaluation needs into well-scoped, executable product requirements.

• Establish and track key product and ecosystem metrics—scenario coverage, reconstruction fidelity, closed-loop evaluation throughput, and customer adoption—and use them to guide prioritization and communicate progress to executive leadership.

• Collaborate with go-to-market, developer relations, and solutions engineering to drive platform adoption, shape developer programs, and articulate the value of NVIDIA's simulation stack versus competing approaches.

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers focused on AV simulation, establishing best practices and raising the bar for PM excellence across the organization.

• Represent NVIDIA's simulation vision at industry events, safety and standards forums, and executive briefings—communicating the technical depth and strategic importance of simulation to both engineering and business audiences.

What We Need to See:

• 12+ overall years of product management experience, with a strong track record of delivering complex technical platform products at scale.

• 4+ years in a senior or director-level PM role, with demonstrated experience leading and growing high-performing PM teams.

• Deep understanding of autonomous driving development workflows—including sensor data pipelines, closed-loop simulation, synthetic data generation, and safety validation methodologies.

• Hands-on familiarity with neural reconstruction, 3D Gaussian Splatting

## Technical Product Manager, Integrations **Remote, US**

### About Nametag

Nametag helps companies verify the real person behind high-risk workforce actions, from account recovery to identity checks, before attackers can exploit the gap.

Deepfakes, social engineering, and stolen credentials have made "who is actually on the other side of this request?" a critical infrastructure problem. We are building the identity verification and account protection layer companies use to answer that question quickly, securely, and with less friction for real users.

### The Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own how Nametag gets into the systems our customers already live in.

Nametag is rarely the application someone opens. It's the identity check that happens inside the helpdesk ticket, the HR onboarding flow, the Slack message from someone claiming to be the CFO. That means our growth is gated less by what our platform can do than by how well we embed it into other people's software — Workday, ServiceNow, Slack, Okta, ICIMS, UKG, and the long tail behind them.

This role exists to run that work as a discipline rather than a series of one-offs. You'll join a dedicated team whose entire purpose is expanding Nametag into new systems and new use cases, and you'll own the question that decides whether each one succeeds: **how, concretely, will this integration work?**

That question is harder than it sounds, because the environments we integrate into are tightly constrained. Workday's extensibility surface is narrow and governed. Slack gives you modals, slash commands, and a Block Kit vocabulary that was not designed for identity verification. ServiceNow gives you a lot of rope and a lot of ways to hang a customer's upgrade path. Many of these platforms give you almost no UI to work with, strict review processes, and no appetite for anything that looks like a redirect to a third party. # Product Owner

$100k - $130k

Full-time

CONCEPT SOLUTIONS LLC

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3251153822534621692?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=187&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7332741062908397089&crId=US_0US_0)

Description

Concept Solutions, LLC (CS) is seeking a **Product Owner** to support a mission-critical application modernization program for a Department of War (DoW) customer.

This initiative focuses on simplifying and unifying access across a portfolio of production applications through a single sign-on experience, a centralized work surface, and a repeatable approach for integrating applications into a shared platform.

The Product Owner will play a key role in guiding product priorities, engaging stakeholders, and ensuring Agile development efforts align with customer needs and program objectives. This position also supports the continued operation and sustainment of existing applications throughout modernization.

- Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog across four customer-gated phases, ensuring alignment with program objectives and delivery milestones.
- Define clear acceptance criteria for user stories and phase-exit deliverables.
- Lead ongoing user engagement with analysts, industry users, and members of the public to understand needs, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Translate user feedback and usability findings into actionable, prioritized backlog items.
- Track and report on success metrics established with the customer.

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in product ownership or business analysis supporting enterprise web applications.
- Experience working in Agile software development environments delivering solutions to federal government customers.
- Demonstrated experience conducting usability sessions and translating findings into prioritized product enhancements.
- Active Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with identity management, workflow systems, or case-management applications.
- Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Work Location and Schedule

- Location: Remote
- Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with core hours of 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Eastern.
- Agile Delivery: Two-wee

**Who is UJV?**

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?

- UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.

- We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.

- We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.

- We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity

- and attention to detail.

- We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.


## **Role Mission**

The Technical Product Owner leads the strategy and delivery of UJV's e-commerce platform: the B2B, B2C, client, advisor, partner, and white-label online booking portals, and the API integrations behind them. Together, these products shape how UJV does business with clients, advisors, partners, and vendors. You will sit at the intersection of users, business, and technology: understanding what each audience needs, deciding what is worth building, and working with engineering to bring it to life.

As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap, prioritize with a clear view of impact and effort, and measure success through adoption and business results. You will work hands-on, using customer research, data, and AI-enabled tools to test ideas early and make confident decisions. This is a high-visibility role for someone who enjoys real ownership, thrives in a small and fast-moving team, and wants to build the technology behind a leading luxury travel brand.

##### Technical Product Owner

Allia Health Group (AHG) is a multi-entity healthcare organization spanning the Brello patient platform, HelloWellness patient care, Southend Pharmacy (SEP), and Zito Care. At Allia Health Group, we don't just follow industry trends—we redefine them. Our mission is to commoditize anti-aging solutions, making them affordable and accessible to the average consumer—not just the wealthy. By offering customized and cost-effective wellness products that follow cost-containment models, we aim to improve people's quality of life and meet them wherever they are on their health journey.

Our product team builds the technology that connects patients, providers, and pharmacy operations across the group — from patient-facing mobile and web experiences to internal platforms that power daily operations. We're a small, high-ownership team where your work ships quickly and reaches real patients.

Allia Health Group is seeking a Technical Product Owner to fully own Brello and the HelloWellness Patient Platform — our flagship patient-facing products, currently mid-way through a major platform migration. You'll take over day-to-day product ownership from the Head of Product and run it end to end backlog, requirements, releases, QA coordination, and stakeholder communication. This role sits alongside a peer TPO who owns our other product lines. You'll be the person engineering, design, and business stakeholders go to for everything about the patient platform — so we're looking for someone who can hold full context, make calls, and communicate them clearly.

- Write clear, technically-grounded requirements and acceptance criteria; work daily with engineering on scoping, trade-offs, and sequencing

At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Product Owner, CPQ to own the backlog and day-to-day delivery of our Configure-Price-Quote platform within the IT Business Applications team. CMDB Product Owner Purpose of the Role

This role is accountable end-to-end for the integrity of CMDB data and for the value it creates for the enterprise - ensuring configuration item (CI) data reliably supports incident, problem, change, and risk decisions across JLL's ITSM practice.

The Product Owner is expected to help transform ESM into a value-providing function for JLL - building a CMDB and configuration data model that supports modern application development teams as well as traditional IT operations, and that provides the trustworthy, well-governed data foundation that AI and agentic AI automation across ESM depends on.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Sports Experience
jobs.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team

The New Content Exploration product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our team is responsible for building the end-to-end member experience for Live and delivering innovative Sports features to market. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces.

In the past two years, Netflix has been home to record-breaking NFL Games, Boxing Events, and the World Baseball Classic Tournament. Netflix is accelerating its ambitions to capture real-time, unscripted magic of Live events looking ahead to the Women's World Cup and beyond. As the ambitions for Live and Sports are growing bigger and bolder in the years to come, a truly innovative product experience plays a critical role in bringing the magic to our members.

The Role

As Product Manager for the Sports Experience, you will own the end-to-end execution of new features for our Sports content slate. You will work in close partnership with the Product Lead for Live and Sports to align on the overall roadmap and priorities. You will directly own portfolio features across the roadmap spanning the Discovery and Playback experience. As we look to onboard new content experiences, you will be at the forefront of scaling our Sports features to those partners. You’ll interface closely with a broad cross-functional team including Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Content and Product.

You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts across both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in balancing requirements/tradeoffs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead when there remain some critics, influencing and keeping momentum in the face of ambiguity.

What You’ll Do

• Launch new features by owning workstreams end-to-end, from framing the problem through launch, measurement, and the next iteration. You drive your areas independently with strong responsibility.

• Influence a team of stunning colleagues across design, engineering, consumer insights, merchandising and data science to deliver outstanding products

• Proactively identify new investments by leveraging consumer insights, market trends, and platform data to uncover new product opportunities for Sports, actively shaping the broader strategic roadmap for our rapidly expanding live ecosystem.

• Working through open-ended problems and identifying opportunities for evolution of existing or conceptualizing new discovery, capability or feature requirements

• Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation, with your data science partners

• Run A/B tests and set the success metrics before launch, run the tests with your data science partners, and interpret the results.

What You’ll Bring

As Product Manager, Sports Experience, you’ll be passionate about the work, bringing:

• 6+ years of experience developing consumer products and features and comfortable operating with complex tradeoffs

• Experience working on Live Sports streaming products at scale, and a great understanding of the Sports lifecycle

• Very high attention to detail, with an ability to connect the smallest experience elements to the big picture goals at the company and team level

• Excellent bias to action, shipping

You have a track record of shipping high-quality consumer products, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and driving measurable impact.

• Deeply understand and socialize the evolving needs of our members with your consumer insights and design partners

jobs.title: Propulsion Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**The role**

Allocortech does not need a backlog janitor. We need someone who understands why four-quadrant FOC, voltage class, SWaP-C, and certification timeline are the product — and can turn that into a roadmap OEMs will buy.

Taurus motor controllers, Clio power/comms hubs, and the surrounding battery/PDU work already power eVTOL, hybrid cargo aircraft, and electric hydrofoils. Your job is to productize that stack.

**What you will do**

* Own the propulsion backlog: Taurus variants, voltage/power SKUs, firmware feature flags, packaging, accessories.
* Sit with EE, FOC firmware, and customers and turn “400 V, regen, eight-week MOTS” into sequenced work.
* Write requirements hardware and firmware can actually build. Kill nice-to-haves that blow SWaP or schedule.
* Partner with sales on positioning, spec sheets, and which custom asks become catalog.
* Keep the 18-month versus 24-month product bets honest.

  

**What you bring**

* 5+ years owning a technical product on power electronics, motor drives, avionics, or vehicle propulsion.
* Enough EE/firmware literacy to argue current loops, isolation, and CAN without hiding behind Jira.
* Comfort in front of aerospace, defense, or advanced-vehicle OEMs.
* Judgment on COTS vs. MOTS vs. custom — and the discipline to say no.
* Bonus: eVTOL/UAS, hybrid-electric, or maritime electric programs.

  

**Why Allocortech**

Fifty-plus people, revenue already tripled, and a propulsion line that is on vehicles instead of slides. You will set what gets built next — not write tickets for a platform team in another time zone.

***APPLY NOW***

  

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production and lab areas.

  

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package. Employees may receive equity opportunities and/or cash bonus, and have access to a robust benefits package including: top tier medical HMO, PPO & a 100% company-sponsored HSA plan option, dental and vision coverage, unlimited PTO, 11 paid holidays per year, flexible spending and dependent care savings accounts, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and access to a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status; please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

**At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be.

Joining our team means embracing a fast-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you.

Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

**Brief Summary of Role**

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use - and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most.

You’ll own a meaningful product area end-to-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve.

You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t).

**What you'll Do**

* **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned.
* **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building.
* **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun.
* **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch.
* **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. Bring experience with technically deep products, such as APIs, integrations, data pipelines, or Salesforce’y systems. You’ll happily dig into an API spec or sketch a workflow in Figma to u

jobs.title: Product Manager - Servicing
jobs.desc:
### **ABOUT OUR COMPANY:**

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
-------------------

Splash Financial is seeking a Product Manager to own the borrower servicing experience. You'll report to the Senior PM for Servicing, focused on building great customer experiences that directly impact how thousands of borrowers manage, repay, and interact with their loans. You'll also play a key role in improving the operational processes and partner onboarding that sit behind those experiences.

This isn't a support role. You'll own your domains end to end: running discovery, writing requirements, partnering with engineering, design, and business stakeholders, and using data to make better decisions faster.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO AT SPLASH:**

* Own the discovery and delivery of borrower-facing servicing features, with a focus on intuitive experiences that make it easy for borrowers to manage, repay, and stay on track with their loans.
* Partner with lender implementation teams to translate partner servicing requirements into product requirements and support go-live delivery across credit union and bank partners.
* Help maintain and evolve our servicing platform configuration, including loan settings, borrower communications, and platform-level changes.
* Drive initiatives that reduce delinquency and improve payment behavior, including self-service improvements, payment plan optimization, and enrollment experiences.
* Use AI tools to accelerate your own workflow, including drafting documents, synthesizing research, analyzing data, and automating repetitive tasks.

Fait Distribution is a family-owned and operated wholesale contact lens distributor and buying group. We pride ourselves in projecting a professional image to our customers that is both confident and enthusiastic. Our commitment to exceeding customer expectations and creating long lasting relationships is driven by our dedicated Associates. Being part of a family-owned company like Fait Distribution is something special. We’re a close-knit company where Associates are valued and truly drive and make an impact on our success. There are always exciting and new opportunities for you to advance your career and grow within our company. At Fait Distribution you will find a supportive and fast-paced environment with a fun work culture. We trust you will find employment here challenging, yet highly rewarding.

The IT Product Manager is responsible for maximizing business value from assigned systems, products, processes, or operational domains by defining product vision, prioritizing work, aligning stakeholders, and guiding Agile delivery teams toward measurable business outcomes. This role serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, ensuring that technology investments are clearly prioritized, well-defined, and aligned with Fait’s operational goals. This is an individual contributor role focused on product direction, stakeholder alignment, backlog prioritization, and delivery value; it does not include direct people-management responsibility unless otherwise assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS/ABILITIES:**

* 3+ years of experience as an IT Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role supporting software delivery in a business environment.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Strong understanding of business and operational processes and how technology supports them.
* Experience making value-based prioritization decisions using customer impact, operational efficiency, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Proven ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations, customer service, finance, sales, and IT.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills; able to translate between business needs, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to define, track, and communicate success measures such as cycle time, accuracy, adoption, error reduction, operational efficiency, and customer/associate experience.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint preferred.
* Experience in distribution, logistics, warehouse, ERP, WMS, e-commerce, or integration-heavy environments is preferred.
* Product Owner, Product Manager, Agile, or Scrum certification is preferred.

**RESPONSIBILITIES – HOW THIS POSITION SUPPORTS THE VISION include the following, but are not limited to:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and outcomes for assigned systems, processes, or operational domains.
* Align delivery priorities with business strategy, operational objectives, and the IT roadmap.
* Represent stakeholder interests while balancing short-term needs, operational stability, and long-term value.
* Clearly articulate desired outcomes and measurable success criteria, not just features or requests.
* Own and maintain the product backlog.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business value, operational impact, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Make clear trade-off decisions when scope, timing, or resources conflict.
* Act as the final decision-maker on backlog ordering and scope trade-offs for the product/team, escalating when needed.
* Serve as the primary interface between business stakeholders and delivery teams.

jobs.desc:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands

About the team

Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.

The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.

About the role

We're looking for an AI Product Operations Lead to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&D.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.

One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.

You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&D.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.

You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.

What you'll do

  • Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Rapidly growing software company in San Fernando, CA (over 22,562 companies use our GPS tracking software) is looking to add a Product Manager to our team.

Product management is a newer function at our company. Until recently it was handled part-time across engineering, operations, and leadership, and it has outgrown that arrangement. The scope and workflows of the role are still being defined, and you'll have a hand in defining them.

We need someone who can take a project from "we should build this" all the way to "customers are using it and understand it": talking to the right people, getting the requirements right before engineering starts building, and seeing it through to launch.

If helping shape a role rather than stepping into a fully mapped-out one sounds exciting, keep reading. If you'd rather join an established product org with a playbook already written, this probably isn't the role for you.

**What You'll Own**

Every project you take on, you own end to end:

* Discovery and requirements. Sit with support, sales, operations, and customers directly. Understand the real-world task the customer is trying to complete, break it into steps, and turn those steps into features and functional requirements. Produce wireframes that show how the workflow will look on screen.
* Tickets engineering can actually build from. Write well-formed Jira tickets with clear acceptance criteria and data requirements: what's displayed live in the UI, and what needs to be stored for later reporting.
* Keeping projects moving. Coordinate with engineering leadership, design, and operations to determine where each ticket fits in overall priorities. Work with engineers on estimates, own the project timeline, make scope trade-offs to hit dates, and surface risks and slips early rather than late. Monitor tickets so nothing sits waiting for a decision that nobody knows they need to make.
* UX quality. Make sure the user can complete the task in the order they naturally think about it, and that information on screen is clear and legible.
* Testing before and after release. Test on staging and production. Find the bugs, the lag, the rough edges, and document exactly what needs to change. Retest until it feels production-ready.
* Internal rollout and training. Write up how each release works, train internal staff, and be the go-to person for questions. Coordinate staff testing of new features and channel that feedback back to engineering.
* Launch. Draft customer-facing announcements and coordinate final release timing with the development team.

Discovery, requirements, and keeping projects moving are the core of the job. Testing, internal training, and launch communications are also part of it, because on a small team the person who owns a feature sees it all the way through; if those parts sound like a chore rather than part of shipping well, please don't apply.

**The Technical Bar**

You don't need to write code. You do need to be able to hold a productive conversation with an engineer about what's possible, what's hard, and what the trade-offs are, and you need to understand why something that sounds like a simple feature may actually be difficult. You should be comfortable looking at how the application behaves and at its data model well enough to specify what should be shown on screen versus stored for reporting.

Our product is GPS fleet tracking, which means physical devices in vehicles, firmware, cellular connectivity, and a lot of data arriving in near real time. Prior experience with a product that includes hardware or devices is a real plus.

Our stack, for context: Golang and MySQL on the server, Vue.js on the web, Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) for mobile, on AWS.

**Ramp-up and the 60-day review**

Nobody expects you to know our system on day one. Your first weeks will be spent learning the product alongside support and operations before you take ownership of a project.

jobs.desc:
**About Clair**
---------------

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help bring one of Clair's next products to life.

The product you'll initially work on exists today in successful private beta and is actively being expanded. That means you'll have a unique opportunity to join early in the product journey and help shape how we take an idea from concept to a real-world product and experience.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly defined roadmap or be handed a clear playbook for success. We have a direction, a problem we're working to solve, and a vision, but there is still plenty to figure out. You'll help turn ambiguity into action, make smart decisions with imperfect information, and work alongside a small, highly collaborative team to build, test, learn, and iterate quickly.

At Clair, building products is uniquely complex. We're an embedded fintech company, which means great product decisions require balancing the needs of our users with partner priorities and internal business demands, all while operating within a regulated environment. You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, finance, regulatory, operations, go-to-market, and partner teams to navigate those competing inputs and find the best path forward.

We're looking for a builder who is comfortable with gray areas, thinks outside the box, and isn't afraid to try something that might not work. You know how to move quickly without being reckless and understand that failing fast is only valuable if you're learning fast, too.

You won't be joining a team with every answer already mapped out. You'll help us find them.

**If you need someone to tell you exactly how to win, this probably isn't the role for you.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Identify, evaluate, and help define opportunities for new Clair products and experiences, often before the problem or solution is fully understood.
* Define and execute product strategy and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Partner closely with engineering and design to move quickly from concept to experiment to product, balancing speed with thoughtful execution.
* Build, test, learn, and iterate quickly—knowing when to invest further and when to fail fast and move on.
* Balance user experience and needs with partner priorities, business requirements, and the realities of operating an embedded fintech product.
* Spend time with partner management and go-to-market teams to identify new opportunities, uncover unmet needs, and develop new product concepts when necessary.
* Develop a deep understanding of Clair users through feedback, behavioral data, research, and direct conversations—and push for new ways to learn when existing data isn't enough.
* Work closely with data and analytics teams to develop hypotheses, evaluate product performance, and make informed decisions without becoming paralyzed by incomplete data.
* Collaborate with design and support teams to create intuitive, elegant experiences that help users understand and confidently engage with financial products.
* Partner with regulatory, finance, operations, and other internal stakeholders to navigate complex requirements without losing sight of the user experience.
* Bring the voice of the customer into product strategy, roadmap discussions, and day-to-day product decisions.
* Analyze market trends, emerging customer

jobs.title: Product Manager/ Game Producer - Casino Games
jobs.desc:
**What are we building?**

Hard Rock Digital is a **fiercely focused** team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a **deeply curious** team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're **customer-obsessed** — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

Our **Games Studio** is at the heart of this mission, building world class proprietary casino games for Hard Rock Bet Casino. Across **Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade games**, we are creating differentiated experiences that combine proven player appeal, outstanding creative execution, innovative mechanics, and the quality expected from the Hard Rock brand. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape these games from the ground up, working across our internal team and external development partners to create content that can become a meaningful part of our casino portfolio and player experience.

**What’s the position?**

We’re looking for a **Product Manager / Game Producer, Casino Games** to help build the next generation of proprietary games for Hard Rock Bet Casino. This is a high impact role combining **Product Management, Game Production, Game Design,** and commercial product thinking. Depending on Studio priorities and individual experience, you may lead games across Slots, Card & Table, Arcade, or multiple categories.

You will own games from the first concept through development, certification, launch, and performance review. Working closely with the Senior Director, Studio leadership, internal stakeholders, RGS and platform partners, and external game development studios, you will turn player and market insights into high-quality games that drive engagement, differentiation, and revenue. The role requires someone equally comfortable discussing game mechanics and player experience with creatives, math and requirements with development teams, delivery with external studios, product strategy and performance with senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the Full Game Lifecycle**: Lead casino games from concept and business case through game design, development, QA, certification, launch, and post launch performance.
* **Build and Drive the Roadmap**: Develop and manage a strong game roadmap across Slots, Card & Table, and Arcade based on player needs, market opportunities, business priorities, and portfolio gaps.
* **Act as Product Manager and Game Producer**: Translate strategy into clear game concepts, GDDs, requirements, priorities, milestones, and actionable development plans.
* **Champion Creative and Game Quality**: Guide gameplay, mechanics, math, features, art, animation, audio, UI/UX, and overall player experience to deliver polished, compelling games.
* **Drive Innovation with Purpose**: Analyze successful games, suppliers, mechanics, player behavior, and adjacent gaming categories to identify opportunities worth adapting, improving, or reinventing.
* **Lead Internal and External Development**: Work closely with external studios, RGS and platform partners, Product, Engineering, Art, Math, QA, Compliance, Release, Analytics, Marketing, and Casino Operations to deliver games successfully.
* **Manage Delivery and Risk**: Own game priorities, development milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder communication while maintaining quality and speed to market.
* **Deliver for Regulated Markets**: Ensure game design, math, functionality, documentation, testing, and implementation meet applicable regulatory and certification requirements.

**About Reserv**

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

**Location Requirement**

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in **California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.**

**About the role**

As the Senior Product Manager, Data at Reserv, you will be at the forefront of driving the

development and innovation of our data-centric products. Working at the intersection of

business, technology, and customer experience, you will be responsible for managing data

products that support our insurance services and operations. You will lead the strategy,

execution, and delivery of data solutions, leveraging insights to improve decision-making,

enhance operational efficiency, and provide value to our customers.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, data science, operations, and business

teams to ensure our data products align with the company’s goals. You will oversee the product

lifecycle, from gathering requirements to launching new features, and continuously optimize

product performance to meet evolving market needs.

**Who you are**

* **Data-Driven**: You possess strong data analytics skills, using data to inform product decisions and measure success, with experience in business intelligence tools and performance metrics.
* **Technically Proficient**: You understand data architecture, analytics platforms, and are comfortable working with engineering teams to build robust data solutions.
* **Customer-Focused**: You have a customer-centric approach, gathering insights and transforming them into product features that enhance customer experience and drive value.
* **Strategic Thinker**: You have the ability to align product strategy with business objectives, identifying opportunities for innovation and growth within the data landscape.
* **Agile Practitioner**: You are experienced in Agile methodologies, able to manage backlogs, lead sprint planning, and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* **Collaborative Leader**: You work well with cross-functional teams, influencing stakeholders at all levels and fostering a collaborative environment to achieve product goals.
* **Excellent Communicator**: You have strong communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts and product visions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem Solver**: You are skilled at analyzing problems, identifying solutions, and making data-informed decisions to drive product success.
* **Adaptable & Innovative**: You thrive in an evolving environment, staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to keep products competitive.

**What we need**

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  

* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Create buy-in for the product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Develop product pricing and positioning strategies
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with engineering team

jobs.desc:
When you join the Sandalwood team, you’ll join an engaging and inclusive group with a mission to help our customers identify, assess, and reduce work-related risks to quality, productivity, and employee health.

We are seeking a passionate support associate to lead the functional definition, lifecycle development, plant integration, and operational rollout of next-generation computer vision and automated inspection solutions.

In this role, you will own and advance a portfolio may include multiple advanced vision integration projects. You will work at the intersection of manufacturing, quality, software engineering, machine learning, controls, and plant operations to turn complex production challenges into scalable digital products.

Your success will help manufacturing teams improve first-time-through quality, reduce scrap, strengthen defect containment, and prevent quality issues from reaching customers.

This is an opportunity to shape products that directly influence manufacturing quality, production performance, and customer protection. You will have meaningful ownership of the roadmap while working closely with the teams that design, deploy, operate, and depend on these systems every day.

**What You'll Do**

Own the Product Backlog and Roadmap

* Define, prioritize, and manage the product backlog for camera and sensor based solutions.
* Align roadmap priorities with plant quality objectives and the broader digital manufacturing strategy.
* Translate manufacturing requirements, business needs, and quality risks into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and product increments.

Partner with Manufacturing Stakeholders

* Collaborate with Assembly, Stamping, and Powertrain teams to understand inspection challenges and operational requirements.
* Engage plant-floor technicians, quality leaders, controls engineers, plant management, software developers, and system integrators.
* Define functional specifications for applications such as visual defect detection and part presence or absence verification.

Lead Agile Product Delivery

* Serve as the primary product authority throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.
* Lead or actively participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide direction and timely decisions to software engineers, machine learning engineers, and system integration teams.
* Keep delivery teams focused on the features and capabilities that create the greatest manufacturing and quality value.

Define Quality and Performance Criteria

* Establish clear acceptance criteria and quality-gating logic for automated inspection applications.
* Define false-positive and false-negative thresholds based on manufacturing requirements.
* Support inspection strategies for applications and critical vehicle build verification.

**About Mariana Minerals**
==========================

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

**The Role**
============

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. Our data systems don't live in a vacuum — they feed process simulators, drive site automation, and are the substrate the business runs its decisions on.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to be the single product owner for the data engineering family — the data platform, analytics, data science, and the AI and agentic workflows built on top of them. Today this work is spread across technical leads and absorbed informally, with no one setting direction across the whole. Your job is to change that: decide what the data organization builds and why, get stakeholders aligned behind it, and make sure engineers can stay heads-down on the work that matters.

This is a hybrid Pioneer/Settler role: you'll get lightweight demos and PoCs built on ambiguous problems, and you'll bring order and cohesive ownership to data work streams that already exist. You'll prioritize ruthlessly and visibly — being explicit about what will not be worked on — and set direction rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Talk to our internal teams constantly — operators, machine learning engineers, software developers, analysts, and data users are your users, and their problems set the roadmap.
* Own the roadmap for the data platform, analytics, and data science tooling: what gets built next, for whom, and why.
* Write the product specs, KPIs, and success metrics that turn ambiguous asks into scoped, shippable work.
* Own prioritization and stakeholder alignment so engineers stay focused on deep technical work.
* Make the build-vs-buy calls for BI and analytics, and prioritize tooling that lets stakeholders answer their own questions instead of adding headcount.
* Own where agents fit versus conventional software, and drive AI and agentic workflows from demo to adopted tool.
* Decide which new data streams get integrated, when, and to what standard as new sensors and sources come online.
* Set the bar for what "supported" and "correct" mean as tools graduate from scripts and spreadsheets, and be explicit about what won't be migrated.

**How You'll Operate**
======================

* **Structure from ambiguity:** Bring direction to cross-disciplinary initiatives and align stakeholders rather than waiting for direction.
* **Ruthless, visible prioritization:** Be explicit about what will not be worked on, not just what will.
* **Hybrid Pioneer/Settler:** Get initial prototypes built with stakeholders, then write the roadmap to validate the use case and, if worth it, take it to production.
* **Ecosystem fluency:** Understand where Mariana's data sits relative to the systems that consume it and relative to the current frontier of LLM capability, so prioritization calls stay well-calibrated.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 4–8+ years in technical product management, data platform or analytics product roles, or equivalent experience leading cross-disciplinary technical programs
* Comfortable being the only PM in a highly technical room — you know when to drive a decision, when to defer to engineers, and how to build credibility without being the most technical person there
* Enough depth in data infrastructure and analytics to earn credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts, and to know when a technical answer is a good one
* Working fluency with the current LLM/foundation-model landscape and whe

jobs.title: Manager, Product Telemetry Lead
jobs.desc:
**About the role:**

LSEG Analytics has been trusted for over 30 years by portfolio managers, risk teams and quantitative analysts. These clients want to access analytics where they're already working. This happens in spreadsheets, notebooks, BI dashboards, automated workflows and increasingly in AI assistants and agents.

Every one of those interactions is evidence: what customers actually use, how often, through which surface, and whether it worked. Today that evidence is uneven, which means the teams who build, sell and support our analytics have an incomplete picture of how customers experience them. This role owns closing that gap.

You will lead telemetry strategy across our analytics platform, owning what gets captured at the point of use, what it means, how it is surfaced, and working with the central telemetry team to ensure that the reporting is meaningful and consistent with D&A standards. That spans instrumentation standards, product adoption analytics, the usage evidence that supports commercial decisions, and the reporting our product, commercial and client service teams rely on.

This is a horizontal role. Telemetry cuts across every analytics vertical and every delivery channel, which means broad exposure to the LSEG estate and to the teams behind it.

This is a hands-on role. You will run your own discovery, own your roadmap, work directly with engineering to deliver, and stay accountable for the success of what you ship.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for analytics product telemetry, from instrumentation at the gateway through to the reporting and visualization built on top of it
* Collaborate with product teams to define what gets captured and what it means: the event schema, the identity and entitlement dimensions, and the rules that make usage comparable and actionable across products surfaces
* Partner with the cloud data platform teams who own storage and pipeline, translating product requirements into what the platform needs to capture and retain
* Inform the consumption layer: dashboards, usage reporting and the visualizations that make customer behaviour legible to the teams who act on it
* Turn usage data into an account of the customer experience — where workflows succeed, where they stall, and which surfaces customers are actually choosing
* Run discovery with your internal consumers across product, commercial, client service and engineering, and treat them as customers of what you build
* Hold the line on data quality and consistency, and be the person who can say what a number means and where it came from
* Act as the subject matter expert on usage data for commercial, client service and internal stakeholders
* Track how consumption patterns are changing, particularly agentic and AI-assisted usage, and make sure measurement keeps pace with them
  

**Background Experience/Skills:**

* Product management experience, or an equivalent background owning a platform, data or API product for internal or external consumers
* Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, event data and data structures, and able to hold a credible conversation with engineers. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to read it and be competent with SQL
* A feel for how data gets presented: you can tell the difference between a dashboard people open once and one they use to make decisions
* Data-driven in practice, not just in principle: you define what success looks like before you build, instrument for it, and change course when the evidence says to
* Judgment about measurement itself: you know the difference between a metric that is easy to collect and one that is worth acting on
* Working familiarity with AI tooling and how agentic consumption differs from human consumption
* Experience in financial data and analytics
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization
* Degree or equivalent in: Bachelors Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering/Operations Research

Description:

At CSpring, we believe in the power of data to drive decisions and real-world impact. We’re a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in data strategy, data engineering, and data analytics. Our clients span the public and private sectors, and our work helps them solve complex problems, gain insights, and achieve measurable results.

We're seeking talented professionals who are collaborative, curious, and committed to making a difference that thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy. Whether you're passionate about transforming public programs, enabling executive decision-making, or modernizing legacy systems, you'll find meaningful work and purpose here.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Purposeful Projects** – Improve systems that serve real people by delivering smarter data, streamlined processes, and strategic insight.
* **People-First Culture** – We’re as committed to your growth as we are to delivering high-impact solutions. You’ll find support, autonomy, and community here.
* **Strategic, Hands-On Work** – From data architecture and documentation to client workshops and solution delivery, you’ll influence every step of the process.
* **Collaborative Trust** – Our clients rely on us to listen carefully, deliver consistently, and guide wisely. We partner with integrity, curiosity, and heart.

**What You'll Do**

You'll work with clients to turn their enterprise data vision into a defined, sequenced, and communicated plan of record:

* Own product definition for the data portfolio — reporting and analytics, privacy-by-design, segmentation, predictive models, and the platform capabilities underneath them.

* Write the product vision documents, acceptance criteria, and release notes that let engineers build without guessing and let stakeholders know what they are getting.
* Define what success looks like for every product, instrument it, and report on it — usage, adoption by department, time to insight, model performance in production, and the business result it was built to move.
