* Working fluency with AI tooling in daily practice.

Zlayt AI is a litigation automation platform built exclusively for personal injury law. From demand letters and deposition summaries to discovery responses and case analysis, Zlayt equips law firms with intelligent tools that draft faster, think strategically, and deliver results without friction, setup, or compromise.

We're an early-stage, product-led company building the category-defining product for legal AI in a large, underserved niche. This is a rare opportunity to shape what the product becomes — working directly with the founding team, real PI lawyers, and real case data.

**The Role**

Zlayt AI is hiring a Product Manager to own the product from problem to shipped feature. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering to decide what we build, why, and in what order — then make sure it ships and actually works for the lawyers and legal assistants who use it every day.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. There is no product org to step into. You'll be writing the first specs, running the first structured discovery, and setting up how product decisions get made.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the product roadmap: talk to PI lawyers and staff, find the highest-value workflow problems, and turn them into a prioritized plan
* Write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guesswork
* Work hands-on with AI: define how features should behave, test outputs against real legal work product, and set the quality bar for what "good enough to ship" means
* Run discovery and feedback loops with early customers, including Zinda Law Group as the first major client
* Define and track the metrics that show whether a feature is working (adoption, time saved, output quality, retention)
* Operate with significant ambiguity in an early-stage environment, making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting quickly

  

**Who You Are**

* **A builder, not an inheritor:** You've shipped a 0-to-1 software product or major feature as the accountable PM — you know what it takes to build something from nothing, not just run an existing roadmap
* **Technical enough to be dangerous:** You've worked directly with engineers day to day, can read a technical design, and don't need a translator to discuss APIs, data models, or model behavior
* **AI-native:** You've shipped or worked hands-on with LLM or AI-powered features, and you use AI tools yourself to do your own work faster
* **Workflow-obsessed:** You've built software for a demanding professional user — legal, healthcare, finance, or similar — where the details of the workflow decide whether the product gets used
* **Startup-tested:** You've worked in small, fast-moving companies where you had to build process yourself, not step into one that already existed
* **Self-directed:** Your track record shows work you personally drove — not just team results you were adjacent to

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Description:

The Product Manager drives growth for assigned product lines by identifying new markets, defining new products, and building strategic partnerships. The role owns the full product lifecycle, from market opportunity through launch, enhancement, cost reduction, and end of life, with primary emphasis on expanding Pearson's reach in packaging automation.

* **Find and pursue growth opportunities.** Identify new target markets, industry verticals, and applications through ongoing competitive analysis, market segmentation, and assessment of market size, share, and growth, along with evaluation of Pearson's current portfolio and positioning. Build the business case for new products, partnerships, and market entries.
* **Define what gets built.** Gather voice-of-customer input through customer visits, sales and service feedback, and industry events. Translate it into clear product requirements, including performance targets, target cost, target price point, and compliance and safety needs, that engineering uses to design new machines and enhancements.
* **Lead development through influence.** Initiate and prioritize new product and service development projects in partnership with engineering and project engineering. Track milestones and work with operations and design teams so products launch on schedule and meet customer, performance, and margin objectives.
* **Own go-to-market and commercial success.** Plan and execute product launches across all four elements of the marketing mix:
  + **Product:** Finalize launch configurations, standard options, and aftermarket offerings (parts, upgrades, retrofits) so the offering matches target customer and application needs.
  + **Price:** Set list pricing, option pricing, and discount guidelines based on value to the customer, competitive positioning, and margin targets. Monitor price realization after launch and adjust as needed.
  + **Place:** Define the channel strategy across direct sales, distributors, and integrator partners, including target territories and verticals. Equip each channel with the training and tools it needs to sell and support the product.
  + **Promotion:** Develop positioning and messaging, and partner with marketing on launch campaigns, demos, case studies, and sales collateral. Serve as the go-to product expert for customers, sales, and internal teams.
* **Manage product line business performance.** Develop and maintain product line business plans covering revenue, margin, and forecasting for new and existing products. Drive cost reductions, manage ongoing enhancements, and lead end-of-life transitions.

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a technically related field, or equivalent experience
* Minimum of five years of product management experience or a comparable background
* Proven ability to set strategic direction and manage the entire product life cycle effectively
* Effective and creative problem-solving skills with a focus on collaboration and innovation
* Demonstrated ability to provide sound judgment and the ability to lead and organize cross-functional meetings, committees and people in a professional manner.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and presentation skills.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.desc:
**Description**

**About the Company**

Ria Money Transfer is a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT). We make it fast, reliable, and affordable for people to send money abroad. Ria has become one of the largest players in traditional remittances, and now we're focused on making online money transfers simple and accessible to everyone.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Ria's omnichannel product portfolio — the programs and tools that bring our massive brick-and-mortar customer base into digital channels. Ria built its business on physical agents and storefronts, and this role owns the strategy and products that move those customers online: the Agent Referral Program, in-store self-service tools, and the agent POS experience. It's a role central to Ria's long-term omnichannel strategy, with scope and seniority that grow as the program scales globally.

You'll own a multi-program, multi-market portfolio end-to-end, partnering across engineering, design, compliance, regional and commercial teams, and our global agent network. This is a consumer-facing PM role with real scale and real stakes — you're on the hook for digital adoption from a customer base placing millions of transactions, and for expanding proven programs across Ria's footprint. If you like solving practical problems that touch millions of people sending money home — and you want to own the bridge between physical and digital, not just a single app — we'd love to talk.

**What You'll Do**

Own the Portfolio

* Own the roadmap and delivery for Ria's omnichannel portfolio: the Agent Referral Program, the brick-and-mortar self-service tool, and the in-store agent POS experience.
* Scale and improve the Agent Referral Program, expanding it beyond current markets (US, AU, CA, UK, MY) to all Ria markets.
* Roll out the B&M self-service tool — transfer status, modify, cancel, receipts, and compliance document upload — from US/AU to all markets.
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from directly.

Drive Digital Migration

* Define and drive new initiatives to migrate brick-and-mortar customers to digital channels (app and web).
* Improve the omnichannel experience in the agent POS used in stores.
* Use product data and customer insight to prioritize the adoption and migration problems actually worth solving.

Ship & Scale

* Lead a cross-functional squad through delivery — managing trade-offs, clearing blockers, and keeping momentum.
* Own outcomes, not just output: define success metrics — digital adoption from the B&M base, program performance, market expansion — and tie your work directly to them.
* Build for scale, expanding proven programs across Ria's global footprint with a repeatable playbook for each new market rather than a one-off lift each time.

Align Stakeholders

* Partner with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Regional and Commercial teams, the Agent Network & Operations, and Analytics to ship programs that meet local requirements.
* Bring compliance and regional teams in early so market launches meet local rules and customer needs.

GaggleAMP helps companies turn employees into active advocates on social media. Mission

Own product at GaggleAMP so that every feature we ship makes our customers' jobs genuinely easier and proves measurable value to their organizations, applying phase-one discipline and customer evidence to every decision.

**Phase-one scoping discipline.** Ship the smallest meaningful version first and let customer feedback drive what comes next. Comfortable cutting scope. Can defend "no" with reasoning.

**Strategic and tactical balance.** Real product work is a mix of new capability, optimizations, and usability-affecting infrastructure, not just new feature delivery. Resist the bias toward shipping new things at the expense of improving what exists.

**Overview**

MARTAC is seeking a Product Manager to own a hardware-software OEM module product line. This module enables platform and mission autonomy by integrating sensors with compute, networking, and circuit-level hardware into a productized package that third parties can adopt. This role requires genuine engineering design skill in circuit integration, compute selection, and networking architecture, not only program coordination, since the Product Manager will directly manage and integrate the components that make sensor integration possible. Beyond engineering design, this role owns the product's full lifecycle and market position, working closely with business development as MARTAC brings the product to customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the engineering design and integration of the product's core components: circuit integration, compute selection, and networking architecture.
* Manage the integration of sensors into the module to enable platform autonomy (navigation, collision avoidance) and mission autonomy (sensor-driven behaviors).
* Define and maintain the product's design specifications, ensuring the module meets performance, size, weight, power, and manufacturability requirements.
* Own the product lifecycle, from concept and design through production, fielded support, and next-generation iteration.
* Own the product's market position, working with business development to shape pricing, positioning, and customer-facing roadmap as MARTAC pursues customers for the product.
* Partner with the Chief Systems Engineer on design reviews, ensuring design decisions meet engineering standards and receive appropriate technical sign-off.
* Coordinate with third-party OEM partners and internal platform teams to define integration requirements and interface specifications for product adoption.
* Support proposal efforts, customer technical interchange meetings, and program reviews as the product lead.
* Maintain configuration control and design documentation for the product line.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on engineering design experience in circuit integration, embedded compute, and networking architecture.
* Demonstrated experience integrating sensors into a hardware platform or module, ideally in support of autonomy or robotics applications.
* Experience taking a hardware or hardware-software product through productization, from design to a market-ready product.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across engineering, business development, and customer-facing stakeholders.
* Comfort owning both the technical design and the business and lifecycle side of a product.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with unmanned or autonomous systems, sensor fusion, or defense OEM hardware products.
* Experience supporting defense customers and contract deliverables.
* Familiarity with platform autonomy and mission autonomy concepts as applied to unmanned maritime systems.
* Prior experience operating within a matrixed engineering organization supporting multiple concurrent product lines.

**Location**

This position is based on-site, either at MARTAC's Melbourne, Florida headquarters or at MARTAC's San Diego, California West Coast Innovation Hub.

About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About the role

We’re looking a Product Manager to own product work for our data marketplace. You’ll make it easier for data vendors to bring high-quality RL environments and training data to HUD, and for research teams to discover, evaluate, and use them. You’ll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn technical and operational needs into product decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the marketplace product lifecycle, from understanding vendor and buyer needs through prioritization, launch, and iteration

  • Improve how vendors onboard, submit work, understand quality feedback, and manage their offerings on HUD

  • Improve how research teams discover, assess, and access environments and training data that meet their needs

  • Work with engineering, research, GTM, and operations to turn complex requirements and manual processes into reliable platform workflows

  • Define and track measures of marketplace health, product adoption, and user experience; use feedback and product data to decide what to build next

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Experience owning a live software product from discovery through launch and iteration

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify technically complex workflows for users

  • Experience talking directly with users, identifying the problem behind a request, and turning what you learn into clear priorities

  • Ability to balance user needs, business impact, and engineering constraints when making product decisions

  • Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative signals to assess whether a product change worked

  • Clear written communication and the ability to bring engineers and other partners together around decisions in an ambiguous environment

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with marketplaces or products serving two distinct groups of users

  • Familiarity with AI training data, evaluations, and RL environments

  • Experience building a product function or establishing product practices on a growing team

  • Early-stage startup experience and strong communication skills for collaboration across teams and time zones

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

Team & company details

At Midrex, you will do work that matters alongside people who believe you matter. The work won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. You’ll be part of a great team— with plenty of autonomy—to bring out your best. And you’ll be well compensated and have a best-in-class benefits package. Take a look:

* Competitive benefits effective from Day 1

* Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) matching (up to 6%)

* Profit sharing with 401(k) kicker

* Generous overtime for qualified positions

* 4 weeks of paid vacation

* Tuition reimbursement

* Raffles for professional sports tickets

* Half-day Fridays

* Flexible home/office work practices

* Paid time to volunteer

* Employee recognition awards

Since 1987, Midrex has been the world leader in direct reduction technology, offering the best proven method for decarbonization in the iron and steel industry available today. Our rapid growth is transforming the steel industry and our planet. And none of it would be possible without our people, who bring vision, compassion, and extraordinary expertise to this work every day. So, if you’re looking to do big work in a small-team environment, Midrex is just the place for you.

Midrex is accelerating its digital initiative focused on software-defined industrial solutions. We are seeking a highly skilled Product Management Leader who will be responsible for maximizing the value of Midrex’s external digital products by translating business strategy, engineering requirements, and customer needs into prioritized, deliverable capabilities.

This role carries dual accountability. As tower leader, you set product direction across the portfolio, allocate product manager capacity against priorities, establish the standards and cadences the team works to, and develop product managers As a product leader, you own the what and why of your assigned products and ensure development teams build the highest-value capabilities first.

The Product Management tower is the connective tissue between plant-floor operational reality, customer value, and software delivery. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of Midrex’s digital product portfolio: defining what gets built, why it matters, and how success is measured. You and your team will work with information technology professionals, process technology experts, field operations, and commercial teams, and directly with Midrex customers, to validate that what we build actually solves their problems.

Midrex’s competitive advantage increasingly depends on software-enabled plant optimization and digital lifecycle services. The Product Management Leader ensures our digital solutions evolve from project-based deliverables to scalable, revenue-generating platforms and that the product management capability behind them matures at the same pace.

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead the Product Management tower and directly manage product managers
* Set portfolio direction, priorities, expectations, and product manager capacity
* Coach, onboard, mentor, and develop product managers across the tower
* Own the Midrex Product Management Framework and ensure consistent practices

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Improvado**
-------------------

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

**What we sell:** extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

**Who buys it:**

* *Economic buyers:* CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
* *Technical evaluators:* VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
* *Segments:* enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
* *Verticals:* pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

**Why this role, now**
----------------------

* **Our messaging is not aligned.** Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
* **The category is crowded and moving fast.** Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
* **Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost** — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
* **Analyst firms are a silent blocker.** When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Positioning and messaging.** Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
* **Competitive intelligence and win/loss.** A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
* **Sales enablement.** The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
* **Market and analyst relations.** The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
* Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
* B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
* Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards

Portside is a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for the global aviation industry. Our platform powers critical operations across business aviation, regional airlines, and aircraft leasing & finance, helping over 1,000 aviation organizations streamline operations, improve decision-making, and operate more efficiently.  
  
Backed by leading technology investors Vista Equity Partners and Insight Partners, Portside is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our platform, investing in AI driven innovation, and building a global team focused on shaping the future of aviation technology.

**Job Summary**

Portside is hiring a Product Manager to work on Horizon, our cloud-based flight management platform built for flight departments, fractional ownership programs, and jet card operators of every size and level of complexity. Horizon serves as the operational core for these organizations, unifying aircraft scheduling, crew management, compliance tracking, and financial operations into a single connected system, supported by advanced analytics and a growing suite of integrations.  
  
In this role, you'll help build and deliver features that support real flight operations, in an industry that is rapidly modernizing, including a growing use of AI.  
  
The ideal candidate takes ownership of problems until they're genuinely resolved, not just flagged, and is curious by nature — verifying assumptions and raising concerns before small issues compound. You're genuinely invested in customer outcomes, not just closing out a feature ticket, and you're collaborative, low-ego, and thrive as part of a team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver on a segment of the Horizon product roadmap, translating outcomes and priorities set by product leadership into shipped features and improvements
* Collaborate day-to-day with a small, cross-functional team with engineers and others, and with the broader product team, to make and execute product decisions
* Maintain regular, direct conversations with customers to inform requirements and validate ideas before committing engineering time
* Synthesize customer input, support themes, and usage data into clear priorities
* Own specific projects and initiatives end to end, with oversight from product leadership
* Own releases for your area, including release notes, briefing Sales, Customer Success and /Support ahead of customers-facing changes, and measuring adoption against a target
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders across departments, framing product work in terms of business impact — revenue, retention, cost, risk — rather than features alone
* Incorporate AI tools into your day-to-day work, including prototyping, PRD writing, and accelerating routine tasks

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager at a SaaS company, or a degree or certification in product management
* Comfortable working directly with customers and internal teams, such as Sales and Implementation, to understand needs and manage expectations
* Fluent in working with engineers, able to translate requirements and priorities clearly to drive toward the best product outcome
* Able to prioritize decisively and defend those decisions with data
* Comfortable incorporating AI tools into daily work, including drafting PRDs
* A genuine interest in the technical and operational side of aviation — you'll need to learn the regulations and understand how flight departments operate

* Familiarity with MCPs or other AI tooling would be a plus
* Basic data analytics literacy, such as SQL, would be a plus

* Competitive base salary
* Fully remote work
* Generous time off policy
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Dynamic, collaborative, and fast-growing work environment.

jobs.desc:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

We are looking for an experienced **Lead Technical Product Manager** to help define the strategy for our global Commerce Platform.

The Commerce Platform provides foundational capabilities that power Levi's digital commerce experiences across channels and markets. These capabilities span areas including product and inventory, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, identity, search, analytics, observability, and the services and integrations that connect our broader commerce ecosystem.

We are undergoing a significant transformation, evolving from a legacy monolithic commerce platform to a modern architecture built on domain-driven services, APIs, event-driven integration, and reusable platform capabilities.

As the Lead Technical Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for key Commerce Platform capabilities, partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business stakeholders to turn customer and commercial needs into scalable technical solutions.

Beyond gathering and prioritizing requirements, you will help shape the platform's future. This includes identifying opportunities for reusable platform capabilities, addressing architectural and process constraints, prioritizing investments that unlock long-term value, and balancing short-term needs against long-term scalability and complexity.

You will bring product judgment, technical fluency, and curiosity. You are comfortable operating in a changing landscape, digging into complex systems and business processes, challenging assumptions, and bringing structure and direction to problems that cross technical boundaries.

**About the Job**

**Technical Product Roadmap**

* Build and evolve the product strategy for defined capabilities within the Commerce Platform.
* Translate customer, business, and commercial needs into scalable technical products and platform capabilities.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape platform strategy, identifying opportunities to unlock value through new technologies and architectural capabilities while proactively addressing technical constraints, tradeoffs, and long-term risks.
* Balance near-term needs with foundational platform investments, technical health, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
* Build toward reusable, configurable platform capabilities rather than market-, channel-, or use-case-specific implementations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the platform, reduce duplication, and establish clearer product and domain boundaries.
* Define clear product outcomes and success measures and use them to guide roadmap decisions.

**Product Discovery, Definition & Execution**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for the platform capabilities you own, from discovery and strategy through implementation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with teams to understand the underlying problem, desired outcome, and value rather than simply translating requests into features.
* Work with engineers and architects to translate product strategy into clear technical requirements and executable work.
* Manage the product backlog, including epics, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and sequencing.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.desc:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

jobs.desc:
We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

jobs.desc:
**About Alpaca Health**
-----------------------

Alpaca Health enables clinicians to become entrepreneurs, starting in autism care.

We help clinicians launch and scale their own clinics by providing AI-powered software, payer contracting, and full back-office infrastructure. Our goal is simple: shift power in healthcare away from large consolidated entities and back to clinicians.

We are growing quickly (30% MoM) and expanding into new states this year. The problems we are solving are operationally complex, high-stakes, and deeply meaningful for families.

We've raised over $14M in funding from early-stage investors like Core Innovation Capital, Adverb Ventures, and South Park Commons, and are building for long-term category leadership.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the buildout of several critical internal functions. You’ll lead the planning, implementation and rollout of internal tools and automations used by the Alpaca team to better service clinicians.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Get to the bottom of hard problems.** You’re going to be thrown into complex and ambiguous problems, clearly define the problems to be solved, and identify the 80/20 drivers and pursue them relentlessly.
* **Rethink how the work gets done.** You’ll have a chance to look at workflows with fresh eyes and design novel, industry first, high leverage solutions that work at scale. You’ll have a high degree of autonomy to select the best automation, integrations, product changes, and AI solutions.
* **Design how work flows.** You’ll map complex processes across people, systems, and outside partners, and design better ones that will stand the test of scale (as we grow 10x YoY).
* **Build it yourself.** Prototype and ship tools, automations, and workflows using code, AI-native tools, and design. You won't need to wait on engineering to prove an idea works.
* **Own the outcome.** You’ll work closely with our Head of Operations & Strategy to define success, then own the metrics and outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **[REQUIRED]** 4 - 8 years of Product Management experience, preferably having previously owned a function at a venture backed mid-stage startup (Series B - D)
* **[REQUIRED]** Hands-on technical ability: comfortable writing code (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or similar), building with AI tools, and working with APIs and data
* **[REQUIRED]** Experience designing or rebuilding end-to-end processes in a regulated or operationally complex environment, such as healthcare, fintech, or logistics
* A track record of world class problem solving. You’ve been able to solve problems that 99% of people were not able to with meaningful outcomes
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas in a clear and concise way. Ability to tailor your message based on the audience you’re speaking to (i.e. clinicians, internal stakeholders, our investors).
* Ownership Mindset: Self starter that can identify the highest leveraged problems to solve, and someone who has a relentless drive to solve them.
* AI Native. You have a clear understanding of the current model strengths and weaknesses and know when best to solve a problem. You function at AI speed, completing high quality work in days that previously would have taken weeks or months.

**Why Join**
------------

* The opportunity to materially impact the health outcomes of the most vulnerable populations
* Join one of the fastest growing healthcare startups in the world (between 30% - 50% monthly growth)
* Join a team of rockstar performers who are taking a new tech first approach to building a scalable digital health platform
* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity
* Health benefits
* Flexible PTO
* Dinner when working late

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
As a Product Marketing Manager at VTS, you'll shape how the commercial real estate industry understands our platform and products.

You'll split your time between owning go-to-market for our property management product and driving platform-level work that makes the entire GTM organization sharper, including competitive intelligence, customer insights, demos, and persona and segment strategy. You'll be a constant collaborator with product, sales, customer success, and design, bringing market and customer insight to influence what we build, and creating the stories and tools that resonate with customers.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You'll help build and define the processes that product marketing runs on as VTS grows.

**\*\* Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office 4 days a week. \*\***  
  
**What You'll Do**

* **Own launches end to end.** Partner with Product from early roadmap conversations through release. Run launch meetings, decide what's release-ready, maintain the calendar, and keep the momentum going with Growth once things go live.
* **Develop positioning and messaging.** Create clear, differentiated messaging across products, personas, and segments that reflects current market and competitive intelligence.
* **Enable the go-to-market team.** Build sales artifacts, presentations, demos, and deliver training that help sales and customer success sell and drive adoption.
* **Lead competitive and customer intelligence.** Monitor the commercial real estate technology and AI landscape, and programmatically mine sources like Gong calls and customer conversations for insights that shape positioning and product strategy.
* **Develop customer-facing content.** Create collateral, case studies, and customer stories with Content and Design that bring our value to life.
* **Define personas and segmentation.** Sharpen our understanding of who we sell to and what matters to them, and help teams across the company apply it.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally.** Work closely with product, sales, customer success, design, and growth so that we execute cohesively.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of hands-on B2B product marketing experience, with a track record of successful launches, sales enablement, and product adoption
* Expertise in positioning and messaging, and in turning them into sales and customer-facing assets
* High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You build the first version quickly, test it, make tradeoffs, and iterate quickly.
* Strong operational instincts. You think in systems and repeatable frameworks, and you build structure where none exists.
* Ability to influence at every level, with confidence presenting to executives, sales teams, and customers
* Ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives
* Experience developing customer content programs, such as case studies, testimonials, and advocacy
* AI-native working style. You use AI tools every day for research, analysis, drafting, and operations, and you have a point of view on doing it well.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with product-led growth motions
* Brand development experience
* Strong design instincts and taste. You aren't a designer but you can speak their language and know what good looks like
* Background in commercial real estate, proptech, or vertical SaaS

  

**What VTS Values & How We Show It**

At Designer Brands, we are the proud parent company of DSW Designer Shoe Warehouse, The Shoe Company, and Rubino, operating nearly 675 stores across North America and a billion-dollar digital commerce business. We lead the footwear industry with a diverse portfolio of iconic brands, including Topo Athletic, Keds, Vince Camuto, Kelly & Katie, Jessica Simpson, Lucky Brand, Mix No. 6, Crown Vintage, and others. **Location: Remote**

**Department:** Digital  
**Reports To:** Senior Digital Product Manager

**The Opportunity**

At Designer Brands, we're passionate about creating digital experiences that make it easier, more inspiring, and more enjoyable for customers to engage with DSW. As a Digital Product Manager, you'll play a key role in shaping those experiences by turning ideas into impactful solutions that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.

* Partner with cross functional teams to explore and lead targeted POCs/pilots for emerging technologies

* Experience owning digital products, platforms, or customer facing experiences

jobs.desc:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

Veeva is seeking a Product Manager, who will be responsible for defining, designing, and delivering critical features used by Regulatory professionals at many of the world’s largest Life Sciences companies.

We’re looking for someone with experience in enterprise software product management and a passion for solving challenging problems with simple, elegant solutions to work with our team of Life Sciences industry and technology A-players. Your work will directly impact how quickly Veeva’s customers can get new and updated therapies to market amidst a complex landscape of global regulations.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design innovative product features to help our customers plan, track, and manage changes that impact the products they are approved to market and trial around the globe
* Author high quality design specifications within an agile methodology
* Prioritize feature development based on strategic initiatives, customer requirements and internal technical needs
* Interact with customers, professional services, strategy, and sales to understand business needs
* Interact with engineering and QA teams to drive high quality product feature implementation
* Be the product evangelist - become a subject matter expect for internal stakeholders and external customers

### **Requirements**

* 3+ years in a product management role
* 3+ years of experience with enterprise software products
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment with little direct supervision
* Strong communication skills: written, verbal, and formal presentation
* Technical skills to translate business requirements into terms that developers can understand
* Working knowledge of relational databases and web technologies
* Must be based in the Eastern Time zone or at least 1 hour offset

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience building SaaS products
* Experience building products on application development platforms
* Experience with regulatory information management for BioPharma and/or MedTech
* Experience with regulated software
* Experience with XML/DTD/XSD based specifications
* Experience with developing AI solutions at scale
* Experience interacting with customers and internal teams remotely and across geographies

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

* Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
* Flexible PTO and company p

jobs.title: Product Manager, Documentation Systems
jobs.desc:
**About Versapay \uD83D\uDE80**

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.

By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

**How you’ll make an impact here – and on your career:**

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Product Manager, Documentation Systems, you will own our documentation as a product: the in-product Help our customers rely on, the implementation and support knowledge our internal teams run on, and the systems that produce both.

This is a build role. Our AI tooling can draft a help article. It cannot tell us whether that article is true, decide whether it should exist, or get an engineer to explain what shipped. You will own the pipeline that produces our documentation, the standards it runs on, and the judgment calls it cannot make.

You will sit on the Product Management team as a peer to the product managers who own our platform and our embedded ERP applications. You will have modern LLM tooling, fully sanctioned and connected to our internal systems, and a mandate to build on it.

### **What you'll do:**

**Own the Documentation Surface**

* Own our full documentation surface: in-product Help, implementation guides, support runbooks, and release notes, across our platform and our embedded applications.
* Decide what gets documented, what gets rewritten, and what gets retired.
* Build an information architecture prioritized by what customers search for and get stuck on, rather than by what shipped most recently.
* Define and own the metrics: documentation shipped with the release, page freshness, Help searches returning no results, and support volume on topics we believed were covered.

**Build the Documentation Pipeline**

* Design and build an AI-assisted pipeline that drafts documentation from our real sources of truth:  
  tickets, pull requests, release artifacts, and recorded demos.
* Build the evaluation process that catches the pipeline producing convincing but incorrect content before a customer does.
* Automate change detection, terminology and style enforcement, screenshot capture, and publishing.
* Own the toolchain. We author in MadCap Flare today and publish into a repo that our product loads. You will decide what to keep, what to automate around, and what to change.

**Improve How We Capture Product Knowledge**

* Our tickets today describe what we set out to build, not what we shipped, so documenting a feature currently means reverse engineering it. Change that.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to establish a definition of done that captures how a feature works: navigation, permissions, configuration, error states, and impact on existing users.
* Build the terminology and style standards that let both people and models write consistently across four ERP surfaces where the same concept carries four different names.

**Keep Documentation True**

* ERPs change their interfaces on their own schedule, and our documentation goes stale when they do. Design the detection and revalidation process and own the SLA on it.
* Learn our products by using them, working out how they behave rather than reading specifications describing how they were intended to.
* Write the small share of content that requires a person: migration guides, error taxonomies, and integration behaviour, where being wrong costs a customer their month-end close.

### **What you'll bring to the team:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ y

jobs.desc:
**Summary:**  
The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners, IT partners, and delivery/engineering teams to build and execute a strategy in alignment with business priorities. Ownership of the product roadmap and a quality backlog will ensure teams deliver the highest-value outcomes with clear priorities and well-defined work. The Product Owner is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with a variety of partners to facilitate discussions, identify dependencies or areas of efficiency, and ensure successful execution of features.

In addition, the Product Owner will build and document requirements in the form of initiatives, epics, features and user stories, communicate daily with the delivery/engineering team, run team meetings and ceremonies, and accept or reject work results.

The Product Owner is an excellent communicator who excels when coordinating efforts, setting expectations, and driving results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Planning
* Define and maintain the product vision, goals, and roadmap in alignment with high-value outcomes.
* Partner with stakeholders to define outcomes, success metrics, and sequencing.

**Backlog ownership**

* Own and refine the product backlog: initiatives/epics/features/stories, prioritization, and readiness, ensuring business direction leads to prioritized, well-shaped work.
* Work with IT teams to manage and prioritize technical debt, ensuring proper allocation of time between maintenance and feature work.
* Define and enforce standards (e.g., Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, clear acceptance criteria, intake process, backlog hygiene).

**Discovery & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Drive discovery to surface and clarify problems while presenting high-value solutions.
* Facilitate tradeoff decisions by presenting clear options (scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks).
* Manage and report on critical metrics.

**Delivery Partnership:**

* Partner with IT partners and delivery/engineering teams to plan and manage flow.
* Support a balance of Scrum practices (e.g., sprint goals/planning).

* Experience as a Product Owner (or equivalent) owning prioritization and backlog quality for enterprise platforms. Customer portal experience is preferred.
* Strong skills in backlog creation (epics/stories), acceptance criteria, and prioritization methods.
* Proven ability to run discovery and align stakeholders around outcomes and tradeoffs.
* Experience working with Kanban teams, scrum teams, agile ceremonies, etc. Experience with Jira is preferred.
* Strong facilitation and communication skills, including operating effectively with a variety of stakeholders and technical/data teams.
* Experience coordinating efforts across business units and technical teams.
* Knowledge of program, project and change management practices.

**ABOUT LINXUP, LLC**

If you are looking for “the right opportunity” with a fast-growing company, with great people, doing great work, look no further. Linxup offers products and solutions that help thousands of field service fleets solve real business problems. If you’re looking for an opportunity to help make a difference for small businesses, you’re in the right place. Linxup helps businesses get more out of the vehicles, equipment, tools, and workers in the field through its robust, easy to use tracking and dash cam solutions. Linxup delivers class-leading reliability, flexibility, and live, US-based onboarding, support, and coaching to ensure customers get the most out of their investment. That’s why more than 30,000 businesses trust Linxup to help them improve the safety, security, productivity, and efficiency of every vehicle, asset, tool, and worker in the field. Founded in 2004 and based in St. Louis, MO, Linxup serves customers in a wide range of industries, including field service, construction, trucking, transportation, and other enterprises that rely on mobile workers and equipment to get the job done.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

This is the product role for someone who likes the layer where software meets hardware.

You’ll own the parts of Linxup that customers rarely see but depend on completely: our public API and the partner

integrations built on it, the pipeline that ingests telemetry from a quarter-million devices in the field, and the OTA

firmware and device management tooling we use to configure, update, and troubleshoot that hardware at scale.

You’ll also own initiatives in our core web and mobile products, so you stay close to the end customer and the day-to-

day experience — this is not a pure infrastructure role, and the mix is part of what makes it interesting.

Your engineering team is technical, and so are many of your customers: partner developers reading your API docs,

integration engineers at ERP and dispatch vendors, and internal teams who need visibility into a fleet of devices. Your

job is to understand what they actually need, decide what gets built and in what order, and write requirements

precise enough that engineers don’t have to guess.

You don’t need to write production code. You do need to be the kind of product owner who reads the API response,

runs the query, and looks at the device logs before forming an opinion.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**APIs & Partner Integrations:**

* Own the roadmap for our public API and the partner ecosystem built on it — requirements definition, endpoint and payload design, authentication, rate limits, versioning, and deprecation
* Work directly with partner developers and integration engineers to scope, launch, and unblock integrations
* Treat developer experience as a product surface: clear documentation, predictable payloads, useful error messages, sandbox access, and sensible defaults

**Device Data & Telemetry:**

* Own product requirements for ingesting data from GPS trackers, dash cams, and asset and equipment trackers deployed in the field
* Partner with engineering on how device data is normalized, enriched, stored, and exposed — both to customers and to downstream features and reports
* Work through the real-world messiness of field hardware: intermittent cellular coverage, buffered and out-of- order messages, power and duty-cycle tradeoffs, and data that is missing or ambiguous
* Define the reporting, alerting, and rules behaviors that customers rely on that data to drive
* Help build the operational visibility the business needs into device state, connectivity, and firmware versions across an installed base of 250,000+ devices

**Core Product & Agile Execution:**

* Own initiatives in our core web and mobile products alongside the platform work — the features customers touch every day
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, own and prioritize the backlog, and run refinement and sprint ceremonies with your e

jobs.desc:
Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc., provides payment technology and education services to more than 1,200 higher education institutions, nearly 12,000 K-12 schools, and millions of individual students, families, and supporters across the globe. Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.

**Job Profile Summary**

The Product Owner coordinates product development, release planning, and manages the overall successful delivery of new and existing products. This position supports the reporting and analytics products within a student information system — including embedded Power BI reports, district and school dashboards, and self-service report-building tools used by K-12 administrators and educators. The Product Owner works closely with school and district users to understand the questions they need answered and translates those needs into data-driven product solutions.

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Works very closely with agile development teams to create use cases, requirements, and estimates in support of company objectives.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Manager  
  
Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW**  
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.  
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. *Judgment is still the job.*  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product strategy:** Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
* **Customer and market understanding:** Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
* **Discovery and user research:** Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
* **Requirements and definition:** Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
* **Prioritization:** Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
* **Agile delivery:** Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
* **Data-driven decision making:** Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
* **Go-to-market partnership:** Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
* **Communication:** Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
* **Problem solving:** Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features

**Ways of Working We Value**  
The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.

* **Prototyping:** Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.
* **User experience design:** Strong instincts for information architecture, user flows, and interaction design. You can give a designer specific, useful feedback rather than adjectives.
* **Practical AI fluency:** You use AI tools in your own work: synthesizing research and feedback, drafting and pressure testing documents, exploring data, and generating edge cases. You know where these tools help and where they add risk or noise.
* **Building with AI tools (vibe coding):** Willingness to use AI assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, or v0 to stand up a prototype yourself. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be curious

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

  • Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

  • Shipping fast: Why not now? We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

  • Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

  • Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

  • Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.desc:
We're hiring one product person, posted at two levels: Founding Product Manager and Head of Product. Apply to the one that fits you best.

 

About Klarify

Backed by Y Combinator, with $1.7M in funding, Klarify helps more than 13,000 therapists every day with their notes and their practice.

Therapists train for years to help people, then spend their evenings writing notes, marketing their practice and chasing insurance. Klarify does that work for them, so they can spend their time on clients. Therapists write to tell us it gave them time back with their families.

Moody (CEO) started Klarify after therapy changed his life, and after his own therapist asked to use the note-taker he was building.

 

The product and vision

Today, therapists use Klarify to:

  • Turn a session into a draft clinical note

  • Ask Klara, our AI assistant, questions about their sessions, or have it draft a letter or treatment plan

  • See a visual map of the themes across a client's sessions

  • Get found by new clients through profiles and blog posts built for Google and ChatGPT

Notes were the start. We're building one place that runs the whole business side of a therapy practice: notes, marketing, billing, insurance and admin. We want to automate everything a therapist does except the therapy itself.

 

The role

You'd join Moody (CEO), Bergie (CTO) and Zach (founding engineer) as one of our first hires. You'll own product and work directly with the CEO, with a focus on adoption and expansion: helping every therapist get more value from Klarify. Therapists have full caseloads and little time to learn new software, so the best version of every feature is the simplest one.

  • Own the roadmap and each feature end to end. Decide what we build next using customer research and product data, and make sure it works before it ships.

  • Lead customer discovery. Talk to therapists every week and learn from the hundreds of customer calls we've had.

  • Own support, the fastest way to learn our customers. Fix the cause, not just the ticket.

  • Drive adoption. Your first project is helping more therapists discover and use the parts of Klarify they aren't using yet, starting with Klara.

  • Build privacy in from the first sketch, working with the CTO, who owns security and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, PIPEDA, PHIPA and Quebec's Law 25).

  • Ship code. Build prototypes, internal tools and real features with Claude Code, and open pull requests that our engineers review. Design with AI tools and our design system.

  • Set success metrics for what we launch, run experiments and follow up until you know what worked.

  • Pitch in on whatever a small company needs, from a vendor contract to a conference booth.

For your first few months you'll make most product decisions together with the CEO. You'll own more as you get to know our customers.

 

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of product management experience at modern early-stage startups, or as part of a founding team

  • You're AI native. You use AI tools every day and have built something real with them.

  • You have an eye for UX and can make complicated things feel simple

  • You ship code. You've opened pull requests that made it to production, with Claude Code or a similar tool. This is a must.

  • You've changed a roadmap because of what customers told you

  • You're authorized to work in the US or Canada. We can't sponsor a visa right now.

  • Strongly preferred: you're in San Francisco and can work hybrid

  • Nice to have: you've worked in healthcare, mental health or another regulated industry

**Company Information**  
Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience.  
  
**Job Description**  
Clinical Ink is seeking a ***Product Owner*** to join our Product Management team based remotely across the United States! The Product Owner manages the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product stream, translating business and stakeholder needs into prioritized requirements and actionable user stories. This role drives delivery by setting sprint and release goals, coordinating dependencies, removing roadblocks, and tracking performance against key objectives. The Product Owner partners with development teams and internal and external stakeholders to communicate progress, incorporate feedback, and support successful releases through documentation and training. This role's responsibilities include:

* Create and manage product roadmap for given product stream
* Drive execution against roadmap by setting sprint and release goals, tracking KPIs, and removing team roadblocks
* Manage all aspects of the backlog from use case drafting, requirement/user story creation and prioritization, to grooming, and acceptance
* Effectively manage cross team dependencies with fellow product team members
* Schedule and conduct agile meetings (daily scrums, grooming, and planning) with Solutions Development team members to ensure successful execution against requirements and feature deliverables
* Regularly communicate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure transparency about deliverables and gain feedback as input to feature definition and development
* Contribute to release notes, product documentation, and training of cross functional team members for release readiness
* Advocate for Agile software development practices amongst your team.
* Regularly present to and communicate with senior leadership about team progress

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 3+ years’ experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, with a strong emphasis on specification/ requirement writing
* Proficiency writing user stories and functional specifications for software applications
* Understanding of basic software design concepts and user interface controls
* Basic understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodology
* Previous experience using Confluence, JIRA, and/or similar tools required
* Strong interpersonal communication skills; ability to write in a clear and concise style
* Proficiency with basic computer skills, including spreadsheets and word processing
* Proactive attitude, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills; strong time management and organizational skills required

**Additional Information**  
Clinical Ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status.

**About Valitana**  
  
Valitana is a rapidly growing FinTech company delivering cutting-edge SaaS solutions to institutional investors. Founded in 2017, our platform provides advanced financial analytics, trade flow insights, and portfolio management tools that empower our clients to make faster and more informed decisions while improving operational efficiency.  
  
Valitana was awarded the 2026 Deal Catalyst CLO Award for Best CLO & Technology Provider – Innovation and serves approximately 100 institutional clients including CLO investors, CLO managers, hedge funds, asset managers, insurance companies, family offices, and broker dealers.  
  
**Position Overview**  
  
Valitana is seeking a Product Manager to join our Analytics product team in Plano, TX. In this role, you will help define and deliver the analytics capabilities our institutional clients rely on to evaluate structured credit markets, trade flow, and portfolio performance. You will translate client and market needs into clear product specifications, partner closely with engineering to bring features to production, and serve as a resource on how our users work with fixed income and loan data. This is an excellent opportunity for a product professional with a foundation in financial markets who wants to grow within a fast-moving FinTech environment.  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Write clear, detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for new analytics features and enhancements.
* Gather and synthesize requirements from clients, client services, and internal stakeholders to identify product opportunities.
* Partner with engineering and data teams throughout the development lifecycle, from scoping and design through QA and release.
* Maintain and prioritize the product backlog in alignment with the product roadmap and business objectives.
* Validate the accuracy of analytics outputs and underlying market data, working with data teams to investigate and resolve issues.
* Support client-facing activities including product demos, feedback sessions, and release communications.
* Monitor product usage and client feedback to measure impact and inform future iterations.
* Stay current on developments in the fixed income, loan, and structured credit markets that shape client needs.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 3+ years of professional work experience in a role related to Math, Engineering, Finance, or Financial Operations. Client-facing experience is required.
* Demonstrated experience writing product specifications, business requirements documents, or user stories.
* Familiarity with fixed income and credit products, including bonds and loans.
* Ability to comprehend complex financial concepts of structured finance products.
* Proficiency in Excel, including advanced functions and data analysis.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Detail oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Resourceful with the ability to work independently as well as a team.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited school.

  
**What We Offer**  
  
Base salary range for this role is $100,000 – $135,000. Valitana offers a competitive compensation package including base salary and an annual performance bonus. Employees receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer-matched retirement plan, healthcare with medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, and PTO.  
  
Employees in this role will work in the office Monday through Wednesday with the flexibility to work remotely Thursday and Friday.
