jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Overview:

The Product Manager plays a strategic and executional role within the business, responsible for leading product development, strategy, and performance within an assigned business unit. This role ensures the successful launch and ongoing management of a product or product line by aligning business needs with customer expectations. They drive product ideation, execution, and stakeholder alignment while balancing customer needs with business objectives.

The Product Manager in this role will be responsible for managing clinical and claims data across products to enable risk adjustment and quality software and service programs. The ideal candidate has worked with or in health plans with exposure to data types commonly seen in health plan operations.

The Product Manager must lead cross-functional collaboration, influence key business decisions without direct authority, and ensure team consensus to bring products to market and manage their lifecycle effectively. Strong leadership, communication, analytical skills, and strategic thinking are essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities:

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap.
* Deliver product market requirements documents with prioritized features and corresponding justifications.
* Work with AI tools to create product requirements and prototypes.
* Be an expert with respect to the competition.
* Collaborate across teams within the company.
* Develop the core positioning and messaging for the product.
* Engage in requirements and feedback gathering with customers.
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop sales tools.
* Propose an overall budget to ensure success.
* Briefly train the sales force at quarterly sales meetings.
* Act as a leader within the company.
* Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
* Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
* Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, or other field demonstrating technical expertise or equivalent work experience.
* 2+ years of relevant professional experience.
* 2+ years of experience with health plan data types, including claims, clinical chart, and eligibility data.
* Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret client business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements.
* Demonstrated success defining and launching web based services and products.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group, executives, managers, and subject matter experts.
* Technical background, with experience in software development.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, Database interaction capabilities.
* Medicare Advantage or other healthcare experience preferred.

**Cognitive / Mental Requirements:**

* Ability to work independently as well as collaborate as a team with a sense of urgency.
* Be value-driven, understand that success is based on the impact of your work rather than its complexity or the level of effort.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work within a matrixed organization.
* Proficiency in all required skills and competencies above.
* Communicating with others and teamwork.
* Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned

Join Allstate Technology Solutions as a Digital Product Manager building AI-powered insurance experiences. * **AI Innovation:** Identify and apply AI (including GenAI and agentic tech), rapidly experimenting to responsibly scale ideas into production

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of hands‑on product management experience with a strong execution track record

* Proficiency in Agile product development
* Comfort operating in ambiguity

Analytics, Business Case Analyses, Prioritization, Product Design, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Management, Product Roadmap, Product Roadmapping, Systems Thinking

Compensation offered for this role is 110,000.00 - 181,025.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

jobs.desc:
**ABOUT SOTHEBY'S**

Established in 1744, Sotheby's promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby's and Concierge. Sotheby's Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby's new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

**ROLE**

This role will own, define and drive the product roadmap for critical internal workflows within our proprietary tools by working with stakeholders, designers, and the engineering team. We are looking for a candidate who is eager to learn, a motivated team player, and who likes to streamline workflows and increase efficiencies with new technology. The ideal candidate is someone who is excited to dive deep into complex business logic, and can emerge on the other side with elegant solutions optimized for our company and staff.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build and maintain a roadmap aligned with end-user needs that feed into your manager's roadmap and communicate delivery and impact to company goals to stakeholders.
* Work in a cross functional product team with design, engineering, QA, along with other product teams to map out requirements and incrementally deliver clear solutions to complex business problems.
* Lead the prioritization of work and manage requests by examining costs and benefits while maintaining positive and candid relationships with stakeholders.
* Engage in user research and interviews, use data to drive decisions and prioritize work.
* Collaborate with business partners to drive adoption of new tools and product features
* Have strong and clear working relationships with business sponsors, stakeholders, and users of their product. Understand their needs, but can use data to prioritize requests and be persuasive in delivering the right user outcomes.

**IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES**

Product Execution

* Experience building software solutions for complex business workflows, or deep understanding of auction house property inbound processes.
* Writes clear specifications for features, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and any gathering related documentation or support (comparables, wireframes, flowcharts, etc).
* Identify when and how to collaborate with design to better define the problem being solved and include design in the ideation and solution process.
* Work with larger teams involving technology and business functions, make recommendations that deliver maximum value to the end user as quickly as possible.
* Ensure that all parties involved have a shared understanding of the problem domain and proposed solution.

Product Strategy

* Understand the overall strategic direction of your pillar and the company. Seek to make a meaningful contribution to that strategy via your product work.
* Clearly articulate the goals in your projects that build towards a broader team goal.
* Craft a near-term product roadmap that aligns with the broader Product Management team and company goals.

User & Market Insights

* Proactively gather feedback from stakeholders or team members at relevant phases of the work.
* Distill user feedback in order to make recommendations for future product enhancements.
* Understand the art auction market and its dynamics.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $80,000-$90,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package

Claims Concierge is the property damage claims partner for personal injury law firms. We handle the end-to-end property damage claim so PI attorneys can focus on the bodily injury side while their clients get a better experience.

A property damage claim touches a lot of people: the law firm, the claimant, the carrier, the body shop, the dealership, the rental company. We're building a company around being a genuine partner to every one of them. Each party should come away from a Claims Concierge file thinking that was the easiest part of the process. That isn't a customer service goal bolted onto the operation. It is the company, and it shapes who we hire, what we build, and how we measure ourselves.

You'll be our first product hire. Until now, product has lived with our founder and CEO, who spent his career as a product leader before starting Claims Concierge. You'll take that work over directly, learn how he thinks about it, and make it your own.

Your product is the property damage claim itself, and everyone who touches it: the case managers and appraisers working files inside our system, the claimants waiting to hear about their car, the partner law firms who need to know what's happening without having to ask, and the carriers, body shops, dealerships, and rental companies on the other end of every call. jobs.desc:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50 US jurisdictions and 100+ countries. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

* 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies
* 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies
* Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Spark, Index, and Khosla Ventures.

Every month, Anrok files more tax returns than ever before, and the next month beats it. Behind each return is a company counting on us to file it correctly, on time, and get the money to the right government. Nobody else is set up to do this at our scale.

As the **File & Remit Product Manager**, you'll own the last mile of tax compliance: from preparing a return until the money reaches the tax authority. Everything else Anrok does builds up to this. You'll be solving two problems that shape the company:

**File every return in the world.** Our filing volume keeps setting records. The systems that got us here won't carry us through the next 10x. You'll define the filing platform that can file every return for every company in every jurisdiction. It should run itself, with automation that monitors and repairs its own problems and humans involved only for edge cases.

**Open Anrok to the world.** Today, a company based outside the US has to open a US bank account before it can remit through Anrok. For great international companies, that's often the last thing standing between them and Anrok. You'll build the remittance infrastructure that lets them pay from their local bank account in top international markets.

Our vision: tax filing is handled like magic, and sellers never have to think about it.

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

* Build a filing platform that scales to every return in the world, with most filings fully automated and zero human touches
* Put AI at the center of filing, with agents that write filing automations, catch problems before a filing period opens, and repair them automatically
* Unlock international sellers by making remittance work from their local bank accounts, in local currency
* Own money movement end to end, from collecting seller funds to landing payments at thousands of tax authorities across currencies, banking partners, and jurisdictions
* Build tools for our in-house TaxOps team, your power users, so they can do more jurisdictions with less effort
* Make the returns experience that sellers trust completely: every filing on time and accurate
* Drive the metrics that matter: cost per filing, 100% on-time filings, and fewer amendments
* Identify the next frontier, including whether Anrok's filing engine becomes a standalone platform of its own

* Systems thinking: you design for 100x, not just for next month

* High standards in places where a mistake costs a customer money
* A GM mindset with strong product and business instincts
* Clear, concise communication, verbal and written

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager II, GTM Strategy
Product Owner - General Analytics Use Case Delivery
Product Manager, Detection Pipeline
jobs.desc:
You live at the intersection of security and product management, and there's no place you'd rather be. You understand that the detection pipeline isn't just plumbing. It's the connective tissue that turns raw security data into signal, and if ingestion, normalization, or correlation break down, everything downstream suffers. You're not intimidated by the scale and complexity of data flowing through a modern security platform. Quite the opposite: you pride yourself on knowing how data moves from source to detection, where the pipeline breaks, and what it takes to make it fast, reliable, and cost effective.

You’ve got an informed opinion about what an MDR should detect, an opinion that comes from customer empathy, hands-on industry knowledge, and a set of experiences that didn’t always go as planned. You can hold a technical conversation with a SOC analyst and turn around and explain the same thing to a Sales team in plain English. You've been waiting for a role where that combination of skills actually matters.

Still reading? Great. This role isn't for all PMs. Yes, all the standard PM things apply: plan, prioritize, communicate, and own a roadmap, build relationships, and become the authority on how internal teams and customers use your platform. But in this role, you'll bring your security experience to bear on one of the most foundational parts of Expel's platform. If you get your energy from untangling how security data flows through a platform at scale and turning that into a roadmap that makes customers safer, you'll thrive here.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you clear ownership of a product area with measurable impact on customer value and business outcomes.
  • Surround you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and operators who are genuinely invested in building something great.
  • Offer a foundation to build on: the detection pipeline is critical to Expel's platform, and there's meaningful work ahead.

What you can do for Expel

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Expel's detection pipeline (normalization, correlation, and automated detections and suppressions), from defining the six month vision to driving execution with Engineering and UX.
  • Establish relationships with internal teams (SOC, Detection Engineering, Engineering) and customers, and use their input, alongside market and competitive signals, to build and prioritize a roadmap that maximizes impact.
  • Be the voice of your roadmap: clearly articulating value to Detection Engineering, SOC, Sales, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to effectively communicate the value of the detection pipeline internally and externally.

What you should bring with you

  • A curious, customer-obsessed mindset — you're comfortable asking "why" until you get to the real problem.
  • 2–4 years of experience in product management or a directly relevant role, with experience in the security industry strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with product management and software engineering processes, from requirements definition through to launch.
  • Familiarity with security tools — EDR, SIEM, and firewall products — and how they fit into a customer's security stack.
  • Broad knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and where security risks emerge in those environments.
  • Experience with SIEM technologies is highly desired — bonus points if you've navigated integration or data pipeline challenges firsthand.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write a crisp user story and present to a customer in the same afternoon.
  • The ability to build trust across Engineering, Security Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and UX.

Additional notes

This role is remote within the United States.

We're seeking an experienced **IT** **Product Owner** to partner with business stakeholders and Agile Scrum teams to shape insurance technology solutions that support underwriting, claims, policy administration, billing, and agency operations across Wisconsin.

**At Rural Mutual Insurance,** we are dedicated to fostering a supportive and collaborative work environment. We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, a matching 401(k), and generous time off. Our commitment to career growth is unwavering, and we take pride in our A+ AM Best financial strength rating and recognition as a Madison Magazine Best Place to Work.

**This position offers remote or hybrid flexibility for Wisconsin-based employees with periodic on-site presence required based on business needs.** Candidates must reside and work in Wisconsin and be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

$95,000 - $115,000 yearly

* Define and communicate Product Goals and partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into user stories, features, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize work based on business value, customer impact, regulatory requirements, risk, and dependencies.

* Collaborate with business and technology partners to support modernization initiatives and the long-term evolution of insurance systems and platforms.
* Monitor product performance and business outcomes, using data and metrics to inform future priorities and continuous improvement.

* 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, or related technology delivery role.

Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters.

**Location:** Remote

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.

**Nice to Have**

**About Overwatch Imaging**  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, Overwatch Imaging builds AI-enabled Smart Sensors and Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software for time-critical airborne imagery intelligence.  
Wildfire is our core market. The U.S. Forest Service, CAL FIRE and agencies from France to Australia fly our sensors to map fires overnight and deliver intel to incident command by morning.

  

**About the Role**  
The Product Owner – Fire & Mapping reports to the Lead Product Owner and leads a dedicated, cross-functional Fire & Mapping product team. Expanding the civil market is the main focus, achieved through product development for wildfire, commercial services and inspection and product sustainment for existing customers. You will partner closely with the Fire & Mapping Product Director: the Director sets product vision and market strategy, and you turn it into the backlog and delivery. The role has two goals:  

* **Drive growth through the product.** Define and deliver the new features based on market and current customer need, expanding the product along new market verticals, such as tactical fire response, etc.
* **Make the product work for existing customers.** Support current fire customers from a technical and functional perspective, so our products perform reliably in their missions.

**Focus Areas**  

* Fire mapping and intelligence (our core)
* Tactical fire response and initial attack
* Commercial infrastructure inspection
* Broader mapping: disaster response, damage assessment and other wide-area mapping missions
* Manned and unmanned aviation platforms

**What You'll Do**  

* Be the technical and functional product contact for existing fire customers, and work issues through with engineering and support.
* Turn customer feedback and the Director's strategy into new features, including for tactical fire response.
* Write epics, user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA.
* Own a prioritized backlog that balances fixes, customer needs and new features.
* Run sprint ceremonies and keep delivery on track.
* Plan releases in sync with the fire season and support release notes, training and documentation.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing & Collections
jobs.desc:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*

jobs.title: Product Manager, Buyer Cloud, Freewheel
jobs.desc:
FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.  
**Job Summary**

FreeWheel is looking for a Product Manager to support and help deliver a market-informed roadmap and strategy for a wide array of buy-side capabilities, with a focus on our core ad serving application capabilities. You'll immerse yourself in the Connected TV (CTV) market to help make us the best platform in the world to buy CTV advertising. Working alongside colleagues throughout Comcast Advertising and FreeWheel, you'll help deliver innovative products that help customers better deliver their ads to the right audiences worldwide.

**Job Description**

This role will work on the Buyer Cloud (fka Beeswax) buying platform within the FreeWheel product suite. Buyer Cloud's driving vision is to be the best platform in the world for buying CTV advertising. Buyer Cloud is an easy-to-use, massively scaled, high-availability and highly flexible platform used by buyers worldwide. We offer our customers the most extensible and transparent advertising platform in the world and process millions of transactions per second.

We are looking for a Product Manager to support the development and delivery of a market-informed roadmap and strategy for a wide array of buy-side capabilities. You'll immerse yourself in the Connected TV market to help make us the best platform in the world to buy CTV advertising.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support the conception, design, and implementation of capabilities that offer our customers unique opportunities to buy CTV advertising, with a particular emphasis on ad serving, filtering, targeting, and so on. You’ll be working on the most core and important parts of a Demand Side Platform (DSP) ad delivery.

* Collaborate closely with our engineering team to guide products to launch and beyond

* Work with stakeholders, internal and external, to help drive high-quality decisions and outcomes

* Help showcase product launches in release trainings, client emails, and company webinars

**Who You Are:**

* 2+ years of product management experience, ideally on the buy-side of advertising products

* Familiarity with, and interest in, building and scaling a DSP

* Some exposure to Connected TV and television advertising, or real time bidding platforms, is a plus

* Strong ability to understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Who we are**
--------------

**We are Payactiv, a Fintech company in the heart of Silicon Valley, devoted to giving workers access to their earned wages when they need them. Payactiv is the pioneer and industry leader in Earned Wage Access. We are the only Certified B Corporation and Public Benefit Corporation in our industry. Our app provides millions with financial services that help them avoid debt, manage their finances, and regain flexibility to pay for things on their own schedule.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The Mission**
---------------

American workers are not OK. A few not-so-fun facts:

* More than half of the workers in the US live paycheck-to-paycheck
* 40% of Americans would not be able to come up with $400 in an emergency
* There are more payday loan stores in the US—some charging interest rates upwards of 600%—than there are McDonalds restaurants

But there's hope. For workers on a tight budget, timing is everything. Getting paid promptly for hours worked instead of waiting for twice-monthly paychecks to arrive can mean the difference between building up an emergency fund or spiraling deeper into debt.

That's where Payactiv comes in. Payactiv is a Certified B Corp that pioneered Earned Wage Access (EWA) in 2012. EWA allows workers to access the money they've earned in-between pay cycles (when their bills are actually due), helping them avoid late fees, overdraft fees, and the need for costly payday loans.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

Payactiv is looking for a Product Manager who wants to build fintech products that make a real difference in people’s lives. You’ll work from our Milpitas, CA office, tackling complex problems at the intersection of technology, financial services, and the everyday needs of workers and employers.

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you are a strategic product leader, a strong customer advocate, and someone who knows how to bring people together to get things done.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Represent the voice of the customer through user research, product data, and direct feedback
* Lead products from early ideas through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Bring design, engineering, compliance, and go-to-market teams together to deliver seamless and impactful solutions
* Translate user needs into product requirements and keep teams aligned around what matters
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Information Security to find the right balance between regulatory requirements and user experience
* Explore emerging fintech trends, AI/ML-driven personalization, and other technologies that can make our products better
* Define success, track the right KPIs, and use what you learn to improve performance, engagement, and adoption

**What you need**
-----------------

* 2+ years of product management experience in fintech, payments, lending, or financial services
* Care deeply about building user-centered financial wellness products
* Use data to make better decisions—but know when judgment and customer insight matter too
* Know how to keep Agile, cross-functional product teams moving forward
* Look for the win-win by balancing user goals and business goals
* Communicate clearly, manage stakeholders well, and influence at every level
* Are comfortable going deep with engineering teams on APIs, integrations, data flows, and mobile products
* Understand fintech products, compliance, and the U.S. regulatory landscape
* Are curious about emerging fintech technologies, including stablecoin and AI

**ABOUT ORGANOX:**

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

OrganOx has an exciting career opportunity for a Product Manager, Upstream at our American headquarters in Madison, NJ. In this role you will oversee full lifecycle management for our existing product portfolio with primary focus on early-stage innovation, strategic planning, and foundational requirements for our next-generation, connected medical device portfolio. You will act as the ultimate voice of the customer, bridging the gap between clinical needs and technical development. * Lead strategic portfolio prioritization exercises, balancing disruptive innovation with incremental product line extensions.
* Monitor changing healthcare regulations, policies governing organ donation and use, global macroeconomic healthcare trends, clinical literature, reimbursement shifts, and competitive intelligence to pivot strategy proactively.

Cross-Functional Pipeline Leadership

* Represent the “commercial voice” in cross-functional core teams consisting of senior leaders from R&D, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Engineering, and Operations.

# Product Manager, Care Operations Platform

Location:USCompany:Caret Health

## Description:

About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

The role

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

What you'll own

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there’s never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We’re looking for a **Product Marketing Lead** to join our team on the US West Coast on a fully remote basis. **What you’ll be doing**

You’ll own Shorthand’s story: who it’s for and how we talk about it. You’ll shape our positioning with the CEO and VP of Growth & Marketing, give Sales the narratives and proof to close deals, lead our launches, and write copy that has a point of view. We’re looking for someone who believes a product should stand out, and who’s experienced in crafting a distinctive narrative that cuts through.

You’ll be our sole product marketer, joining a small, fast-paced Growth & Marketing team that already covers content, demand gen, community, and design. This is a senior but hands-on role, with real influence over how Shorthand is seen, sold, and built.

Anyone can sign up and start building stories in Shorthand. Most of our business comes to us inbound, and our sales team works each deal from first conversation to signed contract. Your job is to make sure every step tells the same clear, compelling story.

You’ll report to the VP of Growth & Marketing and partner with the CEO, Head of Sales, and Product team. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Within Mack Trucks and Volvo Trucks North America Digital Management function you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals, we learn and improve continuously and embrace change to stay ahead.

You work in the intersection between business, technology, and user experience. You understand the end user, customer, and business needs, utilizing user journeys and design thinking to secure the digital product brings continuous value. You optimize the product to achieve the business goals while maximizing return on investment.

You collaborate with other parts of the organization, both in different business functions and the Community of DTO. We have an environment where ideas, thoughts and opinions can be shared. We are team players with clear common ambitions, and we win together.

This is how you could make an impact  
As the Digital Product Manager, People & Culture, you will be key in aligning with the business strategy and evolve the product including vision, strategy, goals, roadmap, and budget through the lifetime of the digital initiative. These will be some selected responsibilities:  
  

* Own and evolve the digital product portfolio supporting People & Culture and Legal processes.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Legal stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements into prioritized product capabilities.
* Lead vendor and platform roadmap discussions, assess product fit and technical health, and manage upgrades, releases, service performance, and application rationalization across the People & Culture and Legal landscape.
* Drive adoption through stakeholder communications, process readiness, training, and change management tailored to employees, people leaders, People & Culture professionals, Legal teams, and other authorized users.
* Define digital product vision, strategy, goals, and roadmaps.
* Regularly collect feedback on implemented work through measures, analytics, and end user input.
* Ensure the entire user experience is designed with the user at the center and secure the product brings continuous value.
* Identify dependencies, including on stable teams and individual contributors.
* Drive planning cycle for product, including roadmap, resource needs and budget required.
* Ensure digital products fulfill all legal, compliance and security demands.
* Secure release and roll-out plan, including change management and training approach.
* Cultivate strong collaboration and teamwork.
* Represent Group Trucks NA in relevant global forums and projects.

**Who are you?**
----------------

We believe you want to take your career to the next level, working with amazing people around the world. To be successful in this position we believe you have a university degree or equivalent, and experience from leading functionally, preferably within IT management.

Furthermore, we believe this role requires experience from working towards digital product orientation and agile ways of working as well as knowledge of information technology trends.  
  
You will need understanding of the cost drivers in systems delivery and operations and the business consequences of the technical decisions made and good familiarity with the disciplines of enterprise digital development and technical architecture.

In addition to this, you are a passionate believer in lifelong learning. You should feel energized by working both independently and interdependently, have proven skills in cross-functional collaboration and thrive in managing, foster, and enable both the perform and the transform angles of the job.

**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  

We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

**Enterprise Technology** plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

**In this position...**

As the Product Manager for Lifecycle Communications & Automation, you will own the day-to-day delivery, reliability, and optimization of CRM journeys that keep customers informed and engaged throughout their relationship with Ford.

Your portfolio will include triggered communications, vehicle order status communications for customers and dealership stakeholders, and eCommerce-triggered journeys. These communications span channels such as email, in-app messaging, and SMS. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, manage communication rules and triggers, and coordinate delivery across business, marketing, data, analytics, and engineering teams.

Reporting to the Sr. Product Manager of Journey Enablement & Decisioning, you will also provide operational backup for AI-powered journey activations. Your ownership of ongoing delivery, performance optimization, and scalable quality-control practices will enable the Sr. Product Manager to focus on strategic decisioning capabilities and more complex personalization initiatives.

This is a hands-on product management role for someone who combines strong CRM Journey design knowledge (preferably in Salesforce Marketing Cloud), disciplined execution, analytical thinking, and curiosity about practical applications of AI. Success means delivering reliable communications, learning what improves journey outcomes, and scaling capabilities without a corresponding increase in manual effort.

  

Based in Dearborn, MI, this is a hybrid position with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week.Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.

**What you'll do...**

**1. Own Lifecycle Communications and Journey Delivery**

* Manage the day-to-day delivery and continuous improvement of subscription transactional communications, vehicle order status communications, and eCommerce-triggered journeys.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing new requirements, enhancements, defects, and operational improvements.
* Translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Coordinate delivery across business stakeholders, marketing operations, data teams, and engineering.
* Communicate delivery progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.

* Define and maintain rules governing communication eligibility, triggering events, timing, exclusions, and journey entry and exit.
* Partner with subscription product teams to assess how bundled offerings affect existing communications and coordinate the necessary updates.
* Ensure vehicle order status communications reflect relevant vehicle-build milestones and order updates for their intended recipients.
* Manage eCommerce-triggered communications based on customer actions and business requirements.
* Identify cross-journey dependencies and help prevent duplicate, conflicting, outdated, or incorrectly timed messages.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”**

**WHO ARE WE?**

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based in San Antonio, TX, but we're truly a remote, telecommuting company.

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

The Product Owner is responsible for translating prioritized product initiatives and epics into well-defined functional and technical requirements that enable efficient and predictable delivery by engineering teams. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and Quality, the Product Owner ensures that product initiatives are decomposed into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation that allow development teams to execute effectively.

This role serves as the operational bridge between product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner owns backlog quality and delivery readiness for their assigned product domain or engineering team, ensuring that stories entering development are well understood, actionable, and aligned with product objectives. The Product Owner plays a key role in maintaining backlog health, supporting agile delivery practices, and enabling consistent, high-quality product releases.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?**

* Translate prioritized product initiatives and epics into detailed functional and technical requirements, including user stories and acceptance criteria
* Maintain and manage the product backlog for assigned product areas or engineering teams, ensuring items are clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for development
* Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure product strategy and roadmap initiatives are accurately reflected in backlog priorities and delivery plans
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Design, and Quality teams to clarify requirements, answer questions, and support effective implementation of product functionality
* Lead or facilitate backlog refinement sessions to ensure stories meet established Definition of Ready standards before sprint planning
* Ensure functional and technical documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with delivered product functionality
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to support effective agile delivery practices
* Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined, and solutions meet expected functionality and quality standards
* Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, or ambiguities that could impact delivery timelines or solution quality
* Support continuous improvement of delivery processes, documentation practices, and backlog management standards within the Product Delivery organization
* 25% of your time may include travel for client visits, conferences, and networking

**WHAT DO YOU NEED?**

* 2–5 years of experience in a product, business analysis, delivery, or technical role within a SaaS or technology environment
* Experience working with agile development teams and familiarity with Scrum or similar iterative delivery frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to translate business or product requirements into clear functional specifications or user stories
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition
* Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, and Design
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Order Management and Renewals Systems
jobs.desc:
Every month, hundreds of thousands of orders and renewals flow through Book of the Month's in-house software systems, and we are seeking a Technical Product Manager to own two of the most mission-critical pieces of software at the business: our Order Management System and our Renewal Management System. These mission critical systems are purpose built by our in-house product and engineering teams to support our subscription service and deliver the best new books to our members every month.. This is an ideal role for a technical PM who is equally obsessed with how systems work and how customers experience them.

**What you'll do...**

*Order Management*

* Own our Order Management System (OMS), which manages the entire lifecycle of an order from the moment a member clicks Ship to the moment it is delivered to our members.
* Be responsible for measuring and optimizing our shipping SLAs, and managing the roadmap that gets us there over time.
* Work and coordinate with key stakeholders to ensure that all updates are scoped well and releases are coordinated with associated updates to SOPs.

*Renewals*

* Own the product management of our Renewal Management System, which stages and processes payments for members of our subscription service.
* Measure and improve involuntary churn through systemic improvements, such as coordinating schedules, evaluating new recurring billing products, and assessing different payment processors.
* Develop a roadmap with our finance and engineering teams to prioritize projects and monitoring systems to track renewals and disbursements.

*Monitoring & Reporting*

* Conceptualize and spec detailed reports that allow you to monitor these systems at a granular level, down to every individual member and order.
* Operate on the instinct that if you cannot measure it, you do not know it is happening correctly.

**About you...**

* 5+ years of experience in a product management role, ideally in transactional product management processing large volumes of orders. E-commerce or subscription experience is required; both is ideal.
* Bachelor's degree, likely in a technical discipline.
* Strong technical skills and deep experience working with engineers to spec technical systems.
* Excellent at communicating technical information to different audiences.
* A rare combination of technical depth and customer obsession: these systems directly shape how members experience our product, and you need a real sense for the customer experience you want, plus the ability to translate it into something engineering can build.
* Exceptionally high attention to detail. In a renewal system, five errors is a huge number of errors, and you care about getting it right down to the individual human.

Salary Range: $100,000 - $165,000

jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

Southfield, MI (Hybrid) · Full-time · Reports to VP of Product

**Who We Are**

We believe in small businesses and the people who grow them. At Credibly, we combine data science, technology, partner relationships, and customer support to give business owners fast access to right-sized capital — from working capital loans and merchant cash advances to lines of credit.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, with offices in New York and Arizona, Credibly has provided access to more than $3 billion in capital to over 65,000 small businesses nationwide.

**The Opportunity**

The Product Manager will drive product planning and execution across Credibly's lending platform: the experiences our merchants and broker partners use to apply and get funded, the internal tools our sales, underwriting, funding, and servicing teams rely on every day, and the data and integrations that connect it all.

You will connect customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility; decide what to build and why; and lead cross-functional teams through discovery, delivery, and launch. You will use data to measure what works, and you will look for practical ways that automation and AI can make our products faster, smarter, and easier to use.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Own outcomes.** Define the goals and KPIs for your product areas (conversion, time-to-fund, operational efficiency, partner and merchant satisfaction) and use them to guide priorities and measure success.
* **Lead the product lifecycle.** Take initiatives from ideation and discovery through requirements, design, testing, launch, and iteration.
* **Understand our users.** Spend time with merchants, ISO and broker partners, and internal teams to understand their workflows and pain points, and turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* **Own the integration and data-vendor portfolio.** Evaluate third-party data, verification, and banking-data providers on hit rate, lift, latency, reliability, and cost; build the business case for adding, replacing, or renegotiating; and manage integrations with funding and capital markets partners.
* **Write clear requirements.** Document vision and scope through use cases, PRDs, epics, and user stories that give agile scrum teams what they need to build the right thing.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Core Models
jobs.desc:
**Who You Are**

You are a highly analytical professional that operates at the interface of Product Management and Data Science.. You understand that a model's value depends only on how well it solves a real customer problem. You can translate a use case into a clear prediction target, define what constitutes a true positive, and reason through the tradeoffs between missed risk and unnecessary alerts. You are comfortable discussing precision, recall, and ROC analysis with data scientists, and explaining what those metrics mean to customers.

You are drawn to the intersection of product strategy and applied machine learning. You know how to turn customer needs into model requirements, evaluate whether an improvement matters in practice, and prioritize new capabilities alongside improvements to existing models. You are rigorous and analytical, but you move with urgency and make practical decisions with imperfect information.

You are collaborative by nature and have achieved success as a team player. You thrive by setting ambitious goals and tracking progress until they are met. You feel strongly about being mission-driven in your work, and above all else you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things.

**Who We Are**

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world's biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind's Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.

Our customers need to understand the intelligence they rely on: what our models assess, how their performance is measured, and where their limitations lie. The Core Models product area connects the development of our models to those customer needs and the workflows they support.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family-friendly work-life balance.

**What A Great Candidate Looks Like:**

* BS or MS in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field, or bring equivalent practical experience.

**About Nearmap**

Property intelligence is reshaping how the world understands the built environment, and Nearmap is driving that. We put powerful aerial imagery, AI-driven analytics, and geospatial tools into the hands of the people who plan, build, insure, and govern the places we all live and work. Our technology turns property uncertainty into decisive action, and our culture brings out the best in the people who build it.  
  
We move fast, we care about craft, and we're proud of what we're building. If you're energized by turning hard problems into real-world impact, we'd love to meet you.

**Location:** Fully remote within the continental United States.

Government agencies do work that genuinely matters - assessing property fairly, planning safer communities, responding when disaster hits. Working in close partnership with other senior product leaders, you'll own new solution development and sharpen existing offerings, and you'll team up regularly with sales, engineering, and marketing to make sure every initiative is well-defined and actually lands for customers.

jobs.desc:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

SHift4 is expanding globally and hiring a key Payment Processing Product Manager, Lead – North America owns the product strategy and delivery for the core transaction processing domain in North America, spanning Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management.

  

This role is central to the company's move away from legacy, homegrown processing infrastructure toward a modern, modular processing platform, and requires close, ongoing engagement with the third-party processors and networks the business relies on today as that transition unfolds. Reporting into the Global Payment Delivery leadership, this individual translates architectural direction into a concrete, sequenced product roadmap, working across engineering, operations, finance, and external processing partners to ensure the platform is reliable, compliant, and positioned for eventual platform independence.

**Responsibilitie**s

  

* Own the product roadmap for Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management within the North America processing stack, ensuring alignment with the broader global processing architecture and platform-independence strategy.
* Serve as the primary product point of contact with existing third-party processing and network partners, managing day-to-day requirements, escalations, and roadmap dependencies while planning for eventual consolidation onto the target processing platform.
* Translate high-level architectural direction (e.g., separating switching/auth, clearing, and settlement into modular, replaceable components) into detailed product requirements, phased migration plans, and measurable delivery milestones.
* Partner with Engineering to scope build-vs-buy decisions for processing capabilities not fully covered by external platform partners (e.g., residuals, billing nuances, reconciliation, reporting), and own the resulting internal product backlog.

* Define and track success metrics for processing reliability, settlement accuracy, exception resolution time, and partner performance, and report progress to senior product and executive stakeholders.
* Document and maintain the logical data model and interface contracts between the processing domain and adjacent systems (onboarding/merchant data, gateway, billing), ensuring consistency in naming conventions and identifiers as legacy systems are decomposed.
* Support internal and external certification efforts (e.g., network/scheme certifications) tied to new clearing and settlement capabilities.
* Act as a bridge between regional (North America) needs and the global Payment Architecture function, surfacing local requirements for peer review and ensuring North America is represented in global processing standards.

* Demonstrated ability to translate architectural or technical direction into an executable, sequenced product roadmap.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside Finance, Risk, Operations, and Engineering.

**Location:** This is a remote role where candidates must **currently** reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia.  
  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship  
  
  
  
  
**About Tivly**  
Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.  
  
**About the Role**  
The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. The role aligns priorities across multiple teams into one clear, sequenced plan, sets the standard for what “ready for engineering” means, and makes sure the work being built is the work that matters most. It operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the primary point of accountability for stakeholder alignment across engineering, client services, sales, marketing, and operations, and it drives cross-team decisions to documented outcomes.  
  
**What You'll Do**

**Stakeholder Management & Outcomes**

* Own stakeholder management for the product area: identify key stakeholders, set expectations, manage communication cadence, and be the single point of accountability for alignment. What You'll Do
* Gather priorities from engineering, client services, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership and reconcile them into one shared, sequenced roadmap
* Surface conflicting priorities early, put the tradeoffs in front of the right decision-makers, and drive them to a documented resolution
* Run regular alignment touchpoints (roadmap reviews, priority check-ins, stakeholder updates) so changes in direction are communicated before they become surprises.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and external partners so that every open item has a named owner, a next step, and a follow-up cadence.
* Escalate with a clear recommendation when a decision belongs above the team.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap aligned to company objectives.
* Lead discovery with client services, sales, and business stakeholders to identify the underlying problems behind requests and validate opportunities before committing to work.

**Requirements & Specification**

* Translate business ideas into clear technical requirements — most requests arrive as a business problem, not a deliverable, and it's in this role to determine what's actually needed and who else needs to weigh in.
* Own backlog health so work arrives at planning well-defined, right-sized, and sequenced against the roadmap.
* Write and maintain requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases precise enough that engineering can build without re-litigating scope.
* Partner with engineering on feasibility and technical approach early, and make scope decisions when tradeoffs arise mid-delivery while keeping stakeholders informed of the impact.

**Process & Standards**

* Define and evolve how intake, refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder acceptance work for the team, adjusting as team size, cadence, and product needs change.
* Partner with engineering to maintain accurate documentation and decision records so past decisions remain traceable.
* Identify recurring friction in how work moves between teams and drive fixes rather than workarounds.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, CRM, lead generation, or insurance/fintech.
* Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.
* Track record of owning a product area’s roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**About ENFOS:**

ENFOS is a profitable, 25-year-old enterprise SaaS company serving many of the world’s leading industrial organizations. Our platform helps finance, accounting, operations, and compliance teams manage complex Environmental Obligations through a centralized system of record built for governance, audit readiness, and operational scale.

We operate in the Environmental Obligation Management market, where many enterprises still rely on spreadsheets and fragmented workflows to manage ASC 410 and IAS 37 liabilities. ENFOS is the only enterprise subledger accounting platform purpose-built to address these challenges through integrated financial, scientific, and operational workflows.

Our platform supports the full Environmental Obligation lifecycle, from identification through derecognition, while enabling enterprise-grade financial controls, audit defensibility, and cross-functional collaboration.

As we modernize the platform for the next generation of enterprise workflows, we are investing heavily in product innovation, AI-enabled capabilities, user experience modernization, and scalable enterprise architecture.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Product Owner to help drive the next phase of ENFOS platform evolution. This role will own backlog execution and delivery for a defined product area while partnering closely with Engineering, QA, UX, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality enterprise software.

The ideal candidate combines strong product execution discipline with an AI-first mindset and the ability to translate ambiguous, high-stakes business problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and scalable workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise product management, agile delivery, and AI-enabled software development. You will help shape both how we build software internally and how AI capabilities are incorporated into the ENFOS platform.

Your work will directly impact how finance, accounting, operations, and compliance teams govern Environmental Obligations across global industrial enterprises.

**What You'll Do:**

*1. Own the Product Backlog and Drive Delivery*

Own backlog prioritization and delivery for a defined product area, translating strategy into clear, executable work for Engineering and QA.

* Own and prioritize the backlog to maximize customer value, risk reduction, and business outcomes
* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and Definitions of Done
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, making clear scope and trade-off decisions
* Prioritize using product usage data, customer feedback, support themes, and revenue impact
* Document prioritization rationale and key product decisions

*2. Partner with Engineering, QA, and UX to Ship High-Quality Software*

Product Owners at ENFOS are deeply embedded in the development team. Your job is to remove ambiguity, accelerate decisions, and protect quality so the team can ship complex, audit-grade functionality on a predictable cadence.

* Partner with Engineering on solution design, sequencing, dependencies, and technical trade-offs
* Partner with QA on test strategy, regression risk, edge cases, and release readiness
* Partner with UX to simplify complex workflows and validate designs with customers
* Lead story-level discovery, clarify requirements, and break large initiatives into shippable increments
* Own release readiness, including release notes and internal enablement for Customer Success and Support

*3. Bring an AI-First Mindset to Product and to How We Work*

AI is becoming a core part of both the ENFOS platform and how the product organization operates.

* Help shape AI-native features including assistants, anomaly detection, document intelligence, and intelligent automation
* Define AI acceptance criteria and guardrails, including traceability, evaluation, and human oversight appropriate for audit-grade systems
* Use AI tools daily to accelerate story wr

We are dealer focused and OEM aligned. We are a leading ERP & DMS software and solutions provider to dealers and rental companies of heavy equipment. We specialize in working with the construction, mining, forestry, material handling, and agriculture industries. Today, we have over 800 employees, offices on four continents, and customers in over 20 countries. We are privately held, and our headquarters are in beautiful Cary, NC. VitalEdge Technologies is seeking a self-starting Product Manager to own a portfolio of Layered Apps built in and around its core dealer management system (DMS). jobs.desc:

This position serves as the product owner and directly manages assigned staff, aligning customer and business needs with AI and Rate Intelligence software development activities. **Key Accountabilities**

* Define and maintain the RespondAI and Rate/RatePro product vision, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with company objectives and leadership direction.
* Gather and evaluate customer feedback, business requirements, and product usage insights to identify opportunities, clarify problems, and prioritize enhancements.
* Spend time at customer sites observing current workflows to evaluate how products fit, identify opportunities for new features and products, and reduce adoption friction.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing customer value, technical dependencies, development capacity, model quality, and ongoing maintenance needs.

* Partner with applicable customer-facing teams on release communication, documentation, training, adoption, and resolution of product issues.
* Guide the development and maintenance of machine learning models, natural language processing capabilities, and data extraction pipelines supporting RespondAI.
* Review technical approaches and design documentation with technical leads, ensuring decisions address business requirements, data quality, performance, scalability, and maintainability.

**Education / Experience**

9+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, and/or leadership position focused on software product delivery; or Bachelor’s with 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, and/or leadership position focused on software product delivery, required. Experience owning software product roadmaps, prioritizing backlogs, and translating business needs into product requirements, required. Experience delivering software products within Agile/Scrum frameworks, preferred. Transportation and logistics experience, preferred.
