jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Product Manager**

  

**Job Description:**

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

  

The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible.

  

They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. This is a hybrid role

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify new opportunities and inform product strategy.
* Translate complex customer needs and market insights into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to ensure successful product development and commercialization.
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies, including pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Monitor product performance, gather customer feedback, and iterate on features to drive continuous improvement and customer engagement.
* Effectively communicate product vision, roadmap, and updates to internal and external stakeholders.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to maximize organizational efficiency.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in product management, particularly with analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of product development methodologies and product commercialization processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.
* Demonstrated ability in group problem solving and strategic execution.
* Proficiency in computer literacy, including advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience with marketing and customer engagement strategies.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of effective multitasking.
Strong researching abilities to inform product decisions and market understanding.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing tax, accounting, or other regulated professional-services software, ideally enterprise products serving large firms.
* Hands-on experience building and launching AI/ML-enabled products or features, including working with engineering on responsible AI, data quality, and governance.

## Description:

Salary range: 10,000 - 15,000 USD gross

**About CUBE AI**

CUBE AI is an **Agentic Crime Prevention Platform**, built at the intersection of **agentic AI, cybersecurity, and fraud prevention**. We serve the institutions on the front line of an exploding wave of AI-powered crime: banks, fintechs, and the platforms criminals cannot operate without. Our mission is ambitious: **make the world a safer place**. How we do it is the part we're most excited about, and the part we're happy to walk you through in a conversation rather than on the open internet.

**Why this is the seat to take**

This is a rare seat on a rocket ship. CUBE AI is early, exceptionally ambitious, and backed by some of the world's leading investors. Our founders have built and scaled startups to unicorn valuations and exits, and have run mega teams at mega companies. We are building the company that puts the institutions the modern economy runs on back on offense against AI-powered crime. The closest analogy is **joining Palantir in its early days**: a hard mission, a category we're defining rather than entering, and a small group of exceptional people compounding fast. If you want a comfortable role, this isn't it. If you want the defining chapter of your career, your best work alongside people who make you sharper, keep reading.

**The role**

This is a **forward deployed** product role. You will not run the roadmap from a distance and you will not learn about our customers through a summary written by someone else. You will sit inside them: in their offices, next to the people using what we build, in their operational reviews, watching the work happen. ==============

**DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.**
------------------------------------------------------------

A modern, AI-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across:

This unique role sits at the intersection of product, data, operations, implementation and customer partnership. The team is responsible for the entire post-sales product operations and implementation lifecycle:

* Discovery: partnering with cross functional client leadership to analyze their operational and financial workflows (flow of goods, information and money) and requirements

* Passion for learning quickly

* Conduct cross functional deep dives across customer organization to map end-to-end business processes and workflows

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Manager** to lead the definition and design of end-to-end client experiences by identifying journey gaps, uncovering opportunities for improvement, and translating complex business, regulatory, operational, and technology needs into actionable digital capabilities. This role will collaborate across multiple product, business, and technology domains to define the systems, business rules, data requirements, and functional capabilities needed to deliver seamless, efficient, and client-centric experiences. Operating initially across multiple teams and workstreams, the Senior Manager will drive cross-functional alignment, shape product requirements, and establish a clear vision for delivery, with the opportunity to assume dedicated product leadership responsibilities as the initiative evolves.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead discovery and requirements definition for a complex international digital initiative spanning authenticated web and mobile app experiences.
* Map the end-to-end client journey across relevant digital, operational, and servicing touchpoints.
* Identify client experience gaps, opportunities, dependencies, and areas requiring new or enhanced digital capabilities.
* Define the intended client experience, including workflows, business rules, decision points, error handling, content needs, and exception scenarios.
* Translate business and client needs into detailed functional requirements that can be understood and implemented by design and technology teams.
* Define and document digital development scope, including what capabilities are required, what is not required, and which teams or platforms are affected.
* Identify the backend domains, systems, services, data, and integrations needed to enable the digital experience.
* Partner with architecture and technology teams to evaluate feasibility, dependencies, implementation options, and delivery sequencing.
* Collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, business, operations, service, design, technology, and other partners to ensure requirements are complete and appropriately reviewed.
* Partner with user experience design and research teams to develop intuitive web and mobile experiences that address the needs of international clients.
* Serve as the central digital product contact for the initiative, maintaining alignment across participating teams and helping resolve cross-domain questions and requirements.
* Work closely with project and program management partners to define, understand, and track digital workstreams, milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, and delivery readiness.
* Facilitate working sessions that bring together business, product, design, technology, and control partners to resolve ambiguity and move decisions forward.
* Communicate complex client experience and technology considerations in a clear, structured manner to both working teams and senior leaders.
* Support prioritization and tradeoff decisions based on client impact, business value, risk, feasibility, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
* Maintain traceability between the client journey, business requirements, functional requirements, design decisions, and delivery scope.
* Monitor delivery against the defined client experience and requirements, identifying gaps or deviations that require resolution.
* As the initiative progresses, potentially provide product leadership for a dedicated delivery or scrum team, including backlog development, story refinement, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as a client advocate and digital experience subject matter expert throughout discovery, planning, and delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of digital product management, product ownership, business analysis, or related experience.

- Assist customers in maximizing the value and use of assigned products.
- Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and collaboration.

**Required**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Sales, Life Sciences, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, helping brands, CPGs, and retailer partners reach shoppers with relevant, effective advertising across the Instacart platform. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll own the Formats domain, where we place 0 1 bets that fuel double-digit growth for Ads and keep CPGs and new advertiser types engaged.

You'll sit at the intersection of CPGs, retailers, and customers, shaping new ad experiences across multiple user-facing surfaces. Your portfolio spans new advertiser, formats innovation, and in-store experiences. You'll partner closely with XFN stakeholders, our Online Grocery team, and external technology partners. * As these bets mature, take on increasing strategic ownership: define and prioritize the next set of incremental bets across the Instacart Ads ecosystem.
* Communicate tradeoffs, progress, and results clearly to senior stakeholders, including the GM of Ads.

* Track record of launching user-facing products and managing trade-offs between users and advertisers
* Experience managing partners and vendors, including external technology providers.

* Experience with performance advertising products.
Experience taking new products from 0* 1 in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Background in ad tech, retail media, or a closely related domain.

jobs.desc:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants' homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

**Location**: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

**Role Scope**

Habitat Health is looking for a Product Manager to own strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes across our clinical and business applications portfolio — including EHR, CRM, Call Platform, Risk Suspecting, and ancillary clinical applications.

This role would be accountable for knowing the problem space deeply, deciding what gets built and in what order, and proving that what shipped actually worked. You'll run discovery with clinical, growth, and operational stakeholders, define clear requirements and success metrics, prioritize a backlog against a real prioritization framework, and partner with technical and vendor teams to deliver against it. You'll work closely with Platform, Clinical, Operations, and Growth leaders — not just to gather requirements, but to shape what the roadmap should be, defend trade-offs with data, and drive adoption once features ship.

**Primary Areas of Responsibility**  

* Own and evolve the product roadmap across the clinical and business applications portfolio, using a structured prioritization framework to balance strategic bets against operational demand
* Lead product discovery — engaging clinical and business stakeholders and end users directly to surface real workflow pain points, not just intake tickets — and translate findings into clear problem statements
* Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; partner with technical and vendor delivery teams (Epic/OCHIN, Salesforce, TalkDesk, and others) to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery
* Maintain the product backlog end to end, balancing new capabilities, enhancements, and technical debt
* Work with business stakeholders to define success metrics and KPIs for each initiative, track adoption and outcomes post-launch, and use that data to inform the next iteration of the roadmap
* Partner with PACE Center Leadership, the Office of the CMO, Population Health, Practice Operations, Finance, Strategy, Growth, and Health Plan Operations to align product direction with business strategy
* Partner with Operations leadership to drive adoption of new rollouts — closing training gaps through documentation, demos, and change management
* Coordinate with multiple vendors, escalating to leadership when vendor needs to be held accountable to scope, documentation, and delivery timelines
* Facilitate stakeholder and steering meetings, and represent the voice of the product to senior leadership
* Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, exercising sound independent judgment to identify issues, evaluate options, make recommendations, and drive matters to resolution

**Qualifications**  

* Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice
* 3+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in healthcare, health

jobs.title: Data Product Owner
jobs.desc:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at marathon.health

**ABOUT THE JOB**

The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the *problems it solves*, not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it.

Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces — starting with a well-structured semantic model — that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. The ideal candidate is fluent in leveraging AI to accelerate how these solutions get designed, built, and maintained.

CoVolt Power is a leading utility-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high-voltage infrastructure. The **Technical Product Manager - Corporate Applications** owns the technology roadmap for CoVolt's corporate applications from the technical side, anchored on our Trimble Vista ERP. You translate business needs into product requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery of enhancements, integrations, interfaces, reporting, and governance across the platforms that run Finance, Accounting, Payroll, HR, Project Accounting, and Procurement. Beyond Vista, you serve as the technical product owner for a portfolio of corporate applications (for example, UKG, LCPTracker, and FloQast), and you own the integrations that connect Vista to the broader enterprise (for example, Procore, B2W, and our reporting and data platforms).

The role is intentionally product-led, not order-taking. * **Drive ERP governance —** operationalize the Business System Owner / IT System Owner model — change control, configuration standards, security roles, segregation of duties, access reviews, and a monthly ERP steering cadence — so Vista stays compliant, controlled, and auditable.

* **Run delivery with product discipline** — own intake, backlog refinement, MVP scoping, release planning, testing, cutover, and adoption across Vista modules (GL, AP, AR, SL, PO, PR, JC, EM) and corporate application changes

We are looking for the **product counterpart to a 10x engineer**: someone who can independently identify customer problems, rapidly validate solutions with AI-native tools, translate them into crisp engineering work, and keep the team focused on shipping intuitive products that drive customer and business outcomes.

This is our first dedicated product hire. It is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who thrives in early-stage startups and is comfortable moving from customer conversation to prototype to roadmap to shipped product. You will report to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, operate as a senior individual contributor initially, and have the opportunity to shape and build the product and design function as the company grows.

This role spans three disciplines that are usually split across three people: **customer discovery, UX design, and product management**. We are looking for someone genuinely strong at all three who is energized by moving between them, not a specialist in one who tolerates the other two.

Because our users are mechanical engineers, manufacturing engineers, and teams building physical products, we are especially interested in people who have worked close to **hardware, robotics, autonomous systems, drones, automotive, industrial automation, advanced manufacturing, CAD/CAE/PLM, or other physical-AI environments**. A mechanical engineering background is highly valued, but hands-on experience building or shipping physical products can be equally relevant.

**What you'll do — Discover**
-----------------------------

* Run customer interviews and site visits with mechanical and manufacturing engineers to understand how products move from design through manufacturing and sourcing.
* Learn the reasoning behind engineering decisions, not just the requested feature: geometry, tolerances, materials, process selection, cost, lead time, quality, and production constraints.
* Turn customer workflows, pain points, and unmet needs into clear product opportunities and priorities.
* Build a continuous discovery habit so the team is never guessing about what customers actually need.
* Develop enough domain depth that engineers feel the product was built by people who understand how they work.

**What you'll do — Design**
---------------------------

* Own the end-to-end user experience: information architecture, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and functional prototypes. There is no separate design partner; this surface is yours to shape.
* Design agentic, AI-first experiences that make complex manufacturing and engineering decisions feel simple and require minimal training or support.
* Design for trust: help users understand why the system is making a recommendation, where uncertainty exists, and when human judgment should remain in the loop.
* Set and hold the quality bar for usability and visual craft as the product and team grow.

**What you'll do — Deliver**
----------------------------

* Prototype and validate solutions quickly using AI-native tools before committing meaningful engineering time.
* Translate validated concepts into a clear roadmap, product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and engineering tickets.
* Partner closely with engineering from definition through QA and launch, making tradeoffs quickly and keeping delivery on track.

* Help distinguish between customer-specific requests and scalable product capabilities that belong in the core platform.

jobs.desc:
### **About Traversal**

Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise.

Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high-impact work.

Today, Traversal operates in mission-critical environments at some of the world's largest enterprises. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we've brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Hanabi, NFDG, and American Express Ventures.

### **The Role**

Traversal is building a superintelligent AI SRE: always-on AI employees, used daily by hundreds of engineers at the world's largest companies during their highest-pressure moments. At the core are the agents and AI capabilities our engineering and research teams build. As a Product Manager at Traversal, you'll build the product on top of them: how the agent behaves, what it does, how it communicates, when it should act, and the user interfaces / product experiences built around it.

On-call engineers and SREs use the Traversal agent to troubleshoot production incidents, work through alert channels, and answer the everyday questions that come with keeping systems running, and adoption and usage have grown explosively. The agent lives in a web app and across headless surfaces: agents in Slack and Microsoft Teams, an MCP that works with coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, and an API engineers build workflows around. You'll bring the same craft to all of them, from pixel-level detail in the UI to tone, clarity, and evals in Slack, and you'll know which surface fits which problem.

Our product team is small but mighty: just a few PMs, each with high agency and a real hand in shaping how the function works. You'll help set the roadmap and the way we work as the company scales through rapid growth. If you use AI agents compulsively, have strong opinions about what makes them great, and want to build AI-native products engineers love so much they turn to them first, we'd love to meet you.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner closely with customers, engineers, and AI researchers to define product strategy and roadmap, leading discovery with SREs, platform engineers, and incident responders at some of the world's largest enterprises
* Build the product layer on top of the core AI agents our research and engineering teams build, thinking holistically across the web app and headless surfaces (Slack, Microsoft Teams, MCP, and API, where the user is often another agent).
* Sweat the details of the agent's prompts: iterate on multiple versions of prompts and harnesses, run evals to see which output is better, and tell a good output from a great one
* Own the features that make the product enterprise-ready, like fine-grained access control and RBAC
* Prototype ideas yourself, and bring a prototype, not just a PRD, to product reviews
* Sequence rollouts: find the MVP: the smallest feature set that tests a hypothesis, shipped on the most minimal surface (headless, Slack, or UI), tested with beta users, then expanded over time
* Work with forward-deployed engineers during customer POVs to turn gaps into shipped features, fast
* Bring in ideas from across the agent ecosystem and anticipate where agents are going next
* Shape the product function: roadmap, process, and how product works with a fast-growing engineering team

**Overview:**
=============

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic program of continuous improvement to support the growth objectives. The goals of the program are to reduce operational issues and risks by standardizing processes, implementing best-practices in key areas, and adding new governance and control functions. In addition, long term digital transformation is required to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve. These two strategic focus areas are driving growth in overall business investment.

  

The Product Owner II serves as owner of a large product or set of products by representing the voice of the customer and stakeholders to ensure that the product provides value to the customer, while aligning with the business strategy. The Product Owner II defines their product vision and roadmap, prioritizes the product backlog, anticipates client needs and serves as primary communicator between product stakeholders and teams while evaluating product progress at each iteration. In addition, the Product Owner II plays a key role in the company’s strategic direction, defining and articulating new opportunities, and working in close concert with key stakeholders, including senior leadership and their dedicated agile team.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Experience Management (XM)
jobs.desc:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview  
The Product Manager for T-Mobile's Experience Management (XM) program is a visionary, strategist, analyst, employee-experience evangelist, respected leader of execution, and professional relationship builder all rolled into a single dynamic package. XM is the product: a repeatable, measurable way for IT to connect what it does (incidents, changes, performance, support interactions) to what employees feel (sentiment) and what the business needs (productivity, reliability, confidence), rather than reporting on operational health alone. The Product Manager is ultimately accountable for XM end to end — the Experience Insight Release Train (Topic Intake through Directional Signal, Insight Brief, and XLA activation), the design and scoring of Experience Level Agreements (XLAs), and the XM Advisory Board (XMAB) governance loop that turns insight into funded, owned action. At a high level this means identifying the intersection of workforce experience problems, data/technical feasibility, business objectives, and the finite hours partner teams have committed, then leading a cross-functional set of stakeholders — EXE, PIE, ServiceNow, Cyber, ISAM, HR&WE, and others who do not report to this role — to deliver against a shared roadmap through influence rather than authority. The Product Manager is a "jack-of-all-trades" leveraging data fluency, quantitative ROI reasoning, and stakeholder leadership to ship decision-ready insights on a 2-4 week cadence and convert them into demonstrable productivity, cost-avoidance, and experience outcomes — not activity for its own sake. No day is the same for the Product Manager. Day to day activities or responsibilities include: running Experience Scans and writing Insight Briefs; maintaining the XLA Scorecard and story metrics; negotiating and tracking partner-team level-of-effort commitments; facilitating the XMAB insight-to-decision-to-action cadence; and defending the program's ROI story to senior stakeholders with rigor and transparency.

**Job Responsibilities**:

**Vision, Strategy, and Analysis**

* Owns the Experience Management (XM) program end to end, including its capabilities and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs), with moderate to high complexity and scope. This includes creating, managing, maintaining and communicating the XM vision and roadmap.

jobs.desc:
At Salient, some of the most important conversations about our products happen when nobody from Salient is in the room. An integrator is advising a school district on a new security system. A sales engineer is explaining how a manufacturer can use the cameras it already owns. A customer is deciding whether a platform that looks good in a demo will hold up across dozens of sites.

We need a product marketer who can make those conversations clearer, sharper, and easier to win, even when we’re not there to help. You would be our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager, with ownership of how we position the portfolio, equip our sales team and partners, and learn from the deals we win and lose.

**Why Salient, and why this role**

Salient Systems makes CompleteView, an open video management platform for organizations managing security across many sites. In plain terms: we take the video from a customer’s cameras, record it, and put it in front of the people who need it. That might be an operator watching live, an investigator piecing together what happened last Tuesday, or an administrator making sure every camera is still online. Customers choose their cameras, and we make them all work together.

We also build the recording platforms underneath it for customers who want a system that’s ready to go. Much of this market still runs on-premise, and we’re building toward a hybrid cloud future. That combination gives us an interesting story to tell, but not one that fits neatly on a single slide.

We sell through integrators and distributors. A message isn’t finished when everyone here approves it; it has to be useful to a partner who may be explaining us to a customer three weeks later. You’ll have the scope to build the product-marketing practice around that reality, not inherit a content calendar and call it strategy.

This is a chance to put several consequential pieces of a go-to-market system together: positioning, pricing and packaging research, launches, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and win/loss. The work gives you room to build a product-marketing practice with a measurable commercial voice, not just a portfolio of finished assets. We do need someone who can make the assets, too.

 **Requirements**  
  
**What you’ll do**

* **Give the portfolio a clear story.** Develop positioning, messaging, and packaging for CompleteView and our recording platforms. Translate product briefs into language that works for security leaders, IT teams, integrators, and distributors. Carry that language through sales, marketing, our revenue-operations partner, and the channel so it gets used, not merely approved.
* **Build tools that help people sell.** Own the living sales deck, create a total-cost-of-ownership model that can stand up to scrutiny, and develop competitive guides, objection handling, and other tools around the points where real deals stall. Partner with Sales on a demo narrative and script that others can deliver well. A deck that lives in someone’s Downloads folder does not count as enablement.
* **Lead major product launches.** Connect the product’s value to the release, build the internal and partner-facing plan, and make sure the story holds together across training, web content, sales materials, and demand generation. Work closely with the people running partner programs; this role owns the product story and the materials those programs use, not the co-marketing funds or partner-event calendar. You’ll also spend time with partners at the events where this market comes together.
* **Make market evidence useful.** Run pricing and packaging studies, maintain a practical view of competitors, and build a repeatable win/loss practice. * Understand new partner datasets, including their structure, coverage, methodology, strengths, limitations, and potential use cases.
* Define how new data should be productized, including what should be included, how it should be packaged, and how customers or internal teams will use it.
* Translate business and product needs into clear requirements and coordinate implementation across Engineering, Privacy, Data Acquisition, and other teams.
* Manage product launches, customer feedback, and ongoing enhancement, including post-launch assessment and roadmap adjustments.

* Assists in implementing GTM strategies and achieving the metrics for product success
* Protects assets and mitigates risks employing IP knowledge
* **Manage great people**
* Inspires Product teams, communicates with diverse groups, and influences change throughout the organization
* **Use great technology**

* Good understanding and usage of tech stacks
* Good understanding of exponential technologies including AI/ML, IoT, and Blockchain
* Agile proficiency for Rapid Product Discovery & Development
* Employs the latest technology in product management by diving deep into technology trends and architectures

* Understands different product management and development approaches

The Product Manager (Platform) is responsible for turning Hygiena's portfolio of software applications, including SureTrend, SureKleanz, SureDoc and SureLab, into one connected system that customers experience as a single product. This role owns the platform roadmap end to end: unified sign-in, cross-app navigation, shared data and combined reporting, in-app cross-sell between products, and the integrations that connect our applications to CRM, ERP and billing systems.

The Product Manager (Platform) pairs strong UI/UX judgment with a clear understanding of how accounts, data and systems fit together behind the scenes. Our applications were built separately, and this person will make them feel as if they were designed together. * Define the shared data model and integration requirements that let applications work together, including common customer, site, and user identities, roles and entitlements, and APIs and events, so that combined reporting and cross-app workflows are possible.

* Own integrations between the applications and Hygiena's commercial systems, including CRM, ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), and billing (Stripe), so that Sales sees accurate customer and plan data and invoicing is timely and correct.

* Collaborate with the other product managers to set cross-app standards and agree on shared roadmap priorities; communicate platform strategy to leadership and enable Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree a plus.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Corporate Technical team is responsible for building and optimizing the many systems and internal technologies that enable Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril's supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by us. We call this system-of-systems "CorpOS". Within CorpOS lies a suite of digital software solutions aimed at solving the problems for our growth, finance, people teams that interplays heavily with our ArsenalOS solutions that enable Anduril's engineering, production and sustainment departments.

We're building the financial systems backbone that lets a fast-scaling manufacturing company move with the speed of a software startup and the rigor of a public company. As Finance Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Operations, and Engineering—owning the platforms, data, and processes that turn raw operational activity into trustworthy financial insight. # Technical Program Manager (Charlotte)

Location:Charlotte, NCCompany:Satyam Venture Engineering Services

## Description:

**Role: Technical Program Manager (TPM) – EE/SW Integration & Release**

**Location: Charlotte, NC, USA**

Technical Program Manager (TPM) with deep expertise in EE integration, and embedded software integration for modern vehicle platforms. This role combines hands-on technical understanding with program leadership, ensuring that electronic control units (ECUs), networks, and software stacks integrate seamlessly and meet all functional, safety, and quality requirements. Drive vehicle-level system integration, coordinating embedded software releases, ECU hardware maturity, diagnostics, validation, and compliance activities. Work directly with software engineers, systems engineers, validation teams, and suppliers to ensure robust delivery.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

- Drive EE/SW integration activities for prototype, pre-production, and production builds.
- Manage ECU-level and network-level integration issues across CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and Automotive Ethernet.
- Ensure bootloader, flashing, and software update processes (OTA or UDS-based) are fully validated.
- Oversee network bring-up, diagnostics verification, and DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Code) testing.
- Align interface control documents (ICDs), network description files (DBC, LDF, FIBEX, ARXML), and ensure configuration consistency.
- Review ECU software release notes to confirm feature completeness and backward compatibility.
- Coordinate SIL (Software-in-the-Loop), HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop), and full vehicle integration testing.
- Drive test automation and regression coverage for system-level functionality using tools such as dSPACE, Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, ETAS LABCAR, or NI Veristand.
- Ensure test results are traceable to system and software requirements.
- Track power consumption, network load, wake-up/sleep, and timing analysis during integration phases.
- Own open issue dashboards (JIRA, ALM, or similar) and ensure clear root cause tracking with engineering teams.
- Support change management and version control (Git, SVN, or PTC tools) to maintain ECU software integrity.
- Validate that ASIL-level software components meet ISO 26262 compliance requirements.
- Coordinate FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and DFMEA closure for integration-related issues.
- Interface with EE design teams, SW developers, calibration engineers, and supplier integration teams to align dependencies.
- Communicate integration readiness metrics (flash status, network stability, regression pass rates) to leadership.
- Prepare gate review documentation, highlighting technical maturity and open risk items before release.

jobs.desc:
**OBJECTIVE / PURPOSE**

This position requires a product leader who owns the roadmap and lifecycle for Distance Learning (DL) physical kits. The Product Manager sets pricing and margin targets, and plans launch and go-to-market. The role is the single intake point for field product requests and makes the call on prioritization and discontinuation.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

* Own the product roadmap and lifecycle for DL physical kits and courses, from concept and definition through launch, growth, and discontinuation.
* Define new courses and kits, projected demand, product cost, pricing, and margin.
* Estimate and suggest pricing to the Senior Manager, DL Operations and Product.
* Monitor the competitive landscape and define competitive positioning for DL kits and courses.
* Serve as the intake point for field product requests; evaluate, prioritize, and communicate decisions back to the field.
* Make product decisions for New Product Portal entries and hand them off to the Operations Specialist, DL for execution; define the product content of each launch checklist.
* Collaborate with the Senior Manager, DL Operations and Product on demand assumptions and build-and-ship readiness before each launch.
* Track product performance after launch, including sales, margin, and customer feedback, and use results to update the roadmap.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure kit and course content meets academic and program requirements.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in relevant field is required. Relevant fields include business, marketing, life or health science, or related discipline.

**Experience:** 3-5 years of experience in product management, preferably for physical products, required. Experience with higher education, science lab kits.

**Specialized Training/Skills:** Project Management training/experience a plus. Strong financial and analytical skills, including pricing, margin, and market analysis. Ability to make and defend prioritization decisions with internal stakeholders and the sales team. Ability to effectively plan, implement, and monitor self-directed and group projects. Must possess good written and oral communication skills.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**Our Mission**
===============

Private markets shape which companies get built and how innovation scales - yet origination still runs on manual workflows and fragmented tools. **Raylu is the AI origination engine for private markets**, so every investor can see more of the market, qualify faster, and move first.

We’re not building generic AI. Raylu is purpose-built for Growth Equity and PE - already powering sourcing for leading funds with:

* Real-time market maps aligned to your thesis
* Standardized, enriched company signals and benchmarks
* Deep contextual research on emerging companies
* Automated, fund-voice outreach to founders and execs

**The Role**
============

We're hiring a Product Marketing Manager to turn what Raylu builds into launches, messages and sales tools that win deals with investors. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Growth.

You'll sit where the roadmap meets the market. You'll decide how each feature is positioned, make sure every launch lands and arm our sales team to beat competitors in demanding conversations with partners and deal teams.

This is a high-ownership role: you'll own launches from early roadmap discussion to post-launch analysis, and your work will show up in every pitch, page and campaign we run.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Own launches end to end.** Run every feature and product launch from roadmap planning to post-launch analysis, and keep the launch calendar.
* **Build the messaging framework.** Turn Raylu's capabilities into clear value propositions for each buyer (PE, growth equity, VC) and each persona, from partners to analysts.
* **Sales enablement.** Create demo narratives, decks, and one-pagers that hold up in competitive, technical conversations.
* **Track the competition.** Monitor AI-for-finance and deal-sourcing tools, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning and roadmap input.
* **Be the voice of the customer.** Interview customers and lost deals, and bring what you hear back to product, sales and marketing.
* **Create customer proof.** Produce case studies, ROI stories and customer quotes that show results like pipeline lift and more founder meetings.
* **Feed growth.** Give the Growth team the messaging, landing pages and assets that power SEO, paid social and campaigns.
* **Build with AI.** Use AI workflows for competitive research, content and enablement; this is how the whole team works.

**Your First 90 Days**
----------------------

* **Days 1–30:** Learn the product deeply, sit in on sales calls and talk to customers. Map the competitive landscape.
* **Days 31–60:** Ship a messaging framework by segment and persona, plus the first battle cards and an updated sales deck.
* **Days 61–90:** Run your first major launch end to end and publish at least two customer case studies.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

* 5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of owning launches for technical products.
* Domain knowledge in finance: you understand how PE, growth and VC funds source and evaluate deals, and the language they use.
* A working understanding of LLMs and AI systems, enough to explain what our product does and why it's credible.
* Proven ability to turn complex capabilities into sharp value propositions for partners, deal teams and analysts.
* Sales enablement instincts: you have built demos and narratives that win competitive deals.
* Experience working closely with product, engineering and sales to shape roadmap-informed messaging.
* Clear, compelling writing, and the judgment to know what to cut.
* High agency, organized and comfortable with ambiguity; you'll build our product marketing playbook from scratch.

**Big Bonus Points**
--------------------

* Marketed to private equity, VC, investment banking or other financial buyers.
* Launched an AI or data product into a competitive market.
* Background in investing, banking or consulting before mov

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Hygiena provides rapid microbiology diagnostic tests and solutions for mission-critical, time-sensitive processes around the world. Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. Solutions are sold in a wide range of industries globally, but the core focus is food safety. Headquartered in Camarillo, California and with offices around the world, we are actively looking for talented individuals to help grow the business!

At Hygiena we believe:

* In providing the highest quality products & service
* Being a leader in innovation
* Having a compelling desire to improve and win in the marketplace
* In contributing positively not only in the workplace, but in our community and environment!

With rapid growth comes opportunity. We are looking for a Product Manager (Platform) to join our team. This is a full-time, exempt, remote role, but preferably based in Southern California.

**About the Role:**

The Product Manager (Platform) is responsible for turning Hygiena's portfolio of software applications, including SureTrend, SureKleanz, SureDoc and SureLab, into one connected system that customers experience as a single product. This role owns the platform roadmap end to end: unified sign-in, cross-app navigation, shared data and combined reporting, in-app cross-sell between products, and the integrations that connect our applications to CRM, ERP and billing systems.

The Product Manager (Platform) pairs strong UI/UX judgment with a clear understanding of how accounts, data and systems fit together behind the scenes. Our applications were built separately, and this person will make them feel as if they were designed together. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, UX, the other product managers, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, the Product Manager is measured on customer adoption, cross-app usage and cross-sell revenue, not on tickets shipped.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and maintain the platform product roadmap and revenue objectives, prioritizing cross-app capabilities based on customer value, revenue impact, technical feasibility, and the needs of each product line.
* Define the unified customer experience across applications, including single sign-on, cross-app navigation, account and site switching, and shared settings, partnering with UX design to deliver experiences that are simple, consistent, and intuitive.
* Define the shared data model and integration requirements that let applications work together, including common customer, site, and user identities, roles and entitlements, and APIs and events, so that combined reporting and cross-app workflows are possible.
* Own in-app cross-sell between products end to end: identify moments of customer need, define prompts and offers with Marketing, route leads to account owners, and run experiments to improve conversion.
* Own integrations between the applications and Hygiena's commercial systems, including CRM, ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), and billing (Stripe), so that Sales sees accurate customer and plan data and invoicing is timely and correct.
* Lead the phased separation of applications from shared legacy architecture into standalone products, planning migrations that avoid disruption to customers' daily workflows**.**
* Partner with Engineering in Azure DevOps for backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination across platform workstreams.
* Collaborate with the other product managers to set cross-app standards and agree on shared roadmap priorities; communicate platform strategy to leadership and enable Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management for B2B SaaS sof

ATC is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.

**Company Description** CIMS Global is a clinical trials technology and data science company with over 16 years of industry experience, focused on accelerating the development of life-saving therapies. The organization bridges the gap between pioneering researchers and effective treatments by providing reliable data and streamlined processes for clinical trials. CIMS Global delivers innovative data science services and solutions that enhance clinical trial design, execution, and outcomes. By leveraging proprietary and advanced technologies such as AI, LLMs, NLP, ML, and advanced statistical methodologies, the company improves the quality, speed, and efficiency of data acquisition, processing, analysis, and regulatory submissions.

**Role Description** The Product Manager/Product Owner (SaaS) will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical trial data science products, from discovery and requirements gathering through launch and optimization, in a full-time remote position. This role involves translating market and customer needs into clear product roadmaps, defining and prioritizing features, and creating user stories and acceptance criteria for engineering teams. The individual will collaborate closely with data scientists, developers, clinical experts, and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of high-quality SaaS solutions that align with business goals and regulatory requirements. Daily activities include backlog management, sprint planning, reviewing product performance and user feedback, and preparing product documentation, release notes, and demos. The Product Manager/Product Owner will also monitor industry trends and competitor offerings to inform product strategy and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

- Product management and product ownership skills, including roadmap development, backlog prioritization, and requirement definition for SaaS products.
- Experience working with data-driven products or platforms, ideally involving AI, ML, NLP, or advanced analytics in regulated or healthcare-related environments.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams (engineering, data science, clinical operations, and business stakeholders).
- Ability to translate complex technical and clinical concepts into clear, user-focused features and documentation.
- Familiarity with agile methodologies, sprint planning, and iterative product delivery.
- Background in life sciences, healthcare, clinical research, or related fields is highly beneficial.
- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences) or equivalent practical experience.
- Demonstrated capability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple priorities, and make data-informed decisions.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

### **Location**

**Chicago — our River North office, five days a week.** Reports to Zach Galant, CTO & co-founder.

CodeHS is hybrid overall. We have people in other offices and people who work remotely, and you’ll work with them regularly. This role is in person because it depends on coming up to speed quickly — on the product, on our customers, and on how the engineering team works — and that happens faster sitting next to people. So does mentorship. We want someone who wants to work that way and is excited about getting to work in person in the office.

We’re hiring our first product manager to work inside the engineering team.

We have about fifteen engineers in small project teams that re-form each cycle, and we ship constantly. What limits our impact usually isn’t engineering capacity — it’s conviction about what to build, why, and how to communicate it to the rest of the team and our customers. We want someone who can get that conviction from teachers, districts, the market, our data, and our own team, and turn it into something engineering can act on.

This is not a people management role.

### **The role**

You own a product area end-to-end from concept to launch. Most likely a newer bet where we’re still working out the shape of it, though it could be an existing surface that needs more attention, or a few smaller ones. We’ll decide together once you’re here and have completed onboarding. Either way the goal is that you build up experience and domain expertise in that area and act like an owner.

You’ll sit with our engineering managers as a peer. You’ll run small teams of engineers with a focus area and are responsible for keeping them on track and ensuring that we build the right thing.

This is our first formal product role, so you have an opportunity to help shape what the product function can do and how it fits within engineering and the company more broadly.

### **How you work**

**You build.** When you have an idea, go make a version of it. Not production code — a working prototype you drove an AI coding agent to build. Engineers review and take it to completion.

**You write things down.** Specs, product briefs, the reasoning behind a decision. If it isn’t written down here, it doesn’t count.

**You talk to the people who use this.** Much of the work is strategy and synthesis. But when the answer is in a classroom or on a call with a district, you go. It isn’t a heavy travel role, but you will need to join calls, talk to people on the team and customers, and build an understanding beyond just reasoning through things on your own.

**You connect engineering to everyone else.** Sales, customer success, support, and curriculum all have product or tooling needs. Your job is to gather the information, synthesize it, and use that to inform what the right things are to build.

### **You should be**

**Comfortable being technical**, without necessarily having been an engineer. You can read a pull request and argue about a tradeoff without needing it translated. When an engineer raises an issue or blocker, you can ask a useful second question to move us back in the right direction.

**Fluent with AI, and adaptive to how things are changing.** You use AI to guide your thinking and move quickly, but you don’t hide behind it for judgment. You should be prototyping with coding agen

**Product Manager**

*Platform for Heavy Industries | SF Bay Area*

**ABOUT NEXXA**

Nexxa.ai is building artificial super intelligence for heavy industries — enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments. We're looking for a rock-start enterprise software experienced Product Manager to work on the NitroOS platform. You'll work at the intersection of AI, heavy industries and business operations to define what we build, how it evolves, and how it scales aligned to the vision. This is not a feature factory role. * Work directly with the CPO and CTO — your ideas will ship in weeks, not quarters
* Backed by silicon valley top VCs with access to their portfolio network, recruiting, and GTM resources
* Early-stage equity with real upside.

**Job Overview:**

**Product Manager, Data**

Keurig’s ecommerce business runs on data. Every coffee discovery, subscription decision, and reorder is a signal. We are hiring a Product Manager to own how data moves through our commerce ecosystem: what we collect, where it lives, how it’s generated, and how it gets turned into product value across Keurig.com and connected commerce.

You will set the direction for the data foundation that powers personalization, merchandising, and decision-making across the business, not just the features sitting on top of it. You will be expected to operate with significant autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and make architecture and investment tradeoffs that shape the roadmap for years. Reports to the Director of Product Management and partners closely with engineering, data science, marketing, CRM, and customer experience leadership.

This role is aligned to the Coffee Operating Unit.

**What You’ll Own**

**Data Strategy and Ownership**

• Define the data model for commerce and customer behavior: what signals we capture, how they’re structured, and what they’re meant to represent

• Own the flow of data across systems, from collection at the customer touchpoint through to activation in personalization, CRM, and analytics

• Set the strategy for where data lives and how it’s accessed, partnering with engineering and data science on architecture, build-vs-buy, and long-term tradeoffs

jobs.desc:
**Role** **Context**

Altic is the rules-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume.

A network is only worth as much as it is connected. An alternatives trade touches a wealth platform, a trading or order management platform, a custodian, and a transfer agent or fund administrator. Today each of those connections is built bilaterally, differently, every time. That is why the industry runs at an 8 to 10 per cent not-in-good-order rate. Altic is targeting less than 0.01 per cent, and connectivity is where that is won or lost.

The connectivity itself is unglamorous and genuinely hard. Some counterparties expose modern REST APIs. Many still exchange fixed-width or delimited files over SFTP on a nightly cycle. Some sit behind decades-old platforms with a batch window and no appetite to change it. The job is not to wish that away. It is to design flows that work across all of it and still deliver a trade end to end, in good order, at volume.

**Purpose of the Role**

You will own how data moves into, through and out of the Altic network. That means consuming the interfaces our network participants already have, exposing the interfaces Altic offers back to them, and designing the flows in between so that the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade completes without manual intervention.

The counterparties in scope are wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms, custodians, and transfer agents and fund administrators. Each has a different technical reality and a different set of constraints. Your job is to build reusable connectivity rather than a series of one-off builds, so that the tenth integration of a given type is materially faster than the first.

You work against the network's rules and technical specification rather than inventing requirements from scratch. Where a rule cannot be implemented as written, you are the person who says so and works it back through.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms
* Custodians, transfer agents and fund administrators
* GPs and asset managers participating in the network
* Altic Engineering and Architecture
* Altic Network Rules and Governance
* Altic Operations, Business Development and Partnerships

**Why This Role Is Different**

This role offers:

* The chance to connect network participant types that have never been connected for this asset class. There is no existing integration pattern for alternatives inside a managed account, because the flow did not exist.
* Ownership of an integration product, not an integration project. Success is a reusable interface that shortens every subsequent onboarding, rather than a delivered connection.
* Real technical heterogeneity to solve for. Modern APIs on one side, nightly flat files on the other, and a trade that has to complete across all of it.
* A specification that already exists. The rules and technical specification are being written alongside you, so you are building against something rather than guessing.
* A measurable target. Less than 0.01 per cent not-in-good-order is not a slogan, and connectivity design is most of how it gets hit.

The network is real to a network participant at exactly the point their systems connect to it. That point is yours.

###### **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US**

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

##### **About Foundant**

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

##### **Where You’ll Work:**

* As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
* With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

##### **What****You’ll****Do:**

* You'll own the backlog for the GivingData scrum teams, keeping it clear, prioritized, and ready so engineers always know what's next and why it matters to the grantmakers who rely on the product.

* You'll carry the voice of the client to our engineering teams, so what we build reflects how the giving community really works.

Product Owner, Field Service

**Overview:** OPEX is seeking a Product Owner, Field Service to own the business direction and ongoing improvement of the technology capabilities that support our Service organization. This role works closely with Service leaders, frontline employees, Information Systems, and external software partners to understand operational needs, define priorities, manage the product backlog, and ensure technology investments improve customer service, employee effectiveness, and business performance.

  

The Product Owner serves as the primary business-facing owner for Service applications and related workflows, including field service, dispatch and scheduling, technical support, mobile technician experiences, installed assets, service contracts, parts and inventory, customer and employee portals, knowledge, reporting, and integrations with other enterprise systems. The role translates business problems into clear product requirements and makes informed trade-offs about what should be addressed first.

  

This is a cross-functional product role rather than a software-development position. The Product Owner defines the business need, desired outcome, priority, requirements, and acceptance expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the product roadmap for Service technology capabilities, aligning priorities to business strategy, customer experience, operational performance, and measurable outcomes.
* Build strong relationships with Service leaders, dispatchers, technicians, technical support teams, finance partners, and other stakeholders to understand needs, pain points, opportunities, and changing business priorities.
* Lead demand intake and requirements discovery for defects, process improvements, configuration changes, enhancements, and new capabilities.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and backlog items with business context, expected outcomes, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and supporting examples.
* Own, curate, and continuously prioritize the Service product backlog using business impact, customer impact, risk, urgency, user reach, expected value, dependencies, effort, and available capacity.
* Lead regular backlog and roadmap discussions with stakeholders, making trade-offs transparent and ensuring priorities, decisions, ownership, and next actions are understood.
* Distinguish between technology defects, data issues, process problems, training or adoption needs, configuration opportunities, vendor product limitations, and true enhancement requests so work is routed appropriately.
* Partner with technical teams and software providers throughout delivery, providing timely business clarification and decisions while allowing technical teams to own solution design and implementation.
* Coordinate business validation and user acceptance testing, ensuring the right users and scenarios are represented and that delivered changes address the original business problem.
* Partner with change and enablement resources on release readiness, communications, training, process changes, and adoption so new capabilities are used effectively after deployment.
* Use operational data, support trends, recurring workarounds, user feedback, adoption signals, and service performance to identify root causes and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Promote effective use of standard enterprise-platform capabilities and configuration before pursuing unnecessary customization.
* Maintain clear visibility into roadmap status, backlog health, aging requests, risks, dependencies, delivered outcomes, and decisions for Service and technology leadership.
* Track whether implemented changes deliver the intended business value and recommend follow-up actions when adoption, process, data, or solution changes are needed.

Are you a problem-solver who loves building strong client relationships and keeping great applications running smoothly? Join Kinsale Insurance, a leading excess and surplus (E&S) lines carrier headquartered in Richmond, VA. We’re known for our high-quality, high-touch approach and innovative, personalized solutions that help clients manage complex risks. We bring that same standard of excellence to the technology our business teams rely on every day.

#### **About the Role**

As a Product Owner, you’ll be the bridge between our technical teams and our business stakeholders, helping ensure our applications run smoothly and our business partners get exceptional support. You’ll triage and resolve complex application issues, serve as a trusted point of contact, and go beyond reactive support. You’ll help plan maintenance, support upgrades, address security vulnerabilities, and contribute to initiatives that improve overall application health. You’ll work in a collaborative, Agile environment where your focus on business impact and client satisfaction makes a difference from day one.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders on custom and third-party application issues, communicating impact, status, and resolution plans clearly and promptly.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve application incidents and defects to minimize business disruption and deliver a positive client experience.
* Translate complex technical issues into plain language for non-technical audiences, facilitating collaboration among business stakeholders, leadership, and development teams.
* Support the rollout of new products and product enhancements using configuration utilities and SQL scripts.
* Support proactive application maintenance, including health checks and performance tuning, with business impact in mind.
* Coordinate application upgrades and security remediations with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure minimal disruption.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the stability, performance, and maintainability of our applications.
* Participate in backlog refinement and sprint planning, and track and report support metrics with insights and recommendations for your team.

#### **What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent work experience.
* 3+ years of experience supporting custom applications in a client-facing role, with working knowledge of incident, problem, and change management.

The product is genuinely complex, because what customers buy is complicated. The challenge is to present listings and information in a way that is clear, effortless and persuasive enough to sell the inventory. This is a hands-on, prototype-first and data-driven role, and being AI-native is essential.

- A track record of shipping real product to real users, with measurable impact
- Exceptional product taste: you know what great software feels like and notice when something is off
- Strong data fluency and experience with product analytics
- Experience prototyping without waiting on design, using tools such as Claude Code, Figma or Cursor
- Clear, concise writing
- Experience owning large, sweeping product changes, not just incremental tweaks

**Why we exist:**

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

**Why we’re hiring:**

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This role exists to close that gap. Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We're looking for a Product Manager that's ready to help our rapidly growing business create innovative experiences within our Casino product. This Product Manager, Games Discovery will ensure FanDuel users that play on Casino are getting an industry leading experience. Your role will be integral in creating seamless access to Casino games customers want to play, fostering a more exciting way to discover new games, and driving customers back to the app to fuel winning moments. You will need to understand and prioritize product and customer needs, define the product vision and OKRs, and working closely with engineering, design, content, commercial and marketing teams to bring solutions to market.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

* Inform, shape, and drive execution of product initiatives surrounding games discovery FanDuel Casino
* Establish and maintain domain expertise on the product, market, and competitors
* Assess product opportunities and spearhead the ideation, prioritization, and design of new initiatives
* Ensure transparency and alignment with organizational stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and operational functions to ensure successful product deliveries and launches
* Identify, prioritize, and execute post-launch optimizations and improvements

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* Minimum 2+ years' experience as a product manager or similar role required

* Excellent stakeholder management and critical thinking skills
* Ability to handle multiple simultaneous projects while effectively balancing scope, resourcing, time, and quality
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for goals and deliverables
* Experience working with AI tools to aid in product management discovery and execution.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).
