jobs.title: Product Manager, TalentPro
jobs.desc:
At ProService, our mission is to help Hawaii employers succeed, and hiring the right people is often the hardest part of that. TalentPro is our managed service for finding and keeping talent. It brings together recruiters, technology, and local expertise so Hawaii businesses can hire hourly workers quickly and keep them. We’re looking for a Product Manager who will own the whole TalentPro experience for clients, candidates, and recruiters, and who wants to build the improvements themselves.

The role sits between product and service. TalentPro isn’t pure software and it isn’t a traditional staffing operation. It runs on an ATS and a payroll platform that you’ll integrate around rather than rebuild. Your candidates apply from their phones and talk to us by text, so one awkward step can cost us hundreds of applicants. Success looks like this: a new client goes live in under an hour, more hires come from our own candidate pool every quarter, and clients see their pipeline in real time without having to ask. When that happens, you’ll know you’ve built something people rely on.

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL**

* Own the end-to-end product experience for TalentPro, turning input from clients, recruiters, and candidates into one prioritized backlog
* Build and ship workflows, automations, and integrations yourself using no-code tools, APIs, and lightweight scripting, and bring in engineering help only when it’s truly needed
* Improve conversion across the mobile and SMS candidate funnel, from application completion through interview scheduling and show rates
* Map and re-engineer how data moves between the ATS and payroll platforms so client setup feels like one click and onboarding is error-free
* Build the data pipelines, dashboards, and monitoring that track operational and financial health and catch issues before a client or candidate does
* Manage relationships with our ATS partner and internal payroll platform team, pushing for changes and knowing when a workaround will get there faster

**IS THIS ROLE RIGHT FOR YOU?**

This is a builder’s role in an early-stage business. There’s no playbook and no dedicated engineering team waiting for your specs. You’ll decide what matters most, build it, test it with a live client or recruiter, and then make it standard. You’ll have close partners in our Customer Delivery Manager and Recruiting Lead, who stay close to clients and candidates every day, and leadership that wants you to move fast. Hands-on building and owning the outcome are not optional — they’re the job.

You’ll also need to love the details. Every text a candidate gets and every click a client makes is something you’ll want to improve, because small friction adds up quickly in a high-touch service. If you’d rather write requirements than build, or need a clearly defined roadmap before you can start, this role will be frustrating. If you find it energizing to turn a messy manual process into something clean that runs itself, you’ll do well here.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TEAM**

You’ve owned a product experience from end to end and have built real tools yourself with no-code or low-code platforms, APIs, or scripting. You know how to get value out of third-party software you don’t fully control. You’ve turned input from customer-facing and operations teams into a prioritized list and shipped against it. You’ve measurably improved a high-volume conversion funnel and have helped shape how a product is packaged and priced. Experience in HR tech is a plus. Above all, you bring deep customer obsession, sharp analytical skills, sound judgment, and the independence to drive work forward with minimal oversight.

You’re probably a fit if:

* **You hunt friction one click at a time.** *You noticed applicants dropping off at a single SMS step, rewrote the flow, and more people made it to an interview. Hiring managers got candidates sooner, and job seekers got hired faster.*

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Facilities Management eXpress** is currently seeking a **Technical Product Manager** to join our team!

Do you build things instead of writing documents about them? Do repeated manual tasks make you want to open your laptop and fix them? If AI coding tools are just how you work, keep reading.

Much of FMX’s data starts in mechanical rooms, on rooftops, and in partner spreadsheets, and collecting it is slow and expensive. You’ll start by making our Facility Condition Assessments dramatically cheaper and faster. Then you’ll bring that approach to everywhere else data enters FMX.

You’ll be the product manager for these tools and usually the one building them, going from “huh, that’s painful” to a shipped fix in days. You’ll also spend more time on site than anyone in Product, so you’ll be our scout for the problems that never become support tickets.

**As the Technical Product Manager, you will:**

*First priority: make the FCA operation as efficient as possible*

* Own the cost and cycle time of an assessment. Baseline cost per building and square foot, technician hours, days on site, report turnaround, and rework rates, then set targets with Professional Services and report on them.
* Tackle the biggest time sinks first, across scoping, on-site capture, data cleanup, report production, and capital plan population.
* Build, ship, and support the FCA tools: the capture app and field workflow, operations tracking, the mapping and floor plan pipeline, and partner data intake.
* Get on site and do the work yourself, interviewing technicians and facilities staff and routing what you learn to the right product manager.

*Broader scope: data ingestion and the cost of operations*

* Cut the cost of bringing customer data into FMX during onboarding, from equipment lists and floor plans to formats nobody planned for.
* Build tooling that makes data intake repeatable instead of bespoke.
* Improve data completeness, not just speed. Thin data gathered quickly is worse than good data gathered efficiently.
* Use AI where it removes real work, like reading nameplate photos and floor plans, drafting condition narratives, and catching gaps before customers do.
* Automate internal work anywhere a small tool saves real time or money.
* When an internal tool earns a place in the FMX product, make the case and hand it off well, with documentation and data model implications.
* Keep the data defensible. Speed only counts if the work holds up.

*What success looks like in year one:*

* You know our cost and cycle time per assessment by heart, because you built the reporting.
* Technician hours or days per assessment are measurably down, thanks to what you shipped.
* The field team wouldn’t give up your tools, and Product makes decisions based on what you bring back.
* You’ve applied the same approach to at least one other ingestion problem, likely onboarding, and cut real cost.

  
**Requirements**

jobs.desc:
Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

  • We’re humans not robots
  • Customers always come first
  • We work better together
  • Simplicity is our strength
  • Our reputation is priceless
  • Hard work pays off

As one of the fastest growing SaaS start-up companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand.

Who You Are:

As an AlertMedia Product Manager you will have a primary role in setting the vision for our products while also playing an integral part in the day-to-day activities to make the vision a reality. Every day you’ll employ your ability to move smoothly between cross-functional teams, inspiring, learning and leading. Time with customers will be one of your best sources of improvements and new feature ideas. Best of all, you’ll be part of AlertMedia’s amazing culture and an important contributor to our rapid growth.

You are passionate about your products, and maybe even a little obsessive. You see both the forest AND the trees. You are energetic, empathic and earnest. Collaborating with people across different functions comes naturally to you. You are known for your willingness to share information and having no ego. You refuse to give up when the path isn’t clear.

When a critical event unfolds, the hard part is rarely knowing that something happened — it is understanding the impact and coordinating the many steps, people, and systems that have to move in the right order, quickly, and often all at once. AlertMedia is transforming how organizations use AI and data to turn response into action, and this role will lead that effort.

What You Get To Do Every Day:

Customer and Market Understanding

  • Develop deep expertise in the personas we serve — security, safety, business continuity, IT, and operations leaders, and the responders who execute when something goes wrong — including how their work is structured, staffed, measured, and escalated.
  • Interview customers and prospects continuously. Run discovery conversations, workflow walk-throughs, and feedback sessions that produce specific problem statements rather than feature requests.
  • Maintain a clear, current view of the problems we solve well today, the opportunities to solve problems better, and the problems we should be solving 12 to 24 months from now.
  • Track industry trends, the automation and AI landscape, platform and integration changes, and the competitive field, and translate them into implications for our roadmap.

Strategy, Prioritization, and Roadmap Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for new AI capabilities: decide what we build, what we defer, and what we decline, with reasoning that stands up to scrutiny.
  • Shape the strategy and positioning for a product that is still being defined and build the case for where it should go next.
  • Balance business objectives, customer needs, and industry trends when sequencing work, and make the tradeoffs explicit to stakeholders.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AutoML
jobs.desc:
**About Deploy**

Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughput. Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.  
  
Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.

**About the Role**

As a Product Manager for AutoML, you will be an essential part of the Deploy team, working effectively across all disciplines to build, launch, and iterate features for our AutoML platform. Deploy's AutoML platform allows our customers to easily train, evaluate, and deploy customized machine learning models. Beginning with their own data, Deploy's AutoML platform guides our customers through the process of creating a fully-functional model accessible via an API endpoint just like Deploy pre-trained models.

In this role, you will work closely with all stakeholders to define product requirements and see implementation through to completion, leading development efforts between engineering and design. You are passionate about organization, experienced in working with agile teams, have a good understanding of best practices in software engineering, highly effective in communicating and problem solving, and have experience managing enterprise projects.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap, functional requirements, and development timeline for Deploy's AutoML platform
* Develop a clear product vision and roadmap, mock up concepts, write specs and oversee execution from inception to completion
* Work with the executive team to determine top priorities, help define new features, and improve our AutoML platform habitually
* Work with teams to drive alignment, remove blockers, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs against technical constraints throughout project lifecycles
* Analyze customer data and feedback to identify opportunities for feature enhancements
* Help engineering and product teams estimate and decompose complex projects into manageable parts with delivery plans, and track progress against those plans
* Clearly communicate product benefits to our customers and internal stakeholders
* Measure engineering velocity, and help identify and establish new best practices to improve the speed and security at which projects are delivered
* Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role
* Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets
* Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority

### **Requirements**

* You have a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar field
* You have 2+ years of Product Management experience and a track record of building web products, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment
* You have technical experience with any of the following: data, analytics, design or engineering
* You have experience working with engineering, design, and customers in enterprise software or related technical fields
* You have technical depth that lets you understand tradeoffs and ask engineers insightful questions about architecture and product decisions alike
* You have excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
* You have experience leading a team, and effectively implementing team goal

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams to develop and maintain product roadmaps, prioritize work based on business value, and drive Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and product reviews.

In this role, you will take ownership of a defined product or capability, balancing functional and non-functional requirements while monitoring product health, performance, scalability, reliability, and overall value. **VALD**is the world leader in technology for the allied health industry, providing innovative human-measurement technology to over 13,000 clients in over 150 countries. If you have a favorite team in the NBA, EPL, or NFL, there's a good chance they use VALD Technologies.

Since its humble beginnings in 2015 in Brisbane, Australia, VALD has grown to a team of over 300 team members in over 35 countries, with 5 offices across four continents.

Driven by a multidisciplinary team of researchers, clinicians, sports scientists, designers, developers and engineers, VALD's suite of systems offer unparalleled insight into human movement, performance, injury risk and rehabilitation.

  
  

**About the role**

**BridgeAthletic** is the training prescription platform behind thousands of strength & conditioning programs from collegiate athletics, pro teams, military, and private performance facilities.

As part of VALD, we're building a closed loop in athlete management, bringing measurement, training prescription, and adaptation closer together.

This role owns BridgeAthletic's nutrition experience end to end: the workflows coaches use to create and deliver nutrition guidance and to track their athletes' compliance and progress, plus the athlete-side experience of logging meals in the app. You'll work closely with engineering, design and other teams to take ideas from problem to shipped product.

**In this role, you will**

* **Own projects from start to finish.** You write the requirements, run the rhythm with engineering, manage scope in-flight, and keep projects moving through to release.
* **Turn problems into solutions.** The roadmap will give you the problem and priority. You'll work out the right solution, think through edge cases and trade-offs, and make sure the final product works in the real world.
* **Own launches.** Make sure releases are ready, documentation and internal teams are prepared, and measure what happens after launch. Shipping is only the start; we care about whether people use what we build.
* **Help shape the roadmap.** Analyze user feedback and usage data to recommend what we should build next.
* **Learn the domain.** Build a strong understanding of strength & conditioning and how coaches actually work day to day.

**Is this you?**

* **1**+ years in project management or similar role.
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills**, with the ability to communicate requirements, decisions and ideas in a way that teams can easily understand.
* **Strong execution skills**, with a track record of keeping projects moving, spotting risks early and raising issues before they become problems.
* **Attention to detail**, with a focus on thinking through edge cases before they reach QA or customers.
* **A data-driven approach**, using product data to inform decisions and questioning the numbers when something doesn't look right.
* **Strong prioritisation and collaboration skills**, with the ability to manage competing priorities and keep teams aligned.
* **Genuine curiosity about the domain**, with an interest in understanding how coaches work and why, even if you don't have a strength & conditioning background today.
* **A growth mindset** aligned with VALD's culture of continuous learning and development.
* Nice to have: a background in nutrition, coaching, or competitive athletics.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Company**
-----------

Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Manager to turn Pramaana’s formalization and verification capabilities into products people use and trust. You’ll own a product area from discovering the problem through launch and adoption, working closely with engineering, research, design, domain experts, and our commercial team.

Our planned product areas include the self-serve workbench and developer experience, Harbor for tax, and government products. Each PM will have a defined product area; this shared draft can be tailored to the relevant audience and workflow. You’ll help establish direction, make practical trade-offs, and stay close to users as the product evolves.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Discover valuable problems. Talk to users, observe workflows, and identify where formalization and verification can deliver a measurable improvement.
* Own product direction and priorities. Define the target user, use cases, roadmap, and success measures for your product area. Make clear choices about what to build next and why.
* Translate technical capabilities into usable workflows. Define requirements, user journeys, and acceptance criteria with engineering, research, design, and domain experts.
* Make verification understandable. Help users inspect sources, assumptions, supporting evidence, unresolved questions, and changes without overstating what the system has established.
* Drive delivery and iteration. Scope experiments and releases, resolve dependencies, test with users, and follow through on quality and adoption after launch.
* Measure outcomes. Track activation, repeat usage, task completion, time to value, and product quality; use evidence to guide decisions.
* Partner with the commercial team. Support demos and customer discovery, bring market feedback into the roadmap, and distinguish reusable product needs from customer-specific implementation requests.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**
--------------------------------------------

* Experience taking a technical product from an ambiguous problem to shipped software and sustained usage, with clear examples of your decisions and their outcomes.
* Strong customer discovery and product judgment. You can identify the underlying need, test assumptions, and prioritize with limited time and resources.
* Technical fluency. You can discuss APIs, data flows, model behavior, and system constraints with engineers and researchers, then translate them into clear product choices.
* Ability to lead across functions through clear reasoning, practical scoping, and follow-through.
* Comfort with information-rich workflows where correctness, evidence, and user trust matter.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**
----------------------------------------------

* Experience with developer tools, self-serve software, enterprise AI, or products used in regulated workflows.
* Relevant tax or government workflow experience for the corresponding vertical role.
* Experience as an early PM, establishing product practices and helping a technical team find repeatable adoption.

**GTM Product Manager**
-----------------------

* **Location:** Preferred: MA, CT, OH, or NY (hybrid); other US locations also considered
* **Department:** Applied Innovation
* **Reports To:** SVP, Applied Innovation

### **About OpinionRoute**

At OpinionRoute, we are redefining how Market Research Agencies run their operations. From programming to sample to data quality and data visualization, we are building the technology not usually accessible to the MRA.  
  
The Navigator (our research operating system) runs the whole project process. Our market-leading Data Quality & Fraud Prevention suite (CleanID, ResponseID, QC Flow) mitigates today’s toughest quality threats. Our enhanced survey Programming & Hosting services are how we make more dynamic surveys for forward-thinking researchers.

We are built for researchers, not investors. Our mission is to take the chaos out of market research operations through modern automation, AI-assisted quality control, and frictionless workflows.

### **The Role**

This role sits between the teams that build our technology and the teams that sell, deliver, and use it. You will report directly to our SVP of Applied Innovation.

We ship enhancements continuously across our internal AI tools, the Navigator and its supporting tools, and our survey programming and hosting platform. Your job is to help us get the most out of every one of them, making sure each release is understood, adopted, and turned into real value for our users.

### **You Sit at the Intersection of Build and Adopt**

* **The build side:** Applied Innovation, Engineering, and Survey System Development. You will be in the know, brought in early, and help shape how it is released.
* **The adoption side:** Operations, Sales, and Marketing, plus our clients. You prepare them for each release, the problems each features olves, the opportunities each function unlocks, and help them put it to work.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **1. Help the Operation keep up with the Tech Team.**

* Our tech team is producing upgrades at lightning speed. You’ll partner with functional leaders to map how this will help their team work better.
* Translate complex technical capabilities (e.g., AI fraud detection, workflow automation, AI-assisted survey programming) into practical every-day guidance for the people who use them.
* Bring feedback from internal teams and clients back to the build teams as clear requirements, priorities, and business cases.

### **2. Release Readiness & Launch**

* Plan and coordinate rollouts of survey programming and hosting enhancements, Navigator features and tools, internal AI tools, and data quality capabilities (CleanID, ResponseID, QC Flow).
* Define positioning and value propositions for market research executives, survey programmers, and research operations leads, partnering with Marketing on external messaging.

### **3. Internal Launches & Enablement**

* Treat our internal teams as clients: launch every new AI tool, Navigator feature, and system enhancement to them with the same care as a client release.
* Run internal launch campaigns, including announcements, release notes, quick-start guides, short demos, and spotlights on how colleagues are putting new tools to work.
* Host onboarding sessions, office hours, and hands-on walkthroughs so teams get value from new capabilities quickly.
* Partner with teams to spot where new capabilities can simplify or automate their day-to-day work.

### **4. Sales & Client Enablement**

**About Us**

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an accomplished, seasoned Lead Product Manager to define and drive the strategy for Netwrix Auditor - the compliance audit and security-investigation backbone of Netwrix Security. In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and go-to-market execution for the highest CSAT rated product in the company's portfolio, and its migration to a true multi-tenant SaaS offering.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise with strong knowledge of data security posture management, compliance auditing and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, SOC 2), plus fluency in the SIEM, SOAR, and SOC technologies (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow, and similar) that security operations and compliance teams rely on every day. You will act as the voice of the customer, ensuring Netwrix Auditor delivers curated, audit-ready evidence for compliance teams and near real-time alerting with rapid, interactive forensic investigation for SecOps analysts — activity, access, and configuration-change auditing across Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, file servers, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with advance DSPM capabilities in support of that mission.

*Strategy & Roadmap*

* Define the vision and long-term strategy for Netwrix Auditor, aligned with company priorities and the compliance-audit and security-operations market.
* Own the product roadmap, including backlog prioritization and release planning, closing on-premises-to-SaaS parity gaps that unlock migration of the Auditor installed base.

*Market & Customer Insights*

* Own the Auditor’s GTM strategy and partnership strategy with the Data Security solution suite, driving Auditor attach on cross-portfolio opportunities, and brief industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester) to sharpen Auditor’s competitive and category positioning.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Work closely with Sales and Customer Success on the Auditor-to-1Secure SaaS migration motion, protecting and growing the largest single renewal base in the portfolio.
* Define and monitor product success metrics, including renewal rate, audit-preparation time reduction, investigation mean time to resolution, and SaaS conversion rate.

**Advanced Specialist Product Manager – Test Security Platforms**

**Summary**

Pearson Professional Assessments delivers the exam and testing ecosystem that professional bodies, regulators, certification programmes and schools depend on to make high-stakes decisions about people. Security is not a feature of that service. It is the service.

The role is accountable for five security domains: Identity, Behavior, Location, Platform and Environment - and for the platforms and shared services that deliver them, across market-facing and internal applications alike. It includes the security capability roadmap for the online-proctored channel.

The role exists because our security capability today is strong but application-shaped. Controls have grown up inside individual products, driven largely by what individual clients asked for, and the same problem has been solved more than once in more than one place. We are moving to a model where security is a deliberately designed shared platform, built from a standing read of the threat landscape and the market rather than from inbound requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

***Domain and platform product ownership***

* Own a persistent, outcome-based roadmap for each of the five domains — refreshed continuously against evidence, not reset annually by the project cycle.
* Design security as a shared platform. Define the capabilities, service contracts and integration patterns that channel and application teams consume, so a control is built once and applied everywhere it is needed.
* Maintain a live capability gap analysis by domain. Be able to answer, at any time, which assurance is weakest and what it would take to close it.

***Market intelligence and outside-in discovery***

* Build and maintain a standing view of the exam security threat landscape — AI-assisted cheating, proxy testing, content harvesting, organised fraud, emerging spoofing techniques — and use it as the primary input to the roadmap.
* Track competitor and adjacent-industry capability deliberately and continuously. Know where we lead, match or lag, by domain, and say so plainly.
* Run continuous discovery with candidates, proctors, test centre staff, client programme owners, and our own forensics and operations teams. Discovery is a habit, not a phase at the start of a project.
* Convert single-client requests into capabilities that serve the whole book of business. Decline bespoke security work with a reasoned, evidenced alternative rather than a refusal.

***Evidence, measurement and model performance***

* Instrument every control. Own the metrics that show whether a capability is actually working: detection rate, precision and recall, false-positive burden, appeal and overturn rates, candidate and proctor impact.
* Partner with data science and analytics on AI and ML-based detection. Set the performance bar, own the precision/recall position, and understand what both error directions cost a real candidate.
* **Ensure the evidence a control produces** **is** **defensible** — capable of standing up to candidate appeal, client scrutiny, regulator questions and legal challenge. A detection we cannot evidence is not a detection.
* Close the loop: forensics findings, incident reviews and result holds from live delivery feed straight back into the roadmap.

***Delivery partnership***

* Work as one team with Engineering Delivery, Architecture and Security Operations — from discovery through production and into operational life.
* Write clearly. Crisp problem statements, decision records and product narratives that a senior engineer, a client and an executive can each read and act on.
* Sequence around outcomes and dependencies, and be accountable for what reaches production — not for the plan.

***Advancing how we work***

* Replace project-shaped intake with durable product ownership in your area, and show the rest of the portfolio what good looks like.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Two-Sided Marketplace
jobs.desc:
About the company  
A venture-backed marketplace modernizing how brands buy sports and live event sponsorships. Most of this market still runs on cold email, spreadsheets, and one-off negotiations, with no central place to buy it the way brands buy digital media. This company is building that platform, connecting brands with sports teams, leagues, venues, festivals, and entertainment properties. Clients include major national brands and professional sports properties.  
  
The role  
You will own how product gets built. You will decide what comes next, write the specs, prototype ideas, and carry them through to launch. The platform is a two-sided marketplace, and you will work across the full experience for both brands and properties. You will work directly with the founders, engineering, design, and customers, and what you decide gets built.  
  
What you will do  

* Own the roadmap: turn customer feedback, data, and company direction into a prioritized plan the team believes in
* Write specs clear enough that engineers can build without a follow up meeting
* Prototype quickly, using AI tools to build clickable, working versions of ideas before committing engineering time
* Dig into product data to understand how customers really use the platform, and turn it into decisions
* Talk with customers every week and pull out what matters most
* Run launches end to end, measure results, and decide what comes next
* Partner with the sales and partnerships teams so field feedback shapes the product
* Help build out the product function as the company grows

  
What they are looking for  

* Results over titles: they care what you have shipped, not your title or tenure
* 2+ years in product, ideally at an early-stage startup, marketplace, or B2B SaaS company. Former founders and engineers who moved into product are welcome
* Real product shipped to real users, with clear outcomes you can point to
* You prototype: you build working versions of your ideas instead of waiting on design
* Clear, concise writer whose specs leave nothing to guess
* Fluent in data and product analytics
* Strong product taste: you know what great software feels like and notice when something is off
* Understanding of marketplaces, or a strong drive to learn them
* High agency: when there is no playbook, you write one

  
Nice to have  

* Background in sports, live events, media buying, or adtech
* Experience as a founder or early startup employee

  
Location: New York, NY (On-site)  
Pay: $100k - $140k per year  
Work authorization: US Citizen or Permanent Resident

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

------------------

As Happen Bank expands its full-spectrum banking offerings, we're investing in the data and marketing technology that enables more relevant, personalized customer experiences. We're looking for a Product Manager to lead capabilities across Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (formerly Evergage/Interaction Studio), helping deliver contextual communications and engagement across our member platforms.

* Lead cross-functional projects from discovery and planning through development, launch, and post-launch support, ensuring alignment, accountability, and continuous improvement

jobs.title: Product Manager, Radar - Fraud and Abuse Prevention
jobs.desc:
About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse.

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.

What you’ll do

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll work directly with customers to understand the novel fraud and abuse attacks they face, identify the most important problems to solve, and turn those insights into product strategy and a roadmap.

You’ll work at the intersection of customers, engineering, data science, design, and commercial teams to shape what we build and bring it to market. Your work will span the fraud and abuse detection and control capabilities at the heart of Radar and the user and developer experiences that put those capabilities into our customers’ hands.

This role requires both urgency and taste. You’ll move quickly as threats evolve, without compromising on reliability, craft, or the details that make complex products feel beautifully simple.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of the fraud and abuse landscape.
  • Investigate emerging attacks with customers, assess their financial and operational impact, and distinguish isolated incidents from opportunities to build broadly useful defenses.
  • Translate findings into a product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing the defenses that deliver the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with engineering, data science, and design to explore signals, shape solutions, and rapidly turn effective defenses into scalable, reliable products.
  • Set the pace for the team by scoping the product thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with high rigor.
  • Work with sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams to validate demand, coordinate launches, and help customers adopt and maximize the value they get from new capabilities.
  • Own product performance, user experience, and business metrics to guide iteration and communicate progress.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience
  • Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and defining metrics that connect product decisions to user outcomes.
  • Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You find ways to test ideas quickly, learn from real users, and turn early solutions into products that scale.
  • Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer problems translate into willingness to pay, adoption, and durable business value.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, product positioning, and adoption.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Remote)
jobs.desc:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Product Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and ongoing oversight of a custom‑developed product within the OCC portfolio. This role ensures that product goals, stakeholder needs, and technical execution remain aligned to support mission‑critical outcomes for the program.

This position will be a fully remote within the United States position.

Responsibilities:

Creates integrated project plans for contract deliverables and new products in development projects. Manages a project team comprised of a multidisciplinary staff. Reviews, manages and controls status of projects and budgets; manages schedules and prepares status reports. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals and objectives. Develops mechanisms for monitoring project progress and for intervention and problem solving with team members and line managers. Generally reports to a Program Manager.

* Manages the direction of a project through the design, implementation, and testing in accordance with project objectives.
* Defines requirements and plans project lifecycle deployment.
* Supervises professional and technical support personnel performing in their regular disciplines.
* Schedules tasks and coordinates with various team members to accomplish the results.
* Manages the integration of vendor tasks and tracks and reviews vendor deliverables.
* Ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables.
* Conducts project meetings and is responsible for project tracking, analysis and reporting.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* Bachelor's with 2-5 years (or commensurate experience)
* Proven experience as a Product Manager overseeing custom software development projects.
* Strong ability to define product vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments and leading cross‑functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, prioritize, and translate stakeholder needs into clear technical requirements.
* Solid understanding of product lifecycle management for enterprise or mission‑critical systems.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing vendor or contractor teams and evaluating delivery against requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including data‑driven decision‑making.

* **Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* Experience supporting federal programs or working within the VA/OCC environment.
* Background with human‑centered design, user research, or usability testing.
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks, APIs, cloud platforms, or DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with backlog management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Knowledge of compliance standards, data governance, or healthcare‑related systems.
* Experience working with distributed, remote teams.

Posted Salary Range: USD $110,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

The Company:

**Serving the People Who Serve the People**

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**ServiceNow Product Manager** 
 
**Purpose of the Role**
=========================================================

JLL's Enterprise Service Management (ESM) team is hiring a ServiceNow Product Manager to own ServiceNow as a strategic enterprise platform. This role is accountable end-to-end for the platform's product strategy.

The Product Manager is expected to help transform ESM into a value-providing function for JLL — treating ServiceNow as a product with a strategy and a roadmap rather than infrastructure to be kept running and ensuring platform investment is justified by measurable business outcomes rather than ticket volume or license spend alone.

Three key qualifications are necessary to be successful in this role: (1) strong platform/product management skill — the ability to own a strategic enterprise SaaS platform's roadmap, backlog, and license/consumption economics across multiple, often competing stakeholder groups; (2) ITSM/ITIL expertise at large-enterprise scale, paired with a proven, hands-on record of using AI and agentic AI to modernize a ServiceNow or ITSM practice; and (3) critical thinking and analytical judgment — the ability to apply industry frameworks, staffing models, and vendor claims appropriately to JLL's business rather than adopting them by rote.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Own end-to-end product strategy and the multi-year roadmap for JLL's ServiceNow platform, acting as the single Product Manager accountable for what gets built, extended, or retired on the platform and why.
* Translate ESM's operating model and business demand into a prioritized platform roadmap, arbitrating competing requests.
* Define and maintain the platform's product backlog, working with the Director, ITSM Platform & Automation Lead to translate roadmap priorities into engineering delivery.
* Build the business case and secure ESM leadership buy-in for major platform investments, module additions, and multi-year initiatives.

**License, Consumption & Value Management**

* Own ServiceNow license and module portfolio management — tracking consumption, utilization, and entitlement against actual usage to prevent both under-licensing risk and shelfware spend.
* Own the ROI/value case for the platform, defining and reporting the business-outcome metrics (adoption, self-service deflection, automation coverage, cost avoidance) that justify continued and future investment.

**Cross-Tower Governance & Release Management**

* Partner with the CMDB Product Owner, Change Enablement Process Owner, and other ESM process owners so platform roadmap decisions stay aligned with data governance and change/release policy.
* Own platform governance standards — configuration, customization, and technical-debt discipline — in partnership with engineering, so the platform does not fragment as adoption grows across towers.
* Apply critical thinking to distinguish JLL's genuine platform needs from vendor sales narratives, and defend prioritization trade-offs to senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity

**AI & Agentic Platform Enablement**

* Own the platform-level roadmap for AI and agentic capability — ServiceNow's native AI Agent Studio, AI Agent Orchestrator, and Now Assist — partnering with the ITSM Engineering Manager and Intelligent Automation Lead on what gets built and adopted, and in what sequence.

**Product Owner, NDA Solutions**
================================

Information Technology · Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) · Full-time, Exempt

National Distribution Alliance (NDA) runs several platforms supporting the group purchasing organization, its operators, and its supplier programs, and this role owns them. The near-term job is integration: bringing systems that overlap toward one coherent experience instead of several disconnected ones.

You’ll set the roadmap, decide what gets built next, hold the technology partners to it, and stand behind the data and reporting that NDA and its Suppliers make decisions on.

The role is designed to work as one of a pair, alongside a counterpart Product Owner covering the National Distribution Alliance (NDA). You’ll each own your own business unit, back each other up, and work to one shared set of standards so a capability needed by both gets built once. Where that counterpart role isn’t in place yet, you’ll carry an agreed level of support for the other business unit in the meantime, scoped with IT and business unit leadership rather than left to absorb informally.

**About UniPro**
----------------

We’re a cooperative of independent foodservice distributors. Our Members compete against companies many times their size, and they win by staying closer to their customers and moving faster. UniPro gives them the scale, buying power, supplier relationships, and increasingly the data and technology that would otherwise be out of reach.

These platforms are how Members, distributors, and operators actually do business with us. Keeping them accurate and dependable is what this role is for.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Own the platforms and the roadmap**

* Act as the primary business owner for NDA’s platforms, making sure each one supports its reporting, operational, and data quality objectives.
* Keep a prioritized enhancement roadmap, informed by talking to operators, distributors, Members, Suppliers, and internal users rather than only by whatever lands in the request queue, and be clear about the trade-offs.
* Push the portfolio toward fewer and better systems: consolidate overlapping systems into one coherent experience, and drive newly implemented platforms from launch to dependable.
* Run the technology partner relationships as the main point of contact for enhancement requests, issues, testing, implementation status, and platform updates. Lead evaluations, renewals, and statements of work, and hold partners to the scope, timelines, and service levels agreed.
* Turn business needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinate testing and rollout, and accept or reject releases against the criteria agreed up front.
* Lead recurring stakeholder meetings, including agendas, action item tracking, and communicating decisions.
* Decide what success looks like for each significant release and report afterward on whether you got there. If something ships and nobody uses it, that’s yours to fix.

**Keep the data right**

* Run the daily, weekly, and monthly validations that keep platform data complete, timely, accurate, and ready to report on, along with the mapping and reconciliation behind reliable reporting.
* Chase missing, late, incomplete, or inaccurate submissions, find the root cause, and get it corrected with distributors and other data providers.
* Audit incoming files and data sources, troubleshoot file errors, and coordinate corrections and resubmissions. Escalate anything that could affect reporting accuracy, operational visibility, supplier programs, or business decisions.
* Maintain master data integrity across product, distributor, operator, and Member attributes, and own the data standards, documentation, governance procedures, and quality thresholds.
* Work with our data team so definitions, metrics, and thresholds stay consistent with UniPro’s wider reporting.
* Validate new reports, dashboards, and calculations before release, spot check live reporting aga

Product Manager AI

End-to-End AI Product Owner – Line of Business or Platform Aligned

Role Overview

The Product Manager / Product Owner – AI is responsible for end-to-end ownership of AI initiatives for a specific Line of Business or claims domain. This role partners directly with business stakeholders to define AI-enabled improvements to claims operations, cost control, and client service performance, and translates those objectives into structured, sprint-ready execution plans.

This role combines strategic initiative shaping with hands-on backlog ownership and daily collaboration with AI engineers and data scientists. It ensures that AI development is grounded in real operational pain points and that delivered solutions are practical, compliant, and measurable in impact.

Key Responsibilities

The Product Manager/Owner works directly with claims leadership, operational managers, and Business Transformation Leads to understand workflow bottlenecks, leakage drivers, customer friction points, regulatory risks, and client performance commitments. They translate these insights into clearly defined AI use cases with measurable operational objectives such as reduced claim cycle time, improved reserving accuracy, enhanced fraud detection rates, or improved document processing speed.

They decompose initiatives into epics and features that reflect real-world operational workflows, ensuring requirements account for system integrations, adjuster behavior, client reporting requirements, and compliance obligations. They collaborate with AI engineers and data scientists to validate feasibility, data availability, model explainability considerations, and downstream operational impact.

They own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring it remains prioritized according to business value and aligned with enterprise AI portfolio constraints. They prepare stories with detailed acceptance criteria that reflect actual claims scenarios and operational realities, not abstract technical requirements.

During sprint execution, they remain closely engaged with the delivery team, clarifying nuances of claims processes, regulatory rules, and client-specific variations. They validate that developed models, automation features, or decision-support tools function appropriately within the claims workflow and align with user expectations.

They communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to LOB stakeholders transparently, ensuring expectations are managed around sequencing and delivery timelines. Following deployment, they monitor adoption, operational metrics, and user feedback, adjusting backlog priorities based on real-world performance and measurable impact.

This role requires balancing operational urgency with disciplined backlog governance, particularly in environments where client escalations or regulatory deadlines may introduce pressure for rapid change.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in Product Management or Business-Technology roles within insurance, claims, or managed services
  • Strong understanding of claims operations, adjuster workflows, or insurance servicing models
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Ability to translate operational pain points into structured technic

# FAR Analyst / Product Owner (Columbia)

Location:Simpsonville, MDCompany:iAdeptive Technologies

## Description:

**About the Role**

The FAR Analyst / Product Owner sits on the ATLAS Data Governance team, is the subject matter expert for ATLAS reporting and analytics and owns the product backlog for data governance and reporting enhancements. The role connects Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) knowledge with data governance so that acquisition data is accurate, well defined, and ready for reporting.

The analyst represents ATLAS data consumers, bringing their reporting needs, questions, and pain points to the governance table. Those insights shape the Office of Acquisition and Grants Management (OAGM) outlook, including its data standards, reporting priorities, and acquisition decisions.

**ATLAS data governance**

- Serve as a core member of the ATLAS Data Governance team, supporting data ownership, stewardship, and decision rights for acquisition data.
- Map ATLAS data elements to FAR requirements and procurement processes (e.g., contract types, clauses, CLINs, obligations, modifications).
- Develop and maintain the ATLAS business glossary, data dictionary, and authoritative definitions for reporting fields.
- Define data quality rules and metrics; identify, track, and resolve data quality issues with data stewards and system owners.
- Document data lineage from ATLAS to reports and external systems such as FPDS and SAM.gov.
- Support data standards, access controls, records retention, and CUI and privacy requirements.

**SME for reporting and analytics**

- Serve as the subject matter expert for ATLAS reporting and analytics, explaining how acquisition data is created, defined, and should be interpreted.
- Translate FAR and acquisition business rules into reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculations.
- Review and validate reports and dashboards for accuracy against source data and regulatory intent before release.
- Write requirements and user stories for new or improved reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
- Analyze acquisition data to surface trends, bottlenecks, and compliance risks.

**Data consumer advocacy**

- Represent ATLAS data consumers, including contracting officers, specialists, program offices, finance, and leadership, in governance discussions.
- Gather and prioritize consumer reporting needs through interviews, working sessions, and feedback reviews.
- Bring consumer use cases and pain points to the governance table and track them through to resolution.
- Help consumers find, understand, and correctly use governed ATLAS data and reports.

**Product ownership**

- Own and prioritize the ATLAS data governance, reporting, and analytics backlog in Jira, balancing consumer value, regulatory deadlines, and OAGM priorities.
- Write epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria for data, report, and dashboard enhancements.
- Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews with the development team.
- Accept or reject completed work against acceptance criteria and the definition of done.
- Maintain a product roadmap for ATLAS data and reporting capabilities and communicate it to stakeholders.
- Keep requirements, decisions, and release notes current in Confluence.

**Shaping the OAGM outlook**

- Turn data consumer needs and analytics findings into recommendations that shape OAGM data strategy, reporting priorities, and policy.
- Brief OAGM leadership on data quality, reporting gaps, and regulatory impacts.
- Assess FAR changes (FACs, class deviations, agency supplements) for impact on ATLAS data, definitions, and reports.
- Develop job aids, training, and guidance so the acquisition workforce enters and uses data consistently.

Job Description


Penguin Random House is seeking a Technical Product Analyst to join the Customer Operations team supporting Distrotheque (DTQ), our proprietary metadata and asset distribution platform. DTQ plays a critical role in distributing book metadata and digital assets to PRH customers and partners and continues to evolve alongside the changing needs of our business and the marketplace.

This role will provide technical and analytical support throughout the product-development lifecycle, with particular focus on detailed requirements, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and release readiness.

jobs.desc:
**Why we exist**
----------------

Most people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options. Treatments like accelerated TMS, SAINT, Spravato, and IV ketamine can work when nothing else has. They're also hard to find, hard to get covered, and hard to deliver well. That gap is why Radial exists.

We support the country's largest network of brain medicine clinics: 27 clinics and more than 100 clinicians across seven states, caring for patients with some of the most serious mental health conditions there are. RadialOS, our AI-native operating system, matches patients to the right treatment, coordinates their care, and takes administrative work off clinicians' plates. We're backed by General Catalyst, and in 2026 we acquired the MSO behind Mindful Health Solutions, one of the pioneers of interventional psychiatry.

Every role here supports our mission of getting patients access to the care they need as quickly as possible.

**The role**
------------

Our patients feel every broken handoff. A referral comes in, gets entered in one system, checked against insurance in another, and scheduled in a third. Somewhere in between, someone with severe depression waits. This PM's job is to find those places and remove them.

You'll sit closer to the work than anyone else on the product team. That could mean working the front desk during the Monday-morning call rush, shadowing a technician through a day of accelerated TMS sessions, or sitting beside a biller as they chase a Spravato prior authorization across three payer portals. Then you'll go back and fix what you saw.

The scope is wide and the autonomy is real. The distance between seeing a problem at a front desk and shipping the fix is short, and we want to keep it that way.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Map how work actually happens across our clinics and operations teams, including the workarounds nobody wrote down.
* Find where time, revenue, and patients fall out of the process, and size each problem so we know which to fix first.
* Decide what to build, buy, or automate, then ship it with engineering, design, and clinical leaders.
* Prototype with AI yourself so ideas get tested in days, not quarters.
* Write PRFAQs and short specs that make the decision obvious.
* Roll changes out across 27 clinics, train the people who'll use them, and measure whether they worked.
* Own outcomes like time to first appointment, prior authorization turnaround, clinician admin time, and patient experience.

**Backgrounds we think could thrive here**
------------------------------------------

* Former health-tech founders who want high ownership and direct contact with users
* Engineers moving into product who still like building the first prototype themselves
* Health-tech PMs who want to be in the room where their product gets used
* Clinic or practice operators who taught themselves to build with AI and want to do it full time
* Builders who care deeply about data models and it impacts front-end workflows

This list isn't a checklist. If you see yourself in one of these, we'd like to talk. If you don't but the role still sounds like you, we'd like to talk too.

**You may be a great fit if you**
---------------------------------

* Have watched someone use something you built and changed the plan because of what you saw.
* Build a rough version the same afternoon when the tool you need doesn't exist.
* Can explain the same tradeoff to a clinician, an engineer, and an executive, and each one trusts you.
* Narrow ambiguity instead of waiting for someone to resolve it for you.
* Earn trust fast with frontline teams, because you show up, listen, and come back with something that helps.
* Reach for AI first. You build your own tools and agents and have opinions about where AI helps and where it doesn't.

Job description

### Description

The **Product Manager** owns the health, direction, requirements, readiness, adoption, and measurable outcomes of assigned Summit K12 products across the full product lifecycle. The role combines strong inbound product management with outbound product ownership: understanding customers and markets, setting priorities, defining requirements, partnering closely with Design and Engineering, validating product quality, preparing the organization and customers for successful adoption, and using post-launch evidence to continuously improve the product.

Summit K12 Product Managers are expected to become credible domain experts in the products and customer problems they own. They do not need to enter the role as the deepest subject-matter expert in every area, but they are expected to build sufficient market, product, workflow, and applicable state or regulatory knowledge to make sound decisions, support expansion into new markets, and represent the product with confidence.

A Product Manager is not a project coordinator, permanent frontline support representative, dedicated QA engineer, or product marketer. PMs own product truth, readiness, prioritization, and outcomes. PjMs drive approved projects through delivery; Product Operations runs the operating system; Product Design owns experience design and usability practice; Engineering owns technical architecture and implementation; Academic owns academic integrity within its authority; and customer-facing functions own scaled execution in their disciplines.

- Maintain a current, evidence-based view of product health across adoption, usage, customer outcomes, support burden, defects, maintenance needs, UX debt, renewal risk, business performance, and strategic fit.
- Own product roadmap and prioritization within approved strategy, balancing maintenance, customer commitments, growth, quality, modernization, and market expansion.
- Make routine product decisions independently within delegated authority and surface keep, improve, consolidate, migrate, or retire recommendations when evidence warrants.
- Own multiple products where scope and complexity permit, using shared systems and clear priorities to avoid administrative sprawl.
- Maintain current representative-user evidence sufficient to support material product and roadmap decisions; evidence quality matters more than interview quotas.
- Combine customer feedback, workflow observation, analytics, support signals, implementation evidence, commercial context, and competitive/market information into clear problem definitions and product decisions.
- Build and maintain credible domain expertise for assigned products, including relevant educator workflows, implementation realities, state or market requirements, policy/accountability context, and customer expectations where applicable.
- As products expand, distinguish reusable core capabilities from state-, market-, or customer-specific requirements so growth does not create unnecessary one-off product variants.
- Make explicit what is known, uncertain, assumed, and still needs validation.

- Maintain and prioritize enhancement, defect, and maintenance work based on customer impact, severity, strategic value, product health, and available capacity.

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

### **Summary**

A commander looking at a recommended target and effect pairing asks two questions: why this, and why now? Target Effect Pairing (TEP) is a capability for USPACOM Joint Fires, built on the Maven Smart System, that answers both with AI recommendations a targeting staff can trace, explain, and audit. It speeds up capabilities analysis and the commander's decision and force assignment, while every inherently governmental decision stays with a human. Engineers can build the software. They can't tell on their own whether it reflects how joint targeting is really done.

That judgment is yours. You bring operational targeting experience and the working habits of a product manager, and you turn joint targeting doctrine, JFE and JTCB workflows, and target development standards into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You work with a Senior UX Designer, software engineers and architects, and a Technical Program Manager who owns backlog priority and government acceptance. You own whether what gets built is operationally right.

Requirements are still forming, and much of the team has never worked in targeting. The recommendations this capability produces will also be independently assessed for quality, so output that merely looks reasonable won't hold up.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Objective 1: In the first 90 days, give the team an accurate picture of how USPACOM targeting runs today**

* Government targeteers review your map of the current workflow, from target development through nomination, approval, and assessment, and confirm it is accurate.
* Engineers and designers can say where each JFE or JTCB decision happens, and who holds the authority for it, without coming to you first.
* Where the command's practice departs from doctrine, the gap is written down along with which one the product follows and why.

**Objective 2: Turn targeting doctrine and decision authority into requirements the team can build and test**

* Engineers build from your user stories and acceptance criteria without a rework cycle over operational intent.
* Every inherently governmental decision point appears in the requirements, with the human approval it needs spelled out.
* Feature requests reach the backlog framed as the operational problem behind them, not only as the feature someone asked for.
* The Technical Program Manager gets priority recommendations grounded in operational value, with the reasoning visible.

**Objective 3: By month six, prove that recommendations hold up before a commander sees them**

* Representative scenarios and acceptance criteria test whether a pairing recommendation is complete, relevant, and defensible.
* Each recommendation answers why this and why now, with its assumptions and limits stated plainly enough for a targeteer to challenge.
* Operational problems show up in your scenarios first, rather than in government evaluation.

**Objective 4: By the end of year one, make operator feedback what steers the product**

* Demonstrations with targeteers, JFE and JTCB staff, and J32 operators produce feedback that changes what gets built next.
* Each capability has measures of success agreed before it is built, and you report agai

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
ABOUT REPAY
  
REPAY (“Realtime Electronic Payments” / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

REPAY is a fast-growing FinTech company seeking a strategic, execution-focused Product Owner to shape the Consumer Payments roadmap for clients and their consumers. This role owns the payment experiences for consumers making payments, vendors receiving them, and partners integrating with REPAY. You will translate user needs into product decisions that make consumer payments simpler, faster, and more reliable. This opportunity plays a meaningful role on the team with the ability to improve everyday payment experience for consumers and the businesses they pay all while building market growth and strengthening our revenue streams.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Identify market opportunities, own and align the product development activities assigned by maintaining a rolling four quarter product roadmap
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Sales, Technology, Operations, as well as REPAY clients, and partners to drive product innovation and roadmap decisions
* Execute on delivery of product initiatives by fostering close coordination with Engineering and QA teams
* Actively engage with cross-functional teams to execute on integrated roadmap capabilities and Go-to-Market (GTM) efforts
* Improve the external customer experience to drive product usability, task efficiency and adoption
* Maintain an expert level of product and market knowledge for the Consumer Payments business
* Prioritize and manage the Product backlog to rapidly deliver value to our customers
Collaborate with Technology to prioritize ongoing technology and security maintenance activities  

**SKILLS & EXPERIENCE NEEDED**

* 5+ years of Product Owner experience in consumer payments and financial technology with progressive responsibility
* Highly collaborative, with the ability to tailor business and technical discussions to diverse stakeholder audiences and lead teams from problem definition through solution evaluation and engineering delivery
* Skilled at problem-solving for maximum business and customer impact while balancing technical, risk, and operational needs
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to research, requirements and PRD development, user story creation, proof-of-concept development, and stakeholder communications
* Ability to translate stakeholder input into clear, actionable requirements for engineering teams
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile development environment
* Advise internal stakeholders on new product capabilities and deliver training on product functionality
* Collaborating on Go-To-Market planning and sales enablement activities in support of product launches
* Ability to engage REPAY clients in consultative discussions about their business challenges and how our products can help resolve them
* Proven ability to define and monitor user metrics—including adoption, activation, task completion, and support volume—to identify friction and prioritize improvements
* Well-organized and thorough; able to structure, analyze, and answer technical and business questions while balancing multiple competing priorities
*

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**

ACH Product Owner

**About your role:**

You will own product execution for Automated Clearing House (ACH) payments capabilities on the Finxact platform, from discovery through release and production optimization. You will work with engineering, operations, compliance, implementation and client-facing teams to deliver ACH features that support reliable processing, regulatory alignment and measurable client outcomes.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the ACH product backlog, feature priorities and release scope aligned to company goals, client needs and market demands.
* Define feature-level objectives and success metrics for ACH capabilities, including straight-through processing, exception rates, return rates and settlement timeliness.
* Develop requirements and acceptance criteria for ACH use cases, including origination, incoming processing, returns, Notifications of Change (NOCs), reversals and same-day ACH.
* Translate National Automated Clearing House Association (NACHA) rule updates and regulatory changes into actionable product requirements, controls and implementation plans.
* Lead cross-functional discovery and delivery with engineering, architecture, risk, compliance, operations and client-facing teams.
* Own ACH exception and decisioning experiences, including workflows for pay and return decisions, NOC handling and return file outcomes.
* Partner with Application Programming Interface (API) and platform teams to define ACH APIs, event flows and integration patterns with internal and external systems.
* Validate product increments through scenario-based testing and user acceptance, including edge cases across returns, NOCs and settlement windows.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 6+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis or product delivery within payments, banking, fintech or core processing environments.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with ACH payments, including origination, posting, exceptions, returns, NOCs and settlement operations.
* 3+ years of experience managing product backlogs, writing epics, features and user stories, and defining acceptance criteria for technology delivery teams.
* 3+ years of experience applying NACHA operating rules and governance expectations to ACH processing, controls and product requirements.
* Experience collaborating with compliance and risk stakeholders on ACH controls related to Regulation E (Reg E), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) requirements, fraud considerations and operational risk.
* Experience using operational and product metrics to prioritize enhancements, investigate defects and improve product reliability.
* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Business, Finance, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience with Finxact ACH concepts and configuration patterns, including network ACH controls and return or NOC behaviors.
* Familiarity with API-based product ecosystems and tools such as Postman for workflow validation.
* Understanding of Originating Depository Financial Institution
