At Businessolver, we believe benefits should be easy for everyone. We combine intelligent technology with human expertise to help organizations anticipate needs, simplify complexity, and create better experiences for employees and HR teams alike. Our people-first culture is built on innovation, accountability, and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful outcomes for the clients and communities we serve. Every role at Businessolver contributes to our mission of helping people thrive through benefits experiences that are smarter, simpler, and more human.

**Job Summary:**

A Product Manager owns well-defined feature work inside a product area and help convert customer and business needs into shipped outcomes. This role partners with engineering, design, Quality Assurance, implementation, operations, and client-facing teams to deliver quality features for participant and administrator experiences across Businessolver offerings. The Product Manager I learns Businessolver’s product domains, seasonal operating constraints, and product management mechanisms while building strong execution fundamentals.

**The Gig:**

* Own defined features or workflows from discovery through launch and post-launch follow-up.
* Write clear problem statements, user stories, acceptance criteria, success measures, and release notes.
* Partner with engineering and design to evaluate solution options, edge cases, dependencies, and sequencing.
* Use customer feedback, analytics, support signals, implementation feedback, and operational data to refine priorities.
* Prepare launch readiness plans, including support needs, internal communications, training, and risk tracking.
* Monitor adoption, quality, and operational outcomes after launch and drive follow-up improvements.
* Maintain roadmap and backlog hygiene for assigned work and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.
* Build working knowledge of Businessolver’s benefits administration domain, client delivery model, and compliance constraints.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Comply with all policies and standards.

**What you need to make the cut:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, design, analytics, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in product management or an adjacent role such as business analysis, operations, implementation, UX, engineering, client services, or product ownership, or demonstrated readiness to own defined product features with guidance.
* Accounting, Banking, Fintech, payment systems, or related experience is highly valued and can be a strong differentiator for this role.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear product artifacts.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and follow through on commitments.
* Comfort using customer feedback, metrics, and operational inputs to make local trade-offs.
* Familiarity with Agile development practices and product development workflows.
* Ability to use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support research, analysis, synthesis, drafting, prioritization, and product artifact development while following Businessolver data handling and governance expectations.
* Ability to balance strategic product thinking with hands-on execution, partnering closely with development teams to translate business needs into actionable solutions.
* Comfortable working "in the weeds" with engineers, including troubleshooting issues, reviewing technical requirements, writing scripts for production support and participating in the implementation discussions for several hours each week.

*The pay range for this position is 82K to 130K per year (pay to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data).*

*This role is eligible to participate in the quarterly bonus incentive plan.*

jobs.title: Product Manager, Lumina Data Platform
jobs.desc:
Overview

We are building a cloud-native data platform that ingests, governs, and serves data to product and analytics teams across the company. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two tightly connected sides of that platform: the sourcing of data into the platform, and the experience of the internal teams who consume it. You will decide which data sources we onboard and how, define the contracts and standards that keep that data trustworthy, and treat the platform's internal consumers — product engineering, analytics, data science, Agentic AI, and operations teams — as your primary customers.

This is a high-leverage role. The quality, coverage, and usability of the platform directly shapes what dozens of downstream teams can ship. You will translate ambiguous, cross-functional needs into a clear roadmap, and you will be measured on adoption, data reliability, and the speed at which internal teams can build on what you provide.

Responsibilities

What You'll Own

  • Data sourcing strategy — prioritize and manage the pipeline of internal and third-party data sources to onboard; weigh coverage, cost, licensing, quality, and effort to decide what gets ingested and in what order.
  • Source onboarding — define the intake process for new sources, from evaluation and vendor/provider assessment through ingestion, validation, and go-live; partner with data engineering on connectors, schemas, and SLAs.
  • Data contracts & standards — establish the schema, freshness, quality, and metadata standards that every source must meet, and the governance for changing them without breaking consumers.
  • Consumer management — own the relationship with the internal teams that consume the platform; run intake for their requests, maintain a clear prioritization framework, and keep a feedback loop that turns their needs into roadmap.
  • Adoption & reliability — define and track the metrics that matter — source coverage, data freshness and quality, consumer adoption, and time-to-onboard a new consumer — and act on them.
  • Roadmap & stakeholders — maintain the platform roadmap, communicate trade-offs and timelines, and align sourcing investments with the priorities of the teams you serve.
  • AI-forward delivery — use AI tools as a default part of how the work gets done — accelerating source evaluation, requirements, documentation, and consumer support — and champion AI-assisted workflows across the platform and its consumer teams.

Qualifications

What You'll Do Day to Day

  • Interview and shadow internal consumer teams to understand how they use data and where the platform slows them down.

  • Write clear requirements and data contracts, and partner with engineering to size and sequence the work.

  • Evaluate new data sources — internal systems and external providers — and make the call on what to onboard.

  • Triage and prioritize the consumer request queue against a transparent framework.

  • Report on platform health and adoption to leadership and to the teams who depend on you.

  • Reach for AI to move faster — drafting specs and docs, summarizing consumer feedback, prototyping, and profiling new data sources — and share what works with the team.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time on data, platform, infrastructure, or API products serving internal or technical users.

  • Data platform fluency — comfortable reasoning about data pipelines, warehouses/lakes, schemas, data quality, and governance; you can hold a credible technical conversation with data engineers.

jobs.desc:
Qaurs Techno Systems LLC is looking for a driven and strategic Product Manager to join our growing team in Cumming, GA. This is an exciting opportunity to shape innovative technology products from concept to launch in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. If you're passionate about building great products and leading cross-functional teams, we want to hear from you!

**6 Month Contract to start, expected to extend through 2027**

**Hybrid schedule (Monday-Wednesday onsite) at one of the following locations:**
================================================================================

* San Antonio, TX
* Houston, TX
* Denver, CO
* Findlay, OH

**About the Role:**  
  
This role is a backfill for a contractor position supporting three Agile teams: two teams focused on operational technology and field systems, and one team focused on analytics, intelligence, and predictive maintenance products. The Product Manager will partner closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, prioritize a large backlog, facilitate PI Planning activities, and drive product strategy across multiple initiatives.  
  
What makes this opportunity unique is that the clinet is looking for a true Product Manager, not an order taker. The hiring manager is seeking someone who can make sound prioritization decisions, challenge assumptions when necessary, balance competing business demands, and provide strategic guidance to stakeholders. Strong product management fundamentals, backlog management, product strategy, stakeholder engagement, and Agile/SAFe experience are critical to success in this role.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product backlog prioritization and roadmap planning
* Gather and refine business requirements
* Partner with Operations Excellence and Insights teams
* Facilitate PI Planning readiness and execution
* Evaluate competing priorities and make value-based decisions
* Communicate product direction and priorities to business and technical stakeholders
* Ensure delivery teams are focused on the highest-value initiatives
* Present updates and recommendations to leadership and business partners

**Required Skills**

* Product Management experience with roadmap and backlog ownership
* Strong product strategy experience
* Excellent prioritization and decision-making skills
* Stakeholder management and requirements gathering
* Agile / SAFe experience
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to influence stakeholders and push back when appropriate

**Preferred Experience**  
  
Operational Technology (OT) systems  
Industrial, manufacturing, utilities, or energy environments  
Oil & Gas industry experience  
Data analytics, insights, or predictive maintenance products  
Industrial control systems or field operations technology

**About Us:**

Qaurs Techno Systems LLC is a technology-focused company based in Cumming, GA, dedicated to delivering innovative and reliable solutions to our clients. Our team thrives on collaboration, creativity, and a shared commitment to excellence in everything we build. We pride ourselves on fostering a supportive work culture where talented professionals can grow, contribute meaningfully, and make a real impact.

Flexible work from home options available.

Kapitus is building a next-generation enterprise data and AI capability that replaces hundreds of legacy analytics workflows with governed, reusable business data products — moving the organization from producing reports to producing decisions.

As a Data Product Manager, you own data products through their full life cycle — from business problem and value hypothesis, through business case, build, launch, adoption, and usage reporting, to retirement of products and the legacy reports they replace. You are the bridge between business requirements, data engineering, governance, and customer-facing teams, and you manage products against outcomes business leaders recognize, not technical output.

This is a product-discipline role, not a hands-on engineering role. You must understand our architecture well enough to link requirements to it and hold credible conversations with engineers. Experience in our business vertical is required, not preferred: you will not be learning the language of lending on the job. AI fluency is an advantage, not a requirement.

**What You Will Do:**

* Identify business problems worth solving with data; clarify each product's value proposition — utility, decision enabler, or driver of new business value — and quantify expected impact before anything is built.
* Define outcome-driven metrics that link each product to business goals (revenue growth, cost, risk, customer experience), alongside standardized product KPIs — adoption, usage, quality, service levels, cost-to-serve — maintained in a metrics dictionary with agreed formulas and owners; avoid vanity metrics that measure activity instead of value.
* Own usage reporting and portfolio transparency: scorecards, value stories co-created with stakeholders, and regular reviews informing invest, pivot, or retire decisions.
* Own retirement: sunset policies, end-of-life roadmaps, and structured decommissioning for products — and legacy workflows — that fail to sustain business value.
* Elicit requirements through stakeholder interviews, focus groups, and customer journey mapping; translate vague, ill-defined needs into well-defined, testable product requirements with clear acceptance criteria.
* Turn requirements into product definitions engineering can build: named owners, defined consumers, data contracts, certified semantic definitions, quality thresholds, and service levels.
* Link every requirement to our platform architecture — layered data foundation, governed core entities, certified semantics, and serving channels (BI, APIs, ML, AI) — so products are built on the platform, not beside it.
* Champion prototyping and iteration: confirm value with consumers at every development stage rather than specifying once and walking away.
* Serve as the connective tissue between business requirements, data engineering, governance, and customer-facing teams, translating in both directions so needs and delivery stay aligned.

At Workwell North America, we're building technology that supports workforce programs used by clients, workers, and internal teams every day. We're looking for a Product Manager to own our North American EOR product experience within Talient and help shape how workforce management works at scale.

You'll partner with Engineering, Design, Operations, Support, and business leaders to solve complex challenges, improve user experience, and deliver products that create measurable value for our clients and teams.
  
This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area, influence product direction, and see the direct impact of your work on business outcomes.

**Why This Role Is Different**

* You'll own a product and business outcomes, not just projects. You'll make decisions, set priorities, and help shape the future of a key business platform.
* You'll work across the business. From Operations and Support to Sales and Leadership, you'll collaborate with teams that rely on Talient every day.
* You'll solve real-world challenges. Your work will improve workforce onboarding, compliance workflows, user experiences, and operational efficiency.
* You'll have visible impact. The improvements you deliver will be seen by clients, workers, and internal teams across North America.

**What You'll Own**

* Own the roadmap and priorities for Workwell's North American EOR product experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, compliance, and user experience.

**Product Delivery**

* Partner with Engineering, Design, and QA to bring new features and enhancements from idea to release.
* Define requirements, user stories, and success criteria that create clarity for development teams.
* Support testing, implementation, and adoption of new functionality.

Product Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Monitor product performance and user feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Drive enhancements that increase usability, adoption, and operational effectiveness.

You'll help deliver products that simplify workforce management, improve the user experience, and support Workwell's continued growth through practical, scalable, and measurable product improvements.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

Owns strategy, discovery, and roadmap prioritization for an assigned product or product area, translating customer and market insight into a validated, prioritized set of initiatives. Operates within UKI’s AI-driven development lifecycle (ADLC): uses AI tooling to validate problems and solutions before engineering time is committed, building working prototypes where that is the fastest way to reduce uncertainty, and writes requirements that engineers and AI agents can execute against. Partners with UX Design and Engineering to drive features from concept through launch, and partners directly with Engineering on delivery.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leads AI-accelerated discovery to validate problems and solutions before Engineering time is committed, partnering with UX Design on research, validation, and design review. When a working prototype is the fastest way to validate a problem, solution, or workflow, builds one with AI-assisted tools, tests it with customers and internal stakeholders, and carries the evidence into prioritization and requirements. Works alongside Engineering in the ADLC harness, from planning and selecting specialists and agents through the build, review, and fix loop, capturing learnings from each cycle and staying current on AI tooling. Writes unambiguous, testable requirements and acceptance criteria that engineers, designers, and AI agents can execute against, paired with a validated prototype or reference where one exists, and partners with Engineering to turn roadmap priorities into a delivery plan. Tracks and reports product-level success metrics after launch, and communicates roadmap status, tradeoffs, and risks to product leadership and stakeholders.

 **Requirements**

Required

* 3–5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS
* Experience owning discovery and roadmap decisions for a defined product area
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable saying no and explaining why
* Working familiarity with agile delivery models
* Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted prototyping and development tools (for example Claude, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or similar); able to produce a working prototype, not only a specification
* Experience working in an AI-assisted or AI-driven development lifecycle, or a demonstrated record of adopting new tooling and ways of working quickly

Preferred

* Experience with cybersecurity training, cyber ranges, workforce readiness, or learning platforms (LMS/LXP)
* Experience building for or selling to DoD, federal, or SLED customers, including familiarity with procurement, security, and compliance constraints
* Familiarity with cyber workforce competency frameworks (NICE Framework, DCWF, DoD 8140) and assessment-driven readiness models
* Prior Experience partnering with and directing a delivery team
* A portfolio of prototypes or shipped features you built or materially shaped with AI tooling

 **Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
* Short and long-term disability coverage for added security.
* Basic life insurance provided by the company.
* Optional supplementary life insurance policy available for additional coverage.
* UKI covers 100% of individual premiums for medical, dental, vision, disability, and basic life insurance.
* A 401k plan with a basic safe harbor matching (up to 4% match with a 5% contribution).
* Enjoy 15 days of PTO annually for vacation or sick leave.
* Benefit from 12 company holidays, aligning with 11 federal holidays, plus Christmas Eve.

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and complete life cycle of assigned product lines, from opportunity identification and concept development through launch, sustainment, and end of life. In alignment with the direction established by the Group Product Manager and company objectives, this role translates direct customer and end-user insights, market opportunities, and competitive analysis into product priorities and requirements. The Product Manager leads product management and commercial activities within the company’s Stage-Gate process and works cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, purchasing, operations, and finance to drive growth, profitability, competitiveness, and customer satisfaction.

**Essential Functions and Basic Duties**

* Manages the product line life cycle from opportunity identification and concept development through launch, sustainment, and end of life.
* Develops, maintains, and executes the strategy and prioritized roadmap for assigned product lines in alignment with the direction established by the Group Product Manager and company objectives. Netflix’s Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Data, AI & Experimentation Platforms accelerate product velocity and business impact by providing cohesive, reliable foundations for data, analytics, machine learning, and experimentation. We reduce friction across the insight-to-production loop so teams can move from questions to decisions and from prototypes to shipped features quickly, with confidence, and with measurable outcomes.

We enable teams to build and scale ML-powered products end-to-end with AI platform capabilities for training, model management, evaluation, observability, developer tooling, and production inference. We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead Data Developer & Analytics Experiences within the Analytics Platform & Experiences team.

Analytics engineers, data engineers, and data scientists will be your primary customers, while enabling business decision makers and insight builders to self-serve on governed, reusable metrics across tools. Partnering closely with engineering, design, and data leaders, you will shape product direction and deliver impactful capabilities across semantic modeling, developer productivity, and embedded GenAI.

jobs.title: Product Marketer
jobs.desc:
About Coval

Coval is the evaluation platform for enterprise voice AI, built by former Waymo engineers applying autonomous vehicle testing standards to help companies deploy and scale conversational agents to 10s of millions of calls a month. The platform gives engineering, product, QA, and operations teams the infrastructure to stress-test agents across millions of realistic scenarios before launch, monitor every live conversation in production, and continuously sharpen performance through human-in-the-loop review. Trusted by more than 80 customers like Chime and Zoom, Coval is the operations layer for voice interfaces, the next platform after mobile and web.

The role

We're looking for a Product Marketer to own how Coval sounds and what Coval says. You'll set the messaging and positioning for a fast-moving technical product, and you'll write the copy, emails, newsletters, and social content that carry it to customers. You'll be technical enough to understand what the platform does and why it matters to the engineering, product, QA, and operations teams who buy it, and a strong enough writer to make that clear to someone meeting Coval for the first time. This role rewards people who can move between strategy and execution in the same week, tightening a positioning doc one day and shipping a newsletter or a batch of social assets the next, while working with the founder, Sales, and Product to turn what we're seeing in the market into a clear, consistent story.

What you'll do

Own messaging and positioning

  • Define and maintain Coval's core company and product messaging, and keep it consistent from the website to the deck to the demo.
  • Turn new features and launches into clear positioning for each audience: engineering, product, QA, and operations teams across our core verticals.
  • Build the messaging foundations the rest of the team can use: value propositions, proof points, and language guidelines for Sales and customer-facing teams.

Write the copy

  • Own copy across the website, product pages, sales collateral, and launch materials.
  • Keep Coval's voice consistent and recognizable, and catch generic, AI-sounding phrasing before it ships.
  • Edit drafts from across the team until they sound like us.

Run email and newsletters

  • Write and ship our newsletter and lifecycle email, balancing thought leadership with product updates.
  • Track what gets opened and clicked, and use it to decide what to write next.

Create social and content assets

  • Turn customer conversations, product ships, and founder perspective into LinkedIn posts, X threads, and other short-form content.
  • Build the social assets that support events, launches, and campaigns.
  • Work from a content calendar and keep the cadence steady across channels.

Feed the loop with Sales and Product

  • Learn what customers are asking and what resonates, and bring it back into the messaging.
  • Know the difference between a one-off ask and a pattern worth building a message around.

Partner on joint marketing

  • Work with partners to tell stories together around new launches, integrations, and customer wins.
  • Plan and host joint events and content with partners, including webinars and podcasts, along with the blogs and social posts that go with them.
  • Make it easy for partners to co-promote Coval with ready-to-use copy, assets, and a clear point of contact.

Manage SEO

  • Own our SEO strategy and keep the blog, site, and product pages working together to drive organic traffic and demo requests.
  • Run keyword research and on-page optimization,

Lexia is looking for a Product Manager who can successfully identify and launch product features for the organization’s educator solutions. Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Product Manager II, you will turn complexity into clarity at speed, navigate competing priorities, and lead through influence, not control. This role is about solving what is hard to shape the future of movement.

You will build intelligent systems that anticipate marketplace needs, and improve the efficiency and reliability of Uber's marketplace at scale.

* **Build intelligent marketplace systems:** Partner with engineering, data science, and machine learning teams to develop advanced predictive models that anticipate supply and demand dynamics, inform real-time decisions, and continuously improve marketplace performance.
* **Shape the future of driver incentives:** Define and execute incentive strategies that activate earners at the right time and place, balancing immediate marketplace needs with long-term engagement, retention, and sustainable economics.

* 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping successful, consumer-facing mobile or web products.

* Deep understanding of marketplace mechanics and the intersection of digital and physical operations.

* Passionate about shipping magical, defect-free products and proa

============

Datasite is the essential infrastructure for M&A. Also comprising Grata, Blueflame AI, and Sherpany, we help dealbreakers find opportunities, manage transactions, and make key decisions.

Whatever your talents, you can find a place for them here. Get involved in some of the biggest business ventures today. Work with other gifted people around the world. Follow your ambitions, or discover a whole new path.

Can you help us simplify the complex, create great experiences, and deliver better outcomes? Then let's talk.

**Job Description:**

Grata is part of Datasite, the platform that runs a large share of the world’s M&A processes. That combination gives us a rare position: Grata knows the private company universe, and Datasite sees how deals actually get done. Derived Intelligence is the team that turns that proprietary data into new products.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Derived Intelligence – the datasets, scores, and signals we build on top of raw data. The portfolio covers derived scores, behavioral signals, and market indices that tell customers which private companies are likely to transact, who is likely to buy, and where the market is heading. You will define what these products measure, work with data science to build and validate the models behind them, and package them into the Grata platform and our MCP tooling.

The core of the job is both analytical and creative: looking at proprietary data across Grata, Datasite, and the wider Datasite family, and seeing a product in it that adds value for customers they can’t get anywhere else. The role requires rigor in defining what a score or signal means, measuring accuracy, setting requirements, and iterating as usage scales.

You will work closely with data scientists, machine learning and data engineers, full stack engineers, design, product marketing, and the commercial team. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, excels in a fluid environment, and transforms ambiguity into clear solutions. The ideal candidate is also deeply customer-obsessed, ensuring that their work consistently aligns with and addresses customer needs.

If you’re passionate about building innovative products, shaping the future of Grata’s data, and driving real impact for users, we’d love to hear from you. Grata is a hybrid company, which means our employees work from our NYC office (in Columbus Circle) on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Xsolla Ads
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT YOU**

The Xsolla Offerwall puts rewarded offers in front of players inside the games and apps of our publishers. A player opens the wall, picks an offer, completes it, and earns in-game currency. Whether they do depends on what they see: the offer card, the creative, the video, the playable, and the reward moment.

Those units come from several places. Some are native offers we render ourselves. Some arrive as VAST video, HTML or MRAID creatives, or OpenRTB Native assets from demand partners. Each format has its own rules, and each one has to look right in a publisher's game, on a phone, without breaking what the advertiser sent.

You'll own how offerwall ads look and perform. You'll decide which formats we support and how they render. You'll design what the player sees, and turn that into specs engineers can build from. You'll measure whether a change made players more likely to engage, and you'll use AI to make better creative faster than a manual process allows.

**ABOUT US**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

  

### **Responsibilities:**

**Ad experience and creative**

* Own the look and feel of every ad unit in the offerwall: offer cards, detail pages, video, playables, interstitials, and the reward flow.
* Set creative standards for advertisers and publishers: layouts, asset specs, safe areas, aspect ratios, and branding rules.
* Balance three groups who want different things: players want a clean experience, publishers want it to match their game, and advertisers want their brand shown properly.

**oRTB formats and rendering**

* Define how we support VAST, HTML and MRAID, and OpenRTB Native inside the offerwall, across Web, iOS, Android, and Unity.
* Write the requirements for format support: which VAST events we track, which MRAID calls we allow, and how Native assets map into our own templates.
* Work with Engineering on creative QA and rejection rules, so broken or non-compliant creatives get caught before a player sees them.

**Design to engineering**

* Turn ideas into Figma designs and prototypes that engineers can build without guessing.
* Write PRDs and acceptance criteria that cover states, edge cases, and device differences, not just the happy path.
* Work with our designers on the offerwall's design system, and keep it consistent across publishers and platforms.

**Experimentation and performance**

* Run A/B tests on layouts, creative treatments, and formats, and read the results yourself.
* Track the metrics that show whether the ad experience works: CTR, video completion rate, offer start and completion rates, IPM, and eCPM.
* Turn what you learn into a prioritized roadmap, and explain the tradeoffs to Engineering, Demand, and leadership.

**AI in creative and workflow**

* Find where AI can improve ad units: generating creative variants, adapting assets to new formats, auto-cropping and localization, and checking creative quality.
* Use AI tools in your own work: prototyping, writing specs, analyzing test results, and getting from idea to something testable faster.

**Cross-functional work**

* Work with Engineering, Design, Demand, Publisher Success, and Data every week.
* Give the Demand team clear creative guidelines they can share with advertisers.

jobs.desc:
**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for a Product Manager who can turn a complicated, regulated domain into software that feels obvious to use. You will own a meaningful slice of the Scriptly platform end to end, from understanding what pharmacies and partners actually need through to what ships and how it performs once it is live.

This is a hands-on role on a small team, and you will not be handed a fully formed backlog. Expect to spend real time with pharmacists, technicians, our Support and Success teams, and enterprise partners, then decide what matters most and make the case for it. You will work with Engineering daily and have the latitude to shape your area rather than administer it.

Our current roadmap spans clinical and dispensing workflow improvements, pharmacy automation and robotics integration, interoperability work including Surescripts and TEFCA participation, and expansion of our hub pharmacy capabilities. There is more opportunity in front of us than any one quarter can absorb, so prioritization is a core part of the job.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Own the Problem, Not Just the Backlog**
-----------------------------------------

* Develop deep knowledge of pharmacy operations and hub services, to the point where you can anticipate what customers need before they ask.
* Talk regularly with pharmacists, technicians, and pharmacy owners, and sit with our Support and Success teams to learn what actually generates friction.
* Translate customer needs, partner commitments, and regulatory requirements into clear problem statements and prioritized outcomes.
* Maintain and communicate a roadmap that leadership, Engineering, and customer-facing teams can all plan against.

**Define and Ship**
-------------------

* Write clear, complete requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, edge cases, and the reasoning behind the decision.
* Partner closely with Engineering through refinement, sprint planning, and delivery, staying available to answer questions and make tradeoff calls quickly.
* Work with design and engineering on interfaces that respect how busy a pharmacy actually is.
* Own release readiness, including documentation, internal enablement, and coordination with Support and Success before anything reaches customers.

**Measure and Iterate**
-----------------------

* Define what success looks like before you build, then track it after launch.
* Use product analytics, ticket trends, and direct customer feedback to decide what to improve, what to leave alone, and what to retire.
* Bring evidence to prioritization conversations so decisions are based on impact rather than volume of requests.

**Partner Across the Company**
------------------------------

* Support enterprise and manufacturer partner engagements by translating contractual and operational commitments into deliverable product work.
* Keep Sales, Support, Success, and Operations informed on what is coming, what changed, and what it means for customers.
* Contribute to integration and interoperability initiatives with vendors, robotics manufacturers, and industry networks.

**Other Duties Assigned**
-------------------------

* Performs related duties in support of department goals
* Assists with special projects and initiatives as needed
* Supports team members and cross-functional tasks during peak periods
* Other related duties as required to meet operational objectives

**Qualifications & Requirements**
=================================

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* 3+ years of product management experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work through a complex domain and become the person others come to for answers.
* Strong written communication, especially the ability to write requirements engineers can build from without guessing.
* Comfort working directly with engineers day to day in an agile process, including backlog grooming in Jira or a similar tool.

jobs.desc:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Product Manager, TMS & Operational Communications owns the day-to-day product health, configuration, user experience, and continuous improvement of EASE’s core transportation management system and operational communications platforms. The lasting problem this role exists to solve: the systems EASE operators depend on every day are healthy, current, well configured, easy to use, and support freight moving without unnecessary friction.

Reporting to the VP / Head of Product Foundations, this role serves as the accountable product owner for McLeod and sits within the Operate function of EASE’s brokerage model (Sell, Buy, and Operate). The role owns TMS workflows, configuration, product experience, adoption, and the business-facing roadmap. Platform & Analytics owns the underlying McLeod database, infrastructure, performance, backup, recovery, and backend reliability.

Success is measured by TMS health, process compliance and business outcomes, not by the number of tickets closed or changes completed. McLeod and operational communications should enable employees to execute consistently, reduce manual workarounds, recover quickly from user-impacting issues, and contribute to SPEED (Shipments Per Ease Employee Daily), EASE’s north star operational metric.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**TMS Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the product roadmap for McLeod TMS, translating operational needs, recurring friction, vendor capabilities, and business priorities into a clear sequence of improvements.
* Maintain a living view of TMS capabilities, configuration, open issues, enhancement requests, and roadmap decisions so the organization has one source of truth for the health and direction of McLeod.
* Partner with the VP / Head of Product Foundations to determine when a need should be solved through McLeod configuration or capability versus another EASE product or platform.

**Outcome Ownership & Measurement**

* Own the outcome metrics for this role, such as user-impacting TMS issue volume and resolution time, workflow adoption, manual workarounds eliminated, release adoption, configuration quality, and operational communications service performance.
* Set each objective with a baseline, a target, a date, and a counter-metric, working with Platform & Analytics on metric definitions and instrumentation where needed.
* Report progress in terms of TMS health, user impact, and business outcomes. Ticket counts, configuration changes, and releases completed are not measures of success on their own.

**TMS Health & Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain a current health view of McLeod, including open defects, recurring user issues, support cases, version currency, configuration risks, license utilization, and vendor commitments.
* Own business-side triage and escalation for TMS issues, ensuring every material problem has a clear owner, priority, communication path, and path to resolution.
* Keep McLeod in good standing by proactively managing lifecycle needs, support status, release readiness, documentation, and known product risks before they become operational disruptions.

**Workflow, Configuration & User Experience**

* Own McLeod workflow and configuration decisions for EASE operations, working directly with users to understand how orders, dispatch, carrier assignment, status management, billing handoffs, and other core workflows are performed.
* Identify and resolve recurring friction, duplicate entry, unnecessary steps, and manual workarounds, and determine whether the right response is configuration, process change, training, vendor capability, or a separate EASE product.
* Maintain clear and consistent standards for TMS configuration and functional ownership so changes are intentional, documented, tested, and aligned with how EASE operates.
* Partner with Product Foundations, Operations, and affected product pillars when TMS workflow changes have downstream impact on AMMI, Forge, integrations, reporting, or other internal produ

An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.

**Your Role**

As part of our ongoing transformation of financial systems and reporting, we are seeking a Finance BI Product Manager to own the Finance Power BI reporting product on behalf of the business. This role is essential to ensuring that Finance reporting is consistent, well governed, and aligned with business priorities, with clear metric definitions, a managed intake and prioritization process, and controlled releases.

You will serve as the main point of contact for report consumers across Finance, operations, and project leadership, setting definitions and priorities for the reporting backlog, holding release acceptance authority, and supervising the BI Reporting Analyst. Working closely with IT and the CORE Studio team, this role will coordinate the transition of Finance BI ownership, maintain the reporting catalogue and nomenclature standards, and drive adoption of Finance reporting with PMs, BEs, and PICs.

**What You'll Do**

* Act as the liaison between Finance, the wider business, and IT for all Financial reporting requests, running the intake process: assessing who else is affected, classifying net new versus enhancement, and assigning ownership.
* Set Finance definitions and priorities for the reporting backlog and hold release acceptance authority.
* Coordinate with IT and the CORE Studio team on hand off of non-Finance BI work, and any Workspace organization updates for existing non-Finance BI models and reports
* Manage the metadata layer: nomenclature alignment, currency and fiscal-calendar decisions, and the reporting catalogue and knowledge documentation.
* Supervise the BI Reporting Analyst, including delegation, day-to-day direction, and quality review.
* Partner with IT on platform efficiency, workflow and dependency planning, and technical escalation within the agreed support boundary.
* Drive adoption with PMs, BEs, and PICs, and represent Finance in the Finance and IT governance path for cross-domain changes.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong financial and accounting domain knowledge, with the ability to define and defend metric and measure definitions.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into reporting specifications and to say no to unprioritized work.
* Working Microsoft Fabric and Power BI literacy sufficient to assess feasibility, review the analyst's work, and hold technical conversations with technical colleagues. Development capability is useful but is not the primary requirement.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance data structures

At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

You'll be joining the Product Management team within T-Mobile's Data & Intelligence organization, serving product and platform needs across the enterprise. The team specializes in data domain and data platform product management, across a portfolio spanning data infrastructure, semantic layer development, and AI-enabled decision intelligence for both human and machine consumers.
  
  
As part of T-Mobile's Enterprise Transformation & AI organization, the team partners with the AI COE, AI Engineering, and program teams to deliver AI-enabled experiences for business partners and consumers. Our products enable the business to move from data access to data intelligence.
  
  
This role is essential for managing technical products that meet specific business objectives and customer needs within the organization. It involves owning the product lifecycle, including vision, strategy, technical delivery, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure successful outcomes. The role requires balancing customer insights, technical feasibility, and business goals to prioritize and deliver product features effectively. Success is measured by product performance, customer satisfaction, and the ability to drive growth through innovative solutions. The work impacts the organization by enabling cross-functional teams to deliver products that enhance customer experiences and achieve business results.

**Scope of the Role**

As a Product Manager, Technical, you'll own a product or feature area within a data domain — setting its roadmap, writing its requirements, and partnering directly with the engineering team that builds it. You'll influence decisions inside your own area and contribute to the domain roadmap around it.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for your product area by defining vision, strategy, and roadmap to align with business and technical goals.
* Conduct market and customer research to identify opportunities and inform product decisions based on data analysis and customer feedback.
* Translate product strategy into detailed features and user stories, managing the product backlog to support Agile development teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to coordinate release schedules and ensure timely product delivery.

jobs.desc:
Shift Digital is the leader in digital marketing program optimization. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Birmingham, Michigan, our comprehensive solutions help national brands and their local retailers measure, manage, and improve the performance of their digital marketing and sales initiatives.

Our Product & Engineering team is seeking a **Product Owner** to help support the strategy, development, and delivery of technology-driven products within the automotive space. This role is ideal for someone with early-career product ownership experience who enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology.

As a Product Owner, you’ll work closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate product goals into clear requirements, manage priorities, and help ensure features are delivered effectively. You’ll also participate in feature testing and validation, providing an opportunity to build both product and technical expertise.

**This position is based in our Birmingham, Michigan office and requires onsite work four days per week.**

### **Key Responsibilities & Highlights**

* Define and communicate product vision and roadmap priorities in alignment with Shift Digital’s strategic objectives.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, technical feasibility, and product needs.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to support the timely and effective delivery of product features.
* Serve as a key point of contact between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping ensure alignment on product goals, requirements, and milestones.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement and team collaboration.
* Develop and refine product features and strategies based on market trends, customer feedback, and business needs.
* Participate in manual feature testing and basic test case development to validate acceptance criteria.
* Incorporate testing and quality considerations into product planning to help ensure quality and user satisfaction.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships across engineering, product, and stakeholder teams.
* Clearly communicate product objectives, requirements, priorities, and updates through both written and verbal communication.

### **Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in product ownership or a related role, with an emphasis on technology-driven products.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Foundational understanding of product management principles and Agile methodologies.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Foundational understanding of database querying and working with web services.
* Willingness to participate in manual testing and develop basic test cases to validate acceptance criteria.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in product ownership, business analysis, or a similar role involving agentic models.
* Familiarity with the automotive industry and its technology landscape is a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Build Forge
jobs.desc:
**About CoLab**

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we've raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

**About the Role**

Mechanical engineering teams rely on a complex ecosystem of CAD, PLM, and enterprise systems to design, review, and manufacture products. At CoLab, we're building software that fits naturally into those workflows.

As a Product Manager for our Build Forge team, you'll own the product direction for how CoLab connects with the systems engineers use every day. Your goal is to make complex engineering workflows simpler, helping customers move seamlessly between CoLab and their existing tools.

This role requires more than traditional SaaS product management experience. We need someone who understands how engineering data moves through an organization, from CAD models and revisions to BOMs, change management, and PLM systems.

You'll work closely with customers, Engineering, Design, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, set priorities, and deliver solutions that create measurable value. One week you might be defining how CoLab integrates with Siemens Teamcenter, the next, you could be mapping a customer's engineering change workflow to identify where disconnected systems create unnecessary work.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* You've spent meaningful time in the CAD, PLM, or engineering software ecosystem. You understand the complexity of enterprise engineering environments and can connect technical details to real customer problems.
* You're equally comfortable discussing revision management with an engineering team and making product tradeoffs with developers.
* You bring curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to challenge assumptions respectfully. You don't need every answer upfront, but you know how to find the right people, ask better questions, and make progress.
* If your product experience is primarily in general-purpose SaaS and you're unfamiliar with mechanical engineering workflows, this likely isn't the right fit.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own the product roadmap for Build Forge, prioritizing CAD, PLM, and enterprise integrations.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows, including revision management, BOMs, engineering changes, and design collaboration.
* Translate complex customer needs into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver intuitive, reliable integrations and platform capabilities.
* Balance customer-specific integration needs with scalable solutions that benefit the broader customer base.
* Use customer feedback, adoption data, and business priorities to inform product decisions.
* Collaborate with Customer Success and other stakeholders to support adoption and continuously improve the product.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in technical B2B software.
* Strong domain knowledge of CAD, PLM, or Mechanical Engineering Lifecycle workflows.
* Experience with platforms such as PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE/ENOVIA, or Autodesk Vault.
* Understanding of engineer

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**Description**

Join Liberty Mutual’s US Retail Markets Servicing Solutions portfolio as a Product Owner I supporting our servicing platform — the internal application used by service representatives and independent agents to view policies, answer customer questions and get documents into customers’ hands.

Every service conversation starts with the same two questions: what does this customer have, and what do they need from me? The answer lives in documents, forms and policy data — and how quickly a representative or agent can find it, trust it and share it shapes the whole experience. This role helps make that answer easy to reach.

You’ll shape how policy information is presented, how documents and forms are found and delivered, and how the right people see the right things, with an experienced product leader and your manager alongside you as Liberty Mutual modernizes its policy systems. It’s a great place to grow as a product owner: real scope, real users and a team invested in your development.

**Why this role matters**

* Meaningful ownership, strong support: You’ll be the day-to-day product owner for the documents, forms and policy information experience, used by thousands of employees and tens of thousands of independent agents, with senior product partners on strategy and the harder calls.
* Critical to daily operations: Finding the right document, sending the right form and reading a policy correctly are among the most common actions in servicing. Small improvements add up fast.
* Ready for what’s next: As Liberty Mutual moves policies onto a modern platform, required forms, ID cards and proof of insurance need to be available from day one. You’ll help make sure they are.
* Trust and access built in: Role-appropriate access to documents and policy information protects our customers and keeps us compliant. You’ll help design experiences where every user group sees what it needs and nothing it shouldn’t.
* Room to learn: You’ll work with research, UX, engineering, architecture, compliance, distribution, enterprise program teams and peer product owners, building the cross-functional skills that define great product careers.

**What you’ll own**

You will help own three connected parts of the servicing experience:

* **Documents and forms:** Help define which documents and forms each user group should receive and how they can be delivered — email, fax, print or text — and make them easy to find, view and send. Partner with cross-functional teams on solutions that pre-populate form templates, and work with research, UX and engineering to design distribution experiences that feel effortless.
* **Policy summary:** Contribute to the strategy for what a representative or agent sees first when they open a policy — insured details, key dates, alerts such as pending cancellations and the signals that matter most in the moment. Talk directly with the people who use the platform to learn what they reach for, then partner with research, UX and engineering to turn it into a summary that answers the question before it’s asked.
* **Policy details:** Play a supporting role in making detailed policy data across insurance lines clear and accessible, accounting for differences by state, product and user type, so users can answer customer questions with confidence. Partner with research, UX and engineering to present that data in intuitive ways that make servicing faster, not busier.

**Key responsibilities**

*Product strategy and roadmap*

* Contribute to and help communicate the product vision and roadmap for documents, forms and policy information, in partnership with senior product leadership.
* Help balance the needs of internal employees and independent agents while supporting a consistent, converged experience where possible.

*Agile product ownership*

* Own and prioritize the day-to-day backlog across business needs, user feedback and program dependencies, with guidance on the bigger trade-offs.
* Write clear, testable user sto

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.desc:
### **#TeamNextdoor**

Nextdoor (NASDAQ: KIND) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 340,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at nextdoor.com.

### **Meet Your Future Neighbors**

At Nextdoor, we believe in the transformative power of community. Our Marketing team is lean but powerful, and each of us brings a diverse opinion and perspective because that is what we seek out and respect in others. We communicate our brand in a way that shows its value clearly, inspire neighbors and businesses to engage on the platform, and partner across the company to keep improving the neighbor and business experience. Our mission is to turn online connections into real-life connections, and you can help make that real.

We offer a warm and inclusive work environment with a hybrid model that blends time in the office with working from home.

### **The Impact You'll Make**

Small businesses are at the heart of every neighborhood, and most are short on time, passionate about their craft, and careful with every dollar. As our Product Marketing Manager for SMB, you will uncover what truly motivates a local business owner to show up on Nextdoor, earn the trust of their neighbors, and eventually advertise. You will own the SMB product marketing strategy, translating customer insights and long-range business goals into positioning, launches, and growth loops that fuel product-led growth.

You will be the voice of the small business owner in product decisions, including 0-to-1 product requirements, and a resourceful operator who finds unconventional ways to reach them. You will use AI as a daily partner to create, investigate, and collaborate, and you will help deliver new experiences to millions of customers worldwide over the next year.

You should be entrepreneurial, endlessly curious, strategic, and willing to roll up your sleeves. If you want the challenge of fast-paced growth, the satisfaction of helping local businesses succeed in every community, and the pride of helping build a talented marketing team, this is the place for you. We strive to give employees the opportunity to make a big impact in the company and in the market.

### **Your responsibilities**

* Build first-hand understanding of small business owners: their goals, what success looks like to them, and what makes them engage in community and choose to advertise. Talk to them regularly.
* Be the product expert, internally and externally, for our small business customers and partners.
* Develop impactful positioning and breakthrough messaging that makes Nextdoor's value to local businesses clear and differentiated.
* Identify and prioritize the most promising opportunities to grow SMB adoption. Design and run low-cost or no-cost growth experiments (e.g. partnerships, local associations, earned and community-led channels, referrals, product-led loops), and turn the wins into repeatable approaches. Share what you learn, including the misses.
* Lead product launches and feature releases across multiple channels to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Use AI daily to create, investigate, and collaborate: synthesize customer signal, prototype messaging and campaigns, analyze data, and build repeatable workflows your teammates can adopt.
* Identify insights from the competitive landscape, voice of customer, NPS, and market trends, and turn them into recommendations that shape and influence the product roadmap.
* Build analytical business cases and measurable KPIs for experiments and product marketing plans. Evaluate results and recommend where to scale, change direction, or stop investment.
* Define priorities and execution for SMB product marketing and align leadership and cross-functi

jobs.title: Product Owner, Digital Workspace
jobs.desc:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

**Position Overview:**  
Dutch Bros is on a mission to make a massive difference one cup at a time. We're a high-growth, people-first company that values "love, acceptance, and kindness". Behind every cup we serve is a connected workplace - the tools, workflows, and AI capabilities that keep our shop crews, regional leaders, and corporate teams moving together. We’re seeking a Product Manager, Digital Workplace to join the Technology team at Dutch Bros. This role owns the digital employee experience end to end - the collaboration, communication, content, and workflow automation tools our people use every day - and it is deliberately hands-on. Microsoft 365 is the anchor of that portfolio (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Viva, and the Power Platform), alongside the AI capabilities we deliver through Microsoft 365 Copilot and agentic solutions. In this role you won’t just manage a tech stack; you will be in it. You will study how work actually gets done across corporate, regional, and shop teams, find where time is lost to manual and duplicated effort, and then build the fix yourself - configuring the tenant, standing up Teams and SharePoint solutions, and shipping Power Platform flows, apps, and Copilot agents. You will take Copilot and agentic AI programs from prototype to enterprise scale, defining success measures and reporting business value in hours returned and cost avoided. Adoption is the product. You will build enablement at scale through a digital workplace Champions network, interactive workshops, and self-service resources you author yourself, and partner closely with Information Security, Infrastructure, Data, People, and Communications to ensure workplace and AI tools adhere to data governance, licensing, compliance, and cybersecurity standards. This is a builder’s product role. It requires strong product ownership, hands-on depth in modern workplace and collaboration technology, a willingness to work directly in admin centers and low-code tools, and the ability to translate technical capability into simple, inspiring, and actionable language for non-technical teams.  
  
**Job Qualifications:**

-----------

**Digital Engagement & Commerce requires a dedicated Product Manager to build and scale AI-powered parts experiences across Shop.Deere.com, Deere.com, and Unified Parts Experience.**

This role will lead a dedicated development team and own the full product lifecycle for Parts AI capabilities: customer and dealer discovery, product direction, roadmap, backlog, requirements, delivery, release readiness, adoption, quality, and measurable business outcomes. This role will be responsible for delivering scalable, cloud-native, and intelligent contact center solutions that enhance member and provider engagement, improve operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with healthcare industry standards.

* Own vendor relationships, contracting, and governance for telephony, transcription, workforce management, and analytics tools.
* Champion agile methodologies, backlog prioritization, and sprint execution across cross-functional teams.
* Drive change management, training, and adoption strategies across operational teams to ensure successful platform transition.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years leading initiatives in contact center platforms or voice automation within a healthcare payer setting.
* Strong understanding of healthcare call center operations, including member services, provider support, care management, and utilization review.
* Proven experience with Amazon Connect migration projects, including integration with AWS services, telephony architecture, and IVR design.
* Solid knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling, and security best practices in cloud communications.
* Experience with voice UX, IVR design, and contact center reporting/analytics.
* Strong business and technical acumen with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear user stories and product features.
* Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional teams, executive stakeholders, and vendor partners.
* Expertise in agile frameworks, especially SAFe or Scrum, and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Productboard.

**Education**:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or related field required.
* Master’s degree or certifications in Product Management, Cloud Technologies (especially AWS), or Healthcare IT preferred.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Careers
jobs.desc:
Infobase exists to power informed decisions. For decades, schools, libraries, and institutions have turned to our resources to build information literacy and help learners develop the skills they need to succeed long after the classroom. We build the platforms and content that make that possible, and right now we're growing the team behind them.

Job Summary

    The Product Manager, Careers sets product direction for Infobase’s careers and career and technical education (CTE) offerings, with the goal of significantly expanding sales in middle school, high school, community college, and public library markets. The role focuses on four areas: a careers strategy built around Advance CTE pathways and career development (guidance and assessment) at the middle school, high school, and university levels; an expanded CTE emphasis within that strategy; an assessment partnership that enables quick expansion; and modern product workflows that help the product grow across these markets. This senior individual-contributor role combines product management with content management for the careers and CTE portfolio, working in close partnership with the Vault leadership team, content teams, platform leadership, and Infobase’s enterprise-level engineering team, and building alignment through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority. The Product Manager, Careers owns the vision and roadmap for this area on an ongoing basis and may be assigned other product initiatives based on organizational needs and the publishing and release cycle of the careers product line.

Essential Functions

    Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

    • Define product vision and strategy for careers and CTE offerings across middle school, high school, community college, and public library markets, grounded in customer-centric design, market analysis, competitive dynamics, revenue analysis, and customer research.
    • Own and prioritize the roadmap, including technology and content, making the tradeoffs needed to balance customer value, business priorities, and delivery capacity.
    • Shape an expanded CTE emphasis within the careers strategy, aligned to Advance CTE pathways and to workforce-relevant outcomes at the high school and community college levels.
    • Build the business case for significant product investments and partnerships, including tradeoffs, revenue impact, and expected results, and present recommendations to product and executive leadership.

      • Partnerships & Assessment Integration

      • Identify assessment and video partnership opportunities, outline deal points, and serve as the frontline contact for those partners.
      • Own a potential assessment partnership, including integration requirements, delivery sequencing for quick expansion, and tracking of partnership outcomes.
      • Define how assessment results connect to careers content and learning assets, including careers videos and career guides, so users move from assessment to exploration to planning.
      • Shape career development experiences (guidance and assessment) for middle school, high school, and university learners.

        • Content Management

        • Manage the careers and CTE content portfolio, including careers videos and career guides, setting priorities for what is created, updated, acquired, or retired.
        • Identify content gaps against Advance CTE pathways, workforce-relevant outcomes at the high school and community college levels, and the needs of a partner assessment.
        • Work with editors and external content partners to plan, commission, and review content, holding it to standards for accuracy, quality, and alignment to pathways.
        • Manage content creation through external vendors

North Dakota Information Technology (NDIT) is seeking a **Product Owner** to join a product team supporting the North Dakota Department of Health & Human Services' Self-Service Portal and Consolidated Eligibility System (SPACES). The Product Owner will collaborate with the Executive Product Owner and/or Senior Product Manager, to be a trusted partner to the business units and use expertise to manage prioritized user stories through the development process to conclusion, including defining dependencies, event sequences and expected outcomes. This position supports the business unit(s) in the definition and maintenance of the Product Backlog and must possess strong interpersonal skills with the ability to listen, build rapport, and earn credibility as a strategic partner within the business unit(s), stakeholders and Scrum or Kanban Teams which include Vendor developers.

* Demonstrate a knowledge of product owner as a practice, SDLC (software development life cycle) and agile frameworks.
* Oversee the development of the product through all its stages, including the planning, refinement, review, and sprint for each event.

* Communicate through spoken word and in writing to a variety of stakeholders.
* Be flexible and able to learn quickly in a rapidly changing technology landscape.

OR  
Associate degree in business administration, computer science, or a closely related field, and four years of current and progressively responsible professional-level practical work experience with agile, customer relationship management, business and technical requirements analysis and elicitation, and writing and reviewing user stories.
  
OR  
Six years of current and progressively responsible professional-level practical work experience with agile, customer relationship management, business and technical requirements analysis and elicitation, and writing and reviewing user stories.

This position can be based anywhere in North Dakota (or a border community such as Moorhead, MN, East Grand Forks, etc). If selected candidate lives within a 50 miles radius of NDIT offices in Bismarck or Fargo, they will work on site one day a week. Otherwise, this position will work remotely.

**Product Manager**

**Team: Marketing**  
**Reports to: Sr. Director of Growth Initiatives**  
**Location: On-site, Corporate Office (Delray Beach)**

**Company Overview:**

Now Optics is a leader in the eye care industry. Its retail brand, Stanton Optical, is amongst the fastest-growing, full-service retail optical centers. The company consistently ranks among the largest optical retailers in the country by Vision Monday. Now Optics continues to expand its retail footprint with 300+ corporate and franchise locations while delivering affordable eye care services by providing a fast and friendly customer experience. We believe in building a positive and cohesive culture where everyone is contributing towards a common goal and set of values.

**Vision:** **Modernizing the eye care experience for all people.**

**Mission:** **Making eye care easy.**

**Values: iCARE**

* **Integrity**: We see integrity as building a foundation of trust with our customers, employees and stakeholders by communicating honestly, ensuring consistency and delivering on our commitments.

* **Collaboratio**n: We see collaboration as combining the talents of a diverse group, offering proactive communication and being open-minded to new ideas.

* **Accountability:** We see accountability as taking initiative, delivering our best in all we do, accepting responsibility for our actions and taking ownership of results.

* **Respect:** We see respect as prioritizing human relationships, being present, connecting with transparency and empathy.

* **Empowerment:** We see empowerment as making purpose-driven decisions to support the company vision, showing appreciation for others, and taking care of the individuals, we serve.

**Role Summary**

The Product Owner is the business-facing owner of our proprietary POS/Ecomm software backlog and roadmap. You turn commercial priorities into well-justified initiatives, align stakeholders on what gets built and in what order, and work with IT development to deliver and launch. You recommend priorities and scope trade-offs. You work alongside the Business Analyst, who owns POS/Ecomm system requirements, BRDs, and UAT, and the Sr. UX/UI Designer, who owns the design and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product vision and roadmap

* Maintain the POS/Ecomm software roadmap, aligned to commercial and growth goals set by the Sr. Director.

* Bring customer and associate insight into prioritization, working with the Sr. UX/UI Designer on research and feedback.

Backlog, prioritization, and delivery

* Draft and maintain the POS/Ecomm software backlog with proposed prioritization for Sr. Director approval.

* Refine backlog items with the BA, BRM, and IT dev. Review and approve acceptance criteria drafted by the BRM against the business case.

* Draft trade-off and scope recommendations when priorities conflict, including deferring features within a BRD to a later release.

* Draft sprint goals in partnership with IT.

* Participate in sprint reviews and accept completed work against the business case and acceptance criteria. The BA signs off on requirement fidelity separately.

Business case and initiative definition

* Write initiative briefs that combine the business case (why this, why now, expected outcome) with a clear problem statement. These feed the BRD process.

* Flag D365/VCS dependencies in initiative briefs early, so the VCS & D365 BA is engaged before BRD work begins.

* Review BRDs, authored by the BA, against the business case and flag gaps or concerns.

* Define success metrics for each initiative and track outcomes after launch, reporting results to the Sr. Director and sponsors.

Stakeholder alignment

* Run standing weekly or biweekly priority meetings, structured by group so D365-dependent and non-dependent groups meet separately. Drive each meeting to explicit agreement on upcoming priorities and review newly surfaced items.

* Support alignment conversations with commercial (ecommerce and brand)

**About Us:** Prometric is a leading provider of technology-enabled testing and assessment solutions to many of the world’s most recognized licensing and certification organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies. We support more than 7 million test takers annually at our testing locations in 180 countries around the world. With over three decades of experience working with clients of all sizes across a multitude of industry sectors, our mission is to design and deliver the highest quality and most innovative testing solutions anytime, anywhere.
  
  
**JOB TITLE:** Product Owner
  
**REPORTS TO:** Product Manager
  
**DEPARTMENT:** Product Management
  
**LOCATION:** Remote
  
  
Job Overview
  
Help bring AI to education and certification. Our team exists to deliver AI-centered features for the education and certification industry. As Product Owner, you'll lead and organize that work, turning product vision into a clear, prioritized backlog the engineering team can deliver with confidence.
  
You'll sit between two groups of experts. On one side are the subject matter experts, educators and certification bodies who understand learning and assessment deeply. On the other are the AI engineers and scientists working with a technology that changes month to month. You won't need to be an expert in either; your job is to learn quickly from both, ask the right questions, and make sure each side understands what the other needs, so that real-world problems become features the team can build.
  
You won't just execute the vision; you'll help shape it. Working closely with the Product Manager, you'll bring what you learn from users, experts and the delivery team to the roadmap for your area.
  
About Us
