jobs.title: Data Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Description Summary**

‎

The Data Product Manager is a senior, self-directed product leader accountable for the strategy, roadmap, lifecycle, adoption, and measurable outcomes of one or more significant enterprise data and analytics product domains. Working with minimal oversight, this role determines the product management approach, makes consequential prioritization and lifecycle decisions within delegated authority, and leads complex, multi-quarter initiatives spanning clinical, operational, financial, population health, regulatory, and consumer functions.  
The role addresses ambiguous and systemic business and data challenges for which established solutions may not exist. It partners with senior business, clinical, technology, analytics, and governance leaders to frame problems, evaluate trade-offs, align investments, and translate organizational strategy into scalable data products and capabilities.  
Operating within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), the Data Product Manager provides strategic direction to Product Owners and cross-functional delivery teams, establishes outcome measures and decision frameworks, and remains accountable for value realization rather than delivery alone. The role also strengthens data product management capability by mentoring colleagues, leading cross-functional working groups, and developing reusable practices and standards.

‎

**How will you make an impact & Requirements**

‎

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Define product strategy and vision:** Independently establish enterprise data and analytics product strategies, business cases, and multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities, healthcare needs, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own prioritization and the product lifecycle:** Direct investment, scope, sequencing, and lifecycle decisions—from discovery through retirement—balancing business value, risk, dependencies, capacity, feasibility, and total cost of ownership.
* **Lead stakeholder alignment:** Partner with senior business, clinical, technology, and governance leaders to frame complex problems, resolve competing priorities, communicate trade-offs, and build alignment without formal authority.
* **Guide SAFe product delivery:** Provide strategic direction to Product Owners and Agile Release Trains, lead Program Increment planning preparation, resolve delivery barriers, and ensure delivered capabilities achieve intended business outcomes.
* **Embed data governance and responsible use:** Integrate data quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, interoperability, and applicable AI/ML controls into product strategy, delivery, and lifecycle management.
* **Drive adoption and measurable value:** Establish KPIs and outcome measures, lead cross-functional adoption and change strategies, monitor product performance and benefits, and recommend improvements, scaling, consolidation, or retirement.
* **Strengthen product management capabilities:** Mentor colleagues, provide functional leadership, lead cross-functional working groups, and develop reusable standards, methods, and decision frameworks that improve product management across the organization.

‎

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager who combines deep securities finance knowledge with the ability to turn complex market needs into intuitive, practical product solutions.

From understanding trading and operational workflows to shaping requirements, prioritizing improvements, and delivering releases, you will own meaningful product initiatives end to end.

This is a unique opportunity to join one of the fastest growing fintechs in Securities Finance, operating at the intersection of technology and financial markets.

* Good understanding of trading, operational, and post-trade workflows.
* Ability to analyze complex problems and translate business requirements into practical, well-defined solutions.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with trading desks and technology teams.
* Ability to take ownership, work independently, and manage multiple priorities.
* Previous Product Management or Business Analysis experience is a plus.
* Previous experience in fintech companies or banking institutions is a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Observability – remote in the US
jobs.desc:
Job Summary

Mirantis is looking for a Technical Product Manager to own observability for k0rdent AI, our control plane for GPU infrastructure and distributed AI workloads. In this role, you will define the observability strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities that determine how operators gain visibility into the health, performance, and resource utilization of GPU clusters running large-scale training and inference. You will shape how k0rdent AI handles everything from GPU-level metrics and distributed tracing across AI workloads, to multi-tenant log aggregation and intelligent alerting — powered by the OpenTelemetry ecosystem, and Prometheus-compatible metrics pipelines.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency in observability tooling and the AI infrastructure stack. You will work directly with engineering to shape requirements, with marketing to define positioning, and with customers to help ensure their success.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and priorities for k0rdent AI observability across the full stack: GPU compute, east-west fabric (InfiniBand, RoCE), high-performance storage, DPU/SmartNIC telemetry, workload schedulers, inference serving, and data services

  • Translate requirements from NeoClouds, GPU clouds, telcos, sovereign clouds, and enterprise platform teams into clear product direction; partner with engineering to define requirements and evaluate trade-offs

  • Manage the observability backlog using feedback from production deployments and design partners to refine priorities

  • Track and shape our response to emerging observability standards and technologies, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), DCGM GPU metrics, InfiniBand/RoCE fabric counters, storage platform telemetry APIs, and AI workload profiling

  • Define integration strategies for vendor telemetry sources across the ecosystem — NVIDIA compute and BlueField DPUs, storage platforms (VAST, Weka, DDN), workload managers (SLURM), inference stacks, and vector and relational databases — into a unified, operator-facing observability plane

  • Partner with product marketing and field teams on positioning, technical briefs, and reference architectures; represent Mirantis with customers, analysts, and ecosystem partners

  • 5+ years in product management or a senior technical role owning an observability product or operating large-scale monitoring infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing (Jaeger, Tempo), and log aggregation (Loki, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch)

  • Fluency in Kubernetes observability, cloud-native monitoring, or metrics and alerting pipeline architecture

  • Ability to work directly with engineering on technical trade-offs and with field teams in competitive GPU cloud and NeoCloud deals

Strongly Preferred:

  • Exposure to GPU observability, including DCGM metrics, AI workload profiling and performance analysis

  • Familiarity with east-west fabric telemetry - InfiniBand counters, RoCEv2 congestion metrics (ECN, PFC, DCQCN), or switch-level fabric health

  • Experience with high-performance storage telemetry from platforms such as VAST Data, Weka, or DDN, including IOPS, latency, and throughput instrumentation at scale

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA BlueField DPU telemetry, SR-IOV, or offload pipeline observability

  • Exposure to workload-level visibility for SLURM job scheduling, inference serving stacks (vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM), or data service telemetry from vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant) and relational databases in AI pipelines

jobs.desc:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

IAM is the nerve center of Stripe. We control how millions of businesses grant access to their account, including employees, AI agents, apps, and API integrations, across the Dashboard, API, CLI, and MCP. We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on.

AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives.

What you’ll do

You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it.

  • Design the experience of granting access, everywhere. Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app.
  • Make agents a first-class citizen. Define how agents authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for the actions that matter most. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard.
  • Drive least privilege, made easy. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and usage-based recommendations that make the secure choice the obvious one instead of the tedious one.
  • Push toward a world without secrets. Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe, eliminating API key leaks as a category of risk rather than reducing their blast radius.
  • Partner across nearly all of Stripe. Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you, even though none of them report to you.
  • Ship, learn, and iterate: Run experiments, follow real usage, and adjust quickly rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

The hardest part of this job, and the most fun, is the constant trade-off: usability vs. security, flexibility vs. simplicity. It takes taste to find a shape that feels effortless for a solo founder and holds up at Fortune 500 scale.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in product management, shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on
  • Background in security, identity, auth, or developer platforms, or serious curiosity about the space
  • A habit of talking to users to find the real problem, not the reported one
  • Tech

jobs.desc:
**Job Title:** Data Product Manager
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
The Data Product Manager owns the delivery and success of one or more of NVA’s data products, working hand-in-hand with business partners to co-own the product roadmap and ensure the product serves clinical, operational, growth, or financial needs. Reporting to the Director of Data Products, the Data Product Manager sets priorities for their product together with their POD (product-oriented delivery team), collaborates with business product owners, Data Engineering, BI/Analytics, AI, and Data Governance to drive delivery, and actively champions adoption of the product with business partners. This is an individual-contributor role focused on turning business needs into trusted, high-quality, widely used data products that are aligned to NVA’s broader data strategy and deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Reports To:** Director, Data Products
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing (Key Responsibilities):**  

* Co-own the roadmap for your assigned data product(s) together with business partners, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, sequenced product backlog.
* Set and continuously reprioritize the backlog for your product with your POD (product-oriented delivery team), balancing business value, effort, and dependencies.
* Partner with business product owners and domain stakeholders to define product requirements, success criteria, and acceptance criteria for each release.
* Manage stakeholder expectations on scope, timing, and trade-offs for your product, communicating status, risks, and decisions clearly and proactively.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure your product is built on reliable, scalable data pipelines and platform architecture, and to sequence delivery within POD capacity.
* Work with BI/Analytics and AI teams to incorporate reporting, self-serve analytics, and AI/ML capabilities into your product where they add value.
* Partner with Data Governance to ensure your product meets standards for data quality, definitions, lineage, and compliance, and aligns to NVA’s broader data strategy.
* Define and track the metrics that measure your product’s success—adoption, data quality, business impact, and time-to-value—and use them to guide priorities.
* Drive the end-to-end delivery of your data product—from discovery and definition through build, testing, launch, and iteration—removing blockers and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Promote and champion adoption of your product with business partners through demos, enablement, documentation, and ongoing support, actively driving usage.
* Gather and synthesize user feedback, monitor product performance, and continuously improve the product to better serve business needs.
* Stay current on data product management practices, tooling, and emerging technology (including AI), and apply them to improve how your product is built and adopted.

**Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (Qualifications):**

jobs.desc:
**Job Summary**

We are accepting applications from individuals with backgrounds in product management, product strategy, and requirements to join our expert network for future independent project consideration. Potential projects involve carefully reviewing AI-generated explanations and examples, examining assumptions, and identifying where proposed answers are inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading.

**Apply at https://work.atasc.ai/join?entry=profile**

**Duties**

Depending on the scope of a future project, contributions may include:

* Review AI-generated explanations and examples involving product management, product strategy, and requirements.
* Evaluate product decisions, including their assumptions, supporting evidence, tradeoffs, and intended outcomes.
* Identify unclear requirements, overlooked user needs, unsupported recommendations, and misleading conclusions.
* Assess how proposed features or product changes affect different user groups, including less visible or underserved users.
* Examine whether proposed success metrics and release criteria support a measurable product decision.
* Provide clear feedback and suggest checks that could strengthen an answer without claiming research, tests, or outcomes that have not been completed.

**Experience**

* Relevant background in product management, product strategy, requirements definition, or related work through professional experience, research, relevant study, or practical projects.
* Ability to explain your individual contributions, decisions, and methods for checking your conclusions.
* Strong analytical reasoning and attention to detail when examining product proposals, requirements, evidence, and competing priorities.
* Ability to communicate ideas clearly and identify missing information or misleading reasoning.

Applicants at different career stages, including those with early-career experience, are welcome. Describe your background and contributions honestly. A human reviewer evaluates your contributions and supporting evidence rather than assuming expertise from a job title.

**Application Process**

Applicants must be **18 or older**. Complete one profile application with your background, education, résumé, and responses to short expertise questions. Select all specialty areas that match your experience.

For this specialty, the intake includes the following example:

*A requested feature benefits frequent users but blocks a less visible group. Explain how you would examine evidence, compare tradeoffs, and define a measurable release decision.*

Focus on your reasoning and proposed checks. Do not disclose confidential work or present unperformed research, tests, or outcomes as completed results.

Profiles are reviewed before any later verification steps. Identity documents and a separate expertise file are not required to apply. Submitted evidence is not automatically considered verified.

Approval means eligibility for future project matching, not professional licensure or guaranteed work. Any assignment depends on availability and agreed project terms. Compensation is agreed separately for each actual project.

**This is an application for future project consideration, not a currently open paid assignment or funded vacancy.** Enrollment is free. Acceptance into the network does not guarantee assignments or earnings.

Pay: $25.00 - $45.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

**Job Description:**

Vertex is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented **Platform Experience Product Manager** to lead the delivery of the connected tax platform experience. This role is responsible for orchestrating Vertex products into a unified, intuitive, and seamless customer experience, eliminating the friction of disparate logins, data re-entry, and inconsistent interfaces across the Vertex product portfolio.

This individual will partner closely with Engineering, UX, Architecture, and Product teams to translate business and customer requirements into engineer-ready specifications and deliver a scalable, cohesive platform experience. The ideal candidate combines strong technical communication skills, sound product judgment, and the ability to navigate and prioritize across multiple competing product teams. This role operates with significant autonomy within a collaborative, execution-focused product management organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Orchestrate the delivery of a unified, seamless platform experience across Vertex products; serve as the connective layer between commercial strategy, engineering execution, and UX design to eliminate customer friction across the product portfolio.
* Translate business and customer requirements into engineer-ready specifications with appropriate technical specificity, including volume, security, and deployment considerations; bridge the gap between strategic intent and technical implementation.
* Lead platform feature development from ideation through launch; define detailed acceptance criteria and partner directly with engineering teams to ensure delivery against requirements.
* Navigate competing priorities across multiple product teams; negotiate trade-offs decisively to establish clear sequencing and ensure the platform roadmap reflects the highest-value customer experience improvements.
* Partner with UX and Engineering teams to design and deliver intuitive, consistent platform experiences; ensure coherence across platform services, applications, and customer-facing workflows in an Agile development environment.
* Use data and KPIs to guide product decisions and measure the impact of platform features and releases against business and customer experience objectives.
* Serve as subject matter expert for the connected platform experience; engage directly with customers and partners to understand pain points and validate that delivered solutions meet intended outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience with a demonstrated track record in SaaS or cloud-based solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and customer requirements into engineer-ready specifications with appropriate technical specificity; baseline fluency in APIs, agile development, and software architecture sufficient to communicate credibly with engineering teams.
* Proven ability to navigate competing priorities across multiple product teams; track record of decisive trade-off negotiation and clear sequencing decisions in complex, multi-product environments.
* Strong experience partnering with UX and Engineering teams to design and deliver intuitive, consistent platform experiences; ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and drive execution across competing priorities.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated proficiency using data and KPIs to guide product decisions and measure feature and business impact.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present priorities, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and leadership audiences.
* Highly organized and self-directed; demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience defining and delivering SaaS platform capabilities, including shared services, platform APIs, or multi-product integration.
* Experience working across multi-product ecosystems

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. jobs.title: Product Manager, Employee Experience & Productivity
jobs.desc:
Summary
  
  
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple — from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios.
  
  
Description
  
  
We are seeking a AI-Driven Product Manager to partner with our stakeholders in the Apple Services organization to deliver internal products and platforms that power their business operations. In this role, you'll own cross-functional initiatives that enable our global teams to work more efficiently, scale seamlessly, and deliver exceptional experiences to our business leaders worldwide. As an AI-Driven Product Manager, you'll build internal products and platforms to deliver maximum impact for stakeholder teams. As new business requirements evolve, you will craft the story, explore alternative solutions and define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your portfolio of products.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in a product management role leading product development cycles from concept to launch, and shipping products at scale.
* 4+ years of experience working cross-functionally with peer teams such as software engineering and UX Design or other technical teams.
* 4+ years of experience delivering products that support content workflows across the entertainment pipeline, including areas such as Music, Business Affairs, Marketing, Finance, Publicity, etc,, within a streaming, television, or film production environment.
* BS or MS degree in computer science, information management, or a technical field, or equivalent experience.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Expert in identifying complex requirements, aligning them to business objectives, and building functional engineering requirements.
* Strong prioritization skills, with the ability to balance multiple projects and programs of varying lengths while managing trade-oﬀs that align strategically to the vision of your portfolio and the product organization.
* Advanced skills in analyzing product data to advise both long-term strategy and short-term solutions that will delight employees.
* Proven ability to break down complex problems into steps that drive agile product development in partnership with UX and engineering teams.
* Hands-on experience designing, shipping, or integrating AI-powered tools and experiences that meaningfully augment employee productivity.
* Proficient with visual design and diagramming tools for wireframing, product ideation, and communicating concepts eﬀectively with design and engineering partners.
* Experience working with vendor-managed products and roadmaps, including influencing and aligning external partners to internal priorities.
* Experience managing and rationalizing a portfolio of products, with a strong instinct for identifying redundancy, driving consolidation, and simplifying the number of solutions without sacrificing capability or experience quality.
* Keen ability to rally teams and shepherd product development from discovery to launch with an unparalleled focus on customer experience and strategy.
* Highly confident leading teams and driving cross-functional alignment in ambiguous problem spaces.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead with influence and present eﬀectively to senior leadership.
* Experience mentoring product managers and contributing to the growth of the broader product organization.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $137,500 and $207,100, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don't just create products — they create the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries. It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
  
  
Description
  
  
Product Operations group is looking to add a Product Manager to support data systems, automation, and tools that enhance manufacturing of Apple's products. You will be responsible for driving solutions from ideation through to deployment, ensuring readiness of data collection and reporting for Apple's products around the world. This team works to ensure our product manufacturing data collection, analytics, and reporting are ready along with new product requirements during their many lifecycles (prototype through sustaining). This team is made up of creative innovators and problem solvers who tackle unique challenges to ideate, translate those ideas into concepts, and deliver new solutions in the data space. It takes deeply dedicated, intelligent, and hard-working individuals to maintain and exceed the high expectations for the exciting products at Apple. The Product Operations Data Team is looking for an extraordinary Product Manager. You will craft, design, and implement our data strategy across the massive supply chain and help build the future of our manufacturing systems. Do you love using your creative right brain and structured, tactical left brain to drive projects, build systems, and find operations efficiencies? If this sounds like you, come join our team.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Minimum 3+ years of product or program management experience, ideally including internal product management, in a highly technical field.
* BS degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; MBA is considered a plus.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Program/product management background with a proven track record of end-to-end project execution.
* Analytical mindset with familiarity with databases, large data sets, dashboards, and business intelligence tools — with the ability to apply them for planning, problem-solving, and identifying improvements.
* Experience with manufacturing infrastructure concepts, with the ability to define requirements or identify process improvements.
* Proven relationship-building skills and the ability to effectively influence peers and management.
* General operations and factory knowledge; good judgment on what is meaningful to drive impact.
* Tableau/data visualization skills and scripting (Python, SQL).
* Skilled at distilling complex problems into simple explanations under tight timelines, and presenting findings at both working and executive levels.
* Comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities in an unstructured, global, virtual environment.
* Highly desirable (but not required) to have education/experience in high-tech manufacturing, supply chain management, NPI, or manufacturing operations.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $133,500 and $201,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

### **Description and Requirements**

**The Team You Will Join**

Join the nation’s largest non-medical carrier of group insurance, where your work will impact over 55,000 customers and cover more than 50 million employees and family members. As part of MetLife’s Group Benefits team, you’ll deliver innovative benefits solutions - life, disability, dental, vision, and voluntary benefits - tailored to today’s employers and workforces. Collaborate with customers, brokers, and partners to expand our offerings and reimagine digital experiences. Join us and be part of an organization committed to supporting customers when they need us most.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the product vision for AI Automation within the Disability Solution Train, maximizing the business value delivered by the ART’s automation and AI teams. This is a transformational leadership role at the intersection of disability claims operations and agentic AI: you will set the strategic direction for how intelligent agents, large language models, and orchestration platforms eliminate manual work, accelerate claim decisions, and reshape how our operations function.

  
  

You will own the AI product roadmap and serve as the formal people manager for a team of Product Owners — experienced professionals in their own right — across the AI Automation, AI Foundation, Analytics, and RPA teams, with accountability for their performance, coaching, and development. You will partner closely with the Engineering AVP and Engineering Directors, who manage the broader engineering staff on these teams, to ensure product strategy and engineering execution stay aligned. You will also serve as the primary bridge between Claims Operations leadership and the engineering teams building AI-powered automation.

  
  

The ideal candidate has personally experimented with LLMs and agentic frameworks, follows what the major AI labs and the open-source community are shipping, and has formed a grounded point of view on where AI creates genuine operational value versus hype. The Product Manager is supported by a Product Management Associate, who partners closely to translating roadmap priorities into elaborated requirements and delivery-ready features.

  
  

Eligible candidates should be prepared to work Eastern Time Zone hours.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the identification, prioritization, and sequencing of AI automation opportunities across the full claim lifecycle, owning the AI product roadmap and robotics-to-AI transition plan while balancing quick wins with transformational initiatives.
* Design human-in-the-loop workflows that pair AI agents with human judgment on high-stakes claims decisions, defining confidence thresholds, escalation triggers, and error handling to ensure operational trust in AI-driven outcomes.

**Product Manager with InSite Health**
======================================

**Job Title:** Product Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full Time  
**Location:** Hybrid-2 days a week at our office is located in Boston or Philadelphia Area, 3 days remote  
**Pay****:** $120,000-$170,000 a year based on experience and background.

**Benefits Include:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About InSite Health**
-----------------------

InSite Health is on a mission to expand access to high-quality behavioral health care for students and families. Our engineering team builds the technology that powers clinical excellence, operational efficiency, and meaningful outcomes across the schools and communities we serve.

We’re looking for a product manager to help us build the next version of our platform used by schools to refer students for mental health services.

You’ll work closely with our product leadership, UX, engineering, and clinical/operations teams to translate real-world needs into intuitive, scalable user experiences.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Plan and conduct user interviews and synthesize what you learn into product decisions
* Coordinate with UX/design to turn user needs into clear, usable solutions
* Write clear user stories with acceptance criteria, and keep the backlog groomed and prioritized
* Partner daily with developers to shape, scope, and deliver features
* Perform feature QA, validating work against requirements before it ships
* Participate in release management: coordinating release readiness, communicating changes, and following up on how releases land
* Gather feedback from stakeholders and users, and help the team weigh trade-offs against our mission and capacity
* Track and share outcomes so the team can see what’s working

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, or a closely related role (for example, tech lead or customer success manager looking to get into product management)
* Strong written communication, especially clear, testable user stories
* Comfort working directly with engineers in an agile environment
* Curiosity about users and the ability to run effective interviews
* Attention to detail and a methodical approach to QA
* Ability to prioritize and stay organized in a fast-moving, small-team setting

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in EdTech or health tech
* Prior experience in a startup or high-growth environment, ideally building 0-1 software
* Experience with industry standard product tools such as Figma, Jira, Claude, and Amplitude
* Data analytics skills

**What makes you a great fit**
------------------------------

You care about the mission, enjoy the details of shipping software, and want to work in a place where you’ll wear many hats and learn quickly. You’re a good collaborator who gives and receives feedback openly.

Compensation Range: $120K - $170K

* Translate business strategies into engineering requirements, validating requirements with the business, engaging target users, and managing feedback through the backlog.

**Backlog Ownership and Prioritization**

* Own and continuously manage / prioritize the backlog of technology-enabled capability work, with a primary focus on new data ingestion and data enablement for B2C marketing campaigns ensuring clear business outcomes, requirements, acceptance criteria, and measures of success before work enters technology delivery.

**Business and Technology Partnership**

* Establish productive cross-enterprise relationships, maintaining open communication about capability strategy and challenges, coordinating internal resources, facilitating decisions, and setting realistic timelines

* Support development and execution of the capability roadmap, including data-source onboarding, capability enhancements, campaign enablement, technical dependencies, and operational improvements.

* Gather and analyze capability KPIs, provide facts and criteria for decisions, assemble dashboard metrics, explain and quantify potential value, and partner with subject-matter experts when developing business cases.

About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives.   • Strong product sense, with the ability to identify user problems and translate them into simple, intuitive product experiences

  • Experience defining product requirements, user journeys and feature specifications in collaboration with design and engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping products or features with measurable improvements in user adoption, engagement or retention

  • Ability to prioritise product decisions based on user needs, business objectives, available resources and development effort

  • Strong analytical skills, including defining product success metrics, interpreting user behaviour and using data to guide improvements

  • Good understanding of software development processes and ability to communicate product requirements and trade-offs with engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or scaling consumer mobile applications

  • Experience launching new products or features across international markets

  • Technical background or previous software engineering experience

  • Experience with AI-powered consumer products or AI-native user experiences

The Platform Team is currently expanding the shared environments, services, and operational capabilities it develops, operates, and maintains in support of RTI projects and strategic initiatives. These capabilities support a broad range of cloud, application, analytics, and research computing needs, including:

* Research computing and analytics environments
* Kubernetes-based application and platform services
* Secure data enclave and lakehouse architectures
* CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code automation
* Cloud cost modeling, observability, and platform operations
* Integrated tools such as JupyterHub, RStudio/Posit, Airflow, REDCap, Stata, Databricks, and custom web applications

We have an immediate opportunity for a ***Product Owner***to join our growing platform team. The successful candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams including platform engineers, software developers, data engineers, security and infrastructure teams, project leaders, and non-technical stakeholders to support, operate, maintain, and enhance existing platform capabilities as well as contribute to the development of new services that support RTI projects and initiatives.

This position is right for you if you:

* Exhibit passion for technology, enjoy working across several projects and systems at the same time, and are energized by building, understanding, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex cloud and platform environments.
* Want to continually learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and practices in cloud engineering, DevOps, research computing, data platforms, and secure application delivery.
* Have experience designing, building, and operating in a cloud computing environment, including the use of Infrastructure-as-Code and automated deployment patterns.
* Have a strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle using version control, continuous integration/continuous deployment, project tracking tools, automated testing, and operational release practices.
* Are proactive and communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders with varying degrees of technical knowledge.
* Are interested in helping project teams adopt reusable platform patterns that improve delivery speed, compliance readiness, operational consistency, and cost transparency.

What You'll Do:

* Works with project teams, software teams, I.T., business stakeholders, and platform engineers to gather requirements and translate needs into actionable platform work.

Overview:

The Manager of Product Delivery is responsible for leading the execution of the product roadmap, ensuring the timely and successful delivery of high-quality software solutions in a regulated healthcare environment. This role leads and develops a team of Product Owners, oversees backlog management and delivery processes, and partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and other cross-functional teams to drive consistent and predictable results. The Manager establishes delivery standards, removes obstacles, and ensures product requirements align with business priorities, regulatory expectations, and organizational goals.

Responsibilities:

**People leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of 4–10 Product Owners; own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career pathing
* Set consistent standards for backlog quality, acceptance criteria, refinement, and sprint readiness — including the compliance and traceability elements required for regulated delivery
* Balance PO assignment and capacity across scrum teams as priorities shift
* Ensure every PO is trained and current on HIPAA, PHI handling, and internal security and privacy policies

**Delivery execution**

* Ensure every scrum team has a groomed, prioritized, ready backlog that reflects current roadmap commitments
* Drive predictable delivery: sprint and release commitments met, scope and sequencing decisions made deliberately
* Own the handoff from product management — confirm requirements are understood, decomposed, estimable, and assessed for regulatory and privacy impact before work enters a sprint
* Escalate and resolve cross-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts
* Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Scrum Masters on release readiness, validation status, and go/no-go

**Regulatory and compliance accountability**

* Ensure requirements and user stories carry the documentation regulated delivery depends on: clear acceptance criteria, traceability from requirement through test evidence, and rationale for changes
* Embed privacy-by-design and least-necessary-access expectations into backlog definition — particularly for features touching PHI, PII, or payer and prescriber data
* Ensure stories involving PHI specify data minimization, de-identification where feasible, encryption, retention, and audit-logging requirements
* Partner with Compliance, Privacy, Legal, and Security on feature-level risk assessments, and ensure findings become tracked backlog items rather than verbal commitments
* Ensure change control and release documentation are completed as a condition of done, and that emergency or expedited changes still follow a documented path

**Process and practice ownership**

* Define and continuously improve the product delivery operating model — refinement cadence, definition of ready/done, intake, change control — so compliance obligations are satisfied by the normal workflow rather than by exception
* Establish delivery metrics (predictability, cycle time, throughput, escaped defects, commitment accuracy, audit findings, compliance rework) and report on them to leadership
* Drive consistency across teams without imposing uniformity where it doesn't help

**Stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary point of accountability for delivery status, risk, and timeline communication to executives and business stakeholders
* Feed execution reality back into roadmap planning — feasibility, sequencing, capacity, compliance effort, and tradeoffs

**Scope of the role**

* Roadmap definition, market and customer discovery, pricing, and product strategy. Those sit with Product Management; this role is their execution counterpart. This role is also not the compliance or privacy function — it is accountable for delivery conforming to the requirements those functions set.

Qualifications:

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 8+ years in product delivery, product ownership, or agile delivery leadership; 3+ years

jobs.desc:
ServiceNow's legal team runs on ServiceNow. NDAs, procurement contracts, conflict checks, and requests for legal advice all move through our own platform.

You'll own a portfolio of AI and platform initiatives for our legal technology team within the Global Business Services Experience team. The goal: give attorneys and legal professionals their time back. Fewer routine requests land on their desks. The ones that do get answered faster. And legal data is structured so AI agents can do useful work with it.

You won't hand requirements to engineering and move on. You'll prototype with AI, prove what works, and partner with our Product organization to turn the best of what we build into features our customers use. This is where we put AI to work for people, starting with our own.

What you get to do in this role:  

Own the roadmap

  • Own a multi-quarter roadmap for legal AI and platform initiatives across Contract Management Pro, Legal Service Delivery, and connected systems
  • Plan each quarter in epics, then deliver through iterative development, testing, and production release
  • Write epics, user stories, technical spikes, acceptance criteria, and solution approach documents that engineers can build from
  • Prioritize a busy backlog with clear tradeoffs, and say no when it matters
  • Lead discovery with legal and business teams, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and translate them into prioritized product requirements and measurable outcomes

Build AI agents legal teams trust

  • Design and deliver AI agents for legal work, such as advice and counsel recommendations, contract redlining against our standard terms, request intake and triage, and contract review

  • Run model and vendor evaluations without locking into a single model or provider

  • Establish baselines and measure adoption, cycle time, quality, and realized productivity improvements after launch

**Job Description:**
  
We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own requirements and interface design for UDS, the data platform behind the Commit & Overage Program. The role bridges business requirements and engineering. You'll translate business needs into well-defined technical stories, lead payload-level and API contract discussions, and keep engineering aligned on what gets built and why. This is a technical role, not a functional one: you should be comfortable reading schemas, reviewing API specs, and reasoning about data flow across services.
  
**Responsibilities:**
  
Translate business requirements from Finance, Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal stakeholders into technical requirements and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  
Lead payload-level design discussions covering event structures, field definitions, validation rules, and versioning.
  
Own API contracts across UDS services (Ingestion, Processing, Extraction, Reconciliation) and integrations with CI, BRIM, Sales CRM, and CSP, including schema governance and change management.
  
Partner with the engineering team on data model decisions, including partitioning and access patterns in Cosmos DB and event flows in Kafka
  
Define and prioritize the backlog, and manage dependencies with upstream and downstream system owners
  
Validate delivered work against requirements, including reconciliation logic and Snowflake/EDP extract outputs.
  
**Required qualifications:**
  
Hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, QA/SDET, data engineering, or solution architecture, with a strong grasp of how systems communicate
  
Experience writing or reviewing API specifications (REST, GraphQL, or event schemas such as JSON Schema or Avro).
  
Comfort with JSON payloads, data modeling, and reasoning about data consistency and reconciliation.
  
Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria for backend or platform work.
  
Ability to work directly with engineers in technical depth and to challenge assumptions when a requirement has hidden implications.
  
Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups on complex, cross-functional programs.

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
  

We are an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship/ immigration status, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Today, York is one of the most innovative aerospace companies, specializing in end-to-end customer solutions and the rapid production of spacecraft platforms. Working closely with engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and program teams, you will develop and execute product strategies, manage roadmaps, and guide products through their lifecycle. You will be expected to take initiative, work independently, and turn ideas into practical solutions that advance the company’s objectives. This role offers the opportunity to significantly impact the company’s trajectory and product success in the market.
  
The ideal candidate has experience independently leading projects with minimal oversight and navigating the complexities of hardware and software development. We value someone who is eager to learn, can organize and align cross-functional teams, and communicates effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  
This role will be fully on-site in our Greenwood Village, Colorado office.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Champion the product strategy and vision, aligning with overall company objectives and market needs
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define and verify requirements, features, and functionality
* Identify opportunities to standardize products across programs while balancing shared requirements with program-specific needs
* Work closely with supply chain and manufacturing partners to ensure product quality and timely delivery
* Oversee the product lifecycle and roadmap, ensuring timely delivery of features

jobs.title: Product Manager/Product Owner
jobs.desc:
Jay Group, a 3PL providing ecommerce order fulfillment to high-growth start-ups and Fortune 500 companies, is seeking a Product Manager/Product Owner (PM/PO) to lead product for one of our dedicated engineering teams.

This is a hybrid role: you own both the why and the what. You set product direction for your team's area, then translate that direction into a prioritized, ready-to-build backlog. You are the single product voice for your team, from customer discovery through sprint acceptance and release.

Our engineering teams practice AI-driven development: AI coding assistants and agents help write, test and review code, which shortens the path from idea to working software. In this environment, the quality and clarity of product intent is the main constraint on speed. You will write requirements that both engineers and AI tools can act on, use AI to accelerate your own discovery and analysis, and keep a high bar for what we ship to our customers and warehouse operations.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following but not limited to the items listed below.

**Product strategy and discovery**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for your team's area, aligned with company strategy, the department's product priorities, and market needs.
* Interview customers and internal stakeholders (operations, client services, sales) to understand business goals and translate them into software requirements.
* Perform market and competitive research to find opportunities to differentiate Jay Group offerings or close competitive gaps.
* Use AI tools to speed up discovery: synthesizing interview notes, analyzing usage and operational data, and drafting options for evaluation.
* Define success measures for each initiative and track whether delivered features achieve them.

**Backlog ownership and delivery**

* Own and manage the team's product backlog, ensuring items are well-defined, prioritized and ready for development.
* Write clear product backlog items (PBIs) with explicit acceptance criteria, business rules and edge cases, structured so that engineers and AI development tools can execute against them with minimal back-and-forth.
* Prioritize based on business value, customer impact, cost and technical constraints, making tradeoffs between scope, schedule and capacity.
* Lead backlog grooming and refinement sessions, and partner with engineering in sprint planning and execution.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the scrum team, providing direction, clarifications and acceptance decisions.
* Validate that completed work meets acceptance criteria and delivers the intended outcome before it is accepted.

**AI-driven development**

* Partner with engineering to take advantage of AI-accelerated delivery: break work into smaller, faster increments, and use rapid prototypes to validate ideas before full builds.
* Use AI-generated prototypes, specs and test scenarios to shorten feedback loops with customers and stakeholders.
* Apply sound judgment to AI output: review generated artifacts for accuracy, completeness and business fit, and keep a human accountable for every product decision.
* Help the team identify where AI can be built into our products and internal workflows to create value for clients and warehouse operations.

**Release and stakeholder management**

* Plan and manage releases of new products and features in coordination with engineering, operations and client-facing teams.
* Communicate roadmap, progress and tradeoffs to leadership and stakeholders.
* Coordinate with other PM/POs across the department to manage cross-team dependencies and keep priorities aligned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or combined PM/PO role.
* Proven ability to own a product area end to end, from strategy and roadmap through backlog and delivery.
* Strong experience writing detailed PBIs and acceptance criteria, and managing and prioritizing a backlog.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a Product Manager to own Tailscale's networking features — the layer that decides how traffic finds its destination by name on top of Tailscale’s seamless mesh connectivity solution. Concretely, you will own four feature sets: App Connectors, DNS, Funnel, and Tailscale Serve & Services.

A tailnet gives every device an identity and an address. Networking features are what turn addresses into something a person, a script, or an AI agent can actually use — a name, a service, an app, a URL.

  • App Connectors route traffic to specific SaaS and private applications by name, so access follows the app rather than the IP.
  • DNS — MagicDNS, split DNS, custom name servers, search domains
  • Tailscale Serve & Services make a workload — not a machine — the unit of connectivity and access: addressable, load-balanced, and durable across the instances behind it. This is the wedge that lets customers replace a service registry, and eventually much of what they use a service mesh for, with Tailscale.
  • Funnel is Tailscale's ingress story: securely exposing a Service running inside the tailnet to the public internet, from a hobbyist sharing a dev server to production webhooks and public endpoints.

This is the most user-visible role in Tailscale's Dataplane Platform, and the work is as much product design as it is networking. DNS settings, connector topologies, and service definitions are configured by network engineers and IT admins in the admin console, API, and CLI, and the distance between "magical" and "unusable" is the object model, the defaults, and the error messages.

See How Tailscale Works, Tailscale Funnel, and Four ways to Tailscale a service to learn more.

jobs.desc:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a Product Manager to own Tailscale's Workload Connectivity product area — making it effortless for applications, services, and infrastructure to securely connect to the resources they depend on.

Networks are increasingly made up of machines talking to machines. CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes workloads, AI agents, and cloud services all need secure connectivity, often across environments and without human intervention. Tailscale provides the building blocks for these connections. Your job is to turn them into a cohesive product experience and a standalone line of business.

You'll own the product strategy across several key areas:

  • Kubernetes operator: Making Tailscale a natural part of Kubernetes infrastructure, enabling secure connectivity to and from clusters.
  • Ephemeral workloads: Enabling CI/CD runners, containers, and automated jobs to securely connect at scale.
  • Agent connectivity: Enabling AI agents to securely connect to the tools, services, and private infrastructure they need to operate.
  • Cloud and infrastructure integrations: Making Tailscale easy to deploy and operate within the cloud platforms and infrastructure tools developers already use.
  • Workload Connectivity as a business: Defining how machine-to-machine connectivity is packaged, measured, and monetized independently of traditional user-based VPN subscriptions.

You'll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to make Tailscale the obvious choice for workload connectivity, from a developer's first integration to production deployments at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Workload Connectivity, including Kubernetes, ephemeral workloads, agent connectivity, and cloud integrations.
  • Define the end-to-end developer experience for connecting workloads, from authentication and deployment through monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Drive the Kubernetes operator roadmap and establish reference architectures and integrations for common cloud-native connectivity patterns.
  • Partner with product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams to develop workload connectivity pricing and packaging, driving adoption and revenue growth.
  • Define and own success metrics for workload adoption, activation, retention, and revenue, using data to guide product investments.

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands, including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation, and Merchandise lines of business, as well as other initiatives, including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

  

This role sits in the Revenue Management & Commerce Shared Services organization within Technology for Disney Experiences. It works closely with various disciplines from across the company, including but not limited to Commercial Strategy, Operations, Data Science, Legal, and other partnering Technology groups.

  

The Product Manager will report to the Manager, Product Management-WDW Admissions Product.

* This team owns the product experience and strategy for Walt Disney World Resort Theme Park Admissions product across web and mobile app platforms including Tickets, Annual Passes, Special Event Tickets, and Theme Park Reservations.

jobs.title: Product Manager -Connected Car
jobs.desc:
We appreciate your interest in this role. We value internal growth and will take careful consideration in reviewing your application.

Generally, internal applicants must be in their job for at least 12 months before applying to a new role and must be in good standing with the Company. Please notify your current management before you apply as they will receive a system notification of your internal application. The recruiting team will notify you about next steps, thank you and good luck!

**General Summary**
-------------------

Kia Connected Car and Mobility Team is looking for a Connected Car Product Manager responsible for achieving the monetization targets for connected car products and services. The Product Manager will support the development of product strategies, evaluate and develop new partner collaboration, define product pricing, drive customer research for product feedback and customer satisfaction assessment, conduct competition benchmarking, and identify opportunities for building and improving new and existing connected car products and services.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Priority One – 25%**

* Prepare the annual business plan and track progress against the plan throughout the year, coordinating updates and identifying any gaps or actions needed to support achievement of business objectives.
* Support new services ideation, customer research, discussion with HQ, vendors, competition benchmarking, and other sources. Translate customer problems into new connected car products, features, and services.
* Support product and market fitment assessment and develop innovative proposals including business case, implementation cost, and time estimate.
* Successfully seeking approvals from management to translate the proposal into a project

**Priority Two – 20%**

* Manage feature launches from concept to launch and post-launch support.
* Develop the product concept and write business requirements for the engineering team. Identify and prioritize product features that will deliver the most value to customers.
* Collaborate with engineering, build and iterate new capabilities to deliver quality products and experiences.
* Serve as the key point of contact for developers, and user acceptance testing (UAT) resources to ensure proper implementation of requirements.
* Work closely with cross-functional partners including Marketing, Sales & Service Operations, Customer Care, and Legal. Present the business goals, build consensus and gain support on the product, sales strategy, legal compliance, and post launch customer support.

**Priority Three – 25%**

* Actively work towards exceeding the conversion targets for the connected services business streams.
* Proactively analyze data, identify opportunities, develop promotional programs, and run campaigns to meet the business goals for different streams of products and services.
* Leverage consumer and market insights to tap into new opportunities and deepen existing markets.
* Using analytics and customer segmentation – develop and measure marketing funnels to enhance engagement, click-through, and conversion.
* Monitor and report on KPIs and the effectiveness of marketing initiatives to the management team and use data to create future marketing strategies.

**Priority Four – 15%**

* Periodically collect product and service usage data from several different sources.
* Translate data into relevant and useful stories depending on the roles of the target team and support them to improve or build new products and services.
* Develop and manage simple business intelligence solutions or self-service tools for the data needs of the Connected Car team.

**Priority Five – 15%**

* Proactively identify areas for market and customer research and coordinate with the research team to gather data and insight about target personas, user experience, product needs, customer pain points, loyalty, and the purchasing decision process

**Product Manager**
===================

**Location:** Remote, US-based, with preference for candidates in the Greater NYC area. Limited travel expectations for company meetings and offsite conferences.

**Employment type:** Full-time, exempt

**Reports to:** VP of Product

**Compensation Package:** $90,000 to $115,000 base salary, plus annual performance-based bonus.

Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, company-paid WellHub access featuring free gym passes and wellness apps.

AllWork is looking for a **Product Manager** to help build and scale the technology behind our flexible workforce solutions.

This role offers a unique opportunity to learn our platform from the inside out before taking ownership of key product areas. You will begin by becoming deeply embedded in our product release cycle, helping ensure that new functionality is tested, understood, and effectively communicated across Engineering, Sales, Operations, and our customers.

As your platform and business knowledge grows, you will transition into direct **roadmap, feature, and delivery ownership** across product areas such as Healthcare Solutions, Self Directed Care, AI & Data, and other emerging initiatives.

This role is a strong fit for an early-to-mid-career product professional who enjoys being close to both the technology and the business and wants the opportunity to take on increasing ownership within a growing, technology-driven Employer of Record (EOR) services company powered by a B2B SaaS platform.

### **What You Will Do**

#### **Phase 1: Build Product and Platform Expertise | Approximately First 3 to 6 Months**

Your initial focus will be learning the AllWork platform while taking ownership of critical release and product communication workflows.

* Own acceptance testing for product releases, including developing test plans from release tickets, coordinating cross-functional testing, and assessing release readiness.
* Develop clear internal and customer-facing release notes explaining what changed, why it matters, and how users are impacted.
* Create internal product release videos and demonstrations that help teams understand new functionality and its business value.
* Communicate roadmap progress and upcoming releases so Sales, Operations, and leadership understand what is coming and when.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to understand product decisions, customer needs, technical considerations, and broader platform strategy.
* Build deep knowledge of AllWork workflows, customers, product architecture, and the contingent/flexible workforce environment.

#### **Phase 2: Own Products and Roadmaps**

As your platform expertise grows, you will take direct ownership of defined products, features, and engineering workstreams.

* Own and evolve product roadmaps for one or more product areas with cross-platform impact.
* Translate customer feedback, business needs, data, and operational insights into product requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead features through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritization through development, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Partner with Engineering on sprint planning, prioritization, technical tradeoffs, and delivery.
* Represent your product areas in cross-functional planning, customer conversations, product demonstrations, and stakeholder updates.
* Define success metrics and use product and operational data to evaluate feature adoption, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and long-term product strategy when making roadmap decisions.

**Description:**
================

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

**Position Summary:**
=====================

We're seeking a Technical Product Owner to lead the Enterprise Systems portfolio for Finance, covering FP&A, Accounting, Billing and Finance Systems. You will own the Finance technology roadmap across ERP, billing, planning and data platforms, including our enterprise data lake. You will be the single point where Finance's requests become ranked, funded and delivered work. You will work through an AI-assisted intake agent built on Claude, Slack, Jira and Confluence, connected to Finance's own intake tracker, and you will help improve it.  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the Finance intake funnel.** Bring every Finance request, including those raised through Finance's own intake tracker, into one structured process: capture, duplicate checks, a vetting checklist and a disposition

* **Run the Finance Technology Portfolio OpCo.** Prepare the themed roadmap, the open-intake rollup and capacity views. Lead the conversations to capture key decisions, navigate risks, and drive recommendations

* **Lead prioritization with Finance leaders.** Facilitate live ranking sessions with FP&A and Finance leadership, record Business Priority and stacked rank, and drive through potential blockers and unknowns.

* **Shape the systems roadmap.** Frame the major platform decisions (billing direction, ERP consolidation, system decommissions) as options with trade-offs, so Finance and Technology leadership can decide.

* **Facilitate business requirements, build technical requirements.** Produce fill-in requirements documents for Finance stakeholders covering business rules, process, inputs, measurement and gating decisions. Make sure each answer maps to something the delivery team will build.

* **Protect data integrity.** Define requirements for the data flows between CRM, billing, ERP, planning tools and data lake: revenue and order classification, reconciliations and month-end close dependencies.

* **Keep records honest.** Sweep in-flight Finance records weekly against meetings, threads and related tickets, so status matches what was last agreed.

* **Partner with delivery teams.** Hand vetted work to Solution Architects, Development Managers and owning ES teams. You own the "what" and "why"; they own the design and build.

* **Accept what ships.** Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered features against Finance's controls and audit needs.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience

* 3–5 years as a Technical Product Owner, Product Manager or Finance Systems analyst

* 3+ years working with ERP or financial systems in a SaaS or subscription business

* Working knowledge of FP&A, revenue, billing and month-end close processes

* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (for example Claude or ChatGPT) in daily product work

Strong communication skills that let you speak to FP&A and other Finance leaders in their language  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with subscription billing, usage-based pricing or revenue recognition

* Experience with planning tools such as Anaplan, and with ERP migrations or decommissions

* Experience with Salesforce (CRM) to ERP integrations

* Working SQL skills and familiarity with Snowflake

SAFe, CSPO, SAFe POPM, or PMI-ACP certification

This role is hybrid out of our Minneapolis office and also open to 100% remote candidates across the U.S. and Canada.

This role translates sales processes, customer experience requirements, and business priorities into scalable applications and integrated workflows that drive productivity and measurable business outcomes. It serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and IT, with accountability for product direction, delivery, and adoption. Areas of responsibilities include Business Application Ownership, Process Translation & Workflow Design, Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements, Delivery & Technical Collaboration, and Adoption & Value Realization. This role does not define sales strategy, sales processes, or customer experience, but partners closely with those who do to ensure effective execution through tools and systems.

* Own and continuously improve core sales and customer systems (e.g., CRM, e-commerce) and the associated workflows that support how the business sells and serves customers
* Define and manage the application vision, roadmap, and priorities, including maintaining a clear and prioritized backlog of work
* Translate sales processes, customer experience requirements, and business needs into scalable system workflows and integrated solutions

* Drive adoption of systems and workflows in partnership with Sales Enablement and business leaders, ensuring usability and minimizing user friction
* Monitor adoption, performance, and business impact, and continuously refine systems, workflows, and priorities based on insights and feedback Key Interfaces

* 5+ years in business application product management, sales operations, or business applications

* Demonstrated success translating business needs into technical solutions
* Strong product management discipline (roadmap, backlog, delivery)

jobs.title: Product Manager, Post-Order UX & AI Automation
jobs.desc:
About Us:

Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.
With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Gametime's Post-Order UX & AI Automation team owns everything that happens after a fan completes a purchase — setting the right expectations, delivering tickets reliably, communicating proactively when things change, and building the tools our Fan Operations team uses to support customers efficiently. This PM will own the roadmap for reducing contact rate and cost to serve while raising fan satisfaction, using AI to power both a better self-service experience for fans and better tooling for the internal team who supports them.

This role is open to various levels/ titles — Senior Product Manager, Staff Product Manager, or Principal Product Manager — we're hiring for the right person and scope, not a fixed level.

What You'll Own

  • Post-order communications: design and streamline the messaging fans receive after purchase — order confirmations, delivery updates, event-change notifications — to set clear expectations and reduce uncertainty
  • Ticket delivery experience: improve the reliability and clarity of ticket delivery to reduce delivery-related complaints and negative reviews
  • AI-powered self-service: build fan-facing AI tools (e.g., conversational support, automated resolution flows) that reduce human contact rate for common post-order issues
  • Agent-assist and internal tooling: build AI-powered tools for our Fan Operations team (e.g., agent-assist, prioritization and routing, automated triage, knowledge retrieval) that reduce handle time and improve resolution quality
  • CSAT: drive improvements in fan satisfaction across the post-order journey
  • Cost to serve: lower the cost of supporting each transaction as volume grows, balancing automation with service quality
  • A roadmap tied directly to contact rate, CSAT, delivery-related complaints, and cost to serve

What We're Looking For

Common bar:

  • A track record of shipping product changes that moved measurable business outcomes
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you'll work closely with Fan Operations leadership, Engineering, Data, Trust & Safety, and Supply
  • Comfort operating at whatever level you're hired into, from hands-on execution to setting multi-quarter strategy

Domain-specific:

  • Experience owning post-purchase experience in a marketplace environment, customer service/support operations, or contact center technology
  • Experience shipping AI or LLM-powered product features, ideally in a support or self-service context
  • Familiarity with support metrics (contact rate, handle time, CSAT, cost to serve) and how product changes move them
  • A data-driven approach — comfort working with SQL/analytics to diagnose where fans get stuck post-purchase

As a Technical Product Manager working with the Integration Engineering team, you will analyze and define system requirements to support the software products in the clinical genetics domain area.
